88e05db4b26f8e58eca99dbae7cf8ef26f22d0a5.summary: New `sponsor-break-events.ts` defines `ads.break_shown`, `ads.break_closed`, and `ads.break_clicked` with a closed `method` vocabulary (`x`, `continue`, `escape`) to distinguish considered exits from reflex dismissals. `freebuff-placements.ts` introduces `PLACEMENT_FORMATS` (`inline`, `showcase`, `spotlight`, `intermission`) and updates `PLACEMENT_SLOTS` to carry a `format` field, separating rendering behavior from surface assignment. `ad-experiment.ts` adds sticky `SPONSOR_BREAK_ARMS` (`control`, `reduced`, `reduced_spotlight`, `reduced_intermission`) and `SHOWCASE_ARMS` with independent salts. `axiom-only-log.ts` registers these events and extends `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` with `sponsor_break_arm`, `showcase_arm`, `sponsor_break_cap_status`, and `no_fill_reason`.

4ac0d8ab8584d5ada8c2f0bda35ab6b7c974e02f.title: GLM 5.3 Flash gains limited access and Freebucks support
4ac0d8ab8584d5ada8c2f0bda35ab6b7c974e02f.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash joins LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS, expanding limited-access availability beyond DeepSeek, MiMo, and Solar. The CLI adopts getFreebuffModelMeter and getFreebucksInfo for consistent quota display and session state merging across active sessions and landing transitions. Freebucks balance and pricing data now persist in compact API polls and session snapshots to prevent UI flicker. Legacy earned-quota fallbacks remain for older CLI snapshots, while new currency-priced rows display balance instead of session pools.

d573b4d0977a99b5bea28768a03e3731c51343f5.title: Supabase format experiment primitive added
d573b4d0977a99b5bea28768a03e3731c51343f5.summary: New file `common/src/ads/supabase-format-experiment.ts` defines the measurement primitive for the Supabase acquisition format experiment. It aggregates pre-normalized event data to compute intention-to-treat metrics without performing database reads or inferring missing callbacks. The logic enforces strict eligibility gates, assigning users to 'display' or 'agentic' arms via FNV-1a hashing, and validates partner outcome coverage before reporting measurement readiness.

d4ee9ca285c94e9348a7da806a9d2b7ecc69807b.title: Sponsor dock detail panel
d4ee9ca285c94e9348a7da806a9d2b7ecc69807b.summary: Adds expandable detail panel to CLI sponsor dock (COD-457) via `use-dock-panel.ts` and `DockAdCard`. Panel toggles with `⌃O` chord, auto-collapses on send or takeover screens. Layout logic in `inline-ad-layout.ts` gates expansion by terminal height to prevent invisible states. Click telemetry merges dock metadata into single `ads.clicked` event.

09fa12bf061ab808dd43735fc2de7beb5288e441.title: turnspendlimit 429 stops SDK retries, shows server copy
09fa12bf061ab808dd43735fc2de7beb5288e441.summary: SDK model-provider now throws non-retryable APICallError on 429 with error code turn_spend_limit. AI SDK previously retried 4x over ~14s, misframing the error as a generic rate limit. CLI error-handling and common constants updated to surface the breaker's specific message instead of a retry countdown. Covers SDK, CLI, and shared error definitions.

8fafc97b35aa47a8dcea952690e2a8bf115f2da8.title: Muse Spark fallback delay increased to 15s
8fafc97b35aa47a8dcea952690e2a8bf115f2da8.summary: MUSE_SPARK_FALLBACK_AFTER_MS raised from 10_000 to 15_000 in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. The increase compensates for the new key pool logic in web/src/llm-api/meta-key-pool.ts, where rate-limited requests now iterate through independent per-team buckets before waiting. This extends the patience window for cases where all keys are exhausted, preventing premature model fallback while leveraging faster resolution via pool rotation.

e2b7fe5a4ebe36206150cc194cc297fc0c8bd251.title: Gravity user agent resolution uses real client header
e2b7fe5a4ebe36206150cc194cc297fc0c8bd251.summary: Added `resolveGravityUserAgent` to serve the real client user agent to Gravity instead of forcing browser-like UAs. Gravity requested the actual client (e.g. `Codebuff-CLI/<v>`) on 2026-09-04 because ~74% of traffic was misreported as Chrome desktop. The function prefers the trimmed `requestHeader`, falling back to the browser-like UA if missing or blank. Scope: `common/src/util/ad-user-agent.ts`.

23c15cfd4656c6eb305dfe9e4bbab938ebadbed8.title: ads.advertiserreportingread event added
23c15cfd4656c6eb305dfe9e4bbab938ebadbed8.summary: New `ads.advertiser_reporting_read` event added to `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. Includes fields `advertiser_id`, `key_id`, `endpoint`, `range_days`, `rows`, `duration_ms`, `outcome`. Sanitized via `sanitizeAllowlistedFields`.

df4b9aa599930aa2b2b9b2bd283089261c4d445d.title: Client-side Imprezia tracker delivery and channel logging
df4b9aa599930aa2b2b9b2bd283089261c4d445d.summary: Added `imprezia-trackers.ts` to deliver third-party measurement pixels and frames from the end user's device. Server-side firing was rejected due to invalid traffic discounts from datacenter IPs. Scope covers Web and Desktop renderers via `common/src/util`, explicitly excluding CLI. Includes `trackerChannels` logging in `imprezia-client.ts` to distinguish missing partner trackers from dropped ones, plus 3s frame cleanup.

f3857f1b81fa3b21e59eba6564a47a8edb64c5f3.title: Add advertiser reason redaction and CPC band constants
f3857f1b81fa3b21e59eba6564a47a8edb64c5f3.summary: New `advertiser-reason-redaction.ts` maps operator eligibility codes to safe advertiser-visible strings, hiding holdout and internal allocation states. `freebuff-topups.ts` adds `advertiserPlacementCpcBand` with a 1000-cent self-serve ceiling. `axiom-only-log.ts` introduces `ADS_CAMPAIGN_INGRESS_EVIDENCE_EVENT` and validates `request_id`/`opportunity_id` regexes in Imprezia logs.

2476a76f4dd8eb14dba89d848e676146c839a7e5.title: Add metric field to ADSFIRSTPARTYSETTLEMENTFIELDS
2476a76f4dd8eb14dba89d848e676146c839a7e5.summary: Added `metric` string field to `ADS_FIRST_PARTY_SETTLEMENT_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. This enables the logging system to capture specific metric identifiers alongside settlement data. Scope limited to shared core logging utilities.

7b211367021e612630a9c1040fea39abdc157e45.title: Plan mode toolset enforcement
7b211367021e612630a9c1040fea39abdc157e45.summary: Plan mode now enforces restrictions via the toolset, not just prompt prose. `str_replace`, `write_file`, `basher`, `tmux-cli`, and editor agents are withheld when `planOnly` is true. This prevents accidental file edits and commits during planning turns. The worked example in the prompt also branches to show plan-only behavior.

3de218cfbec42f26a76cf460205d0a5727735c10.title: Sponsored proposal poller distinguishes absence from unavailable
3de218cfbec42f26a76cf460205d0a5727735c10.summary: The CLI sponsored proposal poller now treats HTTP failures and malformed bodies as 'unavailable', preserving the card context but disabling controls, rather than removing the offer. Only a successful `{ proposal: null }` response triggers card removal. This change affects `cli/src/hooks/use-sponsored-proposal.ts` and `cli/src/types/chat.ts`, adding a `refreshUnavailable` flag to `SponsoredProposalContentBlock` to gate interactions in `cli/src/components/blocks/sponsored-proposal-block.tsx` and `cli/src/commands/ads.ts`.

6e53c6db1674d4f343f2392092a6f316fa9644fb.title: Add getFreebuffServerAccessTier helper
6e53c6db1674d4f343f2392092a6f316fa9644fb.summary: Added `getFreebuffServerAccessTier` to `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` to extract the server-decided access tier from session payloads. This helper distinguishes the authoritative server tier from client-resolved tiers, preventing UI inconsistencies where menu labels disagree with computed allowances. Scope limited to Shared/Core types; callers use this to fall back safely when the field is absent.

0f33961336a021a0fe9943aa72144fec1183c3ab.title: Add dismissed, runfailed, runcommitted to funnel events
0f33961336a021a0fe9943aa72144fec1183c3ab.summary: Added three new event types to `AGENTIC_FUNNEL_EVENT_TYPES` in `common/src/constants/agentic-ad-events.ts`: `dismissed` for user-declined proposals, `run_failed` for non-committable sponsored runs, and `run_committed` for successful branch commits. This change is append-only to align with the Postgres `ad_agentic_funnel_event_type` enum, which only supports cheap `ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE` migrations. `dismissed` completes the `proposal_offered` pair to measure drop-off, while `run_committed` reflects the COD-279 billing model where work is paid upon commit, not PR. `run_failed` is strictly telemetry and does not trigger refunds, as money movement is handled by Accept and COD-92.

2a92b62f5263e702f76e3a7c3b9f89b29a046710.title: v0.0.168
2a92b62f5263e702f76e3a7c3b9f89b29a046710.summary: CLI release package bumped to version 0.0.168. Change isolated to freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No feature or logic modifications.

8870810f21a3f99ee8e7f349bd10e1dce92488d2.title: Widen limited-region Web model catalog excluding Luna
8870810f21a3f99ee8e7f349bd10e1dce92488d2.summary: FREEBUFF_WEB_GEO_EXEMPT_MODEL_IDS widened from LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS to full Web free catalog minus GPT-5.6 Luna. Allows cheap GLM 5.3 Flash in limited regions; Freebucks meter caps spend, not catalog. Web-only change; CLI/Desktop pickers remain narrow. Luna stays plan-gated, visible as locked row.

7bdce0946bbc83e804efd99fca98fa2d99b90e19.title: Solar Pro 4 limited access and Desktop concurrency slot logic
7bdce0946bbc83e804efd99fca98fa2d99b90e19.summary: Solar Pro 4 added to limited-access catalog and marked unmetered at full access via `FREEBUFF_SOLAR_PRO_4_ENTITLEMENT`. New `freebuff-desktop-sessions.ts` enforces `slot-bound` concurrency for GPT-5.6 Luna and Gemini 3.8 Flash to prevent ambiguous usage pairing during parallel admits. Idle slots reclaim after 10 minutes (`FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_IDLE_RELEASE_MS`).

bb9e8822ea946d45870d09ff2ad8db35f872bbda.title: Clarify Freebucks wallet expiry logic in types
bb9e8822ea946d45870d09ff2ad8db35f872bbda.summary: Updated docblock for FreebuffFreebucksWindow in common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts to clarify that the wallet mixes permanent earned Freebucks with expiring monthly bonuses, though displayed as a single number. Spending logic prioritizes the expiring half first to ensure users consume time-limited allowances before permanent balances. This change documents the behavior of FREEBUCKS_BONUS_EXPIRY_REASON and the attribution order for wallet consumption.

13c3ba7d0b36a754116bac24f76957a3eebb9f64.title: axiom-only-log: requestid field for ads fetch
13c3ba7d0b36a754116bac24f76957a3eebb9f64.summary: Added `request_id` field to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. This introduces a request-grain correlation handle (`adr_`) for HTTP ad requests, distinct from the existing auction-grain `opportunity_id` (`opp_`). The change aligns logging with COD-406, ensuring `request_id` keys the decision outbox batch and covers both provider waterfall and first-party rails.

f25d4059b88ff4bdca2e120522d0970fb8d2d103.title: CLI landing screen adds pacificmonth period and monthly allowance type
f25d4059b88ff4bdca2e120522d0970fb8d2d103.summary: Landing screen handles `pacific_month` period, rendering 'this month' alongside existing day/week labels. Core types define `FreebuffFreebucksMonthlyAllowance` with `limitUsd`, `spentUsd`, `remainingUsd`, and `resetAt`, added as optional `monthly` field to `FreebuffFreebucksInfo`. Monthly allowance shown to users, absent on legacy servers to prevent zero-value misinterpretation. `spentUsd` lags up to one hour, sourced from hourly rollup to avoid saturation issues seen 2026-08-17.

10144f7ad1bd85fa528642276370444f1862214b.title: New dev-guest-auth.ts exports DEVGUESTPROVIDER
10144f7ad1bd85fa528642276370444f1862214b.summary: Added `common/src/constants/dev-guest-auth.ts` exporting `DEV_GUEST_PROVIDER = 'dev-guest'`. This constant lives in `common` to prevent NextAuth server-side dependencies (`db`, `stripe`, `node:net`) from leaking into the browser bundle via the auth barrel, which previously caused build errors. The change scopes the shared provider name for the local-development guest login, ensuring the button and provider align without importing the full auth package.

3160888e27f2fb25238fef56ff8e67b9d8d1f5ea.title: Update sponsored proposal fixture logo token handling
3160888e27f2fb25238fef56ff8e67b9d8d1f5ea.summary: Modified `sponsored-proposal-rows.ts` to set `advertiser_logo_token` on the base fixture and explicitly clear it for the 'failed' state. This ensures the shared rows exercise the logo header path by default while preserving coverage for the no-logo state. The change clarifies that the token is shape-valid but not resolvable, requiring specific test handling for surfaces that fetch or assert URLs.

7c5cc043fcad67cd82f362c61bc4c82cae553a78.title: Proportional intro discounts for Plus and Pro tiers
7c5cc043fcad67cd82f362c61bc4c82cae553a78.summary: Introductory pricing shifted from a flat $3 discount to proportional amounts ($3/$6/$15) in `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts`. This ensures the discount scales with tier value, preventing high-tier users from seeing negligible relative savings. The `introPriceUsd` fields are display-only; actual charges rely on matching Stripe coupon IDs in `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_INTRO_COUPON_IDS`. Mismatched constants and coupon IDs will advertise incorrect prices, as no code reconciles the two.

6470ff421860de64df4196f6891f11470625bce0.title: Ad event hygiene: client-minted IDs and render delay metrics
6470ff421860de64df4196f6891f11470625bce0.summary: New `ad-event-hygiene.ts` module introduces shared constants and validation for client-minted event IDs (`X-Freebuff-Event-Id`) and client-measured render delays (`X-Freebuff-Render-Delay-Ms`). `use-gravity-ad.ts` now stamps `receivedAtMs` on ad responses and calculates `renderDelayMs` at card mount, passing these via headers to first-party acks. `first-party-view-ack.ts` mints one UUID per logical event (reused on retries) and `axiom-only-log.ts` updates telemetry schemas to accept optional `client_event_id` and `sample_rate` fields while enforcing backward compatibility for older clients.

219a700815b8cd4d3e19ae9761b2127a53a669e0.title: Add shared HMAC, Redis script caching, and Axiom completeness guards
219a700815b8cd4d3e19ae9761b2127a53a669e0.summary: New `common/src/util` modules centralize security and data integrity primitives: `hmac.ts` provides a single HMAC-SHA256 construction with hex/base64url encoders and constant-time comparison; `redis-cached-script.ts` implements EVALSHA with automatic EVAL fallback for rate limiter Lua scripts; `axiom-complete-response.ts` enforces strict completeness checks on Axiom query results. These changes consolidate previously duplicated logic across internal modules and ensure partial Axiom responses are never persisted. A new `chat_assistant_sr` house ad surface variant is also added to `freebuff-house-ad.ts` for server-rendered ad experiments.

6222be5e6b2164b7dae9ff261d06be5fc88c2b47.title: Remove cost disclosure from sponsored proposal block
6222be5e6b2164b7dae9ff261d06be5fc88c2b47.summary: SponsoredProposalBlock text now reads 'It runs here, in its own worktree.' The explicit mention of session and credit usage is removed. Local runs still consume user credits because advertiser-pays metering (COD-119) lacks a server-side reader. The component avoids 'free' claims until server-side metering is implemented.

a852b83bdfb6dbc2fdc996eb33eecc2e1fbb2489.title: Decision-outbox sampling fields added to ads.fetchcompleted
a852b83bdfb6dbc2fdc996eb33eecc2e1fbb2489.summary: Adds `inclusion_probability_ppm`, `inclusion_reason`, and `user_key_version` to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. `decision_outbox_sample_rate_ppm` becomes a deprecated alias of `inclusion_probability_ppm`, pinned equal for one release so dashboards and exporters keep resolving. The two samplers are distinct: `sample_rate` divides event-stream counts, while `inclusion_probability_ppm` governs whether the durable outbox row was written. `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELD_NAMES` is exported to pin the Axiom-side vocabulary for the COD-367 decision-contract test.

ebb4deb34adc86dfaa1b4584d98edaf6db889f3d.title: run() aborts promptly during pre-request user lookup and agent-run
ebb4deb34adc86dfaa1b4584d98edaf6db889f3d.summary: The SDK's `run()` function now propagates the `signal` parameter to `getUserInfoFromApiKey` and `StartAgentRunFn`. Previously, these initial requests lacked abort signal support, causing `fetchWithRetry` to consume the entire backoff budget even after a user cancel, because the underlying socket remained open. This change ensures that aborts during the pre-model-request phase immediately terminate the retry loop and resolve the run as cancelled.

9b16ec41446c36cc56ac43f225aa3b720d29d848.title: Remove account deletion proof util
9b16ec41446c36cc56ac43f225aa3b720d29d848.summary: Deleted `common/src/util/account-deletion-proof.ts`, removing HMAC-SHA256 proof generation and constant-time verification for Convex account purges. This logic previously bound server proofs to authenticated subjects and mailed codes to prevent premature data deletion. Scope limited to shared core utilities. The removal eliminates the `v1` proof format and associated `crypto.subtle` dependencies.

892f79590b0dbbf4753d4f66051c8b3d8af7a3ce.title: Add ads.requestrejected axiom-only log event
892f79590b0dbbf4753d4f66051c8b3d8af7a3ce.summary: Added `ADS_REQUEST_REJECTED_EVENT` ('ads.request_rejected') to `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. This tracks ad route refusals (rate limits, capability failures) as a privacy-preserving census, omitting bearer secrets, tokens, IPs, and campaign IDs. Fields include `route`, `rail`, `reason` (closed enum from `ad-route-rate-limit.ts`), `limiter_backend`, and `would_limit` (boolean for observe-phase verdicts). Registered in the `AxiomOnlyLogEvent` union and `getAxiomOnlyLogEvent` sanitizer.

18eee2a9d4ab53dcf63a34e2a5b113f86b86f469.title: Remove spentUsd from FreebuffFreebucksSpendCeiling
18eee2a9d4ab53dcf63a34e2a5b113f86b86f469.summary: Deleted the optional `spentUsd` field from the `FreebuffFreebucksSpendCeiling` interface in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. The daily dollar limit is an abuse backstop, not a user-facing metric; rendering it alongside the Freebucks meter caused confusion about which limit was binding. Removing the field eliminates a redundant spend aggregate on every session response. The `limitUsd` and `resetAt` fields remain on the wire for operator surfaces and refusal messages.

7faa16471f65d093f3535980864182ff79dac50a.title: Sponsored consent one-sentence dialog
7faa16471f65d093f3535980864182ff79dac50a.summary: Sponsored consent collapsed to one sentence plus advertiser name. Field-list dialog replaced. `common/src/ads/sponsored-consent.ts` defines `SPONSORED_CONSENT_SENTENCE`, `SPONSORED_CONSENT_NO_NAME`, and `sponsoredConsentName` with 80-char clamp and control/bidi escape. `cli/src/components/blocks/sponsored-proposal-block.tsx` renders the new block; caret locked when name missing. Desktop bridge mirrors constants; test pins equality.

8221e333895c0933b2ab58d669ac40272c339eb8.title: Add freebucksplan ceiling and split session types
8221e333895c0933b2ab58d669ac40272c339eb8.summary: Added `freebucks_plan` to spend ceiling reasons and `FREEBUFF_FREEBUCKS_CEILING_NOTICE` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts`. The new reason is excluded from `FREEBUFF_BUDGET_NOTICE_REASONS` to prevent plan spend-ceiling bypasses, and included in `HARD_CAPPED_REASONS` to enforce the catalog's daily limits. `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` splits `FreebuffFreebucksWindow` into `FreebuffFreebucksWindow`, `FreebuffFreebucksWallet`, and `FreebuffFreebucksSpendCeiling`. This replaces the previous unified allowance model with distinct daily pools, non-expiring wallet balances, and settled USD spend ceilings.

c6a7eae9e05dad4f07be5d34298dcecf93ed08bd.title: Add observational fields to ads.fetchcompleted
c6a7eae9e05dad4f07be5d34298dcecf93ed08bd.summary: Added `opportunity_id`, `first_party_arm_bucket`, and eligibility census fields to the `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` schema in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. Introduced `FIRST_PARTY_ARM_SALT` and `firstPartyArmKey` in `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts` to generate stable per-user buckets for COD-369. These changes are strictly observational; routing logic remains on per-request UUIDs until COD-362 flips delivery. The new `opportunity_id` serves as the correlation handle for first-party fills, while `first_party_arm_bucket` sizes future incrementality contrasts without affecting current inventory allocation.

6b1963707ad3659f9d2308535dff59f317cd8174.title: suppressCommitAttribution flag for sponsored commits
6b1963707ad3659f9d2308535dff59f317cd8174.summary: Added suppressCommitAttribution flag to AgentDefinition and DynamicAgentTemplate to remove agent-attribution trailers from git commit guidance. The run_terminal_command tool description now branches on this flag via buildGitCommitGuidePrompt, serving a variant without Co-Authored-By or Generated with Codebuff lines for sponsored proposals. Covers common/src/tools/params/tool/run-terminal-command.ts, agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts, and sdk/src/tools/sponsored-sandbox.ts. Default false keeps normal user runs byte-identical to prior behavior.

7b65652ad9decd202054622a7fbe267cc7c11201.title: Add requestgeotier and decisionoutboxstatus fields
7b65652ad9decd202054622a7fbe267cc7c11201.summary: Added `request_geo_tier` and `decision_outbox_status`/`decision_outbox_sample_rate_ppm` to `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. `request_geo_tier` resolves viewer tier on every request independent of geo routing flags, preserving distinction between inventory facts and configuration states. `decision_outbox_status` tracks producer actions (`scheduled`, `saturated`, etc.) on both rails to distinguish missing rows from disabled knobs. Scope limited to shared core logging schema.

7f41c17658f1631e318a9aa7b0e4d9bd26ad58da.title: Add no-consent-bridge reason and refuse tilde paths in sponsored
7f41c17658f1631e318a9aa7b0e4d9bd26ad58da.summary: Sponsored local execution gains `no-consent-bridge` to distinguish missing desktop consent UI from unsupported OS containment, with copy directing users to open the app. `containSponsoredPath` now rejects leading tilde paths via `TILDE_PATH` regex instead of resolving them inside the worktree, preventing ambiguous boundary semantics for reads, writes, and cwd. The SDK sandbox grants explicit write access to required device nodes like `/dev/null` after ablation confirmed standard toolchains fail without them. Changes span `common/src/ads/sponsored-local-execution.ts` and `sdk/src/tools/sponsored-sandbox.ts`.

f27429b2728f0614353df3194a77b493d0444e18.title: Reinstate Desktop E-layer waivers in conformance
f27429b2728f0614353df3194a77b493d0444e18.summary: Reinstated waivers for Desktop conformance rows E-3 through E-7 in `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-conformance.ts`. The previous removal was incorrect because the E layer requires real backend execution and user action, whereas current tests rely on fake runners. This change enforces that E-layer rows are only cleared via manual runs in the Agentic Ads testing runbook, preventing false positives from fixture-based tests.

60123cbaaa09113e6f314b9c877df53e41165095.title: Add agenticAcceptEventId helper for funnel idempotency
60123cbaaa09113e6f314b9c877df53e41165095.summary: New `agenticAcceptEventId` function in `common/src/constants/agentic-ad-events.ts` derives the `accepted` event's idempotency key from the proposal ID. This ensures funnel deduplication on `(campaignId, eventId)` works correctly across retried settlements and redelivered scheduler runs. The key is prefixed to prevent collisions with future proposal-derived events. This helper lives in the shared vocabulary to allow the Next settle route and Convex to agree on the format without cross-importing.

26a3a70dac0329050970baa5e1d585b22c8ada9a.title: Privacy Policy copy updated to September 2 effective date
26a3a70dac0329050970baa5e1d585b22c8ada9a.summary: Data-use copy in `freebuff-data-use.ts` and READMEs now matches the September 2 Privacy Policy. `FREEBUFF_POLICY_ROLLOUT` becomes `FREEBUFF_POLICY_METADATA`; old notice fields deleted. Collection answer no longer names DeepSeek; storage answer adds agent traces and restricted-partner language for Cloud repos. Static Markdown drift test covers both README files.

477a8a0d84c0b6cd3c5181ef0a6498eec2079321.title: Refactor Freebuff session response types
477a8a0d84c0b6cd3c5181ef0a6498eec2079321.summary: Renamed FreebuffSessionServerResponse to FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse and restructured the type to separate superseded status from admission responses. Superseded variant now includes desktopSessionCounts. Scope limited to common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts. The superseded status remains a distinct top-level variant in the final FreebuffSessionServerResponse union.

9ede9a4a53b7798cd504493c12aa75323f7a0225.title: Testing docs and setup-env clarify Infisical unit-test isolation
9ede9a4a53b7798cd504493c12aa75323f7a0225.summary: docs/testing.md adds explicit boundary stating unit-test matrix never loads Infisical to prevent mutable production rollout switches from causing unrelated test failures. sdk/test/setup-env.ts updates `FREEBUFF_GOD_QUOTA_EXEMPT` comment to reflect local shell state risk rather than CI secret leakage, while still forcing the default. Scope covers SDK test harness and docs.

4ff67e17e1d2980de3411ac0f573e20160b845d8.title: Fix sponsored run tracking and linked worktree git sandbox
4ff67e17e1d2980de3411ac0f573e20160b845d8.summary: Added `SPONSORED_STATE_IS_TERMINAL` and `sponsoredProposalAwaitsVerdict` to prevent UI from falsely showing 'Start' on running/failed proposals. Introduced `SponsoredLinkedWorktree` grants for `commonDir`, `gitDir`, and `branchNamespace` to fix `fatal: not a git repository` errors in Desktop linked worktrees. Updates `sponsored-proposal-view.ts` and `sponsored-sandbox.ts`. Branch namespace granted as directory to support git ref locking.

38b9fb0ffb5f0f14035dcf78969d153d7b0acfd8.title: CLI adds sponsored proposal accept and consent flow
38b9fb0ffb5f0f14035dcf78969d153d7b0acfd8.summary: Phase 2 introduces `/ads:accept-proposal`, `/ads:pull-request`, and `/ads:remove-worktree` commands plus a local consent screen. Accepting opens a consent panel instead of immediately running code, preventing accidental prompt submission during approval. The flow uses git worktrees on the local machine, with `use-sponsored-proposal.ts` handling the proposal lifecycle and `sponsored-run.ts` managing execution boundaries. Refusal closes the screen without recording state, ensuring the decision remains reversible.

d4bc77782d48297b04fb290ea5fb43ca4dae0d37.title: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.167
d4bc77782d48297b04fb290ea5fb43ca4dae0d37.summary: freebuff/cli/release/package.json version field updated from 0.0.166 to 0.0.167. Scope limited to CLI release packaging metadata. No functional code changes.

2a6cd7375ba0be59db222123a7294c0982ad0453.title: Add listDisposableEmailDomains export to common
2a6cd7375ba0be59db222123a7294c0982ad0453.summary: Added exported function listDisposableEmailDomains() in common/src/util/disposable-email.ts. Returns a readonly string array copy of the curated DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS set. This provides a read-only view of the disposable email list for seeding server-side blacklists. Classification helpers remain the authoritative source for domain checks.

56dbe402f41689aa095fa05026ddd53037ff462d.title: Add sponsored-run-token TTL constant
56dbe402f41689aa095fa05026ddd53037ff462d.summary: New `common/src/ads/sponsored-run-token.ts` defines `SPONSORED_RUN_TOKEN_TTL_MS` as 24 hours. Shared constant ensures Next route and Convex sweep agree on token validity, preventing 409 errors on stale reports. Distinct from Cloud executor timeout, accommodating offline user pauses.

9b2ca33ed534768e4860d8b6949da3934abf2d81.title: House ad suppression for entitled subscribers
9b2ca33ed534768e4860d8b6949da3934abf2d81.summary: Entitled subscribers are now suppressed from `freebuff-house-ad.ts` serving. `resolveHouseSuppressedForUser` is the sole gate checked by all serve paths (candidate filter and four checked-in floors). This prevents marketing copy from reaching users who already bought the subscription. Ad serving logic remains unchanged; a subscription still does not remove ads.

26f3b123cc05ef5f25fd8b0fe2adf7fbbdeeb691.title: Clarify house ad fallback defaults and campaign caps
26f3b123cc05ef5f25fd8b0fe2adf7fbbdeeb691.summary: Updated `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts` comments to clarify that the house ad fallback is off by default in production, while campaigns enforce standard frequency caps. The revision distinguishes between the uncapped fallback mechanism and the capped campaign serving, correcting previous documentation that implied repetition was handled solely by rotation. This ensures developers understand the actual serving constraints and configuration defaults for the ad system.

6edee52fa9c4ab5511163f99269dd8613f0669f2.title: SDK exports sponsored sandbox containment for local execution
6edee52fa9c4ab5511163f99269dd8613f0669f2.summary: SDK exports `sponsored-sandbox` tools and `common` adds `sponsored-capabilities` and `sponsored-local-execution` to enforce security boundaries for local sponsored runs. This separation ensures a single capability classification serves both Cloud and Local environments, with local grants dynamically adjusted based on OS containment availability (macOS/Linux sandboxing vs Windows denial). Files include `sdk/src/tools/sponsored-sandbox.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-capabilities.ts`, and `common/src/ads/sponsored-local-execution.ts`. Desktop conformance waivers are removed as Phase 2 shipped local execution, requiring strict adherence to the new process broker limits.

afc8351b5b724273614569816b30691f1fecf536.title: Remove FutureSearch deep research from web-search tool
afc8351b5b724273614569816b30691f1fecf536.summary: Removed FutureSearch provider from web-search pipeline, eliminating paid deep research features. `web-search.ts` now exclusively uses Serper API, dropping `research`, `researchEffort`, `researchDirections`, and `researchContext` parameters. `futuresearch-api.ts` and `common/src/constants/web-search.ts` deleted; `codebuff-web-api.ts` removed `/api/v1/deep-research` endpoint and associated timeout/retry logic. Researcher agent prompts updated to remove agentic research instructions.

6a4ad1d04afdcc25bf6aea1e3503199ae65e39c3.title: Muse Spark 1.3 replaces 1.2 in Web/Cloud pickers
6a4ad1d04afdcc25bf6aea1e3503199ae65e39c3.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor replaces 1.2 in Freebuff Web and Cloud model pickers. 1.2 is retired from selection but remains served to allow existing sessions to drain; saved 1.2 preferences auto-migrate to 1.3 via `supersededBy`. Changes affect `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`, and `agents/base-chat.ts`. Both models share the same upstream rate-limit bucket and Contributor-tier budget.

59cca53dfb5bc9c9c03141f91494646de4a40ce3.title: Remove sticky first-party arm salt and log fields
59cca53dfb5bc9c9c03141f91494646de4a40ce3.summary: Deleted FIRST_PARTY_ARM_SALT constant and firstPartyArmKey helper from ad-experiment.ts. Removed opportunity_id, policy_version, and first_party_arm_bucket fields from ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS in axiom-only-log.ts. These changes revert the sticky per-user first-party arm experiment (COD-369) that previously replaced per-request UUIDs to ensure consistent bucketing across sessions. Scope limited to common/src/util/ modules; no CLI or Web surface changes.

d227b0349fd05b02d6d5a0f0c628783996fbf89d.title: Add matchoutcome field to Axiom log schema
d227b0349fd05b02d6d5a0f0c628783996fbf89d.summary: Introduced `match_outcome` string field to `ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. Captures hashed-email lookup results (matched, observed_match, unmatched, ambiguous, gated, consent_denied, none) for identity rail analytics. Bounded by construction to prevent user-level digest logging.

f2ddf900349a34acf802d7645accc70840d0a4f3.title: Add FutureSearch deep research to websearch tool
f2ddf900349a34acf802d7645accc70840d0a4f3.summary: web_search tool gains research flag enabling FutureSearch multi-agent deep research, returning synthesized cited answers instead of raw results. New common/src/constants/web-search.ts centralizes provider universe (serper, futuresearch) and research effort tiers (low/medium/high), shared by tool schema, facade, and API validation. packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-api/futuresearch-api.ts implements provider logic; codebuff-web-api.ts adds deep-research endpoint with extended 6-minute timeout and retry-free mode to prevent double-billing. Scope includes agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts prompt updates and common/src/tools/params/tool/web-search.ts parameter definitions.

6891efd69b17644d4cc43382efd3a757e25507a1.title: Sticky first-party arm salt and expanded ad fetch log fields
6891efd69b17644d4cc43382efd3a757e25507a1.summary: Replaced per-request UUIDs with a sticky `FIRST_PARTY_ARM_SALT` (`ads_first_party_arm_2026_09`) and `firstPartyArmKey` helper in `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts` to ensure consistent user bucketing across surfaces. Expanded `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts` with `opportunity_id`, `policy_version`, `first_party_arm_bucket`, and eligibility census fields (`eligible_campaign_labels`, `exclusion_reasons`).

e47bf5c35bbc5397a02ad2dc1074907ad4fdf225.title: Add house leg eligibility check and telemetry
e47bf5c35bbc5397a02ad2dc1074907ad4fdf225.summary: Introduces houseLegOpen() and DEFAULT_FIRST_PARTY_HOUSE_LEG to determine if COD-358 house campaigns may run per request. The check gates on user ID, geo routing tier, and the dark-deploy flag, remaining orthogonal to FirstPartyAdRoute billing logic. Updates common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts and common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts. Adds first_party_house_leg boolean to Axiom logs to track eligibility, not actual fills.

a90d9c446543900a2ec75675fe03844a537ac3f1.title: Per-model compaction policy and cache-expiry token floor
a90d9c446543900a2ec75675fe03844a537ac3f1.summary: New `common/src/constants/compaction-policy.ts` defines per-model idle gap and token floor for context pruning. `agents/base3.ts` now uses `compactionPolicyForModel` instead of hardcoded 1h. `agents/context-pruner.ts` adds `cacheExpiryMinTokens` check. DeepSeek Flash gets 15m/0 floor; others 1h/140k floor.

c10a9f304bd1337ad48ef2b2294d38af5e460dab.title: freebuff-subscriptions: disclaimer window text dynamic
c10a9f304bd1337ad48ef2b2294d38af5e460dab.summary: Hardcoded '5-day' disclaimer replaced by dynamic constant interpolation. Window widened 5->7 days; text now reads 'weekly ${FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_FIVE_DAY_WINDOW_DAYS}-day window'. Fixes stale copy in `freebuff-subscriptions.ts`.

dd1d934b7418b612d453d52e5fc2091011923dbc.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 replaces GLM 5.3 Flash as default model
dd1d934b7418b612d453d52e5fc2091011923dbc.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 replaces GLM 5.3 Flash as the default model across full and limited tiers. The change stems from DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 being the cheapest row, optimal for token-heavy Cloud planner and build paths. Scope includes CLI landing screen and model selector, common constants, and README documentation. A new migration utility (`freebuff-default-model-migration.ts`) handles one-time moves of saved preferences off the old default; limited planner now uses `FALLBACK_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` (MiMo 2.5) instead of `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` to ensure admission.

8592ea01be0a05c20e0741bc3b1dfe82c4694e7b.title: gitignore scratch directory for intent-batch orchestrator
8592ea01be0a05c20e0741bc3b1dfe82c4694e7b.summary: Adds `scratch/` to `.gitignore` to exclude the intent-batch orchestrator's resume state. This prevents committing live approval capabilities and cohort references. Scope limited to repository configuration.

2a958f98f5f8c683057d7419feae9093bea14cfb.title: Add ADSTATEMENTDESCRIPTORSUFFIX for card charges
2a958f98f5f8c683057d7419feae9093bea14cfb.summary: Added AD_STATEMENT_DESCRIPTOR_SUFFIX constant set to 'FREEBUFF.COM' in freebuff-topups.ts. This suffix ensures one-off card charges display correctly under the Codebuff Stripe account, adhering to the 22-character limit when combined with the 'CODEBUFF* ' prefix. Subscription products retain 'FREEBUFF.COM' directly on the Product object. This change affects core constants used for top-up and postpaid sweep statements.

48b5fee79a1016800772e01eafa8ceb3db346f98.title: FREEBUFFLIMITEDSESSIONLIMIT restored to 6
48b5fee79a1016800772e01eafa8ceb3db346f98.summary: FREEBUFF_LIMITED_SESSION_LIMIT reverted from 3 to 6 in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, and `FREEBUFF_LEVELS` in `freebuff-levels.ts` updated so lower tiers grant 6 free sessions instead of ramping 3→4→5. The cut aimed at reselling farms (new/VPN/unsupported-region accounts) but wrongly halved MiMo access for legitimate limited-mode users; farms are handled by trust levels and signup gate. Scope: shared core constants, CLI release README, package version bumped to 0.0.166. Level 0 is now exactly the base (6 limited / 4 premium), keeping `levelSessionBonus` a pure delta; the limited ladder adds its first session only at top rungs.

a71de944590b9d02d5c182133e8c17de5e600db0.title: GLM v5.3 flash restores max reasoning rung and default
a71de944590b9d02d5c182133e8c17de5e600db0.summary: Restores `max` to `GLM_V53_FLASH_REASONING_EFFORTS` and sets `reasoningEffort`/`defaultEffort` to `max` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Reverses the 2026-08-31 pin to `high` after measurements showed `high` collapsed to ~300 thinking chars, making it effectively no-thinking. This prioritizes reasoning depth over tool-call looping risks introduced by #2528.

3b8fa14a1010363bb909958213fa8beea9c31a30.title: Add ad click id constants and format model lists
3b8fa14a1010363bb909958213fa8beea9c31a30.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_AD_CLICK_ID_HEADER` (`x-freebuff-bfcid`) and `FREEBUFF_AD_CLICK_ID_COOKIE` (`bfcid`) to track house-ad clicks across Stripe checkout. The header is server-to-server only and requires HMAC verification at the conversions endpoint to prevent attribution fraud. `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS` and other model resolution functions underwent formatting changes without logic alteration. These constants support conversion reporting while maintaining security boundaries against forged click IDs.

e1792f99509f9abc40904b9f4dad683d57510329.title: Add MRC50 viewability tracking and event schema to common
e1792f99509f9abc40904b9f4dad683d57510329.summary: Added `imprezia-viewability.ts` implementing an MRC50 state machine for ad viewability, requiring 50% pixel visibility for 1 second in foreground. Updated `imprezia-ad.ts` with optional `impreziaEventSchema` to distinguish 'inserted' vs 'viewable' events, defaulting to 'inserted' for legacy compatibility. Shared logic ensures consistent billing between Web and Desktop renderers, excluding CLI due to lack of viewport. Timer resets on visibility drop or backgrounding rather than pausing.

9f81f91397709452f3b757a035fb9e93d0ab9454.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash restored to free mode and subscription premium list
9f81f91397709452f3b757a035fb9e93d0ab9454.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash returns to `FREEBUFF_PAUSED_FREE_MODEL_IDS` after routing fix #2787 resolved BYOK Vertex latency (16.37s vs 2.39s AI Studio flex). Reliability issues were traced to `max_tokens` caps consuming reasoning tokens, not endpoint failures, with 24/24 concurrent turns succeeding post-fix. `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_MODEL_IDS` now derives from `FREEBUFF_PLAN_METERED_CATALOG_MODEL_IDS`, and Gemini 3.8 Flash joins `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS` to enforce daily sub-caps on the catalog's most expensive row.

3975224904d989f60ad8db9139bf51b7390e67c0.title: Add sponsored proposal controls and commands to CLI
3975224904d989f60ad8db9139bf51b7390e67c0.summary: Added sponsored proposal handling to CLI via new components, API utilities, and `/ads:*` commands (`ads:proposal`, `ads:dismiss-proposal`, etc.). Replaced global keyboard bindings on cards to prevent conflicts with composer input, requiring commands or explicit menu navigation for controls. State updates patch blocks by target ID to ensure single source of truth across transcript messages. Control logic isolated in `runSponsoredProposalControl` for testability without network or chat mounting.

0d2d7a08594e7172e82d0f59a6a4c8a6bcc001b4.title: Solar Pro 4 BYOK price comment corrected, one-a-day cap lifted
0d2d7a08594e7172e82d0f59a6a4c8a6bcc001b4.summary: Upstage Solar Pro 4 BYOK pricing comment in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts corrected: OpenRouter's cost_details.upstream_inference_cost is a list-price estimate, not actual billing under Upstage's 90% launch promo through Sep 10. common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts updates FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE to state Solar Pro 4's one-a-day trial limit is lifted, moving it to shared premium pool metering. The promo expiry on Sep 11 triggers a tenfold cap tightening via FREEBUFF_PER_MODEL_SESSION_SPEND_CAPS; web/src/llm-api/openrouter-price-overrides.ts handles repricing during the promo window.

01bf3cd467fb1a2700c866b3097fff745b3c0f5b.title: Free tier shows week and month windows in CLI picker
01bf3cd467fb1a2700c866b3097fff745b3c0f5b.summary: CLI picker now renders free tier's three windows (today, week, month) via `freebuffFreeWindowsSummary` and `getFreeWindowsInfo`. This aligns the free user layout with subscriber plan summaries, using `getZonedMonthBounds` for calendar math. Shared types in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` and utils in `common/src/util/freebuff-plan-summary.ts` drive the change. Display-only for now: week/month usage does not enforce limits, so `weekUsed` may exceed `weekLimit`.

ae136bca432c7f3c74cb18d6c7fda924de2d8a12.title: Version bump to 0.0.165
ae136bca432c7f3c74cb18d6c7fda924de2d8a12.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json bumped to 0.0.165. Routine packaging update.

7bcf9ba0b06d17819d238906d0d0436fa1eb432e.title: Add freebuffPlanHrs for compact duration strings
7bcf9ba0b06d17819d238906d0d0436fa1eb432e.summary: Added `freebuffPlanHrs` to `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts`. Generates abbreviated duration strings (e.g. "24 hrs") for secondary UI lines where full words crowd cards. Headlines retain `freebuffPlanHours`.

d36ecd09839c43b9c0949a8ad83ea5a171cba6bc.title: axiom-only-log.ts adds frequency decision fields
d36ecd09839c43b9c0949a8ad83ea5a171cba6bc.summary: Added `frequency_unavailable_causes` and `frequency_max_reservation_ms` to `ADS_FIRST_PARTY_DECISION_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`. This expands the Axiom-only logging schema to capture detailed frequency reservation metrics and causes for ads decisions. Scope limited to Shared/Core logging utility. Schema uses `as const satisfies AxiomOnlyFieldSchema` for type safety.

6341ef3af85281a213d98d6fab35e502e544dbd5.title: Add placementSurface resolver to freebuff-placements
6341ef3af85281a213d98d6fab35e502e544dbd5.summary: New placementSurface function in common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts maps placement ids to their surface, returning undefined for unregistered ids. Resolves missing surface fields (e.g. Desktop-Below-Chat) to prevent null surface storage failures in ad_placement_delivery and click settlement. Includes regex fallback for legacy CLI-Chat-Inline-N ids not present in PLACEMENT_SLOTS. Scope limited to shared core constants.

321907165f73f9a66f780f275f38e27092f87aa9.title: Add impreziaArmPercent to first-party ad routing config
321907165f73f9a66f780f275f38e27092f87aa9.summary: The `FirstPartyGeoRoutingConfig` interface now accepts `impreziaArmPercent` and a new `first_party_before_imprezia` route. This allows the primary book to preempt Imprezia's slot for a configurable share of Tier-1 requests in the `imprezia_first` arm, stacked directly above the primary window to prevent overlap. The change is scoped to `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts` and `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`, where `preempted` is added to `ADS_IMPREZIA_FETCH_OUTCOMES` to distinguish this state from `not_eligible`. `impreziaFirstRefusal` is required in `firstPartyAdRouteForGeoRequest` context to ensure surfaces correctly gate this new leg.

161b864dd4f665957ded8250837935b5f8612cfc.title: Add shared sponsored proposal view model
161b864dd4f665957ded8250837935b5f8612cfc.summary: New `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-view.ts` centralizes sponsored proposal state, actions, and copy. Decouples channel logic from `freebuff/web` renderers, enabling terminal parity. Enforces strict sanitization for `pr_url` and `advertiser_logo_token` via `sanitizeAdUrl` and shape checks. `committed` state names the outcome, not a pending action.

b6775f5c3e83b041816b59b2c2bb6dcadadf9f91.title: PLACEMENTPREVIEWWIDTHS shifted to 48/80/100
b6775f5c3e83b041816b59b2c2bb6dcadadf9f91.summary: PLACEMENT_PREVIEW_WIDTHS in freebuff-placements.ts replaces the 20/48/60 set with 48/80/100. The 20-column renderer floor is isolated into MIN_INLINE_AD_WIDTH in inline-ad-layout.ts, preserving the hard title budget at narrow terminal widths while removing the unused preview case. Scope covers common/src/ads/inline-ad-layout.ts, common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts, and common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts. The 100-column cap prevents horizontal scrollbars in the creative preview dialog, as 120 columns exceeds the dialog's literal `${width}ch` rendering.

5d679590800f31569758fe1002a5ef087668f7b7.title: thinker-gemini switches to DeepSeek V4 Flash
5d679590800f31569758fe1002a5ef087668f7b7.summary: The `thinker-gemini` agent definition in `agents/thinker/thinker-gemini.ts` now uses `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` instead of `google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview`. The change addresses unsustainable costs (~$2,700/week vs ~$70-85/week) caused by high input token volume on the previous model. The internal ID `thinker-gemini` remains unchanged to preserve existing registration and prompt spawning logic in `chat/agent.ts` and `base-chat`. Reasoning is explicitly enabled with `effort: 'high'` to ensure the DeepSeek lane's thinking flag is active.

3dd1da66d178a91f9d099d3370564ecb00dde3dc.title: CLI package version bump to 0.0.164
3dd1da66d178a91f9d099d3370564ecb00dde3dc.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json incremented from 0.0.163 to 0.0.164. Standard release cycle. No feature changes included.

d49020039fb91ec4c15dbfeaf70940853e84f5e8.title: Referral banner GitHub link moves to /account
d49020039fb91ec4c15dbfeaf70940853e84f5e8.summary: The CLI referral banner's GitHub linking button now opens `${LOGIN_WEBSITE_URL}/account` instead of `${LOGIN_WEBSITE_URL}/web/settings`. This updates the destination URL for the `onClick` handler in `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` to align with the current account settings page structure. The change is scoped to the CLI component and affects the `githubLinked` state rendering path.

12f8f2bb5b72969b7114cec9f24ae47e7e5e4500.title: Add common/src/util/tokens.ts
12f8f2bb5b72969b7114cec9f24ae47e7e5e4500.summary: New `common/src/util/tokens.ts` defines `totalTokens`, `freshInputTokens`, and `formatTokens` for unified token reporting. Consolidates previously divergent logic where `totalTokens` ignored that provider `prompt_tokens` already includes `cache_read_input_tokens`, preventing double-counting on cache-heavy workloads. Shared across surfaces via `Intl.NumberFormat` and tiered abbreviation logic.

210f7ac71cdb6b0f59662b85b4b86cdf0ef5e723.title: ADPLACEMENTCPCGEOFLOORCENTS lowered to 10
210f7ac71cdb6b0f59662b85b4b86cdf0ef5e723.summary: AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_GEO_FLOOR_CENTS in common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts drops from 50 to 10. This sets the minimum billing rate for individual clicks in low-conversion countries after geo scaling, distinct from the campaign base floor. The change establishes a 10-cent commercial floor for inventory that would otherwise remain unmonetized. Higher base rates retain their conversion-rate multipliers above this new minimum.

70f1d8d632956affcf4ef483ae0c317dfd8d9403.title: GLM 5.3 Flash reasoning default pinned to high, max removed from
70f1d8d632956affcf4ef483ae0c317dfd8d9403.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash's `reasoningEffort` is now explicitly pinned to `'high'` and `max` is removed from `GLM_V53_FLASH_REASONING_EFFORTS`. Previously, the row sent no effort value, causing `unset` to run deeper than `max` and trigger non-convergent loops on agent tasks; removing the picker option without pinning the wire default would have left the loop in place for users who never touched the control. This change applies only to Freebuff's internal selection in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`; BYOK and direct-API callers retain access to `max` via `MERGE_EFFORT_ALIASES`.

fcb16dec8af815505ae1dcc2d4f8be9c907fc814.title: Solar Pro 4 pinned to ZDR endpoint and capped at 1 session/day
fcb16dec8af815505ae1dcc2d4f8be9c907fc814.summary: Solar Pro 4 pinned to tag-qualified `upstage/zdr` endpoint to prevent cache splitting and ensure ZDR compliance. Row capped at 1 session/day due to high per-message cost and unmeasured cache rates post-fix. Shared notice and new `freebuffSessionSpendNotice` label model as EXPERIMENTAL to clarify session limits.

091a224cd3b63af11dbded3dea62c726a669d112.title: CodebuffRunner adds terminalCommandBroker and collectDiff flags
091a224cd3b63af11dbded3dea62c726a669d112.summary: CodebuffRunner in evals/buffbench/runners/codebuff.ts now accepts terminalCommandBroker, overrideTools, and collectDiff options. The collectDiff flag gates the host-side git diff collection, allowing sponsored evals to disable it and rely on the scrubbed OS broker instead. A fileFilter was also added to block absolute paths and parent directory traversals.

31e6e831630f42720b61aa08561daa941dbf4ed3.title: Fix totalTokens double-counting cacheReadTokens in usage types
31e6e831630f42720b61aa08561daa941dbf4ed3.summary: Updated `FreebuffRecentUsage` in `common/src/types/freebuff-usage.ts` to clarify that `totalTokens` equals `inputTokens + outputTokens`, explicitly excluding `cacheReadTokens` from the sum. This prevents ~1.8x inflation of token counts at high cache hit rates, as `cacheReadTokens` is a subset of `inputTokens` rather than an additive component. The change affects shared core types used by UI tiles and usage reporting surfaces.

a49b46d62f39fd4cf45e3ba02499b8aefbca0d24.title: Paid spend floors, CLI upgrade hints, near-limit nudge
a49b46d62f39fd4cf45e3ba02499b8aefbca0d24.summary: CLI landing screen surfaces server upgrade hints or plans URL on quota walls. Added `FREEBUFF_PAID_DAILY_SPEND_FLOOR_USD` (full $7, limited $3) to prevent paid accounts inheriting free-tier ceilings; `third_party_client` excluded as reseller pattern. Elevated daily spend cut $5 to $1. New `freebuff-limit-nudge.ts` unifies Web/Desktop near-limit warnings at 0.8 fraction. Pro tier restored; weekly window renamed 5-day to 7-day, wire field `fiveDay` kept.

21d3b7668e7f43c2bcfbcd065b1915ae4329f6d3.title: Referral reward now grants extra premium sessions at full tier
21d3b7668e7f43c2bcfbcd065b1915ae4329f6d3.summary: Referral and streak rewards grant an extra daily premium session for full-tier users, replacing the previous GLM 5.2 model unlock. Limited-tier users retain access to the reward model via the banner, while full-tier users receive additional session capacity instead. The change affects CLI model selection and referral banner logic, with shared constants updated to reflect the tier-dependent reward mechanism. Reward session pools reset daily (Pacific time) and are capped by earned entitlements rather than fixed model limits.

dcc6b662d492759a0776826bd0ee32e36480baa4.title: Shared daily cap bounds and ladder for placements
dcc6b662d492759a0776826bd0ee32e36480baa4.summary: Added PLACEMENT_DAILY_CAP_MIN_CENTS, PLACEMENT_DAILY_CAP_MAX_CENTS, and PLACEMENT_DAILY_CAP_DEFAULT_CENTS to common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts, raising the ceiling from 50_000 to 500_000 cents. These bounds are shared with the campaigns API to prevent form validation mismatches where the API rejects values the builder allowed. The ceiling increase accommodates advertiser scaling beyond the previous $50/day limit. Also added clampPlacementDailyCapCents and PLACEMENT_DAILY_CAP_LADDER, which uses non-linear steps ($5 to $100, $25 to $500, etc.) to ensure the slider's low end remains accessible without burying typical $25-$50/day caps in the first percent of a linear track.

d88c688727818ebcf7ce9bdcdcc18ba16d7946a2.title: Add effectivePlacementCpcFloorCents helper to shared constants
d88c688727818ebcf7ce9bdcdcc18ba16d7946a2.summary: Added `effectivePlacementCpcFloorCents` and `isValidPlacementCpcFloorOverride` to `common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts`. Centralizes floor logic for ad placements, ensuring out-of-range or malformed overrides fail safe by resolving to the global $1 floor (`AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_FLOOR_CENTS`). This prevents price drift across admission validators, click-recording guards, reprice clamps, and table checks.

94eb1cfce38c1ccd0f91a5a7a1e66013863eabbb.title: Add geo-aware first-party ad routing and logging fields
94eb1cfce38c1ccd0f91a5a7a1e66013863eabbb.summary: New `firstPartyAdRouteForGeoRequest` function and `FirstPartyGeoRoutingConfig` interface implement geo-aware inventory routing, defaulting to `DEFAULT_FIRST_PARTY_GEO_ROUTING = false` to preserve legacy behavior. Tier 1 retains primary/backfill policies, Tier 2 offers non-billable bonus inventory on terminal paid no-fills, and unknown geo restricts to paid networks. `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts` adds bounded logging fields for geo controls and CPC state, explicitly separating them from pre-existing pricing metrics.

c3521fd87fc4c8f683e73c08251772dc976ca8ec.title: Add HMAC-SHA256 account deletion proof utility
c3521fd87fc4c8f683e73c08251772dc976ca8ec.summary: Added `createAccountDeletionProof` and `verifyAccountDeletionProof` in `common/src/util/account-deletion-proof.ts` to generate and validate server-side proofs for Adbuff deletion completion prior to Convex account purge. The proof is an HMAC-SHA256 signature over a versioned payload containing the identity subject and deletion code, ensuring integrity and preventing timing attacks via constant-time comparison. This mechanism binds the proof to both the authenticated subject and the mailed code, with the Next route minting it only after Adbuff reports an active suppression fence. The implementation enforces a minimum 32-character secret length and handles `Uint8Array` buffer compatibility for older TypeScript libraries.

f9b0815704eb34ebed2b8852b1a27c4902664d58.title: Add FreebuffFreebucksInfo types and bump CLI to 0.0.163
f9b0815704eb34ebed2b8852b1a27c4902664d58.summary: Added FreebuffFreebucksInfo and FreebuffFreebucksWindow interfaces to common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts to model spendable budgets, including daily/weekly/monthly windows and binding window logic. Implemented getFreebucksInfo helper to extract this data from session responses, ensuring clients can render accurate remaining balances and per-model prices. Bumped freebuff/cli/release/package.json version to 0.0.163.

f3e97864f5d12d3df41f0bc10e08b5afd66dd101.title: Freebuff Standing Constants Split
f3e97864f5d12d3df41f0bc10e08b5afd66dd101.summary: New file `common/src/constants/freebuff-standing.ts` separates user-facing account standing labels from backend trust logic. `FREEBUFF_TRUST_FALLBACK_LEVEL` defaults to 'established' to prevent database failures from throttling free-mode traffic. `freebuff-session.ts` updates imports to reference the new presentation layer.

a67e89052816db2de4de5bc42c4b6c318f91797a.title: Add subscriber desktop session limits
a67e89052816db2de4de5bc42c4b6c318f91797a.summary: New `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIBER_DESKTOP_SESSION_LIMITS` constant raises desktop concurrency ceilings for paid accounts to 3 premium and 8 unlimited sessions, replacing the previous hard cap of 1 and 3. A helper `freebuffDesktopSessionLimits(hasPaidPlan)` resolves the correct limits based on subscription status, preventing paid users from being silently held to free-tier ceilings. The change updates `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and clarifies session response types in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` to reflect tier-specific slot availability.

477b0e47facf165557cca9b60a070dacc3f6f9d9.title: Fix CLI model picker for paid subscriptions
477b0e47facf165557cca9b60a070dacc3f6f9d9.summary: Adds `resolveFreebuffModelPickForSession` and `resolveFreebuffModelSelectionForSession` in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` to correctly resolve model selections based on subscription status. This prevents paid models from being coerced to the default limited model before session admission. The change ensures the picker respects `subscription.tierId` as the authoritative entitlement verdict.

8542dfe658589b2433a7d039b031d1e0eab1be07.title: Advertiser credit line constants
8542dfe658589b2433a7d039b031d1e0eab1be07.summary: Added AD_CREDIT_LINE_* constants to common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts. Defines 3-10 day burn window, $5000 ceiling, 14-day/3-collection minimums, and per-run growth/decrease clamps. Dispute cuts bypass decrease clamp.

443f19f0eae03bcbc0dfb3ac6a5cd869fb9dcbae.title: CLI /skill: bare invocation enters input mode; status bar shows
443f19f0eae03bcbc0dfb3ac6a5cd869fb9dcbae.summary: Bare /skill:<name> invocations now enter a dedicated input mode, allowing users to append instructions before execution. Empty submissions in this mode run the skill as-is, mirroring /interview behavior. Prompt construction is unified via buildSkillPrompt to ensure byte-identical outputs for both arg-based and mode-based invocations. Additionally, the status bar displays real-time context token usage derived from mainAgentState, and new steering buffer utilities prevent mid-turn queue overtaking.

94288ad24bcefe362692ded7a3a8c692a503ff16.title: Remove GLM 5.3 Flash from desktop premium bucket
94288ad24bcefe362692ded7a3a8c692a503ff16.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash removed from FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_PREMIUM_BUCKET_MODEL_IDS in freebuff-models.ts. The model's unmetering on 2026-08-28 invalidated the previous concurrency constraint, while measured production spend confirmed it is the cheapest row served. This aligns the bucket with the criterion of excluding high-cost concurrent usage, ensuring no metered models remain in multi-tab buckets.

646e9fe14848ff98d26448d1c90f42422e3dbe8a.title: 0.0.161 release
646e9fe14848ff98d26448d1c90f42422e3dbe8a.summary: Version bump to 0.0.161 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. No functional changes.

9c1de51074bf984f2827742fffce78a1e7580203.title: Ignore exported user email CSVs in .gitignore
9c1de51074bf984f2827742fffce78a1e7580203.summary: Added `user-emails-*.csv` to `.gitignore` to exclude PII exports. Targets files generated by `scripts/export-user-emails.ts`. Scope limited to repository hygiene configuration. Prevents accidental commit of sensitive user data.

df7e3aa400c51c34ba5185d01ce1527c892a671f.title: Remove formatResetTime alias in CLI time utils
df7e3aa400c51c34ba5185d01ce1527c892a671f.summary: Removed `formatResetTime` alias from `cli/src/utils/time-format.ts`. Callers in `subscription-limit-banner.tsx` and `usage-banner.tsx` now use `formatResetTimeLong` directly. This simplifies the time formatting API by eliminating redundant wrappers.

bd4a417e32556ffb2004437274d0cdd893ad3907.title: Agentic-ad funnel event vocabulary and billing rule
bd4a417e32556ffb2004437274d0cdd893ad3907.summary: New `agentic-ad-events.ts` defines the closed set of funnel stages for sponsored proposals (offered, accepted, PR lifecycle, advertiser-side activation). Billing is strictly CPC on `accepted` via existing first-party click settlement; all other events are pure telemetry that must not move balances or credits. The vocabulary is dependency-free to allow shared imports across Postgres schema, ad-serving rail, and Convex modules. Advertiser S2S postbacks are restricted to `account_created` and `tool_used`; internal stages like `merged` are never accepted from partners.

23c05c4a5fce1db9301b66529c2dd543d51c1e77.title: PlacementTotals adds deliverySpendCents for rate metrics
23c05c4a5fce1db9301b66529c2dd543d51c1e77.summary: PlacementTotals in common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts adds deliverySpendCents to separate ledger-billed spend from delivery-charged spend. Rate metrics now divide by deliverySpendCents to prevent manual back-bills from skewing eCPC and eCPM. This change affects core constants and placement totals interfaces.

f4fca07fcd3d2a041699d3c1216bb216d2dae2ec.title: Add ADPLACEMENTCPCGEOFLOORCENTS constant
f4fca07fcd3d2a041699d3c1216bb216d2dae2ec.summary: Introduced `AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_GEO_FLOOR_CENTS` (50) in `common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts`. This sets the minimum billing price for a single geo-adjusted click after country multipliers apply. It remains distinct from `AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_FLOOR_CENTS`, which enforces the campaign's base rate floor. The separation ensures geo pricing requires no migration, as `ck_ad_placement_campaign_cpc_floor` continues guarding the base rate.

e5d41741aeca4ae11989042f2af1647b94c11e41.title: GLM 5.3 Flash adds reasoning effort ladder
e5d41741aeca4ae11989042f2af1647b94c11e41.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash gains a native reasoning effort ladder (`low`, `high`, `max`) in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. The `reasoningEffort` type union expands to include `max` to accommodate this model's declared values. Default effort is set to `max` because the previous unset state measured deeper than `max`, making this a deliberate minor downgrade to avoid silent depth loss while exposing user control. MiniMax M3 and MiMo remain bare as they lack native effort parameters.

72fffec8570aebd6a07ae1fce403fcdedee01dbd.title: GLM 5.3 Flash moved to unmetered tier
72fffec8570aebd6a07ae1fce403fcdedee01dbd.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash `premium` flag set to false, removing it from `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS` and `FREE_MODE_PREMIUM_RATE_LIMITS` ceilings. Measured production spend confirmed it is the cheapest model served, making session caps illogical compared to already uncapped MiMo and V4 Flash. Changes affect `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and `common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts`. Limited-region users are unaffected as their tier relies on explicit allowlists, not this flag.

fd3c20c290bf78152ecc86ab7ba9191f420ca1ea.title: GLM 5.3 Flash replaces GPT-5.6 Luna as default model
fd3c20c290bf78152ecc86ab7ba9191f420ca1ea.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash becomes the default free model in `FREEBUFF_MODELS` and CLI picker, replacing GPT-5.6 Luna. This shift reflects an order-of-magnitude cost advantage on actual traffic despite similar list prices, and removes the previous 2-session/day cap by setting `dataUse: 'service'` (unmetered). No `reasoningEffort` is sent for untouched turns, letting the provider set depth, though `defaultEffort` remains 'max' for UI alignment. Updates cover `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, READMEs, and CLI release docs.

4a9013b2a97bd2bade3e61b99f3deb7814094eb0.title: Add channel field to ADSEXTERNALCONVERSIONPOSTBACKFIELDS
4a9013b2a97bd2bade3e61b99f3deb7814094eb0.summary: Added `channel` to `ADS_EXTERNAL_CONVERSION_POSTBACK_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts` to distinguish between 's2s' (key-authenticated) and 'client' (keyless browser) ingress. This field is strictly two-valued and never carries partner identifiers, aligning with the requirement to keep Axiom logs bounded to operational dimensions. The change ensures correct telemetry routing and filtering without expanding the log schema into attribution records.

6ace1d00c9409518218bbf90225391e9002a5b21.title: Add deliverySpacingSeconds to pace ad offerings
6ace1d00c9409518218bbf90225391e9002a5b21.summary: Introduces `deliverySpacingSeconds` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts` to enforce minimum gaps between ad deliveries. Replaces hourly burst patterns with jittered daily spacing to prevent learnable rhythms. Applies only to offering logic, bypassing submission checks to ensure user actions are never rejected due to prior engagement timing. Gap calculation uses `glideHash` for jitter, bounded by a 15-second floor and 3600-second ceiling.

1f35b8067456bba14e902e3018e6c41545b2a64e.title: Add ads.impreziafetchcompleted axiom-only event schema
1f35b8067456bba14e902e3018e6c41545b2a64e.summary: Adds ADS_IMPREZIA_FETCH_COMPLETED_EVENT constant and strict field sanitization for browser-side Imprezia decisions. Route reports only bounded serving dimensions: outcome, selection_reason, experiment_arm, surface, ad_count, duration_ms, test_mode, failure_class. Request/content/creative identifiers, URLs, and raw provider errors never enter this event. Also adds docs/specs/ to .gitignore to keep issue-specific plans out of the repository.

5c0c933cea38831e8f3c2a1042c1852363445159.title: Add exponential curve and pacing to budget glides
5c0c933cea38831e8f3c2a1042c1852363445159.summary: BudgetGlide interface adds `curve` field supporting 'linear' or 'exponential' descent. `glidedDailyBudgetCents` implements geometric decay for exponential curves, falling back to linear if start or target cents are zero. New `pacedDailyAllowance` function drips daily caps over the Pacific day for tapering campaigns, preventing early exhaustion of budget. Changes confined to `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts`.

179f317de8d228cc02d32ac4730781a8c0aadbc9.title: CLI release package.json bumps version to 0.0.160
179f317de8d228cc02d32ac4730781a8c0aadbc9.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json bumped 0.0.159 to 0.0.160. Scope limited to CLI release packaging. Diff shows only version field change.

cb3ef3135c27c68f08c1c3e92290607a08732afc.title: GLM 5.3 Flash cap removed, Merge Gateway added to spend providers
cb3ef3135c27c68f08c1c3e92290607a08732afc.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash's 2/day session cap is removed from FREEBUFF_PER_MODEL_SESSION_CAPS after the measurement window closed (93.6% cache hit rate, 6.2x cost reduction vs OpenRouter). The model now meters against the shared premium pool. Merge Gateway is added to SPEND_PROVIDER_IDS and PROVIDER_LABELS as the primary biller for GLM 5.3 Flash since 2026-08-27. FREEBUFF_TIER_CHANGE_NOTICE updated to reflect no per-model caps.

1312fa1702921f9df8394bf191da9ef062fba043.title: Export HOUSEADFAVICONURL constant
1312fa1702921f9df8394bf191da9ef062fba043.summary: Exported `HOUSE_AD_FAVICON_URL` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts`. This constant provides a fallback static favicon path because the ad campaign's `image_public_token` mechanism only supports uploaded bytes, not static URLs. The change ensures the house ad materializer can render the correct icon despite the campaign management console's restriction on editing paused campaigns.

57c010db236b4b5ffba7030cb4eff4bb50a4a333.title: Add shared plan summary to CLI model selector
57c010db236b4b5ffba7030cb4eff4bb50a4a333.summary: CLI model selector now renders a muted plan summary line below the catalog via new `freebuff-plan-summary.ts` shared utility. This mirrors web/desktop plan panels, displaying tier name, daily/5-day/monthly window usage, and blocking reset instants. Height estimation logic updated to include plan summary rows, preventing viewport clipping of critical blocked limit information. Shared summary ensures consistent limit naming and reset calculations across all surfaces.

590e6d257bf4128557f1e5823077c586bb424138.title: Ad pacing switches to rolling hourly window
590e6d257bf4128557f1e5823077c586bb424138.summary: Ad delivery pacing for tapering campaigns switches from a cumulative daily fraction to a trailing 60-minute rolling window. The previous stockpile model allowed burst spending after quiet periods and emptied allowances at midnight resets; the new window enforces a flat ceiling per hour. The `glideHash` function adds an avalanche finalizer to fix FNV-1a low-bit bias that caused identical hourly jitter values. `pacedDailyAllowance` is replaced by `deliveryWindowLimit` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts`, enforcing a minimum of 1 delivery per hour.

8f390e940d2f9457ea52bca4567f727f0a049277.title: Added think-tag-stream.ts to split leaked reasoning in content
8f390e940d2f9457ea52bca4567f727f0a049277.summary: Added `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/think-tag-stream.ts` and integrated it into `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts` to split leaked reasoning from `content` into `reasoning_delta` chunks. This prevents thinking text from rendering as prose when provider lanes fail to populate native reasoning fields. The split uses `historyLeaksThinkTags` to arm implicit open rules for orphan `</think>` markers, preserving raw text in `fullResponse` for turn-end signals.

3623ca3ffeb9e8ed71a65207075c1d4d18e639f3.title: House ad copy refactored and campaign creative limit raised to 25
3623ca3ffeb9e8ed71a65207075c1d4d18e639f3.summary: Freebuff house ad copy in `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts` now derives price from `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS` and defines `HOUSE_AD_VARIATIONS` alongside `HOUSE_AD_CREATIVES`. The constant `MAX_PLACEMENT_CREATIVES_PER_CAMPAIGN` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts` increased from 10 to 25 to support more campaign variants. This change prevents silent API rejections by centralizing the limit used by both the store and campaign builder.

a4837a425cd7f9ac57d590d53a9ef1bc20fa63f6.title: Ripgrep 15.2.0 adds arm64-win32 support
a4837a425cd7f9ac57d590d53a9ef1bc20fa63f6.summary: Ripgrep version bumped from 14.1.1 to 15.2.0 in sdk/scripts/fetch-ripgrep.ts. New arm64-win32 platform configuration added to fetch script and vendor directory, enabling native Windows ARM64 support. Platform resolution logic refactored in sdk/src/native/ripgrep.ts to use a lookup table (PLATFORM_DIRS) instead of if-else chains, exposing ripgrepPlatformDir helper. All existing vendor binaries updated to 15.2.0.

02f42768b0bc73acb01625d4d082a2f6f72d497e.title: Paid plan models offered in limited tier
02f42768b0bc73acb01625d4d082a2f6f72d497e.summary: The CLI and Web model pickers now display paid plan models to subscribers in limited regions. Previously, the client allowlist rejected these models, forcing users back to MiMo even though the server admitted them. The change adds a `hasPaidSubscription` flag derived from the session's `subscription.tierId` to `getFreebuffModelsForAccessTier` and `isFreebuffWebModelAllowedForLimitedTier`. Plan-specific rows are appended to the limited catalog rather than merged, preserving the position of free-tier models.

7bb5501109a4dd88daf5e262cb1356b7b815b200.title: levelProgress returns clamped trust
7bb5501109a4dd88daf5e262cb1356b7b815b200.summary: levelProgress in common/src/constants/freebuff-levels.ts now returns `clamped` trust instead of raw `trust`. Prevents UI from displaying negative or unbounded values when raw trust falls outside tier thresholds. Affects shared core constants used by Web, CLI, and Desktop progress displays. Callers relying on exact raw trust values must adjust to the clamped range.

2f4829e864d268f1cd6987537fd7956f6c67d0dc.title: House ad fallback copy added to common constants
2f4829e864d268f1cd6987537fd7956f6c67d0dc.summary: New `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts` defines copy for the Freebuff subscription house ad, serving as a last-resort fill when no paid or first-party campaign is available. Entry price reads from `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS` to prevent drift from checkout. Covers `waiting_room`, `freebuff_web_chat`, `chat_assistant`, and `cli_chat` surfaces; `HOUSE_AD_DISPLAY_CREATIVE` adds `imageUrl` for card-rendering surfaces like Desktop. A deploy gotcha exists: `common`-only changes do not auto-redeploy `freebuff-web` due to `rootDir` filters, requiring manual ancestry checks.

d40c36e4aae67b74e3067d4c23a2c1c3db9bf665.title: Ignore .claude/worktrees to prevent nested git worktrees and duplicate
d40c36e4aae67b74e3067d4c23a2c1c3db9bf665.summary: Added .claude/worktrees/ to .gitignore to exclude linked git worktrees created by agent tooling. Each worktree is a full checkout with its own .git file and generated migrations, so committing one nests a second working tree inside the repo and drags a duplicate migration index into whichever branch swept it up. Change scoped to .gitignore only; no code or config surfaces affected. Follow-up constraint: agent tooling must keep worktree directories under .claude/worktrees/ to remain excluded.

ec3142a4e62ca638acd914b68a3842d4e8c347f3.title: Add getClient dependency injection to useSendMessage
ec3142a4e62ca638acd914b68a3842d4e8c347f3.summary: Adds optional `getClient` parameter to `useSendMessage` to enable dependency injection for testing. Modifies `use-send-message.ts` to use the injected client, defaulting to `getCodebuffClient`. Updates `send-message.ts` comments and refines abort logic to prevent stale state leaks.

42989afa85b9d0c2cf43c220309ef9f05951d3bb.title: Reopen DeepSeek V4 Flash peak serving
42989afa85b9d0c2cf43c220309ef9f05951d3bb.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash availability changes from `off_peak_only` to `always` in `freebuff-models.ts`, restoring peak-hours serving. The prior closure displaced traffic to Luna, degrading its prefix cache and increasing costs, while Luminal offers a cheaper no-peak-surcharge alternative. `FREEBUFF_SUBSCRIPTION_PEAK_PAUSED_MODEL_IDS` is emptied and `deepseekPeakHoursExcluded` removed from subscription tiers in `freebuff-subscriptions.ts` to prevent stale UI labels. CLI version bumps to 0.0.158.

38feaebb146a689d5dbf3a38b322e7db2e63f071.title: Add CPC yield experiment config and telemetry fields
38feaebb146a689d5dbf3a38b322e7db2e63f071.summary: New `yield-experiment.ts` defines basis-point allocation logic for control, shadow, and treatment arms using FNV-1a hashing. `axiom-only-log.ts` adds bounded `yield_shadow_*` and `yield_live_*` fields to track provider states and outcomes without exposing raw scores or identifiers. `imprezia-client.ts` updates `postToImprezia` to return HTTP status, accept `AbortSignal`, and emit `ImpreziaChatAdOutcome` telemetry. Live routing relies on stable configuration keys and strict validation to prevent accidental enablement.

2cf1163dc72fd40df1b7d56a4ed94d668116dc47.title: Fix Imprezia client 403 logging and body timeout
2cf1163dc72fd40df1b7d56a4ed94d668116dc47.summary: Refactored `postToImprezia` in `common/src/util/imprezia-client.ts` to handle non-2xx responses and body consumption inside the main try block. This ensures `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` and caller abort signals remain active until the response body is fully consumed, preventing indefinite hangs on stalled Imprezia responses. The 403 forbidden path now logs a specific warning about publisher account enablement rather than treating it as a generic API error.

0591414315966ad5f2442f39de7c0ca6a9478558.title: ADPOSTPAIDDEFAULTCREDITLINECENTS lowered to 10000
0591414315966ad5f2442f39de7c0ca6a9478558.summary: Default postpaid credit line constant `AD_POSTPAID_DEFAULT_CREDIT_LINE_CENTS` reduced from 25,000 to 10,000 cents. Adjusts the maximum unpaid placement spend allowed after an advertiser saves a card. Change applies to `common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts`.

f68e7ca5489c3652786a98440b44dc36b95d9176.title: BudgetGlide deterministic daily cap taper
f68e7ca5489c3652786a98440b44dc36b95d9176.summary: Added `BudgetGlide` interface and `glidedDailyBudgetCents` function to `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts`. This implements a linear daily budget taper with deterministic jitter, using an FNV-1a hash of campaign seed and date to prevent predictable cap changes. `effectiveDailyBudgetCents` gates the taper, applying it only to non-subscription campaigns to avoid altering billed prices.

5c250334a319ef47c7ae2d5653ec7f062e1eead1.title: Placements launch promo constants added to freebuff-topups
5c250334a319ef47c7ae2d5653ec7f062e1eead1.summary: Added AD_PROMO_MATCH_MILESTONES_CENTS, AD_PROMO_MATCH_GRANT_CENTS, AD_PROMO_REFERRER_REWARD_CENTS, and related constants to common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts. New AD_SPEND_LEDGER_REASONS entries promo_credit and promo_reversal added. statementKindForReason and isCreditReason updated to handle these new reasons. Promo credit expires in 60 days; referrer reward capped at 10.

adbcb4e4a515334bd3f46580fe8188ba3d27bf84.title: ADPROMOQUALIFYCENTS gates referral reward at $100 spend
adbcb4e4a515334bd3f46580fe8188ba3d27bf84.summary: AD_PROMO_QUALIFY_CENTS constant added to freebuff-topups.ts, setting qualification threshold to $100. AD_PROMO_MATCH_MILESTONES_CENTS updated to single-element array [10_000], replacing previous [25_000, 50_000]. AD_PROMO_MATCH_GRANT_CENTS raised from 25_000 to 50_000. Referral reward now requires $100 collected and spent on active, reviewed campaign before $500 credit issued.

4ff202b7d262eb975b755a5da73965c661801cc6.title: Freebuff upgrade hints on rate limits, plan hours copy
4ff202b7d262eb975b755a5da73965c661801cc6.summary: Added `FreebuffUpgradeHint` type and `upgrade` field to `rate_limited` and `spend_limited` server responses in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`, carrying `url` and `message` to direct users to plan upgrades. Introduced `freebuffPlanHours` and `freebuffPlanHoursSummary` helpers in `common/src/constants/freebuff-subscriptions.ts` to standardize allowance copy as hours rather than ambiguous session counts. Replaced hardcoded 'compute' with `FREEBUFF_SPEND_UNIT_LABEL` constant set to 'tokens' in monthly spend disclaimers. These changes centralize upgrade messaging and unit labeling across core shared constants and session types.

47c4bf8cf7f311a30adfb47f4ca09d914cc3ce9a.title: Add postpaid credit, CPC floors, collection ledger reasons
47c4bf8cf7f311a30adfb47f4ca09d914cc3ce9a.summary: Added AD_POSTPAID_DEFAULT_CREDIT_LINE_CENTS (25000), AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_FLOOR_CENTS (100), and reprice guards (2500 bps max move, 50 min clicks) to freebuff-topups.ts. Extended AD_SPEND_LEDGER_REASONS with 'collection', 'collection_refund', 'collection_chargeback' and AD_STATEMENT_KINDS with 'payment' to support card-on-file collection against negative postpaid balances. statementKindForReason maps 'collection' to 'payment' and the new refund/chargeback variants to 'adjustment'; isCreditReason now treats 'collection' as a credit. AD_PLACEMENT_COLLECTION_RETENTION_DAYS set to 180 to preserve provenance through Stripe exposure windows.

6f7cf660e827d750b278497432eebfa763ca58e5.title: Imprezia Display Ads API integration
6f7cf660e827d750b278497432eebfa763ca58e5.summary: Added `common/src/util/imprezia-display.ts` to support Imprezia's `/v1/display` endpoint, enabling ads on non-chat surfaces like the Desktop new-tab screen. Unlike the chat API, this endpoint is origin-gated and requires a specific `Origin` header (`https://freebuff.com`) to avoid 403 errors. The shared `impreziaBeaconTokenSchema` was exported from `imprezia-ad.ts` to maintain token consistency across both ad types, while `imprezia-client.ts` was refactored to handle the new display transport logic.
