The fix applies only to the CLI self-update integration test environment on Windows platforms.

17d6db8ba087352b631923ba3e14852fcbc18b9d.title: Add published self-update integration test script
17d6db8ba087352b631923ba3e14852fcbc18b9d.summary: New script `cli/scripts/test-published-self-update.ts` added to verify CLI self-update flow across supported targets (linux-x64, darwin-arm64, etc.). Script installs specific npm launcher versions, simulates binary extraction/metadata checks, and validates update paths. Release package version bumped to `0.0.137` in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. Ensures self-update mechanism integrity for distributed CLI binaries.

59b71a2329ee96e2378ae589e09694cfa02eee4a.title: Deprecate stepPrompt field, use tags for step instructions
59b71a2329ee96e2378ae589e09694cfa02eee4a.summary: Removed `stepPrompt` from agent definitions and `ephemeralTrailingMessageBreaksCache` logic. Step instructions now injected via `userMessage` with `STEP_PROMPT` tag and `timeToLive: 'agentStep'`. Context pruner no longer preserves resident step prompts. Covers `base2`, `base-deep`, `context-pruner`, `run-agent-step`, and `freebuff-gemini-thinker` constants.

817391fb58001b3bc24fbc42be479676d265d7d0.title: Unify spawned agent transcript boundaries
817391fb58001b3bc24fbc42be479676d265d7d0.summary: Spawned agents receive identical transcripts across programmatic and streamed paths by slicing history at the spawning `toolCallId`. Legacy `SUBAGENT_SPAWN` announcements removed; `filterUnfinishedToolCalls` retained for provider safety. Inline agents track inherited messages via local `Set<Message>` to prevent double-appending during finalization. Affects `spawn-agent-utils.ts`, `stream-parser.ts`, `tool-executor.ts`.

7335066f45ad29fa39ad3f09fa84c45ab1aca737.title: base-chat switches to DeepSeek direct model id
7335066f45ad29fa39ad3f09fa84c45ab1aca737.summary: base-chat agent definition now uses FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID instead of the legacy Fireworks wire id. The shared completions API retains support for the retired id but routes it to DeepSeek direct, ensuring new chat code avoids the deprecated path. Context window mappings in agents/base-chat.ts and common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts updated to reflect the direct provider. The legacy id remains text-only during staggered deployment to prevent catalog mismatches.

32b7907dfe18e9fd79fac194172c07fcc816edda.title: Terminal command broker cleanup and recovery
32b7907dfe18e9fd79fac194172c07fcc816edda.summary: Terminal command broker now signals completion before reaping its own process group, preventing parent CLI renderer thread blocks on Windows during taskkill. Added `createTerminalCommandBroker` factory and standardized recovery error messages to guide users to restart or switch terminals. SDK `run-terminal-command` implements bounded escalation with `waitForProcessExit` to handle zombie processes and descendants ignoring SIGTERM without infinite waits.

8f24a429cd6addf8fb858155634ef5241fea86b4.title: Context pruner budget raised to 400k for 1M window models
8f24a429cd6addf8fb858155634ef5241fea86b4.summary: Context pruner default `maxContextLength` raised from 200k to 400k in `agents/context-pruner.ts`, with a new `contextPrunerBudgetForModel` helper in `common/src/constants/model-config.ts` enforcing a 250k limit for 262,144-token models like `kimiK27Code` and `openrouter_tencent_hy3`. The change aligns the summarization trigger with the ~1M token windows of served models, accounting for GPT-4o estimator undercounting provider-specific tokenizers. MiniMax M3 remains at 400k despite a 524,288 enforced limit, as the budget stays safely below it. `agents/base2/base2.ts` now consumes the helper to pre-serialize `handleSteps` variants per budget, with a strict union return type preventing silent fallthroughs.

a0d5b7f05d51dd5c0638193e6bff94151af278ee.title: Block l0veyou.com and pumpkinai.space in disposable email list
a0d5b7f05d51dd5c0638193e6bff94151af278ee.summary: Added l0veyou.com, pumpkinai.space, and pumpkinai.it.com to DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS in common/src/util/disposable-email.ts. This blocks a 48-account free-mode compute ring observed on 2026-08-01, which used catch-all domains with deceptive subdomains (e.g., gmail.l0veyou.com) and random local parts. The change applies to the shared core utility, affecting all surfaces that rely on this list for registration or abuse prevention.

e183deaed6c794aacff15662a87d41c98e3201d1.title: Add session heartbeat constants
e183deaed6c794aacff15662a87d41c98e3201d1.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_HEARTBEAT_HEADER` and `FREEBUFF_SESSION_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS` to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. These enable per-tab liveness beats to manage concurrency slots without dropping clients during brief network blips. The server's liveness TTL is a multiple of the 45-second interval, ensuring only quiet rows release slots.

2ae66743c3896cfb8f44812cf9643807c513fd59.title: Add test budget and global state guidance to docs/testing.md
2ae66743c3896cfb8f44812cf9643807c513fd59.summary: docs/testing.md adds guidance on machine-global test subjects and polling helper budgets. Explains that `orphan-reaper` tests require atomic `mkdir` locks due to shared process table state. Introduces `test/support/budgets.ts` to enforce that `waitFor` deadlines remain shorter than test budgets, preventing unattributed unhandled errors.

cc568bb92ddf1d15ac7be8b35e078a80670a6563.title: openai/gpt-5.6-luna context window set to 1M
cc568bb92ddf1d15ac7be8b35e078a80670a6563.summary: Added `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` to `CONTEXT_WINDOWS` in `agents/base-chat.ts` and `FREEBUFF_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOWS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` with a 1,000,000 token limit. Previously, Luna fell back to `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW` (131k), causing a 52k budget and premature summarization on a million-token model. Setting 1M yields exactly 400k budget at the 0.4 multiplier, preventing unnecessary history rewrites and prompt cache invalidation.

115d80be38b93542912a3bb3cb0ed85f67f48290.title: docs: update CI flake handling for unit vs integration suites
115d80be38b93542912a3bb3cb0ed85f67f48290.summary: Updated `docs/testing.md` to clarify that unit suites now fail on retry, while integration suites only generate a `Flaky suite` warning. This change reflects measured CI data where retries rescued integration tests (Postgres containers) but never unit logic, enforcing stricter flake detection for unit tests. The documentation also notes that `max_attempts` remains 3 for unit tests to distinguish flaky from broken suites, and emphasizes that CI runners do not apply resource contention.

612e2a39e0355c12169f3dd37ce5e3bf09942e02.title: New shared thread title util
612e2a39e0355c12169f3dd37ce5e3bf09942e02.summary: Added `common/src/util/thread-title.ts` to centralize thread title generation logic. Includes prompts, sanitization, and length constraints for consistent UI labels. Dependency-free design enables imports by desktop server, renderer, and web API. `sanitizeThreadTitle` strips quotes/punctuation and truncates to 60 chars.

13b1cfee56ea86d90e68a05afbb0399cc5c062a5.title: GPT-5.6 prompt cache fix via resident step prompt
13b1cfee56ea86d90e68a05afbb0399cc5c062a5.summary: Adds `ephemeralTrailingMessageBreaksCache` in `model-config.ts` to detect GPT-5.6's strict implicit breakpoint caching. `run-agent-step.ts` skips per-step ephemeral prompt appends for affected models, while `loopAgentSteps` places a single resident `STEP_PROMPT` per turn. This prevents trailing message deletion from shattering the cache prefix, restoring ~100% cache hit rates vs the ~63% baseline.

ae8c38c6a145ee540ec48aea9027714917d9da36.title: Add offer-gate invariant tests for CLI model picker
ae8c38c6a145ee540ec48aea9027714917d9da36.summary: New `freebuff-offer-invariants.ts` test module enforces that every model offered by a picker is accepted by downstream gates, preventing 400 errors like the recent GLM 5.2 desktop bug. The CLI `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` exports `freebuffCliOfferedModelIds` to provide the real set of offered IDs (grid + referral banner) to this invariant check. Scope includes `common/src/testing` and `cli/src/components`. The check validates `offered ⊆ accepted` but allows reverse drift to support staged model retirement.

3e5be71544b2879899a0dea5162bf6f7e8195bcb.title: Add capacity-limited Claude Fable 5 trial to CLI picker
3e5be71544b2879899a0dea5162bf6f7e8195bcb.summary: Introduces `base2-free-fable` orchestrator and `anthropic/claude-fable-5` model ID for a server-gated trial. The CLI picker now renders an `offer` section driven by `limitedModelOffers` from the session response, dropping unknown IDs to prevent half-labelled rows. `use-freebuff-session` carries over offer state to avoid UI flicker and injects a system message if the user misses the capacity wave, falling back to the standard model. The root agent is unconditionally listed in `FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS` to prevent 403s on subagents when the pool empties mid-session.

ef5190fe8024ca729df82dfa11c847354a3ca279.title: Fix CLI AVX2 crash recovery and EDR watchdog
ef5190fe8024ca729df82dfa11c847354a3ca279.summary: Launcher persists illegal-instruction crashes to prevent retrying the AVX2 build. Terminal watchdog adds `CODEBUFF_NO_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` to bypass PowerShell spawns flagged by EDR. Theme detection removes Windows PowerShell probes that triggered Defender alerts, forcing a 'dark' fallback.

a03e7a8ef057c6b8e9b3c63592e96ab176ea479d.title: Version bump to 0.0.135
a03e7a8ef057c6b8e9b3c63592e96ab176ea479d.summary: Package version updated to 0.0.135 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. This reflects a standard release increment for the CLI package. Scope limited to release metadata.

062743b69a890d6f0e6efba5b3806cd8f6cad036.title: CLI model selector always shows Images badge
062743b69a890d6f0e6efba5b3806cd8f6cad036.summary: Updated `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to unconditionally append the ' · Images' suffix to model taglines, removing the `m.multimodal` conditional check. This change ensures every model row displays the image capability indicator, reflecting that text-only models utilize server-side vision substitution (`web/src/llm-api/describe-images.ts`) to process pasted screenshots. The label length calculations (`compactLabelLen`, `fullLabelLen`) were adjusted to always include the 9-character suffix length.

a5cb80f3d735b96b63f2fc075689ab4ed9955056.title: Superseded model steering applies on every load
a5cb80f3d735b96b63f2fc075689ab4ed9955056.summary: Replaced one-time migration logic with unconditional steering in `cli/src/utils/settings.ts` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. Removed `FREEBUFF_MODEL_PREFERENCE_MIGRATION_ID` and `freebuffModelMigration` settings key to ensure every session starts on the recommended model (V4 Flash) if the saved preference is superseded (DeepSeek V4 Pro, MiniMax M3, MiMo 2.5). Added `supersededBy` metadata to MiMo 2.5 in the constants file. This change affects CLI and Shared/Core surfaces, ensuring stale defaults do not persist across launches.

d5ca1376e2a658169fc355905b29159d5af6a85a.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 replaces M3 in CLI picker
d5ca1376e2a658169fc355905b29159d5af6a85a.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 GA build added with `isNew` badge and `supersededBy` link from MiniMax M3. CLI `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` renders the badge and gates `supersededNoticeFor` to the selected row only. `settings.ts` adds one-time `freebuffModelMigration` via `migrateSupersededFreebuffModelPreference` to shift saved M3/V4 Pro preferences to Flash. `freebuff-models.ts` exposes the migration id and marks M3/V4 Pro as `FREEBUFF_WEB_DEEMPHASIZED_MODEL_IDS`.

31ac8a0f82d45b3a6f82a46a9be1a4c6b8ad3b11.title: ipcapped session status and freebuff root prompt openings
31ac8a0f82d45b3a6f82a46a9be1a4c6b8ad3b11.summary: Added ip_capped status to Freebuff session API and CLI. Triggers when distinct users on egress IP exceed FREEBUFF_IP_USER_CAP. Existing sessions continue; new admissions blocked. Includes FREEBUFF_ROOT_SYSTEM_PROMPT_OPENINGS constant for byte-exact prompt validation.

6e1168a960e83d3c2651c6765b504f45f0d091b9.title: Cloud planner switches to DeepSeek V4 Flash for all tiers
6e1168a960e83d3c2651c6765b504f45f0d091b9.summary: CLOUD_PLANNER_MODEL_ID in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts now points to FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID, replacing MiniMax M3 for full-access plans. The V4-Flash-0731 GA build offers superior coding and tool-use performance at lower cost, eliminating the previous quality-vs-cost tradeoff for planning. Consequently, cloudPlannerAgentIdForModel ignores its model argument and always returns CLOUD_PLANNER_AGENT_ID, as both variants now pin the same model. The limited variant remains registered to resolve in-flight sessions but is safe to remove once none are active.

ef75fd7a27e09c75d822efcfdaa28b023a03e31f.title: CLI hides pre-milestone streak notes and reorders free model picker
ef75fd7a27e09c75d822efcfdaa28b023a03e31f.summary: CLI landing screen now hides streak bonus notes for streaks under 7 days, showing them only after a week is earned. This prevents the dedicated note row from crowding the model picker on compact terminals. The change gates the note via a new check for FREEBUFF_STREAK_WEEK in cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts. Additionally, GPT_5_6_LUNA_MODEL now precedes MINIMAX_M3_MODEL in the FREEBUFF_MODELS array.

f388f14e2b1dcafb2a95799598ceb7e7ac511c24.title: Remove Press Enter cue and center supersede notice in CLI model picker
f388f14e2b1dcafb2a95799598ceb7e7ac511c24.summary: Removed redundant right-aligned `Press Enter ↵` cue from `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to reclaim ~17 columns of dead space per card. The `FLASH_SUPERSEDES_NOTICE` constant in `freebuff-models.ts` replaces inline notices for `DeepSeek V4 Pro`, `Mimo V25`, and `Minimax M3`, now centered on line 3 to prevent width stretching. Cards size to their widest line, with no reserved gutter beyond content.

3a7b54b212bfe45eafb19525bbf52041f9b3a6c9.title: Tmux CLI and Cloud Build switch to DeepSeek V4 Flash
3a7b54b212bfe45eafb19525bbf52041f9b3a6c9.summary: agents/tmux-cli.ts and common/src/constants/free-agents.ts replace MiniMax M3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro with FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID. This aligns terminal-driven sessions with the root model to prevent silent M3 billing and leverages the V4-Flash-0731 GA build for cost-effective coding. Scope covers the Tmux CLI agent definition and the CLOUD_BUILD_MODEL_ID constant. The hand-off still admits a new model-locked session via BlankCloudPlanControls.beginBuild, as session reuse remains invalid despite the shared model ID.

0cda526a6c5bbf6cab64dafb874a9774ac1a4299.title: Fix Windows path pruning and warn on truncated glob scans
0cda526a6c5bbf6cab64dafb874a9774ac1a4299.summary: Glob tool now emits a warning when the file tree scan hits DEFAULT_MAX_FILES, clarifying that empty results stem from truncation rather than missing files. Internally, `project-file-tree.ts` enforces POSIX path normalization via `toPosixPath` before passing paths to the `ignore` library, preventing Windows backslashes from bypassing `.gitignore` pruning rules. This ensures nested directories like `node_modules` are correctly excluded on Windows, preserving the file budget for source code. Changes affect `common/src/project-file-tree.ts` and `sdk/src/tools/glob.ts`.

76d27eac43c54991622be0ff4b8eae09ee27183f.title: v0.0.134 CLI release package bump
76d27eac43c54991622be0ff4b8eae09ee27183f.summary: Version incremented to 0.0.134 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. Reflects standard release cycle progression from 0.0.133. Scope limited to CLI release packaging metadata.

fe2f293cfec04f7effa3601e4719d8d5583b81a2.title: Windows system prompt enforces bash over cmd.exe
fe2f293cfec04f7effa3601e4719d8d5583b81a2.summary: System prompt updated to specify bash execution on Windows, replacing legacy cmd.exe/PowerShell instructions. Directs agent to use POSIX syntax (`ls`, `mv`, `rm`) and forward slashes, explicitly forbidding Windows native commands and PowerShell cmdlets. Mechanism addresses path corruption caused by bash interpreting backslashes as escape characters. Scope limited to `packages/agent-runtime/src/system-prompt/prompts.ts`.

b15fef86116ef07524649f8b6ffd5027e0bee774.title: Freebuff CLI version bumped to 0.0.133
b15fef86116ef07524649f8b6ffd5027e0bee774.summary: Version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` incremented from 0.0.132 to 0.0.133. Release metadata update for CLI distribution.

d248ecc5ad5aafd3b80a52ed21c4244e0aa849d6.title: SkillMetadataSchema accepts nested values, description clamped
d248ecc5ad5aafd3b80a52ed21c4244e0aa849d6.summary: SkillMetadataSchema changed from z.record(z.string(), z.string()) to z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) and description validation switched from rejection to clamping via .transform(). This prevents valid skills with nested metadata (e.g., skills.sh hermes: blocks) from being rejected and allows over-long descriptions to load truncated. Affects common/src/types/skill.ts. Over-long descriptions are sliced to SKILL_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH instead of failing validation.

5d8bc0232add269427599ffd4f928ee6a4786f52.title: Referral GLM selectable outside picker and cache split by access tier
5d8bc0232add269427599ffd4f928ee6a4786f52.summary: Referral GLM is selectable outside renderedModelIds in the CLI picker when unlocked with remaining weekly sessions, while resolveFreebuffModelForAccessTier widens its return type to include FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_MODEL_ID for full tier. The referral cache moves from a single lastKnownReferral slot to a per-tier referralByAccessTier map, since full- and limited-tier blocks carry different meanings; a clean none response clears stale metadata for that tier instead of retaining the cached landing value. Covers cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx, cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts, cli/src/utils/freebuff-referral-cache.ts, cli/src/utils/settings.ts, and common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. saveFreebuffModelPreference now guards with isFreebuffModelId so referral-only and retired session models are never persisted as the next-launch default.

ab4919394f7cd07cc1f360e48f04b600a1f6d40a.title: CLI modellocked now ends stale session on explicit pick
ab4919394f7cd07cc1f360e48f04b600a1f6d40a.summary: Explicit model picks hitting server-side model_locked now trigger a DELETE to end the stale session and re-claim on the requested model, replacing the prior silent local revert. This addresses recurring bug reports where clicks on GLM 5.2 or DeepSeek V4 Flash appeared ignored due to 1-hour idle session locks. Scoped to cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts; background rejoins still revert silently. The consume-once explicit-pick marker prevents infinite retry loops, and DELETE failures fall through to a revert path with updated chat messaging.

f3e3cce8abe081a471cdf9fbd525426f7fba600f.title: Fix CLI model selector layout and focus in limited mode
f3e3cce8abe081a471cdf9fbd525426f7fba600f.summary: Freebuff CLI model selector now retains standalone recommendation in limited mode and forces expansion when async session snapshots reduce available models. Full-access expanded views group all rows under quota-bearing section headers, removing redundant per-row tier chips. Focus remains bound to the recommendation during expand/collapse toggles, preventing silent focus shifts. Layout height estimation uses `Math.max` of predicted and measured content to prevent clipping during asynchronous state updates.

b1f68e07ef57b84fe337023718d350a96ec2305b.title: Remove Kimi K2.7 Code from Freebuff free mode
b1f68e07ef57b84fe337023718d350a96ec2305b.summary: Kimi K2.7 Code (`moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code`) is removed from all free-mode agent definitions and model allowlists in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts`. This follows a hidden state from 2026-07-30 that failed to stop older CLI clients from using it, causing significant free-mode spend. All remaining free-mode requests for this model now return 403 `free_mode_invalid_agent_model`. DeepSeek V4 Flash becomes the recommended free model, marked as superseding DeepSeek V4 Pro via a new `supersededBy` field in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`.

7c831448a6e554c45b87894487ebe7421385045f.title: Drop WSL bash fallback from Windows bash resolution
7c831448a6e554c45b87894487ebe7421385045f.summary: findWindowsBash in sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts removes WSL bash as a fallback candidate. The WSL launcher at C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe exists without a distro, causing cryptic failures on VM state, quoting, and UTF-16. Resolution now checks CODEBUFF_GIT_BASH_PATH, machine-wide Git paths, non-WSL PATH, and bash beside git.exe for per-user installs. The Windows error message drops the WSL option.

2de7fe6b96aee8b402f989d9b1456d7e4f1259eb.title: Version bump to 0.0.132
2de7fe6b96aee8b402f989d9b1456d7e4f1259eb.summary: Version incremented from 0.0.131 to 0.0.132 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No other changes detected in the provided diff.

bfead8065f4f0e68f6247fa51973c73185d00525.title: GPT-5.6 Luna added to Freebuff free model picker
bfead8065f4f0e68f6247fa51973c73185d00525.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna (`openai/gpt-5.6-luna`) added to free model picker and agent registry. High reasoning effort enabled by default via shared constants. Routing pinned to OpenAI endpoint with strict price ceiling ($0.10/$0.60 per M) to prevent 10x billing from Azure/Bedrock fallbacks. Scoped to FREEBUFF traffic to avoid side effects on Codebuff's paid lite mode.

9f80be02582ab23c45aa4fd7adf8370b2613ad92.title: Kimi K2.7 Code removed from client picker due to cost
9f80be02582ab23c45aa4fd7adf8370b2613ad92.summary: Kimi K2.7 Code is removed from FREEBUFF_MODELS client catalog. Too expensive for free tier; remains in SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS server allowlist. Settings validation switches from isSupportedFreebuffModelId to isFreebuffModelId, dropping retired model selections. Covers CLI, Web, Desktop via common constants and README updates.

66199cc009297b239aa41cf46b945195a7a528a6.title: freebuff bumped to 0.0.131
66199cc009297b239aa41cf46b945195a7a528a6.summary: Package version incremented from 0.0.130 to 0.0.131 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Routine release bump.

254c227edee9d656de7fc74312468062e17f7a1e.title: CLI explains modellocked rejections for explicit picks
254c227edee9d656de7fc74312468062e17f7a1e.summary: CLI now surfaces a system message when a deliberate model switch hits `model_locked`, instead of silently reverting. `use-freebuff-session.ts` tracks the last explicit pick and consumes the marker on the first response to distinguish user actions from background rejoins. Scope limited to CLI session hook. Message instructs users to run `/end-session` before switching, noting 1-hour idle timeout.

1ba142d747a1c095f2be79abe6b6adefad0c2a28.title: Desktop multi-session limits and counts
1ba142d747a1c095f2be79abe6b6adefad0c2a28.summary: Desktop unlimited bucket allows up to 3 concurrent sessions, enforced via soft gate and chat-completions session gate. Premium bucket remains 1, enforced by database partial unique index. New `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_SESSION_LIMITS` constant and `getFreebuffDesktopSessionBucket` helper in `freebuff-models.ts`. Server responses now include `desktopSessionCounts` with live per-user totals and `nextExpiryAt` for capacity release timing.

c22abe9a8900d52fac3c91bd1d12f407e631be0c.title: Luna maxprice raised to $0.50/$3.00 to fix strict OpenRouter 404s
c22abe9a8900d52fac3c91bd1d12f407e631be0c.summary: FREEBUFF_GPT_5_6_LUNA_MAX_PRICE in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts increased from $0.10/$0.60 to $0.50/$3.00 per million tokens. Previous exact list prices triggered OpenRouter strict comparison failures (404 No endpoints found), verified against live API on 2026-07-30. New values sit above list but well below Azure/Bedrock ($1.00/$6.00+) to maintain cost fence while allowing OpenAI priority tiers and drift.

5b8b58dbe1bc8498ac86a6e8aaa8e6311e86331f.title: Remove GLM 5.2 referral cap; retire legacy premium route
5b8b58dbe1bc8498ac86a6e8aaa8e6311e86331f.summary: Uncapped GLM 5.2 referral rewards. Removed `FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_REFERRAL_CAP` from `freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` and `freebuff-referral-tiers.ts`. `qualifiedCount` now displays earned sessions directly without max state. Legacy `FREEBUFF_CROF_GLM_V52_MODEL_ID` retired from picker but kept in `FREEBUFF_WEB_MODELS` for active sessions.

6cc0c94c19331c4a4009587d3b698916f00f9f0a.title: Referral tiers removed, sessions-only reward
6cc0c94c19331c4a4009587d3b698916f00f9f0a.summary: Removed `FREEBUFF_REFERRAL_TIERS` ladder, `getReferralTier`, `getTierLimits`, `getNextReferralTier`, and watermark constants from `common/src/constants/freebuff-referral-tiers.ts`. Referral reward now only grants +1 daily GLM 5.2 session (FULL tier, uncapped) or +1 daily free session (LIMITED tier, capped at `REFERRAL_CLI_DAILY_SESSION_BONUS_CAP`). Old web tier daily message limits were never enforced (real limits live in `freebuff-models.ts`) and the deploy watermark is globally disabled via `prod_branding_injection_enabled = false`. File retains only qualification machinery: GitHub account-age bars, attribution windows, and anti-farming ceilings.

f8a40d8bdea49062791c965233871dac46f9505d.title: freebuff CLI 0.0.130
f8a40d8bdea49062791c965233871dac46f9505d.summary: freebuff CLI bumped to 0.0.130. Version increment in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No functional changes.

f5526661a4291076b5784de328a4ddb405831935.title: GLM 5.2 referral pool shifts to daily resets with streak bonuses
f5526661a4291076b5784de328a4ddb405831935.summary: GLM 5.2 referral session pool resets daily (Pacific) instead of weekly, effective 2026-07-29. Full-access users earn +1 GLM session per 7-day streak tier (capped at 4) on top of referral caps. `FREEBUFF_GLM_V52_SESSION_PERIOD` now aliases `pacific_day`; `weeklySessionsRemaining` field name retained for wire compatibility. New `disposable-email.ts` utility flags throwaway domains in referral abuse detection.

faee98a2042d0b024219330c1f6ae2f6df89cff0.title: Compact image indicator in CLI model selector
faee98a2042d0b024219330c1f6ae2f6df89cff0.summary: Appends ' · Images' to the tagline on line 1 for multimodal models in freebuff-model-selector.tsx, preventing it from occupying a separate line. This change addresses layout inefficiency by integrating the indicator directly into the existing tagline string. The modification affects the CLI component's rendering logic for both compact and standard modes. Width calculation functions now include a 9-character suffix length for multimodal models to ensure proper alignment.

159673adf8f8dd060344460862f309b21986134f.title: MiMo and MiniMax model taglines updated
159673adf8f8dd060344460862f309b21986134f.summary: Updated model taglines in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. `MiMo 2.5 Pro` changed to 'Smart & Slow', `MiMo 2.5` to 'Balanced', and `MiniMax M3` to 'Fastest'. These changes affect the user-visible descriptions in the model picker across Web, CLI, and Desktop.

ff0629f1f1b73fec52d0107117f3c27cc46c389f.title: Add projectIndex option to SDK run()
ff0629f1f1b73fec52d0107117f3c27cc46c389f.summary: Adds optional `projectIndex` to `run()` and `initialSessionState` in `sdk/src/run.ts` and `sdk/src/run-state.ts`. Hosts can precompute the file tree and token scores using `computeProjectIndexFromFiles` and pass them back to skip per-run tree-sitter parsing. The new option is ignored if `projectFiles` is absent. This reduces CPU and WASM memory overhead for hosts running multiple sessions over the same files.

25b2071a417f2e28570f4f40d4cfede17d45a0e7.title: Add TTFT histogram util for additive latency rollups
25b2071a417f2e28570f4f40d4cfede17d45a0e7.summary: New `common/src/util/ttft-histogram.ts` defines log-scale bucketing for time-to-first-token samples. Percentiles are non-additive, so storing histograms per hour/model allows summable rollups for the /latency dashboard. Geometric buckets (BASE 1.03, 512 count) ensure ±1.5% relative error, preserving rank order. Constants are baked into `message_latency_bucket` rows; changing them requires re-rolling retained windows.

65f20efb85fbaa7d2ec42f484fbbf9b39c57f751.title: GLM 5.2 CrofAI route promoted to premium with daily quota
65f20efb85fbaa7d2ec42f484fbbf9b39c57f751.summary: CrofAI GLM 5.2 (`crof/glm-5.2`) moved from god-mode-only to full-access Web/Cloud premium selection in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`. It bypasses the shared premium pool, using a new dedicated daily limit (`FREEBUFF_CROF_GLM_V52_SESSION_LIMIT = 1`) to ensure users get one GLM session per Pacific day alongside their standard allowance. The model is excluded from geo-exempt lists, restricting access to full regions, and classified as `service` data use to avoid provider-side training.

075723dbdc661304e710e2b305277f3acfef3101.title: CrofAI GLM 5.2 moves to shared premium pool
075723dbdc661304e710e2b305277f3acfef3101.summary: CrofAI GLM 5.2 (`crof/glm-5.2`) now draws from the shared daily premium pool (`FREEBUFF_WEB_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS`) instead of its dedicated one-session-per-day quota. The isolated pool constants (`FREEBUFF_CROF_GLM_V52_SESSION_*`) were removed, and the model tagline updated to 'Strong all-rounder'. New helper functions `isFreebuffWebRememberableModelId` and `resolveRememberedFreebuffWebModel` prevent both GLM 5.2 routes from being saved as the default model in localStorage, forcing a fallback to DeepSeek V4 Pro on fresh loads.

f377278c442149319ba818d05791b4012b9cf3b5.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro replaces MiniMax M3 as default free model
f377278c442149319ba818d05791b4012b9cf3b5.summary: DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID switches from MiniMax M3 to DeepSeek V4 Pro in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts, with the new ID exported from freebuff-model-ids.ts. CLI picker and landing screen comments updated to reflect the hero model change. Selector rendering now always places secondary details on an indented second line instead of conditionally on narrow terminals; MIN_SELECTOR_ROWS raised from 3 to 4 to accommodate the two-line card layout. The default model now carries a dataUse 'training' warning rendered in the picker row.

dde3b3223f5082e1ce6c3d890dfaee4a1c5e91f4.title: CLI model selector layout and session counter moves inside scrollbox
dde3b3223f5082e1ce6c3d890dfaee4a1c5e91f4.summary: Session counter now renders inside `freebuff-model-selector` via new `belowToggle` prop, removing it from `freebuff-landing-screen`'s reserved height calculation to prevent viewport shrinkage. `CUE_GAP` increased from 2 to 4 in `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` to separate the focused-row cue from taglines, while line 2 details (warnings/hours) switch from indented to centered alignment. `freebuff-referral-banner.tsx` introduces an `inline` variant for `CopyInviteLinkButton` (no border, color-only focus) used in locked states, distinct from the `bordered` variant in unlocked GLM cards. `firstLabelThatFits` accepts a `chrome` parameter to adjust width calculations based on button variant.

1499a9d866f9946dca7209a07323b0c4b501c60b.title: Remove dedupeClientToolResults from agent runtime
1499a9d866f9946dca7209a07323b0c4b501c60b.summary: Deleted `dedupeClientToolResults` utility and its invocation in `main-prompt.ts`. Client tool results now push directly to `messageHistory` without duplicate filtering. This reverts logic preventing provider errors on repeated `tool_call_id`s during SDK retries. Scope limited to `packages/agent-runtime`.

b81352e298d504578da3e408754a0274dbcbacd2.title: Added DESKTOPWORKTREESRECLAIMED analytics event
b81352e298d504578da3e408754a0274dbcbacd2.summary: Added DESKTOP_WORKTREES_RECLAIMED enum value to common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. Tracks desktop worktree reclamation. Internal telemetry constant only.

d281d6eedd789ca6b8590df20edb4388379408f4.title: Fix unpaired tool calls for media-only outputs
d281d6eedd789ca6b8590df20edb4388379408f4.summary: Media-only tool results now emit an empty JSON tool message alongside the user image message to prevent unpaired tool call failures. Previously, `mediaToolResult` produced only a user message, leaving the assistant's tool call unanswered. The fix ensures tool messages always precede media messages in `common/src/util/messages.ts` to satisfy provider ordering constraints.

6fbfd71dd51c396171b911b5fc3894984e0a3dd9.title: Base2 lite mode uses GPT-5.6-Luna and fixes BuffBench judges
6fbfd71dd51c396171b911b5fc3894984e0a3dd9.summary: Codebuff paid LITE mode now runs `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` via `LITE_MODEL` in `agents/constants.ts`, replacing previous DeepSeek usage. Freebuff free modes remain on MiniMax M3, with `code-reviewer-lite` restricted to wire compatibility only. BuffBench judging switched from a silent-failing 3-judge panel to explicit `judge-gpt` and `judge-sonnet` averaging, preventing single-model bias when Gemini judges 403.

c8e487a6246813b34d1f8a6942bef69352c80bc4.title: Cloud planner moves to MiniMax M3 with build split
c8e487a6246813b34d1f8a6942bef69352c80bc4.summary: CLOUD_PLANNER_MODEL_ID switches from DeepSeek V4 Pro to MiniMax M3, while new CLOUD_BUILD_MODEL_ID keeps builds on DeepSeek V4 Pro. The split prevents session_model_mismatch errors during hand-off, as sessions are model-locked. Limited regions retain LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID for both planning and building. A new FREEBUFF_CLOUD_PLANNER_TURN_LIMIT of 12 caps abuse of the free premium chat surface.

ac163119e1412375e526494c81ec179739f4ced4.title: Add Web/Cloud model default and de-emphasis constants
ac163119e1412375e526494c81ec179739f4ced4.summary: Added `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_WEB_MODEL_ID` (DeepSeek V4 Pro) and `getRecommendedFreebuffWebModelId` for Web/Cloud pickers, separate from CLI/Desktop default (MiniMax M3). DeepSeek V4 Pro chosen for cost-efficiency in high-token browser surfaces. `FREEBUFF_WEB_DEEMPHASIZED_MODEL_IDS` mutes MiniMax M3 and Kimi K2.7 in Web picker. Web pickers must render DeepSeek V4 Pro's `warning` due to `dataUse: 'training'`.

24c1a306f8c6654c7412241acd117c8074af5831.title: Shorten policy notice summary in freebuff-data-use
24c1a306f8c6654c7412241acd117c8074af5831.summary: The policy notice summary string in `common/src/constants/freebuff-data-use.ts` was shortened by removing detailed usage restriction clauses. The text now concisely covers prompt usage, AI training, and updated restrictions without listing account limits, automated use, direct endpoint access, or location spoofing. This change affects the shared core constants used across all Freebuff surfaces.

9b8ffc8ef8c48601dc234a57e45ebc83b498a5f5.title: Add Ling 3.0 Flash and switch planner to DeepSeek V4 Pro
9b8ffc8ef8c48601dc234a57e45ebc83b498a5f5.summary: Adds `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash:free` to `FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODELS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, tagged `experimental` with `dataUse: 'training'` due to OpenRouter provider retention risks. Updates `CLOUD_PLANNER_MODEL_ID` to `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MODEL_ID` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`, replacing MiniMax M3. Bumps CLI version to `0.0.129` in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`.

cb202d14e1327ee923368b2dc099364b372dac68.title: Add Freebuff Cloud custom-stack planner constants
cb202d14e1327ee923368b2dc099364b372dac68.summary: Exports CLOUD_PLANNER_AGENT_ID and CLOUD_PLANNER_MODEL_ID in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts, pinning full access to MiniMax M3 and limited regions to LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID. Helpers cloudPlannerModelForAccessTier and cloudPlannerAgentIdForModel ensure agent definitions and UI hand-offs agree, preventing session_model_mismatch. Adds FREEBUFF_CLOUD_BLANK_PROJECT_DAILY_LIMIT=5 in freebuff-models.ts to cap blank Cloud projects, mitigating VM boot abuse. Includes new planner IDs in FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS to authorize context-pruner subagents.

977abd5ce06611d6fe900d31310c581dfcd95291.title: docs/testing.md: CI fan-out, typecheck lanes, sdk cache
977abd5ce06611d6fe900d31310c581dfcd95291.summary: docs/testing.md adds a section explaining CI wall-clock halving (10m40s to 5m29s) by removing needs: edges from ci.yml and splitting typecheck from build-web. It documents typecheck-lanes.ts, which derives lanes at runtime because bun 1.3.14 ignores negated --filter arguments, and warns that missing lanes or unmatched filters exit 0 silently. sdk/dist caching via build-sdk action lacks restore-keys to prevent stale SDKs, and freebuff/web now honors SDK_ALREADY_BUILT. The doc notes freebuff-desktop thread-engine.test.ts is the heaviest suite but not on the critical path, and that per-job dependency cache restore (~40s) is now the floor.

622a2a2228556af643a2addd266099af434504f5.title: Add desktop.featureused analytics event
622a2a2228556af643a2addd266099af434504f5.summary: New `DESKTOP_FEATURE_USED` enum value added to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts` to track long-tail desktop feature adoption. The event is added to `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` in `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts`, bypassing sampling to ensure accurate unique-user metrics for rare features. Volume control relies on intent-only emission and per-session deduplication rather than statistical sampling.

2a8c8af1fba063ed768cafb0e9585b8f560a25fe.title: docs/testing.md: baseline staleness and flaky suite annotations
2a8c8af1fba063ed768cafb0e9585b8f560a25fe.summary: docs/testing.md adds guidance on periodic baseline refresh, noting a 307-test gap in `freebuff-desktop` where CI stayed green despite missing tests. New `Flag retried tests` step emits `Flaky suite` warning annotations for pass-on-retry cases. Docs also warn that `Suite ran no tests` is now annotated for empty suites like `test:.agents`, and baselines for DB-backed suites must be recorded from CI runs to account for skipped test count discrepancies.

4fa56551886ce92ff07d05bc42107ed53ae03a5f.title: Add Desktop autorun analytics events
4fa56551886ce92ff07d05bc42107ed53ae03a5f.summary: Added `DESKTOP_AUTORUN_TOGGLED` and `DESKTOP_AUTORUN_SCOPE_SET` to `AnalyticsEvent` in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. These events track user interaction with autorun settings in the Desktop app. Scope limited to shared constants; no CLI or Web impact.

8e956567928c769287011b3a1b8974d8d646631a.title: Per-package bunfig.toml preloads fix silent test-file crashes
8e956567928c769287011b3a1b8974d8d646631a.summary: Added `cli/bunfig.toml` and `common/bunfig.toml` to preload `sdk/test/setup-env.ts` (plus SCM and agents-artifact setup for CLI). Bun reads `bunfig.toml` and `.env` from CWD only, so package-local `bun test` runs saw no root env, causing `@codebuff/common/env.ts` to throw at import. These throws surfaced as invisible "Unhandled error between tests" rather than red failures, silently skipping entire files. `cli/test/setup-agents-artifact.ts` also auto-generates the gitignored `bundled-agents.generated.ts` on demand, recovering ~371 tests that previously died in fresh worktrees.

9b8e85b8d0d50bfc0c1bffe9caa17eee7798d1bf.title: Added desktop.turnbackgroundwait analytics event
9b8e85b8d0d50bfc0c1bffe9caa17eee7798d1bf.summary: Added DESKTOP_TURN_BACKGROUND_WAIT event to distinguish background command waits from unexplained stalls. Background Bash waits emit no stream messages, causing the stall detector to misclassify them as hangs. This event ensures long waits are counted while keeping desktop.turn_stalled reserved for true hangs. Added to ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS in analytics-sampling.ts to prevent sampling loss for rare signals.

a74c20dc1479774fddf8507f9d9d4ca9e7b6d8f9.title: Add flake-hunt documentation and CI workflow details
a74c20dc1479774fddf8507f9d9d4ca9e7b6d8f9.summary: Docs/testing.md adds a guide for `scripts/flake-hunt.ts`, a harness that reproduces CI flakes by running tests concurrently under CPU load. It details three common defects: hardcoded port collisions, polling instead of event listening, and timers leaking across tests. The section explains how to invoke the script with custom rounds and concurrency, and notes the weekly `flake-hunt.yml` workflow runs it against `freebuff-desktop` without blocking PRs.

860318a19c3c2bd12795963a2e50917ca79e0ba5.title: docs/testing.md: shared-state flake patterns
860318a19c3c2bd12795963a2e50917ca79e0ba5.summary: Added documentation describing two shared-state test flakes found in the `cli` package. Root cause was tests writing to fixed paths (`__dirname/temp-test-images` and `os.tmpdir()/codebuff-test-*`) causing race conditions when run in parallel. Fix involves using unique `mkdtemp` directories per test run. CI masked these issues by isolating package suites, affecting only local dev and this harness.

cb153c1518104ed5254b2189f9dd5d5794600fef.title: Add desktop.eventloophealth analytics event
cb153c1518104ed5254b2189f9dd5d5794600fef.summary: New `DESKTOP_EVENT_LOOP_HEALTH` enum value added to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. This event tracks saturation of the orchestrator's single event loop, which serves the renderer bundle, SSE streams, git work, agent turns, terminals, and preview drives. The data distinguishes backend queuing from local orchestrator pinning, addressing recent reports of slow tab opening.

801a9d02c935e19c2f9529d1330b0de6eac555c4.title: Basher short-circuits summarization for short command output
801a9d02c935e19c2f9529d1330b0de6eac555c4.summary: Basher agent now skips LLM summarization when command output is under 2000 chars, returning raw stdout/stderr/message directly. Reduces latency and token usage for routine commands by avoiding unnecessary model round-trips. Changes `agents/basher.ts` prompts and execution logic; respects `stdoutOmittedForLength` flag to ensure truncated outputs are still summarized.

1402b75d5bd6d305c9bb326da1e9fb0c60a4b35e.title: Opus model bump 4.8 to 5 via OPUSMODEL constant
1402b75d5bd6d305c9bb326da1e9fb0c60a4b35e.summary: Opus-tier model upgraded from anthropic/claude-opus-4.8 to anthropic/claude-opus-5. Hardcoded model strings replaced with OPUS_MODEL constant in agents/constants.ts to prevent sync drift. Scope covers base2, editor, reviewer, thinker, and general-agent subsystems. Manual syncing of the 4.7 bump previously left stragglers and outdated docs.

8e2ef71f5db6f210951e6086acaa0618bf80e055.title: Gemini 3.5 flash-lite replaces 3.1 in helper agents
8e2ef71f5db6f210951e6086acaa0618bf80e055.summary: Lightweight helper agents (basher, browser-use, file-lister, file-picker-max, researcher-web, researcher-docs) switched from `GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_LITE_MODEL_ID` to `GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_LITE_MODEL_ID`. `FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS` retains 3.1 in a shared `GEMINI_HELPER_MODELS` set to prevent 403 errors for pinned CLI/Desktop clients that haven't upgraded yet. Scope covers `agents/*.ts` definitions, `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`, and `common/src/constants/gemini.ts`. 3.5 flash-lite costs $0.30/$2.50 per M tokens vs 3.1's $0.25/$1.50, making this a deliberate cost increase for high-volume subagent calls.

d00f185a4d65a008126a1fbe4e4516fbf003414d.title: Remove retired DESKTOPINLINEADPOOLREUSED analytics event
d00f185a4d65a008126a1fbe4e4516fbf003414d.summary: Removed `DESKTOP_INLINE_AD_POOL_REUSED` from `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. The event was retired alongside the head-pool ad model, which now uses inline parts capped by `MAX_MESSAGE_AD_COUNT`. Historical data remains, but no code emits this event on the Desktop surface. The CLI's `cli.inline_ad_pool_reused` sibling continues to fire.

c9bdd9c7b58e05b498d296cf64fcaaa3db54890d.title: Dedupe client tool results to prevent duplicate toolcallid errors
c9bdd9c7b58e05b498d296cf64fcaaa3db54890d.summary: Added dedupeClientToolResults in packages/agent-runtime/src/util/messages.ts and applied it in packages/agent-runtime/src/main-prompt.ts. The runtime now filters client-supplied tool results against existing history to prevent duplicate tool_call_id errors from SDK retries. Only results with new tool_call_ids are appended; duplicates are logged and skipped.

326a33d9c24c462f1640172b775db7a368e84e56.title: cloud-plan-ready summary field description tightened
326a33d9c24c462f1640172b775db7a368e84e56.summary: The `summary` field description in `cloud-plan-ready.ts` was updated to instruct the model to provide a single short user-facing sentence, explicitly directing implementation details to `build_prompt`. This change refines the tool's parameter schema to prevent verbose summaries and ensure better separation of concerns between the user-facing plan overview and the technical implementation prompt.

0ff93e746badad951717b0a70386bf5b24701517.title: Drop orphan tool calls to prevent 400s
0ff93e746badad951717b0a70386bf5b24701517.summary: Added `filterUnfinishedToolCalls` in `run-agent-step.ts` to remove assistant messages with missing tool results before sending to providers. Strict backends like DeepSeek reject these orphans with 400 errors, breaking subsequent turns if persisted. Updated `util/messages.ts` to safely handle non-array content shapes from client session states, preventing 500 crashes. Scope: Agent Runtime core logic.

c731787cd02fea9b5d37c9e5e6fb06c0e3897045.title: CLI poll jitter and exponential backoff
c731787cd02fea9b5d37c9e5e6fb06c0e3897045.summary: CLI session polling now applies symmetric jitter to healthy intervals and exponential backoff to failures via new `polling-backoff.ts` utility. This prevents synchronized retry waves during shared outages. Changes affect `use-connection-status.ts`, `use-freebuff-session.ts`, and `freebuff-session-api.ts` (which now parses `Retry-After` headers into `FreebuffSessionRequestError`). Failure backoff caps at 300s, base 20s, with equal jitter on the upper half.

3c92d4e7bd963920744771f9af70a7740f5db53b.title: Context pruner added to base-chat agent
3c92d4e7bd963920744771f9af70a7740f5db53b.summary: Added context-pruner agent to base-chat spawnableAgents and implemented handleSteps generator in agents/base-chat.ts. Context windows defined in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts with FREEBUFF_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOWS and FREEBUFF_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW. AgentStepContext and StepHandler types updated with optional model field to pass model ID to serialized generators. Pruner triggers before each step, budgeted to current model's window, preventing mid-thread model switch failures.

2d0defa35f3f84fc905fcc5fd0d677726ff4d32b.title: Add anthropic/claude-opus-5 to ModelName and OpenRouter map
2d0defa35f3f84fc905fcc5fd0d677726ff4d32b.summary: Added `anthropic/claude-opus-5` to the `ModelName` union in `agents/types/agent-definition.ts` and its template copy. `common/src/constants/anthropic.ts` maps `anthropic/claude-opus-5` to `claude-opus-5` in `OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP`. This registers the new Anthropic model for agent definitions and OpenRouter routing.

04bceb38336bd18978e6c75daa2b1451b3f51c8d.title: Context pruner skips run ledger and uses local token counting
04bceb38336bd18978e6c75daa2b1451b3f51c8d.summary: Context-pruner runs now bypass the run-tracking ledger, minting local `untracked-` prefixed IDs to eliminate three web-API round-trips per step. Token counting switched to local estimation, removing serial latency from Anthropic API relays as exact counts are no longer required for free-mode limits. `cacheExpiryMs` baked to 30 minutes in `base2.ts`, `base-deep.ts`, and `general-agent.ts` to prevent lossy re-summarization after short idles. Untracked child run IDs are filtered out in `spawn-agent-utils.ts` to prevent reporting to parent steps.

99f8bdf7238772049723aee6d133b9e2af05e10c.title: Gravity Index CTA link resolution
99f8bdf7238772049723aee6d133b9e2af05e10c.summary: render_ui tool accepts gravity_index link references (search_id + service_slug) instead of raw URLs. Runtime resolves references to exact tracked click URLs from prior tool results, failing closed on invalid refs. Prevents hallucinated or vendor-homepage fallbacks. Covers agent-runtime, common tools, and base-chat prompts.

9960f1f7021572ab6422137dd38830ec6587af47.title: cloud-plan-ready adds requiredintegrations param
9960f1f7021572ab6422137dd38830ec6587af47.summary: The cloud-plan-ready tool schema now accepts a required_integrations array, capturing Gravity service slugs and names. This ensures the coding agent receives explicit credential-bearing service requirements during planning. Scope limited to common/src/tools/params/tool/cloud-plan-ready.ts. The field enforces min(1) strings for slug and name, defaulting to empty array if no external services are needed.

ff555dfc23f4037715103ed7983c5e934eae5555.title: Move streak line logic to common package
ff555dfc23f4037715103ed7983c5e934eae5555.summary: Streak line presentation logic moves from cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts to common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts. CLI module re-exports shared logic, adding terminal-layout gating. Covers CLI and Desktop surfaces via common package. Dots fill to 7-day milestone, gaining trailing '+' for longer streaks; label uses singular 'day'.

aa75163a8f27b8cfc8af9d2ce07ba5f3253fdce0.title: Machine-readable data-use policy replaces text-based warning detection
aa75163a8f27b8cfc8af9d2ce07ba5f3253fdce0.summary: Introduced `freebuff-data-use.ts` to define canonical data-use policies, replacing the previous string-matching approach in `freebuff-models.ts`. Models now carry a `dataUse` field ('service' | 'training') instead of relying on the `FREEBUFF_DATA_COLLECTION_WARNING` string to determine trace retention and picker warnings. This ensures UI warnings and backend trace storage logic derive from the same machine-readable source, preventing drift between human-readable text and actual behavior. Updated README and CLI selector components to reflect the new policy copy and effective date.

086e7bfc29fc3edd9f62a2eddbdc8821ff71b409.title: Add raw HTTP diagnostics to startAgentRun failures
086e7bfc29fc3edd9f62a2eddbdc8821ff71b409.summary: Added `console.error` calls in `startAgentRun` to log raw HTTP status, body, and error objects alongside the existing `logger` calls. This prevents silent failure drops caused by unallowlisted events in the web logger, ensuring opaque "Failed to start agent run" errors include diagnosable context. Scope limited to `sdk/src/impl/database.ts`. Response body text is truncated to 2000 characters.

95d0fd6d9160780a76fe40fd4f79bb21858f0d91.title: renderui tool added to Freebuff Chat, shared validation, Gravity
95d0fd6d9160780a76fe40fd4f79bb21858f0d91.summary: Added `render_ui` to `agents/base-chat.ts` toolNames, letting Chat render interactive widgets. CLI `render-ui.tsx` now uses shared `parseRenderUIButtonWidget` from `common/tools/params/tool/render-ui.ts` instead of local type guard. `cloud-plan-ready.ts` `required_integrations` now requires `search_id` and drops `name`. Gravity selection flow verifies via `search_id` + `service_slug`, runtime substitutes tracked click URL.

ef69165e2f7db1192f722d33574d63f4d4bc8f4a.title: Signup free credits disabled
ef69165e2f7db1192f722d33574d63f4d4bc8f4a.summary: SIGNUP_FREE_CREDITS_GRANT set to 0 in common/src/constants/limits.ts, disabling signup credits. Re-enabling requires restoring the Codebuff GitHub-link hook and pricing copy. SIGNUP_CREDIT_MIN_GITHUB_ACCOUNT_AGE_MONTHS remains 4 for future use.

3b621851400cd86740de15406b74d8f020832c01.title: Weekly GLM streak bonus scales with streak length
3b621851400cd86740de15406b74d8f020832c01.summary: Weekly GLM streak bonus now scales with streak length. New `getFreebuffStreakGlmWeeklyUnits` calculates tiers based on completed 7-day intervals, capped by `FREEBUFF_STREAK_GLM_BONUS_MAX_MULTIPLIER` (4). UI copy in `freebuff-streak-line.ts` reflects the dynamic count. Applies to `common/src/util/freebuff-streak.ts` and constants.

a6064e62018ea29f9349570ff051500030870c1d.title: Add DESKTOPPROJECTREMOVED analytics event
a6064e62018ea29f9349570ff051500030870c1d.summary: Added DESKTOP_PROJECT_REMOVED ('desktop.project_removed') to AnalyticsEvent enum in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. Enables tracking of desktop project removal actions. Scope: Shared/Core constants.

1614c75f6c19c5cd6ee24e0fab2d21382e012e0c.title: runterminalcommand forces bash and rewrites nul redirects
1614c75f6c19c5cd6ee24e0fab2d21382e012e0c.summary: run_terminal_command now enforces bash execution on all OSes, replacing Windows Command Prompt support with Git Bash. Schema descriptions and tool instructions updated to mandate POSIX syntax (mv/rm, /dev/null, heredocs) and forbid cmd.exe commands (del/move, > nul). New rewriteWindowsNulRedirects function in sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts intercepts cmd-style `> nul` redirections and replaces them with `/dev/null` before execution to prevent creation of undeletable literal 'nul' files.

19ef71044ca314d9713b6f291ef272abbcc58724.title: Remove NEXTPUBLICWEBCONTAINERRUNTIMEORIGIN from client env schema
19ef71044ca314d9713b6f291ef272abbcc58724.summary: Removed `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_RUNTIME_ORIGIN` from `clientEnvSchema` and `clientProcessEnv` in `common/src/env-schema.ts`. The key was defined as an optional comma-separated list of valid URLs, but is no longer part of the client-side environment validation. This change affects the shared core environment definitions. Developers should ensure any dependencies on this specific origin configuration are handled via other means or removed.

ed223e710e22a010882d619831743d1c66d4ce9c.title: SDK stream recovery for thrown transport errors
ed223e710e22a010882d619831743d1c66d4ce9c.summary: Added `classifyThrownStreamRecovery` to handle Bun/undici response body severing via `iterator.next()` exceptions. `promptAiSdkStream` now catches these throws, classifies them as transient network errors, and triggers the same capped continuation path as clean stream ends. This prevents unhandled rejections from final-result promises and ensures partial output is preserved for fresh agent steps.

2d3b8b08b30dd13c6590106ec5eb4720ffd18215.title: HY3 Atlas paid tier routes through OpenRouter
2d3b8b08b30dd13c6590106ec5eb4720ffd18215.summary: HY3 Atlas paid tier routes through OpenRouter. HY3_OPENROUTER_PAID_MODEL_ID replaces HY3_ATLAS_MODEL_ID in base2-free-hy3-atlas, FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODELS, and premium ID lists. atlasCloudModels import removed; FREEBUFF_HY3_ATLAS_MODEL_ID retained as legacy alias for direct Atlas fallback. Covers common/src/constants/free-agents.ts and common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts.

4aa3d4c337e0d6424a23184465fdd0d98b1d387f.title: SDK caps subprocess output at 10M chars to prevent RangeError OOM
4aa3d4c337e0d6424a23184465fdd0d98b1d387f.summary: Added MAX_SUBPROCESS_OUTPUT_CHARS (10M) in sdk/src/run-state.ts. Unbounded git diff accumulation previously hit ~2GB runtime ceiling causing RangeError. childProcessToPromise now tracks truncation state; kill at cap resolves instead of rejecting to preserve collected prefix. getGitChanges logs truncation via logger.info.

7427361383f2c51d58977ea9a80d8c0daab82016.title: Bump freebuff CLI version to 0.0.128
7427361383f2c51d58977ea9a80d8c0daab82016.summary: Version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json updated from 0.0.127 to 0.0.128. Changes affect CLI packaging metadata only. No functional code changes.

aff0092445df1aceda16b73f9435f9121831fa44.title: CLI chat-state persistence adds safe JSON fallback, rate-limited save
aff0092445df1aceda16b73f9435f9121831fa44.summary: New `cli/src/utils/safe-json.ts` provides `serializeForPersistence` and `classifyStringifyError` to catch `cyclic` and `oom` `JSON.stringify` failures on multi-MB transcripts, retrying with an ancestor-stack replacer and truncating leaf strings over 1,000,000 chars to 50,000. `run-state-storage.ts` integrates this fallback, downgrades environmental `ENOSPC`/`EACCES` and payload failures to warnings, and rate-limits distinct save issues to one log per chat dir every 5 minutes via `SAVE_LOG_INTERVAL_MS`. `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts` exports `shouldSampleByKey` for deterministic, per-key high-volume log sampling. `chatShapeSummary` and sidecar meta writes enable `/history` listing without parsing unbounded `chat-messages.json`.

84b194f1de686f37ab0e471ed617e9aa9ecdb61d.title: Add desktop feedback source and app metadata fields
84b194f1de686f37ab0e471ed617e9aa9ecdb61d.summary: FEEDBACK_SOURCES now includes 'desktop' alongside cli, sdk, and web. feedbackRequestSchema accepts optional appVersion and platform strings (max 100 chars). Updates common/src/constants/feedback.ts and common/src/schemas/feedback.ts. Enables desktop client telemetry and version tracking in feedback payloads.

d6ec35acf28349f0742cb015e2400f5d07d83eb0.title: Refactor Freebuff session API and fatal exit handling in CLI
d6ec35acf28349f0742cb015e2400f5d07d83eb0.summary: Extracted session logic to `cli/src/utils/freebuff-session-api.ts` and fatal error handling to `cli/src/utils/renderer-cleanup.ts` (`exitCliWithFatalError`). This centralizes slot release and terminal restoration, ensuring best-effort DELETE on exit paths skipping React unmount and combining abort signals with per-request timeouts. Scope: `use-freebuff-session.ts`, `exit-cleanly.ts`, `index.tsx`. Detail: `SESSION_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS` set to 20s to prevent hung requests from blocking the UI.

9ac3cfaccbda1e5eefac4a136587406f1bf5fe83.title: Fix file tree ignore logic for path containment
9ac3cfaccbda1e5eefac4a136587406f1bf5fe83.summary: Added `isPathInside` utility to `common/src/util/path.ts` and refactored `isFileIgnored` in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts` to use resolved paths for containment checks. This fixes bugs where files outside the project root were incorrectly processed or ignored due to naive string prefix matching. The change ensures `gitignore` parsing only traverses directories strictly inside the resolved `projectRoot`. Affects core file tree generation logic.

380909638150bde314b3d4eb96bcd7664fa07529.title: CLI exit cleanup unifies Ctrl+C, /exit, SIGINT paths
380909638150bde314b3d4eb96bcd7664fa07529.summary: Replaced fragmented exit logic with a unified `exitCliCleanly` utility. All exit surfaces (`/exit` command, `Ctrl+C` handlers, `process.exit` calls in pickers) now route through this single path to ensure consistent cleanup (analytics flush, session release, terminal reset). Added `terminal-io.ts` for synchronous fatal error reporting and control sequence writes during early startup crashes, preventing terminal corruption when the renderer fails before initialization.

7f0aadcf9dac5265474b698062f1d51776223fd8.title: NEXTPUBLICWEBCONTAINERRUNTIMEORIGIN accepts comma-separated origins
7f0aadcf9dac5265474b698062f1d51776223fd8.summary: NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_RUNTIME_ORIGIN in common/src/env-schema.ts now accepts a comma-separated list of origin URLs. Validation ensures each entry is a valid URL, with the first entry treated as canonical. Scope limited to shared core environment schema. Detail: uses z.string().refine() with split(',') and safeParse() checks.

3dc5a86f835786fcd0a763eb9fd027c58e732ba5.title: Add WebContainer env schema fields
3dc5a86f835786fcd0a763eb9fd027c58e732ba5.summary: Added optional NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_RUNTIME_ORIGIN to clientEnvSchema and clientProcessEnv in common/src/env-schema.ts. These fields enable WebContainer integration configuration. Scope limited to shared core environment schema.

de58a616b9b0ca15d0fba59c68fe8b7e19ef2fb5.title: Add desktop.turnstalled telemetry event
de58a616b9b0ca15d0fba59c68fe8b7e19ef2fb5.summary: New desktop.turn_stalled event fires when a turn produces no harness stream activity for the configured window. Telemetry only; does not abort the turn. Added to ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS in common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts to ensure rare reliability signals are never sampled. Join with desktop.turn_completed to distinguish recovered long-silent tool calls from real hangs.

23bcdc85d8b5bee8a0e5c41da85a4fd00a56028e.title: Add affiliate signup and activation analytics events
23bcdc85d8b5bee8a0e5c41da85a4fd00a56028e.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_AFFILIATE_SIGNUP` and `FREEBUFF_AFFILIATE_ACTIVATION` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. These events track affiliate-driven user acquisition and activation funnels. Scope limited to shared core constants. Event strings map to `freebuff.affiliate.signup` and `freebuff.affiliate.activation`.

c11ed01ddcbcb4bb5477850724e03e3bce8441e5.title: Add Laguna S 2.1 God-mode route
c11ed01ddcbcb4bb5477850724e03e3bce8441e5.summary: Poolside's Laguna S 2.1 (`poolside/laguna-s-2.1`) added as god-mode-only route. Tests Poolside direct OpenAI-compatible API before wider rollout. Registered in `FREEBUFF_ROOT_AGENT_IDS`, `FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODELS`, and `FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODEL_IDS` within `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts`. Marked `experimental: true` and `premium: true`.

21d02b63f7a0e4b97b0e825243a70231d24de6fc.title: Add internal CrofAI GLM 5.2 god-mode route
21d02b63f7a0e4b97b0e825243a70231d24de6fc.summary: Adds `FREEBUFF_CROF_GLM_V52_MODEL_ID` (`crof/glm-5.2`) and `base2-free-glm-crof` agent to `freebuff-models.ts` and `free-agents.ts`. This god-mode-only route isolates CrofAI testing from the standard Fireworks referral path. Scope includes `SUPPORTED_FREEBUFF_MODELS`, `FREEBUFF_WEB_GOD_ONLY_MODELS`, and `FREEBUFF_WEB_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS` allowlists. The internal wire ID maps to native `glm-5.2` on CrofAI, marked `experimental: true`.

f832b44401fb12895cc2023f6e4daf776f7edd74.title: Remove NEXTPUBLICWEBCONTAINERAPIKEY from client env schema
f832b44401fb12895cc2023f6e4daf776f7edd74.summary: Removed `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBCONTAINER_API_KEY` from `common/src/env-schema.ts`. The variable is no longer defined in `clientEnvSchema` or mapped in `clientProcessEnv`. This change affects only the shared core environment configuration.

21e20ab6257f3141ddca47ec45624e70688a4bc1.title: Remove reason field from FreebuffSessionServerResponse ratelimited
21e20ab6257f3141ddca47ec45624e70688a4bc1.summary: The optional `reason?: 'concurrent_sessions'` field is removed from the `rate_limited` status variant in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. This change eliminates the specific signal for Desktop multi-session concurrent-tab backstops, which previously distinguished them from daily/weekly quota limits. The `entitlementBreakdown` comment is updated to reflect that it is no longer absent on non-quota rejections, as those rejections are no longer tagged with a `reason`. This affects the shared core type definition used by CLI, Web, and Desktop clients.

6a8bd574f8f06b5f519397bf8b066709ab784545.title: Add OpenRouter alias for Poolside Laguna S 2.1
6a8bd574f8f06b5f519397bf8b066709ab784545.summary: Added `openrouter/poolside/laguna-s-2.1` model ID and `base2-free-laguna-s-2-1-openrouter` agent ID to test the paid OpenRouter route independently from Poolside's direct API. Updated `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` and `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to register the new alias in root agent lists, model maps, and god-mode-only UI configurations. Existing `poolside/laguna-s-2.1` entries remain for the direct API route.

6741ac4a35ff3d5b290540a363ae19c6c5c485cf.title: Reddit CAPI retention milestones and email normalization
6741ac4a35ff3d5b290540a363ae19c6c5c485cf.summary: Retention events now fire strictly on exact calendar-day milestones (1d, 7d, 24d) using `daysBetween === milestone`, replacing the previous 'newly crossed' logic. Email normalization strips plus-tags and dots from local parts before SHA-256 hashing to improve match rates. `click_id` is removed from user payloads, and `buildRedditCapiUserPayload` is exported. Event names consolidate surface-specific variants (e.g., `FirstPromptCli`) into generic ones (`FirstPrompt`), with legacy analytics enums retained for historical dashboards.

0b35949fad7bbaf605afbd048ca912c14d4a3173.title: Add cloudplanready tool
0b35949fad7bbaf605afbd048ca912c14d4a3173.summary: New `cloud_plan_ready` tool signals blank Freebuff Cloud project plans are ready for user approval. Agent calls it after clarifying requirements and verifying third-party services via `gravity_index`, triggering a "Start building" button without starting implementation. Covers `common/src/tools/params/tool/cloud-plan-ready.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/cloud-plan-ready.ts`, registered in `toolNames`, `publishedTools`, and handler lists. `endsAgentStep` is true, pausing the agent loop until the user approves the plan.

6238261f2378f06c8e96ce1a0691da31374011e0.title: CLI release package version bump to 0.0.127
6238261f2378f06c8e96ce1a0691da31374011e0.summary: freebuff/cli/release/package.json version bumped from 0.0.126 to 0.0.127. Internal packaging update for the CLI release artifact. No functional changes or user-facing impact.

ace6dfaa46c3c14d6ce640c5146a1110df23d57f.title: Relocate thinker spawn limit in base2 agent prompt
ace6dfaa46c3c14d6ce640c5146a1110df23d57f.summary: Moves the `THINKER_SPAWN_LIMIT` instruction from the top of the spawn guidelines to after the context brevity note in `agents/base2/base2.ts`. Removes `THINKER_SPAWN_LIMIT` from the `buildImplementationStepPrompt` array. This reorders prompt instructions to prioritize parallel spawning and sequencing guidance.

92ff02610686d5d9fc79060254e0ba759de87c76.title: CLI landing screen layout tweaks and Kimi tagline update
92ff02610686d5d9fc79060254e0ba759de87c76.summary: Freebuff CLI landing screen logic now conditionally renders streak bonus notes and logos based on terminal dimensions to prevent UI crowding. The `getFreebuffStreakBonusNoteForLayout` function suppresses the note if height < 52 or width is insufficient, while logo display rules shift to hide branding in medium-height terminals unless the picker is collapsed. Additionally, the `Kimi K2.7 Code` model tagline in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` was updated to include ' & Slow'.

b3680bc95f78bcedbcb5b13ae1b18a4f4bb2aa8e.title: freebuff-streak-line.ts reduces FREEBUFFSTREAKBONUSMINHEIGHT from 52
b3680bc95f78bcedbcb5b13ae1b18a4f4bb2aa8e.summary: Internal constant `FREEBUFF_STREAK_BONUS_MIN_HEIGHT` in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts` changed from 52 to 30. Adjusts minimum height threshold for the streak bonus visual element. Affects CLI rendering only.

31731d4b275ad637ad19e9531442b3f5acaa8d7f.title: Add streamrecovery Axiom event, prototype-safe tag matching
31731d4b275ad637ad19e9531442b3f5acaa8d7f.summary: Added `stream_recovery` allowlisted Axiom event for stream-cut/output-limit recovery sites, with typed field sanitization dropping unknown keys and mismatched types (strings truncated to 200). `countTrailingStreamRecoveryNotes` renamed to `trailingStreamRecoveryStreak`, returning count plus `lastSource` of the most recent recovery note. `RECOVERY_TAGS` array replaced with `SOURCE_BY_RECOVERY_TAG` Map so tags like 'constructor' cannot resolve via prototype chain. Covers `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`.

8785289028f63c9a6d0f34de8380e3de400c1f3c.title: MiniMax M3 premium, server-driven limits, fallback flips
8785289028f63c9a6d0f34de8380e3de400c1f3c.summary: MiniMax M3 switched to premium tier in freebuff-models.ts, joining FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_MODEL_IDS and drawing from the shared 5/day pool. Landing screen and model selector now prefer server-sent rate limits (base + streak/referral bonuses) over static constants, with the counter visible in collapsed picker state. Session-ended banner flips exhausted premium sessions to DeepSeek V4 Flash via in-memory override, preserving saved preferences. Desktop premium bucket comment updated to reflect GLM 5.2 as sole non-premium concurrency cap.

74ee22bd83306ec1e06b515b52e03e43a31b41cd.title: Premium and limited session limits raised to 6
74ee22bd83306ec1e06b515b52e03e43a31b41cd.summary: FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT and FREEBUFF_LIMITED_SESSION_LIMIT constants increased from 5 to 6 in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. This expands the daily allowance for both premium and limited access tiers. The change propagates to README documentation, CLI landing screen comments, and referral tier examples. GLM referral caps remain separate from this shared daily pool.

908988675e48fa01e64a50b5f9ac2410d06900dd.title: CLI hides bundled agent IDs and strips persisted hidden blocks
908988675e48fa01e64a50b5f9ac2410d06900dd.summary: HIDDEN_AGENT_IDS changed from 'codebuff/context-pruner' to 'context-pruner', matching substrings to cover bundled and publisher-qualified IDs. Hidden agents now skip spawn info and streaming IDs in sdk-event-handlers.ts to prevent orphaned IDs lingering until tool result clears them. sanitizeRestoredMessages in send-message-helpers.ts calls new stripHiddenAgentBlocks in message-block-helpers.ts to remove previously persisted hidden agent blocks from transcripts.

f9e4f6d7dec93b1e1e1ff3f7cb5f4e81966e1ac6.title: freebuff 0.0.125
f9e4f6d7dec93b1e1e1ff3f7cb5f4e81966e1ac6.summary: Version bump 0.0.124 to 0.0.125 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. Routine release artifact update. No functional changes.

f306a65c7959b621b722d98e361dedf64a575a88.title: Add suggestprompts to TOOLSWHICHWONTFORCENEXTSTEP
f306a65c7959b621b722d98e361dedf64a575a88.summary: Added 'suggest_prompts' to the TOOLS_WHICH_WONT_FORCE_NEXT_STEP constant in common/src/tools/constants.ts. This prevents the agent runtime from automatically advancing to the next step when the suggest_prompts tool is invoked. Scope limited to shared core constants.

68d2a1c12fcf666d7d4d067a3f00e5953afebd34.title: Base2 agent caps thinker spawns at one per request
68d2a1c12fcf666d7d4d067a3f00e5953afebd34.summary: Base2 agent prompt injects `THINKER_SPAWN_LIMIT` constant into spawn, core, and implementation sections. Restricts thinker agent spawning to one per user request to prevent redundant agent invocations. Applies to `agents/base2/base2.ts` across default, free, lite, max, and fast modes. Constant enforces 'do not spawn any thinker again' after first spawn.

4b03dcbd2a7791366306ab976dba52fd9659b6d6.title: Add Gravity CAPI integration for first message events
4b03dcbd2a7791366306ab976dba52fd9659b6d6.summary: New `common/src/gravity-capi.ts` module implements Gravity CAPI client for 'FirstMessage' conversion events. `sanitizeGravityCapiData` validates untrusted `window.gravityPixel.getCAPIData()` output, enforcing length bounds on user_data fields and client_context JSON size. `sendGravityFirstMessageConversion` POSTs to `api.trygravity.ai/gateway/events` with 3s timeout, throwing on non-terminal statuses. Surfaces typed as 'cli', 'desktop', 'web', 'cloud', 'chat'.

35474f6bf77e51e4dbcf3773cbb0ebf5c30d6fe7.title: CLI: stopActiveRun replaces abortActiveRun
35474f6bf77e51e4dbcf3773cbb0ebf5c30d6fe7.summary: CLI refactored to use `stopActiveRun(reason)` instead of `abortActiveRun()`, removing direct `abortControllerRef` and `stopStreaming` dependencies from `Chat` and `command-registry`. The new `stopActiveRun` uses a module-level handler registered in `chat-runtime-context` to manage queue pausing/discarding based on the reason (e.g., 'user-interrupt', 'logout'). `prepareUserMessage` now accepts an `AbortSignal` to prevent appending prompts to a new chat if a switch occurs during async image processing. Scope: `cli/src/app.tsx`, `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts`, `cli/src/contexts/chat-runtime-context.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts`.

8b1e3056a8678ddbcd1f18cf505017accb927cfd.title: Bump @ai-sdk/provider to 2.0.3
8b1e3056a8678ddbcd1f18cf505017accb927cfd.summary: Upgraded @ai-sdk/provider from 2.0.1 to 2.0.3 in packages/llm-providers/package.json. Refactored failedResponseHandler typing in openai-compatible chat and completion language models to use ReturnType<typeof createJsonErrorResponseHandler> instead of explicit ResponseHandler<APICallError> generics. Removed unused APICallError and ResponseHandler imports from @ai-sdk/provider-utils.

9262d077baa57360516b372dae789cd193f7a15a.title: Add FREEBUFFWEBSTANDARDSESSIONLIMIT for non-premium Web models
9262d077baa57360516b372dae789cd193f7a15a.summary: New constant FREEBUFF_WEB_STANDARD_SESSION_LIMIT caps fresh sessions for full-access Web/Cloud models outside premium/referral pools at 6 per day. CLI retains unlimited access to these models, while browser surfaces enforce the cap to deter automated project/session churn. FREEBUFF_WEB_STANDARD_MODEL_IDS derives the affected model list by filtering non-premium entries from FREEBUFF_WEB_ALL_MODELS. Reset timezone and period reuse the premium pool settings (America/Los_Angeles, pacific_day).

6501764d584c609c88de49fbb649c5b5f055c3d9.title: Context-pruner subagent lifecycle events
6501764d584c609c88de49fbb649c5b5f055c3d9.summary: Refined `onResponseChunk` handling in `spawn-agent-inline.ts`. Context-pruner subagents now suppress raw text summaries while forwarding `subagent_start` and `subagent_finish` lifecycle events to the client. This prevents UI noise during internal pruning while maintaining visibility into the pause duration. Uses `sendSubagentChunk` for text and `writeToClient` for lifecycle objects.

ff901fe20bad843eac69657fe3f446d4285af737.title: SDK auto-retries interrupted streams via source-tagged error chunks
ff901fe20bad843eac69657fe3f446d4285af737.summary: The SDK now detects silent stream endings (connection cuts, reasoning output-limit hits) and yields source-tagged error chunks instead of ending the turn. The agent loop forces a retry step, capped at 3 consecutive recoveries, while the CLI UI shows a transient retrying status via `setIsRetrying`. Core changes span `sdk/src/impl/stream-interruption.ts` (detection), `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts` (`StreamRecoverySource` type), and `cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts` (UI state). `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_STREAM_RECOVERIES` limits retries; sourceless errors remain silent inline tool failures.

1328a3f288ed36e8ee37a3aac1b8ca1efff52cd6.title: Extract Freebuff model IDs to dependency-free module
1328a3f288ed36e8ee37a3aac1b8ca1efff52cd6.summary: Stable Freebuff model identifiers `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` and `FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID` moved to new file `common/src/constants/freebuff-model-ids.ts`. This decouples browser-safe constants from server-side model configuration in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, which previously caused type environment issues in desktop renderer. The original module re-exports these IDs to maintain backward compatibility. `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` updated to import from the new module.

16931ade9e64c9e5a453642da335cf4b08ed6093.title: Add FreebuffActiveSessionInfo type
16931ade9e64c9e5a453642da335cf4b08ed6093.summary: New FreebuffActiveSessionInfo interface added to common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts. Includes model, admittedAt, and expiresAt fields for multi-session clients to display active session windows. Shared/Core surface only.

6655cc5ad6e660c64cbca9251ef019eecf59dde9.title: Fix CLI stream status loss during Chat unmount
6655cc5ad6e660c64cbca9251ef019eecf59dde9.summary: Chat interrupt handler now calls abortActiveRun() instead of relying on local abortControllerRef. useChatStreaming derives effectiveStreamStatus via resolveStreamStatus(), bridging hook-local idle state with store-backed isChainInProgress and hasActiveRun(). Prevents UI from falsely showing idle when Chat unmounts during active SDK run. Covers cli/src/chat.tsx, cli/src/hooks/use-chat-streaming.ts, cli/src/utils/active-run.ts, cli/src/utils/status-indicator-state.ts.

94f0f052111d7430d1cc973c9653333d045e5f6d.title: Fix MiMo 2.5 Pro multimodal flag and dynamic model support check
94f0f052111d7430d1cc973c9653333d045e5f6d.summary: MiMo 2.5 Pro `multimodal` flag set to false in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` to prevent provider rejection of image content. `FREEBUFF_MULTIMODAL_MODEL_IDS` and `FREEBUFF_WEB_MULTIMODAL_MODEL_IDS` now derive from model definitions rather than static arrays. New `getFreebuffModelImageSupport` helper returns `undefined` for unknown models to avoid stripping images for unverified capabilities.

e78563f1e523d46e46a3234eeb84bb3e77cb9b4b.title: CLI chat runtime context
e78563f1e523d46e46a3234eeb84bb3e77cb9b4b.summary: New ChatRuntimeProvider in cli/src/contexts/chat-runtime-context.tsx decouples runtime state from Chat view. app.tsx keys runtime by chatSessionId, not resumeChatId. History and session gates keep same key, preventing runtime reset on view-only route changes. use-chat-input.ts consumes initialPrompt once via callback ref, eliminating remount-based auto-submit.

e8c2211146a5a3fd3718e8dee4825c4757e60986.title: Desktop shutdown lifecycle analytics
e8c2211146a5a3fd3718e8dee4825c4757e60986.summary: Added `DESKTOP_SHUTDOWN_TURNS_ABORTED`, `DESKTOP_ORPHANS_REAPED`, and `DESKTOP_TURNS_RESURRECTED` enums to `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. These track harness CLI child lifecycle events during quit and recovery to quantify orphaned-CLI occurrences. Scope limited to shared analytics constants. Event strings use `desktop.` prefix matching existing desktop telemetry.

b6199c08ae729268fb8e37886fe7608ee7c7c17c.title: CLI session quota display adapts to weekly periods and entitlement
b6199c08ae729268fb8e37886fe7608ee7c7c17c.summary: CLI landing screen now renders 'this week' vs 'today' based on `period`, and types add `entitlementBreakdown` for session limits. This aligns UI with server-side weekly resets and exposes how `limit` combines base, referral, and streak sessions. Affects `cli/src/components/freebuff-landing-screen.tsx` and `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. `entitlementBreakdown` is optional; older servers omit it, and `windowHours` remains deprecated.

ea226cb387463c614ad636bf2fa368cca721099c.title: Context7 API v2 migration and read-docs param hardening
ea226cb387463c614ad636bf2fa368cca721099c.summary: Context7 integration upgrades to API v2 with new search response types and token-budget truncation logic. `read-docs` tool schema enforces `trim`, `min(1)`, `int`, and `positive` constraints on inputs, while `max_tokens` default drops to 10000 and auto-clamping logic is removed. Changes span `agents/types/tools.ts`, `common/src/tools/params/tool/read-docs.ts`, and `packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-api/context7-api.ts`. `truncateToTokenBudget` uses binary search with UTF-16 surrogate pair safety to enforce exact token limits.

1b952b35d6dac171d48c8e0fd7daf70c873a40b5.title: Add desktop codex resolution analytics event
1b952b35d6dac171d48c8e0fd7daf70c873a40b5.summary: Added AnalyticsEvent.DESKTOP_CODEX_RESOLUTION to track which codex CLI the Codex harness resolves per process. Registered in ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS to ensure 100% sampling. Provides field visibility into packaged app codex detection when stdout breadcrumbs are unavailable.

ed5c777e9ea95739a4f2484a600d096304e6a3e3.title: Update comment for FREEBUFFSTREAKBONUSSESSIONUNITS
ed5c777e9ea95739a4f2484a600d096304e6a3e3.summary: Comment for `FREEBUFF_STREAK_BONUS_SESSION_UNITS` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` reworded to "Session units added to an eligible streak-reward pool". Clarifies the constant defines units added to a pool, not granted per grant. No logic change; value remains 1. Scope limited to `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`.

0b0023ff8767b3d84e2b2b09dbeb4942bdaeac8f.title: freebuff 0.0.124
0b0023ff8767b3d84e2b2b09dbeb4942bdaeac8f.summary: Version bump to 0.0.124 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. No functional changes.

5b05edcad1c49dbfae18bb40a3a8026b8b5673c6.title: GLM streak bonus derives live instead of milestone grants
