10218ba5aa9794a3327524cc1922daa9f3e39ce1.text: The app now clearly tells you when a model is temporarily unavailable or restricted to paid subscribers. This helps you understand if you need to upgrade or simply wait for a specific time window to use certain features.

28d0514641dc8804ec29db0727c13bb9f2bc2ca1.text: Extra usage limits from your subscription now add to your free allowance instead of replacing it. This gives you a larger total capacity for requests.

9f0de8454bcac2ea8898d1f6592c488da4942f7b.text: The ad no longer shows the advertiser's web address, as that data is missing. Clicking the ad still works the same way.

cb53f476e75fa8151b31fc9ae263d0aa59281d5d.text: The system now uses fixed labels for why people leave, so reports stay accurate. Beta pricing rules were also set.

b42492330322ad9c82caf4620c05e4ab36d661d4.text: The team stopped using a shortcut to save files during background checks on one type of computer because starting fresh was actually faster. This internal change helps the system run more efficiently without affecting how you use the product.

1d9a61e734810b53404ced16489971b33109725e.text: The advanced AI model now requires a paid subscription to use on the website, while desktop and command-line tools keep free access. The website may temporarily block this model during busy times to manage costs, showing when it will reopen.

907cda721501e4f656b82ef0bf61e19af07926ef.text: The assistant now remembers your subscription details, such as usage limits, while you switch between options. This stops the plan information from briefly disappearing or flashing on the screen.

9043277365c41dd3d8c20f4d192b64d879823dce.text: The app no longer suggests ready-made comments. It now requires users to write their own messages to avoid repetitive, robotic text.

72f1310353bddeacfee88d760a6193527ff69dd2.text: Starter and Pro users can now use premium features more often, matching their total daily limit. The confusing warning about a separate premium cap is gone, so the app accurately shows what you can do.

ec01bf10020d29d13062f0218f3176e5a0e3f4b0.text: The system now clearly shows when a campaign is paused because it hit its daily spending limit or used its total budget. This fixes a confusing display issue where the status looked active even though ads were not being served.

4a41787b377f56263a296bc5a8458ad2707aafae.text: The app now tracks when ads are seen more reliably, ensuring the right ads show in the correct order without repeating.

15ebdcb20344b1faa17ff5345846ba1241d3e664.text: The assistant now correctly handles hidden reasoning text that gets split across messages. This internal fix prevents occasional display glitches, so you see the answer clearly.

b11ec75a04ede2ef903e89bbe41fb5080514e102.text: The system now clearly shows how many free premium sessions you have used today and how many remain. This prevents the app from double-counting your usage, ensuring you see an accurate picture of your remaining daily allowance.

54790e3a6614fea67d6dabd01fd367fabb684dc8.text: The system now safely records basic, private statistics about your project's size to help improve performance. It does not save your code, file names, or project details.

a733b317c1e05ace5fe868e3d4f52d300dbd018c.text: The daily limit for this specific AI model returned to one session per day. Referral bonuses no longer increase this allowance.

7a65d914646cc0f2883efcbc94971198e8064c16.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant gave the wrong reason for being unavailable. It now shows the correct busy hours instead of office hours.

8238d829cad6ce2b95694de923e6e58c9a240e5d.text: The system now tracks monthly spending limits separately from session counts. This prevents unexpected costs when using expensive models.

c5e4bf5459e0119e774dbda81d74d89d580f6c6f.text: The message shown when your free access changes now says that limits on specific models are gone. Some models still offer unlimited free use.

fbda78872046ff7f2223c83c8093d1d1f9237dca.text: The system now automatically skips uploading certain internal test files that contain sensitive advertiser details. This is a small safety fix that helps keep private data out of the shared project.

cb3ea78eda6ea14b43bc1624d0e854fdd9a898d0.text: You can now earn rewards for starring projects on GitHub, and you only need to upload a screenshot as proof instead of writing a comment.

75d33f9429a93c53c7c2f5b5dac73adc3a832d32.text: The product's internal packaging information was updated to ensure consistency. This is a small, behind-the-scenes change that does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

81dc44a30b2de783596bce9e6c8192a674be6a23.text: The system now records whether automatic payments and external settlements are active. This helps track money settings accurately without storing private advertiser details.

ed41bbe6cce57a22a3d03f3a69848063615c385c.text: The team updated internal notes to correctly describe how the software identifies the platform family versus the product surface. This is a small documentation fix that does not change how the product works for users.

dc2947f208c695a64f1781053d8afe1a3968a40a.text: When a connection fails during a task, the assistant now shows the specific reason for the failure instead of a generic error message. This helps you understand exactly what went wrong.

ed27ce1cf3e461105e209dcd13d8e5e22219331f.text: The system now records a safe, limited summary of ad conversion reports. It keeps only basic results like success or failure, hiding private details. This helps the company track ad performance without risking user privacy.

4e45c27aa823ee8d4a0abe9d493d85479e030149.text: The assistant can now use a new, limited model source. A message explains that a premium model is temporarily running on a faster, cheaper one while systems recover.

0b60b7df7979a111f67629386bd2a64f36885060.text: The system now uses shorter, organized summaries of project changes instead of raw data, which prevents crashes on large projects. This keeps the tool stable and responsive when working with many files.

99c8777e213d27579525e378d569d3e430d7b1e6.text: The system previously flooded its logs with repeated error messages, which made it hard to spot real issues. Now, it records these specific refusals only once, helping the support team see and fix actual problems faster.

8bf398cd72689f7ca4bea6eb14ad7a7b162763ee.text: The assistant now uses a free version of its smartest thinking mode without counting it against your daily limit. This switch happens behind the scenes to save resources, so you might notice slightly different answers, but you won't hit usage caps as quickly.

ff5d55049a4f9d7a0175b82bbc68a7c75c89e811.text: Internal checks were updated to match a model moving from a paid tier to an unlimited tier. This ensures the interface correctly shows usage limits and warnings for this model.

836022e5e8a479b8330a80261070e80b636da639.text: The limit on how many chats you can open at once no longer depends on which models use up your monthly credits. This means adding new credit-based models won't accidentally block you from using multiple tabs simultaneously.

8d2fe1d276001824281f633df332852e67e82564.text: The system now blocks sign-ups from five known fake email services. This helps keep the platform safer for real users.

a4d50e7363432ab28c574b022a0b2fc76de0ab2a.text: The system now logs when you click an ad or see one, recording details like the ad source and where it appeared. This helps track ad performance more accurately behind the scenes.

8953a389fa9deb1c8cb479d483b24327a2c38cb7.text: The system now tracks where links appear and records which groups see which ads more accurately. This helps show you relevant content without breaking the display.

29e42653f8ec332f88173a5a05520ff6f8119655.text: The system now checks that error messages tell users to use a VPN or connect directly if their access is blocked. This ensures helpful instructions appear when limits are hit.

116f691de944ce3ef91a7e628964eba0b4e6c10d.text: The app no longer sets separate daily limits for each model. All models now share the same daily allowance, except for two specific models that remain free to use.

115a6a5cc676b1a4969d2045ad34ebb5d8bd00ab.text: The sign-up process now allows you to skip questions and submit partial answers without getting an error. You only need to answer at least one question to proceed.

989208414f3649ca01ab3b87500917770ddcf204.text: The system now quietly records whether an ad placement succeeded, failed, or had no inventory. This helps internal teams spot and fix delivery issues faster without seeing any private campaign details.

e3a285c926ba174296495a785ca36ed7ea44aad8.text: An internal safety check was tightened. You will not notice any change in how the product works.

061b2465fb339069a9a7b09081c6125a5919a574.text: The app now uses a new assistant by default. Two older assistants pause during busy hours. Some subscriptions may automatically switch to a lower plan when they renew.

467ba64dca85ea541f5c3db0d34bbf024ccccf92.text: The system now records where you are using the chat, such as on a desktop, phone, or web browser. This helps the service understand your experience without changing how you use it.

01b15151126e71919675bb0ab8972e1720377b12.text: The assistant now uses a cheaper, more reliable option during busy times. This change costs less and runs smoother for you.

1bbdc9e90d4becb32401d13293d9cbd7c9a5841c.text: Users with specific email addresses now see a special version of the ads. This change is small and only affects those test accounts.

7e9bd8cdb6cb73fb329d494669361e7226a17ed0.text: The system now removes more hidden characters from ad text. This makes the displayed content safer and more predictable for users.

d9e94b083c24c9e1fa9655b0e55f5cdfc6506865.text: The limit on free sessions for the new assistant model is removed, so you can use it as often as other models. This change fixes an earlier mistake in how costs were calculated.

2b718cc3be65d5704cf71390e398c989c1641b84.text: The ad system now tracks clicks and earnings more accurately. It hides old, messy data to keep reports clean.

1a069f10a6dcb5116116520f285a565bc7e658ac.text: The system now checks one setting instead of two to decide if special ads appear. This simplifies the process without changing how you see the ads.

4140a604bcff8120f0e60c1cd20258bdbb9e6cd0.text: The app no longer shows a fake usage limit for accounts that don't have one. You won't see confusing '0 of 4' messages if you have special access.

ee79648a9e2aff11d54250c2dd488709b9fb3626.text: The daily limit for using the Luna model increased from two to three sessions. This means you can ask it for help one more time each day.

79ca37b5008dc6dfe804a8b7bb002be7d4435abf.text: Internal code cleanup. Improved how the system handles time displays and command outputs.

695d4d15676d9937d172ccf87909013085942be1.text: The assistant now treats weekends as always off-peak. This means you will not encounter peak-hour restrictions on Saturdays or Sundays.

95e94c20aecc773fd13da69de9eebff40f6436bb.text: A new advertising system now shows ads to a small group of logged-in users. This change affects only those selected users and does not alter the experience for others.

5acb86de2a75b3c0a36e2ce451723bf1e5dece38.text: The app stopped sending small, unimportant usage notes to the analytics service. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

50aa984b714af271946c68a2ed80466a01338c4e.text: Developers cleaned up the code that handles keyboard navigation in the command line interface. This change is internal and will not affect how you use the product.

a23c8b25050c3630473d9be4309c3eaa858cde07.text: The assistant's text display logic was updated to work on older devices. This small internal fix ensures the chat interface functions correctly without changing how you use the product.

09f62ecb291de42ee67f62602f769b8f37c79bfb.text: A test that sometimes failed for no reason was fixed using a more reliable method. This change makes the software more stable, but other similar tests still have a small chance of failing.

6f9acbfeb578ed83e026547695d86a172b8011fe.text: The app's background update number increased. You will not notice any change.

990ae116fee764e1daf72f0fda57880cf3d369b7.text: The top-tier model no longer limits you to one free session per day. It now shares the same daily allowance as the other premium models.

923de567621991a2f4d90fe7bcfcf4fd016a24ca.text: The system now records basic, non-personal details about ad loading times for internal checks. This helps the team track performance without collecting private user data.

5a504c380ad0497547ff88e63624d6101795cc92.text: The advanced AI model is now available all day, not just during quiet hours. This means you can use it anytime without waiting for off-peak times.

84c46ec290a6e544a29a30189b87a2fa1fa4ec90.text: The Pro subscription option is no longer available for new purchases. If you already have it, your access continues, but you cannot buy it again.

28220d571736520903c8e75cfd41a8588cd5e1a0.text: The list of special models is now managed automatically to prevent errors. A new premium model is available for paying users.

ac2a035d604166a86390a7272dd56b60efd8a556.text: The default assistant switched to a faster, cheaper model. The smarter model is now only available at certain times.

4fa5ea05a929de13ec11d3f1a4549953efa6c09b.text: A new ad dashboard is now available for managing campaigns and tracking spending. Advertisements are checked to remove harmful text and require secure links. The system also directs ads to users more reliably.

41eb6446627cc703eeb8323efaf1e6477204a06d.text: A small internal change tightens security for special test features. Regular users will not see any difference in how the product works.

098dd053d11a6338dae3f4abd62996a0c18982aa.text: A small internal update makes the assistant display its name more reliably and easier to maintain. You will not see a change, but the system now handles new variations more smoothly.

b2efafdc0d4a0bf860ea5dd9581c8d754a664087.text: The system now supports a new, highly capable assistant option that is restricted to advanced users. Regular users will not see this option available for standard tasks.

01301385919da16daba8bd458609835c69e31a7e.text: Access to the placements console is now controlled by a different setting. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

a275174b3e37c2e809245dcc06a74e6406b8d8b2.text: The software's internal label changed to mark a new release. This update does not change how the tool works or what it can do.

7895583a6c3216d4a977080028483c8b65fc9d3d.text: Ad spending limits and reports now follow Pacific Time daily schedules.

9a9f7dd95b7843187a4048b1b950b3539ab8fd5c.text: The ad display rules were centralized, ensuring the command line and web preview show ads with identical formatting at all standard widths. Additionally, the system now rejects invalid links, preventing broken ad cards from appearing.

07685661de57b219d53ab908cf2e2bafcdb3e1eb.text: The app now shows the latest like and reply counts for two example posts, updated to match the August 21, 2026 data. This small update ensures the sample statistics you see are current, though repost and view numbers remain unavailable.

0b697402591b23688e8fff0b8861d7b427190e2e.text: Ad headlines now display correctly in the command-line interface. Previously, some ads hid their main text to show a button label instead. This fix ensures you see the full ad message.

b563ba5e6b3bf0de5a76a0d72c354ae3db370210.text: The system now has a safer way to check who has special admin powers. This stops other people from pretending to be an admin to access hidden settings.

aefe67a7bd41d1b8cce4e53d39f9e22677aaf630.text: The model selection menu now uses a fixed time instead of the current time. This stops the menu from changing options unexpectedly while being tested, making the testing process more reliable.

592d93f5d9e627a00fa4db4e1d1e8ca7662421a0.text: The example ads now show real view and repost counts, matching what the authors see.

9d0e435b3802e4b6b833c1ed349d604e5b804f0d.text: A new, free, anonymous AI assistant model is now available for web and cloud users. It can handle very long conversations and includes safeguards to prevent unexpected costs.

2a3c3c791364d4f39c2c61d80162909cd199cd29.text: The app added paid plans with different session limits. Premium models cost more, so they use up your allowance faster.

d777cd21617ccc5dd611a59920a609556e577551.text: A small internal update was made to the software's setup files. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ed706ca47d476c9a68e7302b22b3c615dd522dd1.text: The assistant now uses a stronger model by default. During busy hours, it automatically switches to this stronger model instead of waiting for a slower one.

3f3cb3851705ca43846d8a13c2c12a7ebfe94a38.text: The system no longer lowers your daily usage limits during times when the service is most popular. You can now use the same amount of the service every day, regardless of how busy it is.

b21d5ab27d1d97f850e5b3b673d985093136342e.text: The app received a small internal update. You will not notice any changes to how it works.

9311890b70d198454df8e25b72df2d064854dc48.text: When a model is unavailable, the selection list now shows the exact time it returns instead of just turning grey. This helps you know when to try again.

1e69baf9bf0ba91e9f693f1a6942e2b92c880783.text: The program now translates file addresses from a specific tool into a format Windows understands. This ensures files are found correctly when using that tool.

ffed5e29d2c86da974e22ca462675bb334d3212c.text: The app now waits briefly and tries again when creating folders if the system is slow to respond. This prevents errors during file operations on some networks.

b9ace3f9b2782eb321dd299ec9972689f3e08daa.text: An old policy notice ended early. New ad showcase features display images in fixed boxes, but repost and view counts remain blank until proper access is granted.

105640d21d124ff1dd6a7ccd7df06fffb9a5c34f.text: The assistant can now create user accounts and share login details directly, skipping the sign-up page. You must approve this action for it to work.

657d06d953134758769d273970853bd370e89c3e.text: Free ads ended and billing started again. Users will now be charged for ads.

04e751a97e5f614d12c8165741fdaaf212197531.text: Internal guides now explain how to spot rare, random glitches that automated tests might accidentally hide. This helps the team fix unstable features faster, so you see fewer unexpected errors.

6c1591f8a5caf4b189e75bea718139d506c0b121.text: The assistant now uses a new default model to handle everyday questions. A different model moved from paid to free access, while others gained daily limits or time restrictions.

5baa7a52d32ba2ed115a659fa28eed38a4414cef.text: Developers added internal notes to explain how the system tracks usage costs for standard models. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

b4e5713b824dff395fcf7112cfc5ccae94429984.text: Ads now skip manual review and go live faster. Advertisers still need account approval, and admins spot-check ads later.

f9ccbec282a4812b8d2e12af28d75395af286030.text: A small internal safety check was updated to ensure all assistant prompts work correctly. Users will not notice any changes.

0ce5fb0b7d299ff3a646c2785016dd3287928df3.text: We added clear forms for reporting problems or asking questions, and set up automatic checks to help the team respond faster. This change does not affect how the product works.

7b1bde13e85e50fb7f0ca7675ebf8c29788ec464.text: The app now shows separate daily limits for each premium model instead of mixing them together. This fixes a display error that made it unclear which models had stricter usage caps.

24de8d9513fd0584a4a18a73f3d3ca5e7e54a1bf.text: The system now automatically adds the standard web address prefix when you paste a link without one. This prevents errors when submitting URLs, so you can paste links directly without worrying about missing details.

2e3e3f6691f3de16b7b0b5ddcb1612c553a382de.text: Standard prompts are now free. The system no longer blocks users with low balances from using basic features.

f7bb825f48d23a5e38f2a43748657d567847cd9a.text: A small internal change helps keep temporary test files from being saved to the shared project. This keeps the main system clean and organized for everyone.

8c034b5f9242c0bb48b8021f96eeb2e159096d16.text: The app now checks that you actually posted a comment on a social media post, instead of just accepting a link to the post itself. This ensures that ads are properly verified before you receive rewards.

55402897958a0f19676f33abeb1432e63ea53ca7.text: The system now blocks internal test notes and design drafts from being saved to the main record. This helps protect private user information. No product features changed.

08a8371fb064793ba00624c528e8738489aea268.text: Every message now costs one point of trust, regardless of which assistant model you use. This makes usage limits easier to predict, since fifty messages always cost the same amount.

b378f994a87f43adea2fa4fed651663f2b89b08e.text: Ad payments are paused, and free campaigns now last up to 7 days. This prevents unlimited spending of user rewards.

187b1e916c06bd3ab87208ac647577fb4b9f6b03.text: Ads now cost a fixed daily amount instead of charging each time someone clicks. You pay the same price all day, regardless of how many people see or click the ad.

ba0e40bacf53a1ffa8dfcf0db6ab7b0da43b139a.text: The system now identifies the ad viewer and the ad buyer as the same person, fixing a glitch where the ad service thought two different people were involved. This prevents ads from being blocked or counted incorrectly.

b5111f885a8e3b737cffff102f353444ea860ada.text: The system now correctly recognizes a 'flagged' status, ensuring ads are displayed accurately. Advertisers gain a new showcase page that displays real engagement data and specific reach numbers.

7dcb4fb1e09cbd72bb0d86409739ff616bc6d472.text: The system now limits how many projects you can use daily and how many tasks run at once. This prevents the service from becoming overloaded and ensures smoother performance for all users.

1470aa4e189c2d0347843109e5ec86dbab395402.text: Database health alerts now report hidden sessions as a number instead of silently passing. This gives you a clearer view of potential issues.

e73d39fff1ab55bc2c2615d60efd7129afa5c7fc.text: Links in the command line tool now point to a faster-paying feed instead of the slower referral page. Shorter wording keeps the screen clean.

fad014c575a497df9a3169fb2bc516281a081a58.text: The software team removed a temporary note from the internal settings. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for you.

cef358330ebed218abe3c1d8df88a8d4bb8315db.text: The system now correctly identifies when a free model is swapped in, preventing errors for users without credit balances.

35dc6d079403192cc19e9552f4a951fa9776f707.text: The assistant now strictly follows security settings when looking for skills on a server. This prevents it from accidentally using personal skills from a home folder, ensuring it only uses the correct skills for your project.

01ea6aba4c679543e05913a5db8faa49937b13c0.text: The system now supports a new spending provider called Luminal. This is a small internal update that lets the product track expenses from this new source.

d2b9697a48a5b058d6648dbe78561f63a88af7b8.text: The app received a small internal update. This change does not affect how you use it.

89832d9b3ade452149cf8e9658bd4537107fc5e7.text: Users on plans without access to the high-cost AI model now face lower spending limits during busy hours. This prevents unnecessary restrictions for those using cheaper models, whose costs do not spike at peak times.

aaf1843ce840d29bf339feae4644adf3df1e06c9.text: The team added a safety rule to keep messy test files from getting mixed into the main product. This change is small and internal. It helps ensure the software you use stays clean and reliable.

5f72959fab4202f5b667112c914282bcc195fb9b.text: The assistant now estimates text length locally, removing a delay caused by external checks. User skills remain visible in the command-line tool, while server-side defaults stay safer.

35eec19e84f06cc0bfef213d204165ac1e9867a4.text: The system now uses one shared rule for busy hours to adjust prices and limits. Users see clear local times when limits reset instead of a generic daily message.

9175fd397356dbcfa51334ff19281711e7ade0e9.text: A small internal update makes the product's testing process more reliable by using a fixed setting instead of depending on the tester's computer setup. This change does not affect how you use the product.

bdc6b61fb93d720c2e1dbc084046eec16580336f.text: Premium users now get fewer fresh sessions per day on the website and cloud. The limit dropped from six to five. Command-line tools remain unlimited.

d20038cb58001e360bbcfb30960817b202e8993a.text: The system now separates who makes the AI from who sends the bill. This keeps spending reports accurate, especially when one company runs another's model.

9b9b25e76714ba3cfc7fff9a8b13428164cdc2cf.text: The system updated its internal records to correctly identify the location of its task-decision tool. This change prevents false security warnings but does not alter how the application functions for users.

695a52ed5a16bd3c3482682e2f84b29ac47c5190.text: The system now limits spending for accounts with higher risk to prevent excessive usage. These accounts face stricter caps on how much they can use the service in a single session.

d0c7b069051a45044d107598a2ce98ef80d63100.text: The price for the assistant's default brain changed, making it much more expensive during busy hours. The team noticed this but kept the same brain running for now, while flagging it for a future decision on whether to switch.

7129d45870e6486850aca5729015b555653ca7d1.text: The app now tracks your activity level to determine how many free sessions you earn, and businesses can advertise to you for a small fee. Premium users get slightly fewer free sessions, while users in limited regions see a larger drop.

2fa82f2e26c68a2e750dcdd3515855e661d05577.text: The system now uses one shared rule for counting days. This prevents mistakes that could hide or double-count some data.

c200e2d4f1c2dbc77bdd889971d83fb755fb0f53.text: The system now checks the health of the database more consistently and accurately. This helps prevent silent failures and ensures alerts trigger based on real capacity limits, keeping the service stable for you.

6c49e12dc09c72d510ee13940ea543ef19b418e5.text: The desktop app now uses a helper that checks tasks without spending credits. This stops 'out of credits' errors for free users when starting work.

192cb715a3ae26a1deee15731d0ddd86560fe262.text: The app now records when you start signing in. This helps the company see the full path from trying to log in to actually succeeding, without missing any steps.

eb2eb5ec4b15f2b31cee2ff7c6870aef398526aa.text: The software now uses only the standard data collection address, removing the option to redirect it elsewhere. This internal update has no visible effect on how you use the product.

ae35b542f1b2cc0e6e455ef9effa1cdb9ad4c818.text: Singapore users can now spend up to $5, replacing the previous $0.50 limit. This change follows high rates of false refusals, while specific abusive domains were blocked.

2d370c194f127b56a4273462587f7589a557b834.text: Media attachments now wait until all related requests finish before showing. This stops the assistant from getting confused and freezing during conversations.

8da51dc0eaecae13822690e91ea90a9038bd9dc6.text: The assistant's basic free option switched to a different underlying model because the previous one was paused. This only affects limited access; full access users see no change.

f97ca5511b01eba2552e9be7d7332194f5118ca3.text: The system now treats email addresses from well-known privacy services as legitimate. This stops it from blocking or limiting these users based on their email provider.

095d6d65a1697d4cb31e0a39df9adeafcf7946c2.text: The 'Beta' label was removed from the product's description in the help guides. This is a small internal update to the text only. The program itself works exactly the same as before.

6eb9bf8e4038d432a370d0186b0d124fe912fabe.text: The system now removes incomplete requests from saved history before restarting a session. This prevents errors when resuming work.

2afc2b2dfac9a0bcb48e18ccc0c1f720f6f2e6a7.text: If the main AI service is blocked, the system now tries other options instead of failing completely. It still checks prices to ensure you are not charged extra unexpectedly.

09e160095a84086726021f1c614790d8558f8ca5.text: The system now identifies missing or invalid human-verification checks separately from other issues. This helps support teams diagnose signup problems more accurately.

5db7a544be7c5ec414b833a4cb295fa8511b1b8c.text: The assistant now limits spending more strictly for privacy reasons to prevent unexpected charges. It also marks requests as skipped when it cannot verify if they are safe to send.

6e27bb24543eadf602931a09a003526915b1509c.text: The app now shows the same short message to all blocked accounts. This hides details about why you were stopped.

43db7ec34405a23491b376662bf243226a136619.text: A small internal cleanup removed unused code for checking database request costs. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

7c219be7ef6d60e088fcfa9fcd566a798153d57b.text: Users blocked for specific security or location reasons now see clear messages explaining why. General capacity limits still show vague notices.

871d75810e6732f65067d4bd6faec927c529332d.text: Daily spending limits now vary by account instead of being a flat fifty dollars. This change helps stop abuse while keeping legitimate users from being blocked.

1fca3e29a75dddac2d4b2fc694f8f13a42b51253.text: The system now identifies user input without adding hidden text markers. This internal cleanup makes the underlying code simpler and easier to maintain.

0029f0a29f01837307120b1212694ffaa2899474.text: The app now checks if you use privacy tools like VPNs or Tor. If you do, your daily spending limit drops to 50 cents to help spot risky activity.

2daa1edbfdcc1e2b867db89a6ee29cb5b6ac9c8f.text: Removed a test case checking if late results cross user boundaries. No impact on product features or user experience.

9c97c4b81c451b11472f72068b175d485a9512a8.text: Fixed a bug where a timer could stay active after a task finished. This prevents the app from holding onto unused resources, keeping it running smoothly.

c6d10a5bff56b7a83bd09e507bc5adc2a373c8dc.text: The app updated its privacy notice to clearly state that it uses ads and does not collect your files or data, except when specific models might. This change only affects the text shown in settings and does not change how the app works.

ad5d3005fb7f08e572e6fe8323303b26497795e1.text: The app now quietly records counts of automatically archived threads and delivery conflicts. This helps the team understand how often these background issues occur.

80bc9c895dd73f9996ae18af67432e9ae1b09181.text: The assistant now automatically removes old, unfinished requests from its memory when you start a new conversation. This prevents the assistant from getting confused by leftover tasks and keeps your chats running smoothly.

7db20c99a59d3ee3b410142d90b0f781f3861cc3.text: The command-line tool got a small update to its release information. This change only affects how the software is packaged for distribution and does not change how you use it.

c0e5740f4ee47c3c7dd3fe6f890b2fc5b26b34d7.text: The system now handles a new type of image data format. This ensures the assistant correctly understands pictures sent through a specific connection.

204d98237e29a1004f52c2d7d6beac9cfbb9f694.text: The assistant now correctly handles image addresses in more formats, and won't accidentally double up the address part when saving or sending pictures. This means fewer errors when you try to use images with the assistant.

cef314aab409b9198cc4f5665e4a52da528c4eb4.text: The link in the command-line tool now goes directly to the referral tracking page instead of the general earnings screen. The button text was updated to say 'Open referral status' to match where it leads.

603b0d994dece07838c774cb022529dee7a28f1d.text: The dashboard buttons now highlight more clearly when selected using the keyboard, and the daily progress dots are easier to tell apart.

4eab91e6da752b9f8269e52018db5854dd9f0fc2.text: A safety check was added to the testing system to ensure the default assistant model stays at the top of the list. This internal fix prevents the order from changing unexpectedly, so users continue to see the correct default option first.

df226b46771c1d64d1f4fd9f7e11e7996e47cba5.text: Added hidden settings for new AI models to help the system manage them internally. These models are not available for you to select or use in the app.

190ac96c3428bfbd1ea3ffbdeaf77659f088a902.text: The assistant now copies text more reliably by using a backup method if the standard clipboard tool is missing. It also cancels old copy attempts when you select new text, preventing the wrong information from being saved.

c7ddc18ceedc4938f6df6f859c14e98de8ad0562.text: The list of models you can choose from now shows the recommended one first. This makes it easier to find the best option without scrolling.

d9ee7bfc3e52b9156522bc86250fc7376f9fe955.text: The app now uses a smarter assistant by default. If that one is busy, it automatically switches to a faster version so you can still chat.

fc178cb1ef7c7d06ee0bf55e88a7b6415f2cb291.text: Removed a temporary workaround that let users skip a setup step if it failed. This is an internal cleanup with no visible change to normal use.

a0a9a4c80ae8b8aba38b449aa29ad9e214633c43.text: The assistant can now use three new high-capacity models that handle longer conversations. These models are set up to appear only when available for your specific account, so you won't see broken or empty options in your list.

42f9dcb2036fe5685daf5f73da59512789e1f5c8.text: The team updated the label on the program's installation package. This change does not affect how the software works.

79d6a9de6e44b00e4d484725b74991122ae257ab.text: The main assistant now uses a new underlying system. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

7ef9669a46ffdb16f461c281a67ac52e4d3b9560.text: We fixed a rare glitch that could make the app behave strangely during startup. This change only affects internal testing, so you will not notice any difference in the product.

c1ff21d02571b1a923041ad489802f64a1514bca.text: The app now shows account access level and limits before joining a session. If this feature is turned off, these details will not appear.

b07e38d987cc4aa41a1c0fea1a2502a462f0f50f.text: Setup checks are now simpler, so you won't get blocked by old timing rules. You can skip answering questions if you don't want to, without seeing confusing error messages.

bab9f2907dff6c3f090b3ba645f64c91e95e997e.text: The setup questions changed, so you now pick subscriptions directly, and some old choices like Instagram and Discord are gone or combined. Your past answers still count, so nothing you picked before disappears.

a5b6b0cf4ef9fbf7f6cf529e803601f243cd1b0f.text: Daily limits for creating new projects increased to ten. Temporary errors during setup no longer count toward this limit. Users can only run one project at a time.

0d865059f023cea0d49fd9dce302ed1762f196c8.text: The onboarding gate now prevents infinite redirect loops during save failures by setting a temporary bypass only after errors occur, and requires valid option selections.

8057a82e406417ae68791f4ca8e5e26bb812be03.text: The visual style for a specific model was changed to match the rest of the list, because the previous faded look appeared broken. This update only affects how the text looks on the screen and does not change how the model works.

fe30ebff1d8856788874e037cf2b741f95b6ead3.text: If you haven't finished the setup questions, the assistant now clearly asks you to do so instead of showing a generic waiting message.

4da4570dc9d90c75467c5d5541882cd919481bf0.text: Added hidden settings to let the website record user activity for debugging. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for users.

c235ded0aec8696b8af0e9fbb9e7fe1529e8bf1f.text: Clicking the queue preview now expands the panel to show full details. This small interface update makes it easier to view queued items without extra steps.

5f8f4c0129f21df6161929ca0031ce67b2ccd141.text: The tool's internal packaging files were updated to a newer release version. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

d0a5d3f4e4a0caaee723ea2e10499a9c3b64b0fc.text: The app updated its internal records to prepare for a new release. This change does not affect how the app works.

a801ecf452f6262853055d6aafb484bf3a74ec3c.text: The description shown for a specific AI model changed from 'Balanced' to 'Strong all-around.' This label update reflects the model's general-purpose capabilities but does not change how it works.

364433c460916d2de22bf35956dfa0f9f5e8edff.text: The assistant can now use a new, simpler thinking mode. Model settings were cleaned up to show correct options, helping you pick the right speed and accuracy.

84f4ca34cd7481a4d5bc577ebf5d7343b385650a.text: The text colors and button sizes in the ad and referral banners were adjusted to look consistent and prevent layout shifts when navigating with a keyboard. A duplicate promotional message was removed to reduce clutter.

b615f928ac3c3d888c5e82b21fdd768e8d7e941e.text: The product received a routine update with no new features or fixes. You do not need to take any action, and the app works exactly as before.

3a66664e54bc6ebb3dcc9dd073e45769a85d045f.text: The tool now correctly handles specific system files needed for certain Linux computers. This prevents the application from failing to start or install on those machines.

44212cc2816aedc01e2239edb193a18909727871.text: When a service runs out of usage limits, the tool now shows the real error instead of asking you to buy credits.

9d25b4958aa958f70db200e3cbde351f54538ffd.text: An internal check was updated to match how the assistant builds its instructions. This change does not affect what the assistant can do for you.

90ca26c0745bcbbcd40ea7ac385c031977d328cc.text: The service now better checks where requests come from to stop people from sharing access unfairly. This change helps keep the product running smoothly for everyone.

b9810f1556b1ad235441f5bea1278b948d119973.text: The signup process now clearly explains why it blocks certain requests, such as duplicate accounts or suspicious activity. This keeps the service secure while giving you direct feedback if you cannot create an account.

e43fdc88870d851ec92b669dbba00bd5ffe17d0d.text: When the main assistant is unavailable, the system now switches to a different backup assistant. This change helps keep conversations running smoothly by using the same default assistant for new chats.

a6f9f6f9f36afe33900b80d4df2d61d646a8460f.text: The system now records usage costs and token counts even if a response stops early. This ensures billing and tracking data remains accurate.

00e5fa83a7e86d744e826cef0021ee41b4ccce17.text: The app now tracks usage and memory cleanup events. You can see exactly how much the assistant uses and when it summarizes history to save space.

df64ef498a3fb6d30d36e94869a65e2fed60f6f5.text: The software now needs a newer version of its underlying engine to run. Users must update their system to keep using the product.

7ca8fa441715fb750cbaac2bb834a4b544c42313.text: The team adjusted internal safety rules for automated checks to prevent false alarms when the system is slow. They also improved how the team sees these checks to find problems faster. You will not notice any difference.

702b43bf6fbd41be7405bc3e02773f21a7888d37.text: The assistant now uses a different method for its free version because the previous one was less accurate. This change improves how well the free tools complete tasks.

5db7bafe633f286ebf8cb91d151d557ce8df3db1.text: The assistant's name changed in internal tests. No features changed for users.

58e2564ab07e029b066e81765e85b4be189b303e.text: Removed support for three specific AI models that are no longer available. The default AI model used for creating new agents was updated to a currently supported option. This is an internal cleanup to prevent errors when setting up agents.

44177dad55f47ee36c17c8c98b60c95202fa9ab1.text: A behind-the-scenes update ensures the app uses one consistent rule to decide if a connection problem means you have been signed out. This prevents confusing errors where a temporary delay is mistaken for a permanent loss of access.

db9b6fc11799d1756d2b434b432c8da1f6422046.text: The command-line interface now supports several new free models. This change separates the command-line version from the desktop version to prevent conflicts.

c26a74d54c7b2ff0429b410b0109aa0115f29c6f.text: The text in the referral banner was shortened to make it easier to read. This small update does not change how the feature works.

837519d09bdafee951022bd77b63e5cfc25ecc7e.text: The app now shows a promotional offer for a new model, including how many free sessions you get each day and when the deal ends. Older versions of the app will continue to work correctly without seeing this new banner.

97ea5981ff9943999d24543fa28dd5cc6fe5654a.text: The app now shares exact streak numbers alongside the visual display. This lets screens show progress as custom graphics instead of just dots, without changing how you see your streak.

389f40a9a9a113232c22a5e93ee40d01a4ee7b08.text: The app now finds the command-line tool on Windows more reliably, especially if it is installed in a custom folder or on a drive other than C:. This prevents errors when the app tries to run terminal commands.

da1f340a36ff033086086da3fe1411e796af2bc3.text: The assistant now uses a single, consistent scale for thinking effort across all devices. You can choose how much effort the assistant spends on a task, with options limited to what each model supports. This change is internal and does not alter how you interact with the assistant, except for clearer effort controls.

caba427c7fed797dd58e2cd6cc5a22232a5eeaea.text: The assistant now uses its most detailed thinking mode for Muse Spark. This fixes a previous error where it might not have applied this setting correctly.

119af4afe0f2529ce76714ac740c1db1cb8940fc.text: The company removed two specific AI assistants from the list of tools available for advanced, unrestricted use. Regular users will not notice any difference.

1b28a1b851243771ec6e1433673df5e676496f9c.text: The assistant now uses a simplified, single-step mode for web tasks, removing extra review layers to speed up responses. It also reads specific sections of files more accurately, preventing errors where it might think it has reached the end of a document too early.

e39fb73424f48f7861215b6d67b095c21885f9ee.text: Muse Spark's default reasoning setting is now 'xhigh'. This means the model will spend more time thinking before answering, which may make it slightly smarter but also slower.

baaa1bb3570337a95a6fdc526ef83963dd67bde6.text: The assistant now ignores a specific, old-style instruction file and only reads newer, standard formats. This internal cleanup ensures it follows your current guidelines without confusion from outdated files.

9ddaa67d28223f14873db3c78e8fd0fbf98608c1.text: The system now ignores small, normal speed changes when checking if the product is running too slowly. This prevents unnecessary alerts from popping up during regular use, while still warning if performance drops significantly.

68b34fa74dd1efa2451b9a4a6df7f5a15ba2a2b3.text: The assistant now reads instructions from a single standard file instead of checking an older, less common one. This ensures the tool follows the correct rules without confusion.

85fe163fd7843afe7dc3d07df57d2ac8eade07c4.text: A new assistant model is now available. Three older models were removed, but users never saw them anyway.

7a29686a3dc1313a85ce61f22d76bc18a78de3f5.text: The sign-in code now uses the same one-hour limit everywhere. This stops you from getting timed out early in one app but not another.

ab5e182182a84b9df51cc00e8cdf96ce75d4bc0f.text: The team adjusted the speed limits for internal database tasks to match real-world conditions, separating fast tasks from slower ones. This change helps detect performance drops more accurately, but users will not notice any difference in the product.

0bbfdeb6b0c850151bbedd015b31cd6c99f9e2a8.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant would sometimes stop working and give no answer after searching for information. The assistant now always completes its task and replies to you.

6f2db456ac3170ab87b7099c362f20f295369fb3.text: The testing setup now starts all checks together with longer time limits for slower computers, reducing false failure alerts. This internal improvement helps catch real issues more reliably without affecting how the product works for you.

e1129d9e5842529779d9d8098b3d0b0efe715045.text: The system now tracks dates using a single, fixed time standard instead of local time zones. This prevents missed records when time zones cause days to start or end at different times.

4f80bdb45dcca5ab6c33304482b9699356711a0e.text: A small internal update clarified that a specific safety check remains a report-only signal because most flagged accounts were actually doing legitimate work. This change does not affect how the product behaves or what you can do.

660747443d071feffcc7ccb584ac2977e631e0dc.text: The app now records when you fail to sign in on a desktop computer. This helps the support team see why sign-ins break and fix them faster.

968c6682de8ea3e75d3dbbad2c6591fe28176920.text: A background test now waits for a clear signal before finishing, instead of guessing how long to wait. This makes the test results more reliable.

bb7dbadf40439cd9a5159185a4d1a242b68f74ac.text: The system now recognizes when an outside service connects without using its standard features. This detection is currently off to avoid blocking legitimate users, so you will not notice any changes yet.

68d9a88c81cfd8b1b1de979ca99eb3468290f961.text: The system now uses a broader rule to identify outside tools, reducing mistakes where legitimate features were wrongly blocked. This improves reliability when using web search or reading links.

87acd39098734f870266915e02267851c4cd4a4f.text: The system now spots requests from outside its own apps and sends them to a cheaper, simpler model. This saves computing power for regular users, so your experience stays smooth and fast.

2d6439de4640f2f4642e07c1f8decad1cdb00812.text: The message explaining why some AI models are unavailable now appears in the same place across all apps. This ensures you see the same clear explanation no matter where you use the product.

fe7b8fad52fa2ea67a8d2cbb86638e7e0cbb7cf8.text: The assistant now recognizes when your computer cannot run its main program and automatically switches to a simpler version to keep working. It also collects error messages to help fix the problem.

2bc664c5bd3c5ed730de2a5af880493d2c5d672c.text: The system now tracks usage for the new version of the assistant separately from the old one. This helps the team accurately measure costs and activity during the transition period.

d800f61ca0291aa9270a75e454fb1a4a8ce09712.text: The system now separates minor spending increases from major cost spikes. This helps teams focus on serious issues without getting distracted by small, expected changes.

4e79ce476b22c73f06a2ca9fe5210d83d1c325ed.text: The assistant now reads only the parts of files it needs and can shorten long conversations to stay within memory limits. This makes it faster and able to handle larger projects without losing track of what it was doing.

070db75b0429851b103a870004b5029c4cd5700e.text: The assistant now suggests next steps based on what you want to achieve, rather than listing specific technical tasks or chores.

8d95d803aedf841503be0f60718ed8374e492b5c.text: The app now records when you click the savings button. This helps the team see which savings messages work best for you.

accfa422f66916c360186c12c240d9279acaf396.text: The assistant now follows a single, consistent set of rules for suggesting next steps. This ensures its recommendations are always practical and ready for you to act on, rather than asking you to do manual work.

0be72bef521398a74121b5719210a8c5c2e1abfb.text: A small internal fix improved how the system handles connection timeouts during startup. This makes the software more stable when starting up.

1358346295e7e4fcd7b2bd3d4fa93b268518b28d.text: The app now records when a bookmark prompt appears and when you confirm it. This helps the team see how often people leave before saving bookmarks.

787e80a8f1456623d2b0605c9f282165ac72dcb7.text: The release package was updated. This internal packaging change does not affect how the product works.

0f112dfc17a5d2dfc4419d5c4471a7cb8b49276c.text: The app now records when a specific startup step fails on Windows. This helps the team find and fix rare connection issues faster.

e455a7f11d4caa461b258678a9a3bb975da44860.text: The assistant now uses a safer method to run commands, preventing the app from crashing on Windows. This fixes a bug that stopped the tool from working after repeated use.

92a6961b894204c5620f9dd77cd2606e54b9a397.text: Typing in the command line now feels snappier because a delay was fixed. You can also hide specific skills from the AI assistant while still calling them yourself.

25d69d5854023aae6361a9dbe09ab23090638563.text: The assistant's description now says 'Queue' instead of '1M context'. If a request takes longer than 10 seconds, it automatically switches to a different model so you do not have to wait as long.

405bf49baa05e2abf854e5c051b36ad54a35002f.text: The app now records startup errors more reliably, even if security software blocks it. This helps the team diagnose why the terminal might fail to open.

fbf092f424327cab5a5086a0cf209d9199dcac73.text: The model selection list now shows the exact reasoning level that will be used. This prevents confusion between what is displayed and how the assistant actually behaves.

851f10f5262ed0de613c360e7724ff58e450f0ad.text: The app now correctly lets you choose a specific AI assistant when you have a limited plan. Previously, it would sometimes switch you to a different assistant without telling you.

8553a9efe9d42dc01079c1f7a63907ea55ec77d0.text: The tool now checks its setup before running. If files are misplaced, it fixes them or stops with a clear error. This prevents crashes from broken installations.

55258aabc4592ed2e90fc5d99fd7ae1e8a7bf10b.text: A hidden safety check now stays off on Windows unless you turn it on. This stops security software from blocking the program when it starts.

51994660ab6530ff0764978a8241ed2b80fa1d30.text: Internal tests now check the assistant's reset sequence more precisely. This change does not affect how you use the product.

6110b0bbfbe668dffcf4d5fe86ce8147293bf73a.text: The assistant stopped using a specific model's memory limit settings. It now falls back to the standard limit for this model.

f392d93770b49c7399c49afd550a4d2783c37afd.text: A small internal update was made to the command-line tool. This change does not affect how you use the product.

6059b884a999ffb281a0c15913c659f9bc6f5308.text: The assistant can now retry requests when the service is busy or slow, instead of forcing you to restart. This change also adds clearer setup instructions for the program.

95f7ba2869aed9e0bd0ef259d86becf75a4ac23e.text: Internal updates now track how long data requests take, helping prevent the app from slowing down over time.

3a8cc3135b1201b6403abb26762a309b269c8119.text: The app now tracks whether a request might have succeeded even if the screen timed out. This prevents it from accidentally repeating actions, like claiming a spot twice, when the connection drops.

52804281c6e03e0c74bbd7eb6b9965d369a5cf15.text: The assistant can now process much longer conversations or documents without forgetting earlier parts. This internal update removes a previous limit on how much text it can hold in memory at once.

175191e4366e34542cfe2d7dfdd9162faf7c2361.text: The company removed the Enterprise option from its product list. This means the Enterprise plan is no longer available.

372bcb13336cfa7eb8060b1b80208c8a9884fb9f.text: The system now automatically waits and retries when a specific AI helper is busy, instead of failing. This keeps things running smoothly for you if you use the web version.

126f792988825047c0b547dcf5f7bfb27ae9000d.text: The app now identifies itself to the AI service it uses. This helps track usage and keeps things running smoothly for you.

d62db1eebd81b366812817ac479860ba7ab066e9.text: The help text now lists the actual names of the AI brains the app can use. It also notes which one runs by default.

a6571b01b1383c6806b1344375d38525846701ac.text: The cloud version of the tool is now officially released, and a new contact form for large businesses was added. When someone fills out this form, the system records their company size and which AI service they use to help the team understand incoming requests.

2368b27e2d8a3b5f98f3e242083ba4a59dc0e0e2.text: The software's internal labeling system was updated to match the latest release schedule. This change affects only how the product identifies itself behind the scenes and has no impact on user features or performance.

27caf8248eaf3be6e303a93b58e27529e2008630.text: The assistant can now handle much longer conversations with a new model. This means you can share more information at once without the chat forgetting earlier details.

7005d45cc1116a842069903738371fc3c64f2c92.text: The app now checks settings files more consistently to avoid showing secret information. It also handles ignored items more reliably so one bad rule does not break others.

956dcf938814d5da8af5f2c1c1216f14d1bcd769.text: Users in limited-access regions can now use the new AI model. Previously, they were forced to use an older model, which made their rewards impossible to spend.

b2a5e5362384591ac9d67ae57216ea088c5cc01d.text: The app now shows a link to earn money by completing tasks, instead of only asking you to invite friends. Since this app cannot open your web browser, you must copy and paste that link yourself to visit the page.

adf5bef2be7cd107b6fdefb43b9e9e6fffadf1d7.text: The product added two new AI options that are much more expensive to run, so only premium users can access them. This prevents standard users from accidentally using these costly features without proper limits.

e93edfe8d2d61a6b285ed4e7614d50a8c9de8e29.text: The app checks for updates more efficiently and keeps a running count of assistant actions. This makes the interface feel faster and more responsive during long tasks.

a47be121a650358f747794cf743870e75d35e6b3.text: The team moved a few internal testing scripts so they don't run automatically. This fixes a minor reporting glitch and keeps the product's status updates clear.

76020951df33514036c99751ccb03abd92b47274.text: The system now checks browser information to better identify legitimate users, reducing the risk of accidentally blocking real accounts. This is an internal safety improvement with no immediate visible changes to how the product works.

7baf11ac08f12726408167fd391367d461a96249.text: Automatic checks for the product now ignore tests that need live external connections. This keeps routine testing fast and reliable.

218d2266be52bd7c37ca12f32c07766f8f7c267b.text: The system now recognizes two new assistant models. This is an internal setup change with no visible difference for users yet.

c7445e24582aabfa1c2f45c2108982511769385a.text: The free version of the assistant no longer offers the HY3 model. Users will see this option disappear from the list of available models.

ba0d1c06f45f11e6259d8d3c03aee844a0b60a97.text: The system now limits how long it waits for a command to finish, capping the wait at ten minutes. This stops the assistant from hanging for hours on simple tasks, so you get an answer or an error faster.

2e0d17a8eb3b3bf8b25564ff44b3338348cbfc63.text: The website now quietly tracks how users move through setup guides and tours to see where they stop. This helps the team understand which steps are confusing or hard to finish.

c799255a7afc9de583e6fed26712c5a5ec2c48fd.text: New web users now get a different default AI assistant that is better at complex tasks and does not require extra privacy warnings.

f28ecce37f526a75beecd2e0c8d82da50630abba.text: Some free assistant options are gone, and one smart assistant now needs a referral to use. You will see fewer choices in the menu.

f831624f857d2174a4f72a594f53e8cdec65e528.text: A small internal fix stops some automated checks from getting stuck. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

dd1e2cfc9f90b5c1b0c2e056e7eecf45ae0c7cd5.text: Fixed a rare crash that could happen when loading the app in certain ways. No visible changes for everyday use.

60dd01fe109f976b0e1e7eea23b9bd0e3ba67b6e.text: You can now use GLM 5.2 if you have a grant from a bounty, even on a limited plan. The app checks your remaining sessions to unlock it instead of blocking you based on your plan type.

4f9fad7460a17948620ee4c82d02a3ddb4bba868.text: The app can now safely take over an open session on a different computer if the original one is stuck. This prevents old, inactive windows from blocking you from using the feature elsewhere.

383fb0ceededb4056d40b1f6db984a321b7feb21.text: The start screen now uses simple symbols that display correctly on all computers. The text no longer crashes into the title, so you can read it easily.

9bf66ff09f2303f7bc13ebb134678c45869f2e30.text: When the service is too busy, the app now shows a clear 'high demand' message instead of a generic error. This helps you understand that you are waiting for a spot, rather than experiencing a technical failure.

e4a3a7abe1a6db3cdb1a3ff7ad5bae9737e48fa3.text: The system now keeps active tasks running for a short time after a session ends. This prevents your work from stopping suddenly if you close the window or lose connection.

4d3c46a551d4e0e3f37e902090ea267ec9b9ab5e.text: The system now blocks sign-ups from specific temporary email providers known for abuse. This helps prevent spam accounts while still allowing legitimate users to sign up with their normal email addresses.

32b7907dfe18e9fd79fac194172c07fcc816edda.text: The app now finishes tasks more smoothly, preventing the screen from freezing when stopping commands. If a command gets stuck, the app will try to close it safely and then ask you to restart your terminal window.

81bb087616c1eebb0516d8c74562cd6c4cd3cdbf.text: The system now blocks 37 new temporary email addresses. This stops spammers from creating fake accounts using lookalike domains.

037b51122b8b627807b9f138f7fffa16b0a6fe65.text: The site now records when you click desktop download buttons. This helps the team see which buttons people use and if clicks are accidentally double-counted.

04d4379f1617e48948e10d522ee2688dd9b84942.text: The app now correctly hides or shows files based on folder rules. This fixes cases where some files were mistakenly treated as hidden or visible.

12660b067482362d977d9d423b6a2c107ad0c76c.text: The assistant now detects when it stops after thinking without giving an answer. This prevents silent failures and ensures you receive a proper response.

9c3d9f0caebc6cd1ad214b92a7440fd0ff1cf929.text: The tool got a small routine update. You will not notice any new features or changes in how it works.

d1c94381b39773dbd68e9c7ebbd4909724179110.text: The tool now runs commands in a separate space so your typing stays smooth. This fixes glitches where the screen froze or text got mixed up while a task ran.

542451446bb2086182f9a10dfd9dc56cece4c133.text: The app can now stop an AI response the moment you cancel it.

f56844fd118df56422c40c55968c247d6253c562.text: Fixed a bug where mouse clicks or window switching could break the app's display on Windows. You can now safely click outside the app window without causing visual glitches.

eeb5209f0d72ca408c7decfcbac295cf21d06cea.text: The review assistant now uses its intended AI model and blocks other models from taking over. This ensures you get consistent feedback without silent changes to the underlying technology.

32405d54b26ef83e80be7c091a8c9610c6bf3b8a.text: The app now blocks certain terminal features while running commands on Windows. This prevents glitches if a command tries to change how the window works.

af3257b3b7d7a81bde74a67d84d9a683478b684d.text: The desktop app now records every failed recovery attempt. This helps the team understand why the app sometimes fails to resume after a stall.

cfefab1485351974f3ed0461c9d4797fbb251c9d.text: The app now checks its update information more carefully before starting. If it finds old or broken details, it fixes them instead of using bad data.

0251dddf1475cf3bd2449b2fe3f4cb429903459d.text: The error message for connection timeouts now mentions slow model starts as a possible cause, alongside network drops. This helps users understand why a request might fail without assuming the internet connection is at fault.

17d6db8ba087352b631923ba3e14852fcbc18b9d.text: A new internal check verifies the automatic update feature works correctly across different computers.

8c9929fa0f77987bcfd64f0625b68a97cf9dc17b.text: A small internal fix helps the self-update test work correctly on Windows. This change does not affect how you use the product.

13b1cfee56ea86d90e68a05afbb0399cc5c062a5.text: A small internal fix helps the assistant remember previous parts of a conversation more reliably. This makes replies faster and cheaper for you to use.

33d6139537ac60f9e475e9ff4211498fd9f65c73.text: The app's internal version number increased. No new features or fixes were added. This is just a routine update.

59b71a2329ee96e2378ae589e09694cfa02eee4a.text: The assistant now uses a different method to receive step-by-step instructions. This internal change helps the system manage conversation history more efficiently.

8f24a429cd6addf8fb858155634ef5241fea86b4.text: The assistant can now remember more of your conversation history before summarizing it. This allows it to handle much longer chats without losing track of earlier details.

817391fb58001b3bc24fbc42be479676d265d7d0.text: Background tasks now show the same conversation history, no matter how they are started. This makes the assistant's answers more consistent and reliable.

5423683dc8558497f5168a3e65a61e9a5e01e0ad.text: The assistant now uses a smarter model for checking its own work. It stops running extra, unnecessary checks when this better model is active, saving time and resources.

7335066f45ad29fa39ad3f09fa84c45ab1aca737.text: The assistant switched to a direct connection for a new model. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

e183deaed6c794aacff15662a87d41c98e3201d1.text: The system now checks if each open tab is active every 45 seconds. This prevents brief internet interruptions from blocking your ability to use the service.

a0d5b7f05d51dd5c0638193e6bff94151af278ee.text: The system now blocks sign-ups from known throwaway email addresses used to create fake accounts. This helps keep the service free for real users by stopping people from abusing the free tier.

2ae66743c3896cfb8f44812cf9643807c513fd59.text: The team added clearer instructions for internal tests to prevent errors that could disrupt the service. This small internal update helps keep the product running smoothly for you.

612e2a39e0355c12169f3dd37ce5e3bf09942e02.text: The app now uses one shared rule to name conversations, making titles cleaner and shorter. This small internal fix helps labels look consistent across different screens.

cc568bb92ddf1d15ac7be8b35e078a80670a6563.text: The assistant now recognizes the full memory size of a new model, allowing it to remember much more of your conversation. This prevents it from prematurely summarizing or forgetting earlier details, making chats smoother and more consistent.

ae8c38c6a145ee540ec48aea9027714917d9da36.text: Added tests to ensure every model option shown in the app is actually available for use. This prevents errors when you try to select a model.

115d80be38b93542912a3bb3cb0ed85f67f48290.text: The testing rules now catch broken features faster by failing immediately when core checks repeat errors, while still allowing flexible retries for external connections.

ef5190fe8024ca729df82dfa11c847354a3ca279.text: The app no longer crashes on some computers and avoids security warnings from your antivirus software. These fixes help the program start reliably without being blocked.

3a7b54b212bfe45eafb19525bbf52041f9b3a6c9.text: The assistant now uses a different, cost-effective model for terminal tasks and cloud builds. This prevents unexpected charges and keeps costs lower.

3e5be71544b2879899a0dea5162bf6f7e8195bcb.text: Users can now try a new, limited-capacity model in the command-line interface. If the trial fills up, the system automatically switches to the standard model to keep working.

6e1168a960e83d3c2651c6765b504f45f0d091b9.text: The service now uses a newer, more capable assistant for planning tasks. This update improves the quality of generated plans without increasing the cost.

062743b69a890d6f0e6efba5b3806cd8f6cad036.text: The list of AI models now always shows an 'Images' label next to each name. This means you can paste screenshots into any model, and the system will handle the image analysis for you.

ef75fd7a27e09c75d822efcfdaa28b023a03e31f.text: The app now hides streak rewards until you reach seven days, clearing space for the model list. It also puts a new model option first in the picker.

4e2403d6d910b7b0f6566d1eba3bfb35d4fb0aaa.text: The app now checks that the 'NEW' badge and upgrade hint appear only on the specific model you are currently using if a better one is available. This ensures you see exactly one relevant suggestion without clutter.

a5cb80f3d735b96b63f2fc075689ab4ed9955056.text: The assistant now automatically selects the best available model every time you start it, ignoring any older settings that might have saved a less optimal choice. This ensures you always get the most up-to-date performance without needing to manually adjust your preferences.

f388f14e2b1dcafb2a95799598ceb7e7ac511c24.text: The model selection screen removed a redundant 'Press Enter' label and centered a warning message. This makes the list of choices look cleaner and less cluttered.

a03e7a8ef057c6b8e9b3c63592e96ab176ea479d.text: A small internal update to the command-line tool's release metadata. This change does not affect how the tool works for users.

31ac8a0f82d45b3a6f82a46a9be1a4c6b8ad3b11.text: The system now blocks new users from starting a session if too many distinct people are using the same network connection. Existing sessions remain active and unaffected.

d5ca1376e2a658169fc355905b29159d5af6a85a.text: The assistant can now use a new model. Older options are marked as replaced, and your saved preferences automatically switch to the new one.

7c831448a6e554c45b87894487ebe7421385045f.text: The assistant stopped using a Windows tool that often failed to run commands correctly. This reduces confusing errors and makes command execution more reliable.

76d27eac43c54991622be0ff4b8eae09ee27183f.text: The application's internal version number increased. This routine update does not change how the program works.

fe2f293cfec04f7effa3601e4719d8d5583b81a2.text: The assistant now uses one consistent method for handling files on Windows. This prevents errors where file names or locations became scrambled during tasks.

f3e3cce8abe081a471cdf9fbd525426f7fba600f.text: The tool now keeps the suggested option visible and highlighted when the list shrinks, so nothing moves unexpectedly. It also adjusts the list size automatically to ensure all options fit on the screen without cutting off text.

0cda526a6c5bbf6cab64dafb874a9774ac1a4299.text: The file search tool now correctly ignores cluttered folders on Windows, preventing it from getting overwhelmed and missing actual files.

b15fef86116ef07524649f8b6ffd5027e0bee774.text: The tool's internal update label changed. This has no effect on how you use it.

5d8bc0232add269427599ffd4f928ee6a4786f52.text: A new AI model is now available in the menu if you have free sessions left. The system also remembers your model choice more accurately based on your account type.

2de7fe6b96aee8b402f989d9b1456d7e4f1259eb.text: The app's internal label increased. This change does not affect how the product works.

6cc0c94c19331c4a4009587d3b698916f00f9f0a.text: The reward for inviting friends is now a simple daily bonus of one extra chat, instead of growing with each new invite. This makes the benefit easier to understand and consistent every day.

d248ecc5ad5aafd3b80a52ed21c4244e0aa849d6.text: The system now accepts skills with complex internal settings that were previously rejected, and automatically shortens overly long descriptions instead of blocking the skill.

b1f68e07ef57b84fe337023718d350a96ec2305b.text: The free version no longer supports a specific AI model because it caused unexpected costs. You will see an error if you try to use it, so switch to the recommended alternative.

254c227edee9d656de7fc74312468062e17f7a1e.text: When you pick a new assistant that is locked, the app now tells you why instead of quietly switching back. It asks you to end your current session first, noting a one-hour idle timeout.

66199cc009297b239aa41cf46b945195a7a528a6.text: The assistant received a routine update. Users will not notice any changes.

ab4919394f7cd07cc1f360e48f04b600a1f6d40a.text: When you pick a new model, the app now ends the old session and switches to it. This fixes cases where clicking a model seemed ignored because the previous session was still locked.

5b8b58dbe1bc8498ac86a6e8aaa8e6311e86331f.text: Removed a limit on referral rewards for this service. You now earn rewards for every successful referral, with no maximum cap.

159673adf8f8dd060344460862f309b21986134f.text: The short descriptions for three AI models were updated to better reflect their speed and balance. These changes only affect the text shown in the model selection menu.

1ba142d747a1c095f2be79abe6b6adefad0c2a28.text: Free desktop users can now open up to three sessions at once, while premium users remain limited to one. The app shows how many sessions you have open and when the next one will close.

bfead8065f4f0e68f6247fa51973c73185d00525.text: The assistant can now use a new model for free. This gives you more options without extra cost.

9f80be02582ab23c45aa4fd7adf8370b2613ad92.text: The free version of the app no longer offers the Kimi K2.7 Code assistant because it costs too much to provide at no charge. If you previously selected this assistant, the app will automatically switch you to another available option.

075723dbdc661304e710e2b305277f3acfef3101.text: The new model now uses the same daily limit as other premium options instead of having its own separate one-use allowance. This means you can use it more often, but it will not stay selected as your default choice after you close the app.

f8a40d8bdea49062791c965233871dac46f9505d.text: The software received a routine update to keep its packaging current. This change does not add new features or fix bugs, so you will not notice any difference in how the product works.

c22abe9a8900d52fac3c91bd1d12f407e631be0c.text: We fixed a problem where the assistant could not use a specific AI model. This change lets the assistant use that model again.

ff0629f1f1b73fec52d0107117f3c27cc46c389f.text: The app now saves a summary of your project files so it does not need to re-read them every time you start a new session. This makes the software run faster and use less computer memory.

f5526661a4291076b5784de328a4ddb405831935.text: The daily limit for free AI chats now resets every day instead of once a week. Users with full access earn extra chats for using the service on consecutive days, and the system blocks more fake accounts from claiming free benefits.

faee98a2042d0b024219330c1f6ae2f6df89cff0.text: The list of available AI models now shows a small 'Images' label next to the model name, instead of on a separate line. This makes the menu look neater and saves space.

f377278c442149319ba818d05791b4012b9cf3b5.text: The free assistant now uses a different model by default. The list of options shows more details on a second line, and a new model is marked as using your chats for training.

c8e487a6246813b34d1f8a6942bef69352c80bc4.text: The assistant now uses a new model for planning chat responses, while keeping a different model for building tasks to prevent errors. To stop misuse, free premium chats are limited to 12 turns.

25b2071a417f2e28570f4f40d4cfede17d45a0e7.text: The system now tracks response speed in a way that lets it combine data across many hours and models without losing accuracy. This means the latency dashboard will show more reliable average wait times for the assistant's first reply.

65f20efb85fbaa7d2ec42f484fbbf9b39c57f751.text: A new assistant model is now available to premium users. It allows one session per day and keeps your data private from the provider.

dde3b3223f5082e1ce6c3d890dfaee4a1c5e91f4.text: The screen layout was adjusted to prevent the view from shrinking when scrolling through model options. Small spacing and alignment tweaks make the text easier to read, and buttons in locked states now look different from those in unlocked states.

ac163119e1412375e526494c81ec179739f4ced4.text: The website now suggests a different, cheaper assistant for browser tasks than the desktop app does. Some older options are hidden from the web list to keep the focus on the best choice for your device.

24c1a306f8c6654c7412241acd117c8074af5831.text: The short summary shown when you agree to share your data is now shorter and easier to read. It still explains how your prompts are used, but it no longer lists every detailed rule about account limits or automated access.

9b8e85b8d0d50bfc0c1bffe9caa17eee7798d1bf.text: The app now tracks long waits when it runs background tasks. This helps avoid false warnings about the app being stuck.

d281d6eedd789ca6b8590df20edb4388379408f4.text: This small internal fix ensures the assistant handles image-only responses correctly. It prevents errors when the assistant tries to answer without a matching text response.

b81352e298d504578da3e408754a0274dbcbacd2.text: The software now quietly records when it cleans up old desktop work areas. This helps the team understand how the program uses your computer.

cb202d14e1327ee923368b2dc099364b372dac68.text: The assistant now uses specific models based on your access level to prevent errors. Free users can create up to five blank projects daily to stop system abuse.

622a2a2228556af643a2addd266099af434504f5.text: The app now quietly counts how many people use less common desktop features. This helps the team see what works for you without slowing anything down.

9b8ffc8ef8c48601dc234a57e45ebc83b498a5f5.text: The assistant can now use a new experimental model, and its main planner switched to a different version. This means you might see slightly different responses, and the new model may use your data for training.

1499a9d866f9946dca7209a07323b0c4b501c60b.text: The assistant no longer checks for and removes repeated responses from its tools. This small internal change may cause the assistant to report errors if it tries to use a tool multiple times.

2a8c8af1fba063ed768cafb0e9585b8f560a25fe.text: The testing team now checks for missing or unstable tests that previously went unnoticed. This helps catch problems earlier, so the product works more reliably.

4fa56551886ce92ff07d05bc42107ed53ae03a5f.text: The app now records when you change desktop startup settings. This data helps improve the product. You will not notice any change in how it works.

860318a19c3c2bd12795963a2e50917ca79e0ba5.text: Internal checks that broke when run at the same time are fixed. This change does not affect how the product works.

977abd5ce06611d6fe900d31310c581dfcd95291.text: Internal checks were reorganized to run in parallel, cutting the time needed to verify changes. This speeds up updates and bug fixes without changing the product itself.

8e956567928c769287011b3a1b8974d8d646631a.text: Some background tests used to fail without showing any error, so problems could hide. This fix makes those failures visible and prevents a few checks from being skipped.

801a9d02c935e19c2f9529d1330b0de6eac555c4.text: The assistant now skips extra processing steps for short results, delivering answers faster.

a74c20dc1479774fddf8507f9d9d4ca9e7b6d8f9.text: The team added instructions for a tool that finds random glitches by stressing the system. This helps keep the app stable, but users will not notice a direct change.

cb153c1518104ed5254b2189f9dd5d5794600fef.text: The app now secretly records how busy its main engine is. This helps the team see if slowness comes from the app itself or the internet, so they can fix slow tab opening.

c9bdd9c7b58e05b498d296cf64fcaaa3db54890d.text: The assistant now checks if it already received a response from a tool before adding it again. This prevents errors when the system tries to send the same result twice.

0ff93e746badad951717b0a70386bf5b24701517.text: The system now fixes broken conversation records automatically. This stops errors from appearing during chats.

6fbfd71dd51c396171b911b5fc3894984e0a3dd9.text: The paid lite version now uses a newer AI engine, while the free version stays on its current one. Scoring tools now use two different judges to average results, preventing errors from one judge failing.

1402b75d5bd6d305c9bb326da1e9fb0c60a4b35e.text: The assistant's underlying brain got a major upgrade, making it smarter and more reliable. This change ensures all parts of the product use the same, latest version of the brain, so you get a consistent experience everywhere.

d00f185a4d65a008126a1fbe4e4516fbf003414d.text: The computer stopped recording an old type of internal data that no longer happens. This change does not affect how you use the product.

3c92d4e7bd963920744771f9af70a7740f5db53b.text: The assistant now checks memory limits before answering to prevent errors when switching models.

8e2ef71f5db6f210951e6086acaa0618bf80e055.text: Background helpers now use a newer, smarter assistant model. This helps the product understand and complete tasks better, though it costs a bit more to run.

326a33d9c24c462f1640172b775db7a368e84e56.text: The assistant now gives shorter, simpler plan summaries to you. It moves technical details to a separate place, so the main overview stays easy to read.

2d0defa35f3f84fc905fcc5fd0d677726ff4d32b.text: The assistant can now use a new model. This adds another option for generating text.
