Adds explicit note to summary prompt: condensed markers (`[USER]`, `Read files:`) are log-only, not response format. Covers agents context compaction via context-pruner.ts. Prevents agent from imitating summary markers instead of issuing real tool calls.

759536f390f1616d3e4f73ac9aa8e40c2d40f22c.title: SDK: Fix reasoning.exclude suppression
759536f390f1616d3e4f73ac9aa8e40c2d40f22c.summary: Fixed bug where `reasoning.exclude` option failed to suppress reasoning tokens in `promptAiSdkStream`. Logic now correctly checks provider options for `openrouter` and `codebuff` before yielding reasoning deltas. Changes confined to `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`.

e68a330a70788ea18964be0be64004d86c8be051.title: Fireworks fallback to standard API on any 500 error
e68a330a70788ea18964be0be64004d86c8be051.summary: Fireworks custom deployment fallback logic updated to trigger on any 5xx status code, replacing the previous 503-only check. This ensures transient server errors (500, 502, 504) also fall through to the standard API, improving reliability. The `DEPLOYMENT_SCALING_UP` specific handling remains but is now nested within the broader 5xx condition. Affects `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts`.

db4d3b66234703d944bc7a867be44b83b0236d59.title: Add thinker-gemini agent for free tier
db4d3b66234703d944bc7a867be44b83b0236d59.summary: New `thinker-gemini` agent added using `google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview` model. Free tier users are instructed to spawn this agent for complex problems. `thinker-gpt` updated to remove `providerOptions`.

2df5e04d4e070ae1a75a7fb195654b626c771f7a.text: The assistant can now find and use custom instructions you save in specific folders on your computer, even if they were not loaded at startup. This means you can create new skills without restarting the app.

db4d3b66234703d944bc7a867be44b83b0236d59.text: The assistant now uses a new thinking model for free users to solve hard problems better.

ce142ff1af0292cfac040f7e7cc82402e1424145.text: Internal testing tools updated to use a new evaluation setup for the assistant. No changes to how you use the product.

d4f08ddeb63417f96c4ba9c7e30fd80e608b52a8.text: The assistant's internal thinking step is now less detailed. This change makes responses slightly faster and more concise.

a64c5cc462ef3da1ed159b2a103a9f8e926e790d.text: Internal tools now save detailed activity logs for testing, but only when a specific setting is turned on. This does not change how the product works for you.

894a5b618d53a24c2af1bb8db82fb17bb3494dbd.text: The assistant now ignores internal formatting markers in its memory, preventing it from accidentally copying them instead of performing actual tasks.

927f7722099850cff0b359c9f3f7d28be459c95c.text: Free users now always get a deeper thinking step before the assistant answers. This helps the assistant plan better responses without you needing to ask for it.

d6769f7b647e6866397210dda0957bd180ea3b8a.text: The assistant now needs a clear instruction and a specific command to run tasks in the background. This change ensures it understands exactly what to do before starting.

759536f390f1616d3e4f73ac9aa8e40c2d40f22c.text: Fixed a bug where the option to hide internal thinking steps did not work. Now, when you choose to hide these steps, they stay hidden.

e68a330a70788ea18964be0be64004d86c8be051.text: If the main system gets overloaded, the app now automatically switches to a backup system for any type of server error. This helps keep the assistant working smoothly without interruptions.

c89706ad40999ddc78d23a062d26787fd212cbbd.title: Change Stop button label to Esc
c89706ad40999ddc78d23a062d26787fd212cbbd.summary: Stop button label updated from Stop to Esc in cli/src/components/stop-button.tsx. Reflects keybinding convention for interrupting execution. Affects CLI surface only.

0df74ef688d9809f4d6e1897f386c3e2e38861dd.title: Expensivebuff CLI package added for April Fools
0df74ef688d9809f4d6e1897f386c3e2e38861dd.summary: Added `expensivebuff` npm package (v1.0.4) as an April Fools joke. The CLI binary prints an ASCII logo and directs users to the real Codebuff and Freebuff packages. Includes `expensivebuff/cli/release/README.md`, `index.js`, and `package.json`.

1579802a544a49757295094a45979ea4e0f16c3a.title: CLI fix agent cancellation lock release
1579802a544a49757295094a45979ea4e0f16c3a.summary: Immediate release of chain lock and queue state on user abort in `send-message.ts`. Previous behavior held lock until `client.run()` resolved, blocking new messages. New logic updates `isProcessingQueueRef` and `setCanProcessQueue` directly in abort handler. `handleRunCompletion` and `use-send-message.ts` skip redundant state resets if `abortController.signal.aborted` is true.

868fb291a133d92404b1bc086e483a7823cd053a.title: Remove evalbuff and expensivebuff
868fb291a133d92404b1bc086e483a7823cd053a.summary: Deleted evalbuff directory and references in AGENTS.md. Removes documentation and code for the eval optimization loop. Scope limited to repo structure and agent docs.

448db9644f4e3a13231905e15d9a9faca0cb7ca7.title: Expand top-freebuff-users script with detailed metrics
448db9644f4e3a13231905e15d9a9faca0cb7ca7.summary: The `top-freebuff-users.ts` script now accepts a configurable `agentId` argument (default `base2-free`) and expands output to include detailed per-user statistics such as daily/hourly activity, token usage, and cache hit rates. It aggregates data via additional SQL queries for daily and hourly distributions, rendering ASCII bar charts for time-of-day and day-of-week usage patterns. Default lookback window increased to 168 hours (1 week) and limit reduced to 50 users. Internal tooling only; no user-facing changes.

66318e6a90d7de70353f12eeaf80b2c7058b8652.title: Update Freebuff landing page FAQ and LOADED description
66318e6a90d7de70353f12eeaf80b2c7058b8652.summary: Clarifies the 'How can it be free?' FAQ answer to specify 'text ads' in the CLI. Updates the 'LOADED' philosophy description to list 'code review, browser use, deep thinking' and append 'and more' instead of a fixed list. Changes confined to `freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx`.

bb432101d7f49b21528f013bebf610882f5d6afb.title: CLI wrapper prints crash diagnostics for SIGILL and SIGSEGV
bb432101d7f49b21528f013bebf610882f5d6afb.summary: The CLI release wrapper adds `printCrashDiagnostics` to detect and report `SIGILL`, `SIGSEGV`, `SIGBUS`, and `SIGABRT` exits, including Windows NTSTATUS equivalents like `0xC000001D`. It also introduces `resetTerminal` to emit ANSI escape sequences clearing alternate screen, mouse, and bracketed paste modes when the child process is killed. This applies to `cli/release/index.js` and `freebuff/cli/release/index.js`, ensuring the parent process cleans up terminal state and provides actionable error messages for binary compatibility issues.

0f588b09f03c5086960f61d84df918a3e6303686.title: Remove dead CLI test code and stale docs
0f588b09f03c5086960f61d84df918a3e6303686.summary: Deleted cli/src/__tests__/path-completion.test.ts and cli/src/__tests__/unit/copy-button.test.ts as dead code. Removed docs/evalbuff/interpreting-task-prompts.md. Scope covers CLI tests and EvalBuff docs.

c8bfaa1f66a85810bce9989c8fa8719ca8481b80.title: Symlink CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md, improve doc read tracking
c8bfaa1f66a85810bce9989c8fa8719ca8481b80.summary: Added CLAUDE.md symlink to AGENTS.md in evalbuff/src/run-carve-eval.ts to ensure Claude Code auto-loads shared agent docs. Updated copyDocsIntoRepo to create the symlink if missing and include it in git staging. Enhanced runCarveEval to accumulate and log doc reads across baseline and re-run iterations for better tracking.

ecc1502818ffdeef7c0a8d074f5f02bbb5b51e97.title: Add retrieval-led reasoning note to AGENTS.md
ecc1502818ffdeef7c0a8d074f5f02bbb5b51e97.summary: AGENTS.md now prioritizes retrieval-led reasoning over pre-training-led reasoning, instructing agents to read relevant docs before implementation. Doc links in the file were simplified from markdown links to plain text paths. evalbuff/src/run-carve-eval.ts added helpers to track and merge doc file reads from agent traces, exposing `docsRead` in `CarveEvalResult`.

1579802a544a49757295094a45979ea4e0f16c3a.text: When you stop a response, the system now frees up immediately, letting you send your next message without waiting. This prevents the tool from getting stuck in a 'busy' state after you cancel.

868fb291a133d92404b1bc086e483a7823cd053a.text: The company removed an internal tool that helped the assistant learn and improve. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

c89706ad40999ddc78d23a062d26787fd212cbbd.text: The Stop button now says Esc. This matches how you usually cancel things.

0f588b09f03c5086960f61d84df918a3e6303686.text: The software team removed unused internal test files and an outdated guide. This change does not affect how you use the product.

448db9644f4e3a13231905e15d9a9faca0cb7ca7.text: Internal reporting tools now show detailed activity statistics for top users. This change does not affect the product experience.

0df74ef688d9809f4d6e1897f386c3e2e38861dd.text: An April Fools' joke was added to the software. It does not change how the product works for you.

66318e6a90d7de70353f12eeaf80b2c7058b8652.text: The help page now explains that text ads pay for the free service. It also shows more examples of what the assistant can do, like reviewing code and browsing the web, and notes that this list keeps growing.

c8bfaa1f66a85810bce9989c8fa8719ca8481b80.text: The assistant can now automatically use shared guidelines, ensuring consistent behavior. Internal tracking of document usage was also improved.

ecc1502818ffdeef7c0a8d074f5f02bbb5b51e97.text: The assistant now reads relevant documents before answering or building things, which helps it give more accurate results. This is a small internal update that improves how the assistant finds and uses information.

bb432101d7f49b21528f013bebf610882f5d6afb.text: If the program crashes due to a compatibility issue, it now shows a clear error message instead of leaving your screen broken.

fa7a9595e40b9274416ac57d46ca2474b7d570a5.title: Add google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview to agent types and Buffbench judge
fa7a9595e40b9274416ac57d46ca2474b7d570a5.summary: The ModelName union in agent-definition.ts accepts 'google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview'. The Buffbench judge agent 'judge-gemini' now uses this model instead of 'google/gemini-3-pro-preview'. Changes apply to .agents/types/agent-definition.ts, agents/types/agent-definition.ts, common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts, and evals/buffbench/judge.ts.

bc92e426ed46b2e0e36f445d859859675e559028.title: thinker-gpt stops inheriting parent system prompt
bc92e426ed46b2e0e36f445d859859675e559028.summary: Added `inheritParentSystemPrompt: false` to the `thinker-gpt` agent definition in `agents/thinker/thinker-gpt.ts`. The agent now runs with only its own instructions prompt, preventing parent system prompt leakage. Scope limited to the thinker-gpt agent config.

ec3f863b4fc3c158a975971a5633d8f0317636d1.title: Tool executor error includes truncated input
ec3f863b4fc3c158a975971a5633d8f0317636d1.summary: Tool executor now appends the original tool call input to error messages. Input is JSON-stringified and truncated at 500 chars to prevent log bloat. Affects `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts` in both standard and custom tool execution paths.

caf904df1dba70f89294614c03fa39906d09fa90.title: Stop button idle contrast raised
caf904df1dba70f89294614c03fa39906d09fa90.summary: StopButton idle state switches from TextAttributes.DIM to TextAttributes.NONE in cli/src/components/stop-button.tsx. Raises contrast for the unhovered ■ Stop label. Scope limited to the CLI stop-button component. No migration or config impact.

ae389387291f5e23faa1e1392195593ea81b49c2.title: Fix condition hook use in message-with-agents
ae389387291f5e23faa1e1392195593ea81b49c2.summary: Moved `useMemo` hook above conditional returns in `AgentChildrenGrid` within `cli/src/components/message-with-agents.tsx`. This resolves React hook rule violations where hooks were called after early returns (`agentChildren.length === 0` or `depth >= MAX_AGENT_DEPTH`). Scope limited to CLI component rendering. Ensures consistent hook execution order regardless of render path.

149a328add45abd7bc11cecd4ee0bec3c2d0fdf0.title: CLI terminal reset and error propagation fixes
149a328add45abd7bc11cecd4ee0bec3c2d0fdf0.summary: CLI wrapper and renderer now enforce terminal state reset (alternate screen, mouse, cursor) on SIGKILL or fatal errors. `renderer-cleanup.ts` exports `TERMINAL_RESET_SEQUENCES` for reuse in `cli/release/index.js` and `freebuff/cli/release/index.js`. Early `uncaughtException` handlers in `cli/src/index.tsx` ensure errors print to the main screen before renderer init. Wrapper update logic uses `once('exit')` and explicit `resetTerminal()` calls to prevent state leakage.

ff5f05819b65bdfcbd25b3f67c4ec1dd8130878d.title: Update Freebuff home description
ff5f05819b65bdfcbd25b3f67c4ec1dd8130878d.summary: home-client.tsx updates FAQ and philosophy text to highlight 9 specialized subagents, including thinker-gpt, and clarifies slash commands. Scope limited to Web UI copy and styling (zinc-500 to zinc-400).

5edd8088d621ddf38c76a323de30c93e37f3fc08.title: coerceToArray wraps zod array schemas in tool params
5edd8088d621ddf38c76a323de30c93e37f3fc08.summary: Added `coerceToArray` preprocess wrapper to array fields in `ask-user`, `propose-str-replace`, `read-files`, `read-subtree`, `spawn-agents`, `str-replace`, and `suggest-followups`. Handles upstream models emitting single objects instead of arrays for tool arguments. Scope limited to `common/src/tools/params/tool/` schemas.

5f271d644e4e896d600fdff14f81b27fe5b84d02.title: Add carve-based eval pipeline to evalbuff
5f271d644e4e896d600fdff14f81b27fe5b84d02.summary: evalbuff now supports carve-based evaluation via `carve-features.ts` and `run-carve-eval.ts`, which analyze a codebase to identify features, generate diffs that delete them, and run agents to rebuild them against ground truth. This replaces the previous git-commit-based eval approach. The `ClaudeRunner` now accepts a configurable `model` argument (defaulting to `claude-opus-4-5-20251101`), and `openai` v6.33.0 is added to `evalbuff`'s dependencies.

3886a0c449d74a23d08ff1e60013f689c18f53ef.title: Remove stale planning docs and rename authentication knowledge file
3886a0c449d74a23d08ff1e60013f689c18f53ef.summary: Deleted CREATIVE_FEATURES_DEMO.md, REFACTORING_PLAN.md, and ROADMAP.md to remove obsolete internal planning and demo artifacts. Renamed authentication.knowledge.md to docs/authentication.md to align with standard documentation structure. This cleanup affects only repository documentation files.

caf904df1dba70f89294614c03fa39906d09fa90.text: The stop button now displays with higher contrast when not active. This makes the button easier to see and identify.

3886a0c449d74a23d08ff1e60013f689c18f53ef.text: The team cleaned up old internal planning notes and organized the login guide. This change affects only internal files and does not alter how the product works for users.

ec3f863b4fc3c158a975971a5633d8f0317636d1.text: When a tool fails, the error message now shows a short snippet of the request that caused the problem. This helps support staff diagnose issues faster without exposing full private data.

ae389387291f5e23faa1e1392195593ea81b49c2.text: A small internal fix ensures the interface displays agent information correctly without crashing. You likely won't notice any difference unless you previously saw errors.

fa7a9595e40b9274416ac57d46ca2474b7d570a5.text: The system now uses a newer version of its AI model to review and grade agent performance. This update aims to improve the accuracy of these automatic checks.

149a328add45abd7bc11cecd4ee0bec3c2d0fdf0.text: The program now cleans up the screen properly if it crashes. You will see error messages instead of a broken display.

bc92e426ed46b2e0e36f445d859859675e559028.text: A small internal update stops one assistant type from accidentally mixing in instructions from other parts of the system. This means the assistant follows its specific rules more accurately.

ff5f05819b65bdfcbd25b3f67c4ec1dd8130878d.text: The app's home page text now explains that it uses nine specialized helpers and clarifies how to use slash commands. The visual appearance of some text changed slightly to be lighter.

5f271d644e4e896d600fdff14f81b27fe5b84d02.text: The testing system now checks the assistant by removing features and seeing if it can rebuild them. This is an internal update to improve how the assistant learns, so you will not notice any immediate changes.

5edd8088d621ddf38c76a323de30c93e37f3fc08.text: The assistant now accepts single items where it expects a list, preventing errors when users provide just one entry instead of multiple.

946dd70655b5aca3929477e67877f1d6a3fd7584.title: Fix flaky e2e CLI tests
946dd70655b5aca3929477e67877f1d6a3fd7584.summary: Increased timeout to 8s and added exit listener in `e2e-cli.test.ts`. Fixes flakiness from slow CI startup. Scope: CLI test suite.

3f5910ed11a32b551ef094318694f0d7010f09da.title: CLI status bar gains stop button during streaming
3f5910ed11a32b551ef094318694f0d7010f09da.summary: New `StopButton` component added to CLI status bar. Renders only when `statusIndicatorState` is `waiting` or `streaming`, wired to `onInterruptStream`. Files: `cli/src/components/stop-button.tsx` (new), `cli/src/components/status-bar.tsx`, `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Button uses `■ Stop` label with hover-triggered `TextAttributes.BOLD`.

5ca697b1fb19d7a2c270c3cd2266f920b8628f20.title: Add strict: true to fireworks tool definitions
5ca697b1fb19d7a2c270c3cd2266f920b8628f20.summary: Strict mode enabled for Fireworks function tools in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. Maps tool definitions to inject strict: true, preventing hallucinated call formats. Internal API payload adjustment.

dd82cab4cfa6b71e670946fd7a226056e84737ac.title: Fix message context loss on CLI response cancellation
dd82cab4cfa6b71e670946fd7a226056e84737ac.summary: Moved `finalizeQueueState` from the abort listener in `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts` to `handleRunCompletion` to prevent race conditions where users could send new messages before the cancelled run's state was saved. This ensures the chain lock remains held until `client.run()` resolves, preserving message history integrity. Scope covers CLI streaming hooks and associated SDK cancellation tests.

6bbf8ceebddb2347b03e358dba07c820f7142276.title: Add FREEBUFFGITHUBID/SECRET env vars for OAuth
6bbf8ceebddb2347b03e358dba07c820f7142276.summary: Added optional FREEBUFF_GITHUB_ID and FREEBUFF_GITHUB_SECRET to env schema and defaults. auth-options.ts now uses these vars with fallback to CODEBUFF_* equivalents. next.config.mjs sets NEXTAUTH_URL in dev mode. Updated .env.example and CI env defaults.

acef43db12096e373ff788fff9443bf01523b682.title: CLI renderer enable alternate screen buffer
acef43db12096e373ff788fff9443bf01523b682.summary: CLI renderer sets useAlternateScreen: true in createCliRenderer. Terminal reset sequences now include \x1b[?1049l to exit alternate screen buffer. Scope: cli/src/index.tsx, cli/src/utils/renderer-cleanup.ts. Cleanup handler writes reset codes directly to stdout.

571084860ec1996fc025e54911935ff59e722105.title: Agent grid splits large agents onto full-width lines
571084860ec1996fc025e54911935ff59e722105.summary: Consecutive small agents share a `GridLayout` row while each large agent gets its own full-width line. `block-processor.ts` adds `splitByAgentSize` and `splitAgentsBySize` using `shouldCollapseByDefault` to partition items. `agent-block-grid.tsx` and `message-with-agents.tsx` map these subgroups into stacked `GridLayout` instances inside a column `box`. Small agents collapse by default and pack together; large agents render at full terminal width.

42c96674ee31177b09bc05b4483909a9690a37df.title: evalbuff signal quality fixes and doc writer edit history
42c96674ee31177b09bc05b4483909a9690a37df.summary: commit-task-generator.ts filters lockfile noise (bun.lock, package-lock.json, etc.) from diffs and file lists to improve eval signal quality. docs-optimizer.ts adds DocEditHistoryEntry interface and formatEditHistory function to track accepted/rejected doc edits with score deltas, feeding history into the analysis prompt. run-evalbuff.ts commits pre-loaded docs into test repos to prevent git diff HEAD corruption, adds scoreBefore/scoreAfter to docsKept/docsRejected arrays, and caps improvement iterations at 5.

088ce23eb3b6e81ffe376d02ac0ccd6a9a36d7a0.title: Add /b/:hash redirect to go.trybeluga.ai
088ce23eb3b6e81ffe376d02ac0ccd6a9a36d7a0.summary: Added redirects configuration to `next.config.mjs`. `/b/:hash` paths now redirect to `https://go.trybeluga.ai/:hash`. Change is scoped to the Web Next.js config. Redirects are non-permanent.

e1b8a1bf045f51ea8c38f67a3bb2bf5006150444.title: evalbuff direct LLM API and trivial commit filtering
e1b8a1bf045f51ea8c38f67a3bb2bf5006150444.summary: evalbuff package replaces `claude` CLI spawning with direct `@ai-sdk/anthropic` API calls in `evalbuff/src/llm.ts`, removing process overhead and context pollution. `commit-task-generator.ts` adds `isTrivialCommit` logic to skip version bumps and changelog updates, saving agent invocations. Judge aggregation switches to averaging scores across reviewers to neutralize model-specific biases. New `base2-free-evals.ts` agent definition supports the free evals orchestrator.

dd82cab4cfa6b71e670946fd7a226056e84737ac.text: Fixed a bug where canceling a response could wipe out previous chat history. Now, stopping a message keeps the conversation context intact.

5ca697b1fb19d7a2c270c3cd2266f920b8628f20.text: A small internal update helps the assistant follow instructions for using tools more accurately. This means fewer mistakes when it tries to perform actions.

42c96674ee31177b09bc05b4483909a9690a37df.text: The assistant now tracks past document edits to make smarter recommendations. It also ignores irrelevant file changes to focus on real work.

946dd70655b5aca3929477e67877f1d6a3fd7584.text: A small internal update improved the reliability of automated checks. This helps ensure the command-line tool works consistently without interruptions.

571084860ec1996fc025e54911935ff59e722105.text: The display now separates large and small items into their own rows. Large items stretch across the full screen width, while smaller items group together to save space.

6bbf8ceebddb2347b03e358dba07c820f7142276.text: The system now supports a new way to sign in with GitHub. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

3f5910ed11a32b551ef094318694f0d7010f09da.text: A Stop button now appears in the status bar while the assistant is working or typing. Clicking it interrupts the current response.

acef43db12096e373ff788fff9443bf01523b682.text: The app now uses a separate screen area for its display. When the app closes, it automatically restores your previous terminal view.

e1b8a1bf045f51ea8c38f67a3bb2bf5006150444.text: The assistant now talks to its brain directly instead of through a middleman, making it faster and more focused. It also ignores boring updates like version numbers, saving time and money.

088ce23eb3b6e81ffe376d02ac0ccd6a9a36d7a0.text: Links starting with /b/ now go to the correct Beluga page. This is a small fix to help links work better.

67c066f27636e4016d3dcea7f0b002c9f1e9a610.title: Remove wait-for command from tmux CLI agent
67c066f27636e4016d3dcea7f0b002c9f1e9a610.summary: The tmux CLI agent helper script no longer supports the `wait-for` command. The implementation in `agents/tmux-cli.ts` has been removed, along with all references in usage strings, system prompts, and documentation. Users and agents must now rely exclusively on `wait-idle` to stabilize output before sending further input.

abe4eb8d07ac905d29a84ce6397dce7cef5c7f36.title: Login page styling refresh
abe4eb8d07ac905d29a84ce6397dce7cef5c7f36.summary: Login page and sign-in components receive visual styling updates. Background gradients, glassmorphism cards, and refined button states applied. Files: freebuff/web/src/app/login/page.tsx, freebuff/web/src/components/login/login-card.tsx, freebuff/web/src/components/sign-in/sign-in-button.tsx, freebuff/web/src/components/sign-in/sign-in-card-footer.tsx.

c1b713e625d91c6c8e60899f4235b4c3b5b71c85.title: Increase Free Mode Rate Limits
c1b713e625d91c6c8e60899f4235b4c3b5b71c85.summary: Free mode rate limits raised in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/free-mode-rate-limiter.ts`. `PER_MINUTE` 20 to 25, `PER_30_MINUTES` 200 to 250, `PER_5_HOURS` 1000 to 2000, `PER_7_DAYS` 10000 to 20000. `PER_SECOND` unchanged at 2. Scope limited to web API rate limiter constants.

2007a95dcb103c5d503abbef858a5c69af72e12c.title: Rework evalbuff: commit learning, parallel agents, trace compression
2007a95dcb103c5d503abbef858a5c69af72e12c.summary: Evalbuff restructured around two modes: Commit Learning (default) walks git history oldest-first, generating vague prompts from diffs and running N parallel agents (default 5) against parent commits, with state saved per-commit for resume; Prompt Mode runs a single prompt without git history. New `commit-task-generator.ts` extracts commit info, filters merge/initial commits, and caps diffs at 200k chars. `trace-compressor.ts` added to compress agent traces before feeding them to the doc-writer agent, reducing token usage. `cli-runner.ts` now spawns detached process groups and kills the entire tree on timeout via `process.kill(-pid, 'SIGKILL')`, preventing orphaned child processes.

a8119a983e8b19a7e803234bb762b0dc4b01c48b.title: Refactor knowledge.md into AGENTS.md and docs/
a8119a983e8b19a7e803234bb762b0dc4b01c48b.summary: Split monolithic knowledge.md into AGENTS.md for core conventions and multiple docs/ files for agents, dev, env, and testing. This modularizes documentation for easier maintenance and targeted reference. Covers root AGENTS.md, docs/agents-and-tools.md, docs/development.md, docs/environment-variables.md, and docs/testing.md.

1c5d74b8b0729556a69dc6f0e8fc1c0ab2a2174c.title: Sign-in button hover background adjustment
1c5d74b8b0729556a69dc6f0e8fc1c0ab2a2174c.summary: Added `hover:bg-zinc-800` to the `SignInButton` component. Improves visual feedback on hover by darkening the background alongside existing border and shadow effects. Applies to `freebuff/web/src/components/sign-in/sign-in-button.tsx`.

71db42d0a57ade0f25939cedd4fab6060e41232f.title: Fix free-mode-rate-limiter test time advancement
71db42d0a57ade0f25939cedd4fab6060e41232f.summary: Corrected time advancement logic in `free-mode-rate-limiter.test.ts` to accurately simulate 30-minute window resets without exceeding the 5-hour limit prematurely. The test now calculates elapsed time within inner loops before advancing the clock, ensuring the final check correctly triggers the 5-hour limit.

49dbb241650a6c468387d87c21dd4677824a39c5.title: Add evalbuff docs optimization loop and handleSteps generator patterns
49dbb241650a6c468387d87c21dd4677824a39c5.summary: Introduced `evalbuff/` subsystem for automated documentation optimization via iterative agent evaluation. Added `docs/patterns/handle-steps-generators.md` detailing correct `handleSteps` generator signatures, `spawn_agents` tool call structures, and `STEP` yielding patterns to prevent TypeScript errors. Moved legacy evalbuff CLI and agent definitions to `evalbuff/old/` while updating `AGENTS.md` with new subsystem and documentation links.

5e8ed7bfaf21a0a33ad7c498ef064239a3525c81.title: Add signupSource to Loops signup event
5e8ed7bfaf21a0a33ad7c498ef064239a3525c81.summary: sendSignupEventToLoops now accepts optional signupSource param, defaulting to 'codebuff'. Auth callbacks pass explicit source: 'freebuff' in freebuff/web auth-options.ts, 'codebuff' in web auth-options.ts. Value lands in Loops contactProperties.signupSource. Covers packages/internal/src/loops/client.ts plus both NextAuth entry points.

54f4585e20a1b0c4ece8a8d9197d9697f9df7c36.title: AGENTS.md simplified, opencode submodule removed
54f4585e20a1b0c4ece8a8d9197d9697f9df7c36.summary: AGENTS.md updated to reflect current architecture, adding freebuff and evalbuff descriptions while removing obsolete goals, request flow, and conventions sections. opencode submodule deleted. Repo-only change; no user-facing behavior or API impact.

abe4eb8d07ac905d29a84ce6397dce7cef5c7f36.text: The login page looks different now, with softer colors and smoother buttons. Nothing about how you sign in has changed.

1c5d74b8b0729556a69dc6f0e8fc1c0ab2a2174c.text: The sign-in button now darkens slightly when you hover over it. This small change gives clearer visual feedback that the button is interactive.

67c066f27636e4016d3dcea7f0b002c9f1e9a610.text: The assistant stopped using one old way to wait for a screen to be ready. It now uses a single, more reliable method for this step.

71db42d0a57ade0f25939cedd4fab6060e41232f.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system checks time limits. This ensures the free mode resets accurately and prevents it from stopping too early.

54f4585e20a1b0c4ece8a8d9197d9697f9df7c36.text: The team updated their internal guide and removed a tool that no longer works. This change only affects the developers' workspace and does not alter how the product functions for you.

c1b713e625d91c6c8e60899f4235b4c3b5b71c85.text: The free version of the service now allows more messages over time. You can send slightly more requests each minute and many more over longer periods before hitting a limit.

49dbb241650a6c468387d87c21dd4677824a39c5.text: The team improved how the system checks and updates its own instructions to make sure it works correctly. This internal change helps keep the assistant reliable, but you will not notice any difference in how you use it.

a8119a983e8b19a7e803234bb762b0dc4b01c48b.text: The instructions for the assistant were broken into smaller, organized sections. This helps the team update guidance more easily without affecting unrelated areas.

2007a95dcb103c5d503abbef858a5c69af72e12c.text: The tool now checks changes in reverse order to learn from past work, using multiple assistants at once for speed. It also cleans up leftover background tasks to prevent system slowdowns and reduces the amount of text it processes to save space.

5e8ed7bfaf21a0a33ad7c498ef064239a3525c81.text: The system now records which website you signed up from. This helps the company understand how people find the product.

65c4187f2e28a11c50b3c9e143f3362f328861b5.title: Simplify get-started header
65c4187f2e28a11c50b3c9e143f3362f328861b5.summary: Removed absolute-positioned nav header from `get-started-client.tsx`. Adjusted main content padding to compensate for removed header height. Scope limited to Web get-started page. No functional changes to model logic or data.

9ca55a5f430b82d293a1a8035eed89e612d3cdb2.title: Context pruner reads correct params for findfiles and readdocs
9ca55a5f430b82d293a1a8035eed89e612d3cdb2.summary: agents/context-pruner.ts summaries for find_files and read_docs read input.prompt and input.libraryTitle/input.topic respectively. find_files previously read input.pattern; read_docs previously read input.query. Scope: agents/context-pruner.ts only. No action.

6ca71dc98efecf951cc96f4ac3e0b6aa560cb6f8.title: Fix nightly e2e workflow agents path
6ca71dc98efecf951cc96f4ac3e0b6aa560cb6f8.summary: Nightly CI workflow path corrected from .agents to agents. Agents package test:e2e script removed. Ensures nightly runs target agents e2e tests.

a8f35eae25cefcebf9ff85cce0fb28e7a668dc9c.title: Linux headless check reads DISPLAY via getCliEnv
a8f35eae25cefcebf9ff85cce0fb28e7a668dc9c.summary: safeOpen now reads DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY from getCliEnv() instead of process.env directly. CliEnv type and getCliEnv() extended to expose display server vars for Linux headless detection. Covers CLI utils open-url.ts, env.ts, types/env.ts. Keeps browser-open skip warning behavior identical.

8d0bbfb78f0ffafa963dbf606c63e57af75b31e3.title: Bun 1.3.11 replaces 1.3.5 across workspace
8d0bbfb78f0ffafa963dbf606c63e57af75b31e3.summary: Bun version pinned to 1.3.11, replacing 1.3.5. Range specifiers like ^1.3.5 and >=1.3.5 replaced with exact 1.3.11 in engines and packageManager fields. Covers root package.json, .bun-version, and all workspace packages including CLI, evals, agent-runtime, and web. Types packages @types/bun and bun-types updated to match.

2b9c6ad7c87825fb63acc6ab00954d1bc9524bf9.title: CLI: Add conversation scope to review screen
2b9c6ad7c87825fb63acc6ab00954d1bc9524bf9.summary: Added 'conversation' to ReviewScope union and REVIEW_OPTIONS in cli/src/components/review-screen.tsx. Maps to 'all changes made in this conversation' in getReviewScopeText. Updates prompt-builders.ts to include new scope in buildReviewPrompt.

c6128f73521d191ff7f1e60047f6486a5c2918e4.title: Freebuff CLI login targets freebuff.com
c6128f73521d191ff7f1e60047f6486a5c2918e4.summary: CLI login flow now uses freebuff.com instead of codebuff.com when IS_FREEBUFF is true. New LOGIN_WEBSITE_URL constant in cli/src/login/constants.ts selects freebuff.com (or localhost:3002 in dev) for Freebuff builds. use-fetch-login-url.ts, use-login-polling.ts, and plain-login.ts consume the new constant for baseUrl. Codebuff builds retain the original WEBSITE_URL.

2d599476c5131484e22f488f306d89526df625e4.title: Add login and publish commands to CLI --help output
2d599476c5131484e22f488f306d89526df625e4.summary: The CLI `--help` output now lists `login` and `publish` commands via `addHelpText`. This improves discoverability of authentication and registry actions for users running `freebuff --help`. The change affects `cli/src/index.tsx` in both standard and lite/plan/max modes. In lite mode, only `login` is shown; in standard mode, both `login` and `publish` are appended.

97e7cadd60d76206b8344f53b07d5f30a24e3950.title: safeOpen wrapper prevents headless Linux crashes
97e7cadd60d76206b8344f53b07d5f30a24e3950.summary: New `safeOpen` utility in `cli/src/utils/open-url.ts` replaces direct `open()` calls across CLI components and OAuth flows. The wrapper detects headless Linux environments by checking `DISPLAY` and `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` env vars, skipping browser launch to prevent process crashes from `xdg-open` signals. Updates touch `chat.tsx`, `command-registry.ts`, banners, and OAuth handlers (`claude-oauth.ts`, `chatgpt-oauth.ts`) to use `safeOpen`.

3f47c49de6a9e18c2c045ef8119115eceb591952.title: Add HTTP proxy support to CLI installer
3f47c49de6a9e18c2c045ef8119115eceb591952.summary: The CLI installer now routes binary downloads and version checks through corporate proxies using standard environment variables. Previously, direct connections caused timeouts for users behind firewalls, requiring manual npm config changes that didn't affect Codebuff's native fetch logic. The update modifies `cli/release/index.js` and `freebuff/cli/release/index.js` to implement `HTTPS_PROXY`, `HTTP_PROXY`, and `NO_PROXY` handling via `CONNECT` tunneling. `WINDOWS.md` and `cli/release/README.md` document the new variables, noting that `npm config set proxy` only affects the initial npm install step, not subsequent Codebuff self-updates.

65c4187f2e28a11c50b3c9e143f3362f328861b5.text: The layout of the getting-started page was simplified. This small visual update does not change how the product works.

2b9c6ad7c87825fb63acc6ab00954d1bc9524bf9.text: You can now review all changes made in the current conversation with one click. This makes it easier to see everything the assistant did in this chat session.

c6128f73521d191ff7f1e60047f6486a5c2918e4.text: The login page now points to the correct website for this version of the tool. This fixes a small internal routing issue so you sign in at the right address.

9ca55a5f430b82d293a1a8035eed89e612d3cdb2.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system reads search requests. This ensures the assistant accurately finds and uses the right documents.

8d0bbfb78f0ffafa963dbf606c63e57af75b31e3.text: The project's underlying tools were updated to a newer version. This ensures everyone uses the same software, making the system more stable and consistent.

3f47c49de6a9e18c2c045ef8119115eceb591952.text: The installer now works with corporate networks that block direct internet access. It no longer times out when downloading updates, so you do not need to adjust extra settings manually.

6ca71dc98efecf951cc96f4ac3e0b6aa560cb6f8.text: A small internal fix ensures automated tests for the assistant run correctly. You will see no change in how the product works.

97e7cadd60d76206b8344f53b07d5f30a24e3950.text: The app now checks if it can open a web browser before trying. If it cannot, it skips that step to avoid crashing. This makes the tool more stable on computers without a graphical interface.

a8f35eae25cefcebf9ff85cce0fb28e7a668dc9c.text: The assistant now checks your computer's display settings to decide whether to open a link. This internal update helps the program work correctly on systems without a screen. You will not notice any changes in how links open.

2d599476c5131484e22f488f306d89526df625e4.text: The help menu now shows the login and publish options. This makes it easier for users to find and use these features.

f2cfd899c2e71d25f69fdf3e8bdd962a4325d003.title: Remove isDeploymentHours from Fireworks deployment routing tests
f2cfd899c2e71d25f69fdf3e8bdd962a4325d003.summary: Removed `isDeploymentHours` import and its 8 test cases from `web/src/llm-api/__tests__/fireworks-deployment.test.ts`. Replaced the `uses standard API outside deployment hours` test with `uses standard API when custom deployment is disabled`, switching from a time-based spy to an explicit `useCustomDeployment: false` flag. Scope: Fireworks deployment routing tests only. Detail: the routing decision moved from implicit ET-hour gating to an explicit boolean parameter.

953516b8f05bfc39c35b30a8ec762f68fca0e146.title: Reinstate custom deployment hours
953516b8f05bfc39c35b30a8ec762f68fca0e146.summary: The `isDeploymentHours` function in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` now enforces the 10:00-20:00 ET window by returning the calculated boolean instead of hardcoded `true`. This change restores the intended time-gating logic for custom deployments, which was previously bypassed by the temporary override. The modification affects only the Web surface via the LLM API integration.

fb1bbbe130c7397b115ad5517e1765f12d6f348b.title: Add referral attribution tracking
fb1bbbe130c7397b115ad5517e1765f12d6f348b.summary: New `ReferrerTracker` component attributes new users via PostHog. `get-started-client.tsx` stores referrer in `localStorage`; `onboard/page.tsx` mounts tracker to fire `FREEBUFF_REFERRER_ATTRIBUTED` and set `freebuff_referrer` user property once. Covers Web app.

e78d48287319787a3d2a64b144bcc76c67298303.title: Get-started page uses referrer param instead of ref
e78d48287319787a3d2a64b144bcc76c67298303.summary: The `get-started` page now reads the `referrer` query parameter instead of `ref` to populate the invitation title and client prop. This change aligns the parameter name with its semantic meaning in `freebuff/web/src/app/get-started/page.tsx`. The update applies to both `generateMetadata` and the page component. The 50-character slice limit on the referrer name remains unchanged.

4c95226fb382cfcb26fd7b5d09c57377cbfca2d6.title: Fix Enter key detection in terminals sending linefeed
4c95226fb382cfcb26fd7b5d09c57377cbfca2d6.summary: Added `terminal-enter-detection.ts` to treat `linefeed` keys as Enter when no `return` key is observed. Updated `chat-input-bar.tsx`, `multiline-input.tsx`, `use-chat-keyboard.ts`, and `keyboard-actions.ts` to use `isLinefeedActingAsEnter` and `markReturnKeySeen`. This resolves submission failures in niche Linux terminals that send `\n` instead of `\r` for Enter.

1ba9f20469e72bd2b6940227d8811577721861dd.title: Freebuff web adds PostHog analytics
1ba9f20469e72bd2b6940227d8811577721861dd.summary: Adds PostHog analytics to freebuff web via new PostHogProvider.tsx wrapping layout.tsx. Captures get-started and home page events defined in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. Includes proxy rewrites in next.config.mjs routing /ingest to us.i.posthog.com. Identifies users by email on session, resets on logout, gated by NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_API_KEY.

7d7138e1f7e4cfca6975491fdd467018717e29ea.title: README adds Freebuff install and description
7d7138e1f7e4cfca6975491fdd467018717e29ea.summary: README.md updated to introduce Freebuff. Includes npm install command, ad-supported model description, and links to freebuff/README.md. Title changed to Codebuff & Freebuff.

cdf440c5e1dc88edc40ee6b4f5de4773b3262b66.title: Add top-freebuff-users.ts script for usage analysis
cdf440c5e1dc88edc40ee6b4f5de4773b3262b66.summary: New scripts/top-freebuff-users.ts queries database to list top Freebuff-only users by message count within configurable time window. Excludes users with base2 or base2-max messages to isolate pure Freebuff usage. Reports email, messages, credits, cost, and last active timestamp. Flags users with ≥50 messages for high-usage review.

94809a3c60388d1c7f5a95708bb118a7967338d8.title: Get Started page
94809a3c60388d1c7f5a95708bb118a7967338d8.summary: Added `freebuff/web/src/app/get-started/page.tsx` and `get-started-client.tsx`. Detects OS for install command `npm install -g freebuff`. Displays editor logos for VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ, Terminal in `freebuff/web/public/logos/`.

a01949c4e199540a788ea5159ae63fc7c59d6cc2.title: Fireworks deployment enabled, followups mandatory
a01949c4e199540a788ea5159ae63fc7c59d6cc2.summary: Fireworks deployment accounts/james-65d217/deployments/lnfid5h9 activated in scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts. isDeploymentHours() in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts returns true, removing 10-20 ET window. Base agent prompt in agents/base2/base2.ts makes suggest_followups mandatory for questions. Summary instruction simplified.

f2cfd899c2e71d25f69fdf3e8bdd962a4325d003.text: The test checks for the special time window were removed and replaced with a direct switch to confirm the system uses the standard option when the special option is off. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

fb1bbbe130c7397b115ad5517e1765f12d6f348b.text: The app now remembers which website sent you here when you sign up. This helps the team understand how people discover the product.

953516b8f05bfc39c35b30a8ec762f68fca0e146.text: A temporary setting that let the system run at any time was removed. The system now follows the scheduled hours of 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM Eastern Time.

4c95226fb382cfcb26fd7b5d09c57377cbfca2d6.text: The program now recognizes the Enter key in some older Linux systems that previously caused submission errors. Users on these specific systems can now send messages normally.

94809a3c60388d1c7f5a95708bb118a7967338d8.text: A new guide now shows the right setup steps for your computer. It also lists which programs work with the tool.

a01949c4e199540a788ea5159ae63fc7c59d6cc2.text: The assistant is now active all day and always offers follow-up questions to help you explore topics further.

cdf440c5e1dc88edc40ee6b4f5de4773b3262b66.text: The team added an internal tool to find users who only use the free version and send many messages. This helps them understand how the free service is used without affecting the product experience.

1ba9f20469e72bd2b6940227d8811577721861dd.text: The website now records when people start using it or visit the home page. This helps the team see how often these actions happen.

e78d48287319787a3d2a64b144bcc76c67298303.text: The 'Get Started' page now uses a clearer label for the person who invited you. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change what you see or do.

7d7138e1f7e4cfca6975491fdd467018717e29ea.text: The team updated the help guide to explain how to get a new assistant that works for free because it shows ads.

8b391e482ac25b8c3eb93634e8102c2563d4cc07.title: Fireworks test script defaults to minimax-m2p5
8b391e482ac25b8c3eb93634e8102c2563d4cc07.summary: scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts switches FIREWORKS_MODEL to accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m2p5. The previous custom deployment accounts/james-65d217/deployments/lnfid5h9 is commented out. This aligns the long-running test with the public API model.

846076cc9b50bc4917ba2a020b4bf5e9f9aea00c.title: Fireworks minimax-m2.5 deployment id Infid5h9
846076cc9b50bc4917ba2a020b4bf5e9f9aea00c.summary: Fireworks deployment id for minimax/minimax-m2.5 changed from qne3jo8v to Infid5h9 in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. Update rotates the dedicated deployment account/james-65d217/deployments/Infid5h9. Scope limited to web fireworks.ts plus test script scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts comment. FIREWORKS_USE_CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT remains false.

4036f839da0e6fb7790a0288b271fabf5dc953d7.title: Enable custom Fireworks deployment flag
4036f839da0e6fb7790a0288b271fabf5dc953d7.summary: Set `FIREWORKS_USE_CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT` to `true` in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts`. Switched active model in `scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts` to `accounts/james-65d217/deployments/lnfid5h9`. Scope covers Web API config and test scripts.

7a2147533f1e73d451545edbd35f7238f180202b.title: free-mode-rate-limiter test stability fixes
7a2147533f1e73d451545edbd35f7238f180202b.summary: Refactored `free-mode-rate-limiter.test.ts` to remove reliance on `makeRequests` helper for per-second limit checks, replacing it with explicit loops. Updated time advancement logic in the 30-minute window test to advance by 1 minute instead of 1 second, ensuring the per-minute window expires before triggering the 30-minute limit. Scope limited to web API tests.

f6a994b95e61d9b5fe8e3eac9996eb1dd312d35a.title: Increase free-mode rate limits
f6a994b95e61d9b5fe8e3eac9996eb1dd312d35a.summary: Adjusted `FREE_MODE_RATE_LIMITS` in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/free-mode-rate-limiter.ts`. Increased `PER_SECOND` from 1 to 2 and `PER_MINUTE` from 15 to 20. This change specifically targets the web API surface.

2e555ff878222bcf498dade93f7cb3df2ab95112.title: Add X close button to ChatGPT connect banner
2e555ff878222bcf498dade93f7cb3df2ab95112.summary: Replaces the static `esc` hint with an interactive `x` close button in `cli/src/components/chatgpt-connect-banner.tsx`. The button calls `setInputMode('default')` from `useChatStore` to dismiss the banner. Applies to connected, error, loading, and initial states.

dae55fdfe7024589b8d7b6b03f71ac798c1b75fb.title: Add 1 request per second rate limit to free-mode-rate-limiter
dae55fdfe7024589b8d7b6b03f71ac798c1b75fb.summary: Added PER_SECOND: 1 to FREE_MODE_RATE_LIMITS and a 1-second window to RATE_WINDOWS in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/free-mode-rate-limiter.ts. This enforces a strict 1 request per second cap for free mode API calls, preceding the existing minute/hour/day limits. The change applies to the /v1/chat/completions endpoint logic.

546904add2511685af801fb09866d5c67d229196.title: CLI help banner shows workflow tip for connected ChatGPT OAuth
546904add2511685af801fb09866d5c67d229196.summary: Help banner in cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx now displays a workflow tip (/interview → /plan → implement → /review) when ChatGPT OAuth is connected. Previously, only the connection prompt appeared for unconnected users. Scope limited to CLI help banner component.

ad659432d52d69c2172658c9e154c93ebaa96d8e.title: setoutput accepts top-level or data-wrapped params
ad659432d52d69c2172658c9e154c93ebaa96d8e.summary: set_output handler now parses raw fields first, then falls back to `output.data` if top-level validation fails. This supports OpenAI strict schema enforcement by allowing a permissive `data: z.record(...)` input shape while injecting real outputSchema via prompt instructions. Agent prompt strings updated to explicitly mention both accepted formats. Validation errors now select the parse attempt with fewer Zod issues to provide more actionable retry feedback.

bc346d5d299af3d1c4c95a05012072c32dcd7807.title: Fix Fireworks deployment id for minimax-m2.5
bc346d5d299af3d1c4c95a05012072c32dcd7807.summary: Corrects the Fireworks deployment ID for minimax/minimax-m2.5 from Infid5h9 to lnfid5h9 in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. Updates the corresponding hardcoded model constant in scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts to match the corrected ID. Refines TTFT and output token rate calculations in the test script to handle undefined firstContentChunkTime gracefully.

2e555ff878222bcf498dade93f7cb3df2ab95112.text: A close button was added to the connection message. You can now click it to hide the message instead of pressing a key.

7a2147533f1e73d451545edbd35f7238f180202b.text: Internal tests for the free version were updated to run more reliably. This change improves system stability but does not affect how the product looks or works for users.

bc346d5d299af3d1c4c95a05012072c32dcd7807.text: Fixed a typo in the internal address for a new AI model. This change is small and invisible to you, but it helps the system find the model correctly.

4036f839da0e6fb7790a0288b271fabf5dc953d7.text: The system now uses a different, custom version of the AI model for internal tests. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

546904add2511685af801fb09866d5c67d229196.text: When you ask for help, the tool now shows a suggested step-by-step process for working with the assistant if your account is already connected.

dae55fdfe7024589b8d7b6b03f71ac798c1b75fb.text: The system now allows only one request per second for free users.

8b391e482ac25b8c3eb93634e8102c2563d4cc07.text: A small internal change updated the test system to use a newer assistant model. This helps the team check that the product works correctly with the latest version. You will not notice any difference when using the product.

ad659432d52d69c2172658c9e154c93ebaa96d8e.text: The assistant now handles two ways of receiving your instructions. This helps it understand your requests more reliably.

846076cc9b50bc4917ba2a020b4bf5e9f9aea00c.text: Internal systems updated the address used to connect to a specific AI model. This small change ensures the service stays online and does not affect how the product works.

f6a994b95e61d9b5fe8e3eac9996eb1dd312d35a.text: The app now allows more requests per second and minute for free users. This reduces waiting time.

78d22242fc0272fc1fffcb7dc8e11c65f62650ae.title: Add --isolated flag to browser-use MCP server
78d22242fc0272fc1fffcb7dc8e11c65f62650ae.summary: Added `--isolated` flag to `chrome-devtools-mcp` args in `agents/browser-use/browser-use.ts`. Ensures browser sessions run in isolated contexts to prevent state leakage between agent executions.

305645d86822a91dbc775f595fb8c46c1e938183.title: Add isfreebuff flag to CLI identifyUser call
305645d86822a91dbc775f595fb8c46c1e938183.summary: Updates `setAuthLoggerContext` in `cli/src/hooks/use-auth-state.ts` to include `is_freebuff: IS_FREEBUFF` in the `identifyUser` analytics payload. This change ensures user identification events correctly distinguish Freebuff instances from Codebuff. The flag is sourced from `../utils/constants`.

6bca8a1e31d8ac42f4355e0a255970e4d3e6902d.title: Add ttftms column to message table
6bca8a1e31d8ac42f4355e0a255970e4d3e6902d.summary: New migration 0042 adds `ttft_ms` integer column to `message` table. `consumeCreditsAndAddAgentStep` accepts and persists `ttftMs` alongside existing `latency_ms`. Update `packages/internal/src/db/schema.ts` and `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts` to reflect the new field. Migration file `0042_needy_jack_murdock.sql` handles schema change.

5e21d8a169f62b3ca201fa2e2ae2dcdda3906826.title: Add header-based country detection fallback for free mode
5e21d8a169f62b3ca201fa2e2ae2dcdda3906826.summary: Chat completions API now prioritizes `cf-ipcountry` and `x-vercel-ip-country` headers over GeoIP lookup for free mode gating. The `getCountryCode` helper replaces `getCountryFromIp`, filtering out 'XX' and 'T1' placeholders before falling back to IP resolution. Updates `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` with structured logging for header and GeoIP results to aid debugging.

afe8895a33fc3c6d600bee9b1291bd5b1a4f279a.title: context-pruner: Include edit results, exclude librarian, tmux-cli,
afe8895a33fc3c6d600bee9b1291bd5b1a4f279a.summary: context-pruner now serializes full JSON results for str_replace, propose_str_replace, write_file, and propose_write_file into the summary, replacing the previous diff-only extraction. This ensures edit outcomes are preserved when pruning context. The pruner also excludes librarian, tmux-cli, and browser-use from its processing scope.

304ebcc5c6ae9afe71d7da416c79dc7ae355c4c9.title: Add MiniMax cache stats script and fix usage stats denominator
304ebcc5c6ae9afe71d7da416c79dc7ae355c4c9.summary: Added scripts/query-minimax-cache-stats.ts to report overall and per-client cache hit rates for minimax/minimax-m2.5 over the last 19 hours. Updated scripts/query-usage-stats.ts to calculate average input tokens and cache rates using only `input_tokens` as the denominator, excluding `cache_read_input_tokens` and `cache_creation_input_tokens` from the total. This aligns usage metrics with standard cache efficiency calculations.

e205b670db0541ddfbc8996ae2f525fafa58cb1a.title: In-memory rate limits for free mode API
e205b670db0541ddfbc8996ae2f525fafa58cb1a.summary: Added `free-mode-rate-limiter.ts` enforcing fixed-window limits (15/min, 200/30m, 1k/5h, 10k/7d) per user in `_post.ts`. Returns 429 with `Retry-After` header and analytics tracking on breach. Scope: Web API chat completions. Implementation uses in-memory `Map` state with periodic cleanup; no persistent storage.

ea8a3f85557694e0dfe2c37d53bd4840b2ad67a3.title: Revamped context pruner: separate budgets and back-walk
ea8a3f85557694e0dfe2c37d53bd4840b2ad67a3.summary: Context pruner overhauled to use separate token budgets for user messages (50k) and assistant/tool content (20k), replacing previous character limits. The new algorithm builds summaries by walking backward from the most recent message to preserve recency. This change affects agents/context-pruner.ts, introducing constants like USER_BUDGET and TOOL_ENTRY_LIMIT while removing helper functions like truncateLongText from the main scope.

0aa4b4a2b2640bfbe62e7db4bed3ca74bdd50aff.title: Add /connect to Freebuff-only command sets
0aa4b4a2b2640bfbe62e7db4bed3ca74bdd50aff.summary: Added 'connect' to FREEBUFF_ONLY_COMMANDS in cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts and FREEBUFF_ONLY_COMMAND_IDS in cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts. Ensures /connect is treated as a Freebuff-exclusive command alongside /plan. Scope limited to CLI command registry and slash command data definitions.

9a15b34b64bc4e27fc9946b1f122e3c1296089ba.title: Add freebuff property to chat completions analytics
9a15b34b64bc4e27fc9946b1f122e3c1296089ba.summary: Analytics events in chat completions now include a `freebuff` boolean property. `withDefaultProperties` helper added to `common/src/analytics.ts` injects default properties into `trackEvent`. `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` wraps `trackEvent` to attach `freebuff` based on `isFreeMode(costMode)`. CLI auth state hook updated to send `freebuff` instead of `is_freebuff` to `identifyUser`.

6bca8a1e31d8ac42f4355e0a255970e4d3e6902d.text: The system now records how long the assistant takes to start answering. This helps track response speed without changing how you use the product.

78d22242fc0272fc1fffcb7dc8e11c65f62650ae.text: The assistant now runs web tasks in separate, private sessions. This prevents information from one task leaking into another.

9a15b34b64bc4e27fc9946b1f122e3c1296089ba.text: The system now records whether you are using the free version. This helps the team understand how people use the product.

305645d86822a91dbc775f595fb8c46c1e938183.text: The system now marks user activity to show which version of the assistant they are using. This helps the team tell the difference between users of the free version and the paid version.

afe8895a33fc3c6d600bee9b1291bd5b1a4f279a.text: The assistant now saves the full outcome of file edits in its memory, not just a summary. This helps it remember exactly what changed. Other tools were removed from this memory process.

304ebcc5c6ae9afe71d7da416c79dc7ae355c4c9.text: The team improved how the system measures data reuse to make usage statistics more accurate. This internal update does not change how you interact with the product.

ea8a3f85557694e0dfe2c37d53bd4840b2ad67a3.text: The assistant now keeps recent conversations clearer by using smarter memory limits. This helps it remember your latest requests better without getting confused by old details.

e205b670db0541ddfbc8996ae2f525fafa58cb1a.text: The service now limits how many free requests you can make in short periods. If you hit these limits, you must wait briefly before trying again.

0aa4b4a2b2640bfbe62e7db4bed3ca74bdd50aff.text: The /connect command is now available only to Freebuff users. If you use a different plan, you will not see this command in the menu.

5e21d8a169f62b3ca201fa2e2ae2dcdda3906826.text: The assistant now uses a faster, more reliable way to identify your location. This helps ensure you see the correct version of the service.

3615f8e093a71ed66aab77d729e223d5a43c2aaf.title: Disable custom Fireworks deployments in web LLM API
3615f8e093a71ed66aab77d729e223d5a43c2aaf.summary: The `FIREWORKS_USE_CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT` flag in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` is set to `false`. This forces the application to use the global Fireworks API exclusively, bypassing the `FIREWORKS_DEPLOYMENT_MAP` configuration. The change is scoped to the web client's LLM API integration. Custom deployment IDs remain defined in the map but are currently unused.

19a82f970a5661260a917e2506e679d8e440733c.title: Add x-session-affinity header to Fireworks requests
19a82f970a5661260a917e2506e679d8e440733c.summary: Fireworks API requests now include an x-session-affinity header set to the user ID. This change propagates the sessionId through createFireworksRequest and createFireworksRequestWithFallback in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. The header enables better prompt caching on the Fireworks backend by associating requests with specific sessions.

0c471f89c97d1a59149f15b822325cbc83696486.title: Bump GitHub Actions versions
0c471f89c97d1a59149f15b822325cbc83696486.summary: Updated GitHub Actions to latest major versions (checkout@v6, cache@v5, artifact@v6/v8, setup-node@v6, gh-release@v2). This ensures compatibility with current runner environments and security patches. Changes affect CI workflows and setup actions.

436817ae59687e1e192d10213a8facf43ad3c5b2.title: FAQ copy and formatting update
436817ae59687e1e192d10213a8facf43ad3c5b2.summary: Updated `home-client.tsx` FAQ answers to clarify data training policies and model availability. Added `whitespace-pre-line` to `FAQList` to render new line breaks. Added 'What else is cool' entry detailing subagents and `/interview` workflow. Updated 'LOADED' philosophy description to include browser use.

8d5530d30f22eced4b4121fc93425741f571e3ad.title: Add session affinity and usage stats metrics to scripts
8d5530d30f22eced4b4121fc93425741f571e3ad.summary: Scripts query-usage-stats.ts and test-fireworks-long.ts updated. query-usage-stats.ts adds median and max requests per client to SQL and output. test-fireworks-long.ts adds x-session-affinity header for prompt caching.

ba2b7f09639dd52b3455bc7d4c6cecbfc6f2865e.title: Freebuff country-block error message update
ba2b7f09639dd52b3455bc7d4c6cecbfc6f2865e.summary: CLI error handling now branches on IS_FREEBUFF to display 'Freebuff is not available in your country.' instead of the generic free mode message. This aligns user-facing text with the specific product branding for blocked regions. Updated docs/error-schema.md reflects the new message variant. Web home-client.tsx and README.md also updated to include New Zealand in the supported countries list and adjust speed claims.

d5fdfe238f9f7994e68226db45970c9e748cc435.title: Fix build in fireworks-deployment tests
d5fdfe238f9f7994e68226db45970c9e748cc435.summary: Added missing sessionId parameter to test calls in web/src/llm-api/__tests__/fireworks-deployment.test.ts. This fixes build errors caused by type mismatches in test mocks. Scope limited to test files.

c0d0ea04cec97c6db2e1df022ed57efaa22ce245.title: Add query-usage-stats.ts script for LLM token metrics
c0d0ea04cec97c6db2e1df022ed57efaa22ce245.summary: New internal script scripts/query-usage-stats.ts queries the message table for token usage stats. Calculates average input/output tokens, cache hit rate, requests per second (median/peak), and client request volume for specific models like minimax-m2.5. Used for internal capacity planning and model performance monitoring.

0e542543908c5aac088985127d0d9773675f35e1.title: Move analytics init to initializeApp
0e542543908c5aac088985127d0d9773675f35e1.summary: Refactored CLI startup to move `initAnalytics` from `main` in `cli/src/index.tsx` to `initializeApp` in `cli/src/init/init-app.ts`. This ensures analytics are initialized before `initializeDirenv`, preventing errors when the logger calls `trackEvent` during direnv setup. The `APP_LAUNCHED` event tracking in `index.tsx` now relies on the initialization state established by `initializeApp`.

a5dffe7095c4de101fb244995422d56488efc270.title: Enable custom Fireworks deployments
a5dffe7095c4de101fb244995422d56488efc270.summary: Fireworks provider config flips FIREWORKS_USE_CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT to true in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts, routing requests to dedicated deployment IDs instead of global API. Adds scripts/benchmark-providers.ts to compare 10-turn conversation caching costs across Fireworks, SiliconFlow, and CanopyWave using identical system prompts. Scope covers Web LLM API layer and internal tooling; no user-facing UI changes.

19a82f970a5661260a917e2506e679d8e440733c.text: The assistant now remembers your conversation history better. This helps it answer faster and more accurately.

0e542543908c5aac088985127d0d9773675f35e1.text: Fixed a startup bug where setting up environment tools could cause errors. The program now prepares its tracking system earlier, preventing these crashes.

3615f8e093a71ed66aab77d729e223d5a43c2aaf.text: The service now uses one standard connection for all AI tasks instead of allowing special custom connections. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

c0d0ea04cec97c6db2e1df022ed57efaa22ce245.text: The team added an internal tool to track how much text the assistant reads and writes. This helps them plan for future growth and monitor performance.

ba2b7f09639dd52b3455bc7d4c6cecbfc6f2865e.text: Users in blocked countries now see a clear message that the service is unavailable in their region. The list of supported countries was also updated.

d5fdfe238f9f7994e68226db45970c9e748cc435.text: A small internal fix corrected a mistake in the automated checks that verify the assistant's features. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

8d5530d30f22eced4b4121fc93425741f571e3ad.text: The system now keeps your requests together to save time and tracks how much usage comes from each person.

436817ae59687e1e192d10213a8facf43ad3c5b2.text: The help section now explains how data is used and lists new features like subagents. Text formatting improved so answers are easier to read.

a5dffe7095c4de101fb244995422d56488efc270.text: The company changed how their system connects to the AI service to use a dedicated, private setup instead of a shared public one. This is an internal update that does not change what you see or do in the product.

0c471f89c97d1a59149f15b822325cbc83696486.text: Internal updates to the systems that build and test the product keep them current and secure. This change does not affect how you use the product.

8ddecbc32ae834589e7c117278110b846ecca378.title: tmux remain-on-exit enabled
8ddecbc32ae834589e7c117278110b846ecca378.summary: scripts/tmux/tmux-start.sh sets tmux option remain-on-exit on for session. Keeps session alive after process exit for terminal output capture. Internal tooling change.

fa4fa5c6b53f6d2738346cd7687d28fba9a2ea71.title: Freebuff release blocked by e2e tests
fa4fa5c6b53f6d2738346cd7687d28fba9a2ea71.summary: The freebuff-release workflow now requires passing e2e tests before creating a release. This is achieved by adding an e2e-tests job that calls the freebuff-e2e workflow and updating the create-release job's needs. The e2e workflow was modified to support being called by other workflows (workflow_call) and to ensure concurrency groups are unique per caller. This ensures only verified code is released.

496279d0f4f8f7f026cb0e4a301a8d4b7fc865bf.title: Fix lineStartCols property access in multiline input
496279d0f4f8f7f026cb0e4a301a8d4b7fc865bf.summary: Corrected property access from `lineStarts` to `lineStartCols` in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. Fixes type errors and ensures visual line calculations use the correct data structure for cursor positioning and scrolling. Scope limited to CLI multiline input component.

cab81d0e6908fa90f377b3c6bfae2967f3649cab.title: e2e script runs build:binary before tests
cab81d0e6908fa90f377b3c6bfae2967f3649cab.summary: package.json e2e script now runs build:binary before bun test. Fixes e2e tests failing due to missing binary. Packaging change.

a967c6e936ae8cc5d880b7b03eb46f6db6f2d9bb.title: build-binary.ts searches repoRoot for OpenTUI core bundle
a967c6e936ae8cc5d880b7b03eb46f6db6f2d9bb.summary: Refactored `patchOpenTuiAssetPaths` in `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts` to locate the `@opentui/core` package in either `cli/node_modules` or `repoRoot/node_modules`. Added `findOpenTuiCoreDir` and `findOpenTuiCoreBundlePath` helpers. The bundle lookup now prefers hashed files (e.g., `index-<hash>.js`) over generic `index.js`. This ensures the tree-sitter asset path patching works correctly in monorepo setups where dependencies are hoisted.

97841ca2cf22c0bb84d779fd7f81e0cc8cfba71c.title: Revert multi-package nodemodules search for OpenTUI core
97841ca2cf22c0bb84d779fd7f81e0cc8cfba71c.summary: Reverts the build binary script to search only cliRoot/node_modules for @opentui/core, removing repoRoot fallback and hashed bundle preference. patchOpenTuiAssetPaths now directly resolves index*.js in cliRoot. Fixes potential path resolution ambiguity or incorrect patching when multiple node_modules exist.

e29a8bbf9b72ab3941c2fa40ce5cf537ef629c5f.title: Add checkoutref input to release workflow
e29a8bbf9b72ab3941c2fa40ce5cf537ef629c5f.summary: Added `checkout_ref` input to `freebuff-release.yml` and `--ref` flag to `freebuff/cli/release.ts` to allow deploying from specific commits. The CLI now parses `--ref <commit-sha>` and passes it to the GitHub Actions dispatch payload, overriding the default `github.sha`. This enables targeted releases from non-main branches or specific historical commits.

0eba219ede87a8c8712489b3a5a5ab190dc19992.title: Fix paste events not firing when multiline input loses focus
0eba219ede87a8c8712489b3a5a5ab190dc19992.summary: MultilineInput now registers a global paste listener on `keyHandler` instead of relying solely on the scrollbox `onPaste` prop, ensuring drag-and-drop pastes are captured even when the terminal lacks focus. A backup scrollbox handler with microtask-based deduplication prevents double-processing. The `StdinParser` timeout is increased from 10ms to 100ms to prevent bracketed paste sequence corruption in terminals like Ghostty and iTerm2 that split sequences across reads.

cb8a36a7e4df9697f164823df2c5f9527e440dc8.title: Librarian subagent clones GitHub repos for codebase queries
cb8a36a7e4df9697f164823df2c5f9527e440dc8.summary: New `librarian` subagent shallow-clones GitHub repos into `/tmp` and answers questions about code structure or documentation using `minimax/minimax-m2.5`. The agent returns structured output containing `answer`, `relevantFiles`, and `cloneDir` to facilitate caller cleanup. Implementation in `agents/librarian/librarian.ts` enforces read-only exploration via `run_terminal_command` shell utilities, explicitly blocking project directory writes and standard file tools that cannot access `/tmp`.

4afe5ddfce9ecbebda62fb155060a29a0eb6cd07.title: Strip ANSI paste and route copy through renderer OSC 52
4afe5ddfce9ecbebda62fb155060a29a0eb6cd07.summary: Paste handlers in cli/src/utils/strings.ts and cli/src/hooks/use-chat-keyboard.ts strip ANSI escape sequences via Bun.stripANSI before processing clipboard or event text. cli/src/utils/clipboard.ts adds registerClipboardRenderer/unregisterClipboardRenderer so copyTextToClipboard prefers renderer.copyToClipboardOSC52 before manual OSC 52 and platform tools. Scope is CLI only: use-clipboard.ts registers the renderer on mount, clipboard.ts and strings.ts carry the logic. tryCopyViaRenderer returns false when no renderer is registered, preserving existing fallback chains.

97841ca2cf22c0bb84d779fd7f81e0cc8cfba71c.text: The tool now looks for its helper files in only one specific place. This stops it from picking up the wrong files when several copies exist.

496279d0f4f8f7f026cb0e4a301a8d4b7fc865bf.text: Fixed a bug where the cursor and view could jump to the wrong spot when typing on multiple lines. This change is internal and improves stability.

fa4fa5c6b53f6d2738346cd7687d28fba9a2ea71.text: Before releasing new features, the software now automatically checks to make sure everything works correctly. This internal safety step helps prevent broken updates from reaching you.

a967c6e936ae8cc5d880b7b03eb46f6db6f2d9bb.text: The tool now finds its setup files in more places. This helps it work correctly on computers where files are stored in shared folders.

cab81d0e6908fa90f377b3c6bfae2967f3649cab.text: The team fixed an internal issue that caused some automated checks to fail. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

e29a8bbf9b72ab3941c2fa40ce5cf537ef629c5f.text: Internal update. Allows deploying specific versions. No user impact.

8ddecbc32ae834589e7c117278110b846ecca378.text: The system now keeps a session open after a process finishes, allowing it to capture all terminal output. This is a small internal tooling change that does not affect how users interact with the product.

0eba219ede87a8c8712489b3a5a5ab190dc19992.text: Copying text into the program now works more reliably, even when the window is not active or the text is pasted in small pieces. This prevents errors when pasting long text or dragging and dropping content.

4afe5ddfce9ecbebda62fb155060a29a0eb6cd07.text: The app now cleans up hidden formatting codes when you paste text, preventing visual glitches. It also uses a more reliable method to copy text to your system clipboard.

cb8a36a7e4df9697f164823df2c5f9527e440dc8.text: The assistant can now look up information in online code libraries to answer questions about them. It creates a temporary copy for reading, then deletes it after answering.

8aadbbe8061e7088a6d364ae2198a5616eef1d3b.title: Upgrade @opentui/core and @opentui/react to 0.1.87
8aadbbe8061e7088a6d364ae2198a5616eef1d3b.summary: Upgraded @opentui/core and @opentui/react from 0.1.74 to 0.1.87. This change affects the CLI's terminal UI rendering capabilities. The update ensures compatibility with the latest features and bug fixes in the OpenTUI libraries.

34e7ba56803e2d7c0117f53603b01d8bb21ee81b.title: waitForReady added to FreebuffSession e2e helper
34e7ba56803e2d7c0117f53603b01d8bb21ee81b.summary: Added waitForReady method to FreebuffSession in freebuff/e2e/utils/freebuff-session.ts. This helper polls terminal output to ensure the TUI renders its initial layout before tests proceed. It checks for a minimum number of non-empty lines, with configurable timeout and line count. This stabilizes e2e tests by preventing race conditions during CLI startup.

ac433e6920693a653d3392077d297b490779dbd9.title: Move /interview above /plan in CLI command registry
ac433e6920693a653d3392077d297b490779dbd9.summary: Reordered `interview` command definition to precede `plan` in `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. This adjustment places the interview workflow earlier in the command list, likely prioritizing spec-generation over planning in the default UI or autocomplete order. The change affects CLI command registration and slash command metadata, ensuring consistent ordering across surfaces.

9367f31e3f5af6725e18ea8b8aefebdc1cf100e2.title: Remove freebuff CLI subtitle shimmer
9367f31e3f5af6725e18ea8b8aefebdc1cf100e2.summary: Removes the 'The free coding agent' subtitle and shimmer animation from `use-logo.tsx`. Replaces `<text>` with `<box>` in `agent-branch-item.tsx` to fix layout. Internal cleanup only.

ad37d317e83d0c2102e1e847eb5144f69d12fb2c.title: Add working... shimmer to subagents
ad37d317e83d0c2102e1e847eb5144f69d12fb2c.summary: The `agent-branch-item.tsx` component now renders a `ShimmerText` "working..." animation when `isStreaming` is true. This provides visual feedback that a subagent is actively processing. The change applies to the CLI interface, specifically within the agent branch UI blocks. The shimmer interval is set to 160ms using the theme's secondary color.

a4fa669c020282e34620ce1a4bcd7183c7dec4d5.title: Fix freebuff e2e tests
a4fa669c020282e34620ce1a4bcd7183c7dec4d5.summary: Updated e2e test utilities to improve stability and branding verification. `waitForReady` timeout increased from 15s to 30s in `freebuff-session.ts`. `tmux-custom-tools.ts` now calls `waitForReady` before capturing initial output. `freebuff-tester.ts` prompt updated to check for visible startup content instead of specific 'Freebuff' branding.

f994c8d1139555f94ca5ed6ba533862c7ffb03f1.title: Hide streaming indicator in collapsed agent branches
f994c8d1139555f94ca5ed6ba533862c7ffb03f1.summary: The streaming text indicator now requires isExpanded to render. Prevents visual clutter in collapsed agent branches. Scope: cli/src/components/blocks/agent-branch-item.tsx.

f689232cfc268ab21eaac235988c85cf986a40f6.title: Rename commander and commander-lite agents to basher
f689232cfc268ab21eaac235988c85cf986a40f6.summary: The `commander` and `commander-lite` agents were consolidated and renamed to `basher`. This removes the free-tier variant distinction, using a single lightweight shell command executor backed by `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview`. Updates propagate to agent registries, CLI display constants, and prompt instructions across core and CLI packages. Legacy `commander-lite` references are removed from free agent model maps.

6a25ed71f39086bc5a602ccda95836735a758390.title: Add CanopyWave prompt caching benchmark
6a25ed71f39086bc5a602ccda95836735a758390.summary: Adds `scripts/test-canopywave-long.ts` to benchmark CanopyWave prompt caching across 10-turn conversations using a ~5k token system prompt and `minimax/minimax-m2.5`. Updates `scripts/test-siliconflow.ts` to read `SILICON_FLOW_API_KEY` instead of `SILICONFLOW_API_KEY`. Internal tooling only.

889181a5804829704934025f56da75be65588cf0.title: Paste file paths to attach files in CLI
889181a5804829704934025f56da75be65588cf0.summary: CLI now accepts pasted file paths as attachments via `addPendingFileFromPath`. Renders `FileAttachmentCard` with ASCII icons and truncates names >16 chars. Blocks message send while `hasProcessingFiles` is true, showing 'processing attachments...'. Updates `pending-attachments-banner.tsx`, `message-block.tsx`, and `chat.tsx`.

f994c8d1139555f94ca5ed6ba533862c7ffb03f1.text: When you collapse a section of the conversation, the animated text indicator is now hidden to reduce clutter.

8aadbbe8061e7088a6d364ae2198a5616eef1d3b.text: The program's visual display system received an internal update. Users may see smoother or more reliable graphics.

9367f31e3f5af6725e18ea8b8aefebdc1cf100e2.text: The text under the logo is gone. This small update cleans up the visual design without changing how you use the tool.

889181a5804829704934025f56da75be65588cf0.text: You can now paste file paths to attach files. The app shows a card for each file and waits until they are ready before sending your message.

f689232cfc268ab21eaac235988c85cf986a40f6.text: The system merged two command-running tools into one simpler version. You will see one fewer option, but the way you ask for commands to run stays the same.

ac433e6920693a653d3392077d297b490779dbd9.text: The interview option now appears before the plan option in the command list. This makes the interview workflow easier to find and select first.

a4fa669c020282e34620ce1a4bcd7183c7dec4d5.text: This small internal update makes automated checks more reliable and flexible. It gives the system more time to load and checks that content appears, rather than looking for a specific brand name.

34e7ba56803e2d7c0117f53603b01d8bb21ee81b.text: A small internal update helps the testing system wait for the app to fully load before running checks. This reduces the chance of false alarms about startup issues.

6a25ed71f39086bc5a602ccda95836735a758390.text: The team built an internal test to check if a new AI model can remember long conversations better. This work happens behind the scenes and does not change how the app works for you today.

ad37d317e83d0c2102e1e847eb5144f69d12fb2c.text: When a helper task is running, you now see a moving 'working...' label. This shows the task is active, not stuck.

d2ba4cef9ae65da25bed5bff3f8856a79a51fa9a.title: Remove mode-restriction e2e test from CI
d2ba4cef9ae65da25bed5bff3f8856a79a51fa9a.summary: Removed `mode-restriction` from the matrix in `.github/workflows/freebuff-e2e.yml`. This prunes the specific test case from the end-to-end suite execution. Scope limited to CI configuration.

3fa2a41c386abbc5a4cbf1b45076ac70cb68450d.title: Add e2e:knowledge-file npm script
3fa2a41c386abbc5a4cbf1b45076ac70cb68450d.summary: Added `e2e:knowledge-file` script to `freebuff/package.json` executing `bun test e2e/tests/knowledge-file.e2e.test.ts`. Extends e2e test surface to cover knowledge file behavior. Aligns with existing `e2e:ads`, `e2e:agent`, `e2e:code-edit`, and `e2e:terminal-command` patterns.

70d797f327ad76f34188745720fcfb00c578f068.title: /interview command added to CLI
70d797f327ad76f34188745720fcfb00c578f068.summary: Added /interview slash command to CLI, enabling AI-driven spec generation. Uses buildInterviewPrompt to enforce multi-round ask_user tool interactions, preventing premature code changes. Files modified: command-registry.ts, prompt-builders.ts, router.ts, slash-commands.ts, input-modes.ts. New 'interview' input mode disables slash suggestions and blocks keyboard exit.

499d7efcab4252154770c95067c5a1cb32368b56.title: New docs: architecture, error-schema, request-flow
499d7efcab4252154770c95067c5a1cb32368b56.summary: Added three new documentation files: `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/error-schema.md`, and `docs/request-flow.md`. These documents detail the Codebuff monorepo structure, error handling mechanisms, and the end-to-end request flow from CLI to server and back. The architecture doc outlines package dependencies and responsibilities, the error-schema doc explains server responses and client-side transformation, and the request-flow doc traces the prompt lifecycle through SDK, agent runtime, and backend.

02ec8206f65656145e2c6e7a4d201323f0a16246.title: Add Browser Use agent
