02ec8206f65656145e2c6e7a4d201323f0a16246.summary: New agent definition `agents/browser-use/browser-use.ts` enables browser automation via Chrome DevTools MCP server. Uses `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` model. Requires local Chrome installation; MCP server auto-downloads via `npx`. Structured output schema includes `overallStatus`, `results`, `consoleErrors`, and `lessons`.

f2350eca2bd211bd25a64478537f2968b921be9b.title: NZ added to free mode allowed countries
f2350eca2bd211bd25a64478537f2968b921be9b.summary: Added 'NZ' to the FREE_MODE_ALLOWED_COUNTRIES set in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts. Enables free AI coding agent access for users connecting from New Zealand. Scope limited to the web API completions endpoint.

8df7b4d10604e41cdd816e0f9055b224a756b710.title: Extract API error codes and messages from response body
8df7b4d10604e41cdd816e0f9055b224a756b710.summary: Added parseApiErrorResponseBody helper to extract structured error codes and messages from API response bodies. Agent runtime and SDK now use this helper to surface server-side error details (e.g., Forbidden) instead of generic error strings. AgentOutputSchema gains optional error field to carry parsed error codes. Covers common/src/util/error.ts, packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts, and sdk/src/run.ts.

734d709579253b9ff76e261804262abe28ded7ac.title: Freebuff E2E CI workflow and test suite
734d709579253b9ff76e261804262abe28ded7ac.summary: Added GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/freebuff-e2e.yml` to run E2E tests on every commit to `main` and PRs. Tests use `tmux` to drive the compiled Freebuff binary, covering startup, slash commands, code editing, and agent behavior. New utilities in `freebuff/e2e/utils/` handle binary resolution and session management. An optional SDK-driven agent tester (`freebuff/e2e/agent/freebuff-tester.ts`) verifies complex interactions using `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`.

af302c3677798d0e10cb709b70af8983d9a93670.title: browser-use subagent gated on chrome detection
af302c3677798d0e10cb709b70af8983d9a93670.summary: Added `browser-use` to the `base2` agent list, gated by `chromeAvailable` in `ProjectFileContext`. `system-info.ts` implements `findChromeExecutable` to check standard install paths, updating `getSystemInfo` to return the boolean. `prompts.ts` injects 'Chrome: installed/not found' into the system prompt, allowing the base agent to skip spawning `browser-use` if Chrome is missing. `run-state.ts` uses the shared `getSystemInfo` helper.

bd2276b98669efd76b968fe3fe2253c8a249ca3a.title: Extract structured error details in SDK run
bd2276b98669efd76b968fe3fe2253c8a249ca3a.summary: SDK run.ts now extracts structured error details from API response bodies. Parses responseBody for error code and message fields. Scope: sdk/src/run.ts. Handles AI_APICallError responseBody JSON parsing.

3fa2a41c386abbc5a4cbf1b45076ac70cb68450d.text: The team added a new automated check to verify how the assistant handles knowledge files. This is an internal quality improvement, so you will not see any immediate changes in the product.

af302c3677798d0e10cb709b70af8983d9a93670.text: The assistant now checks for Chrome before trying to browse the web. If Chrome is missing, it skips that step to avoid errors.

8df7b4d10604e41cdd816e0f9055b224a756b710.text: The app now reads the specific reason for a failure from the service instead of showing a generic error. Users will see clearer messages explaining why an action could not be completed.

734d709579253b9ff76e261804262abe28ded7ac.text: The software now runs automatic checks every time changes are saved. These checks simulate a user to ensure the assistant works correctly, helping prevent bugs from reaching you.

70d797f327ad76f34188745720fcfb00c578f068.text: The assistant now asks you questions to understand your needs before creating a plan. This helps ensure the final result matches what you actually want.

d2ba4cef9ae65da25bed5bff3f8856a79a51fa9a.text: The team removed a specific internal test from the automated checks. This change only affects how the software is tested behind the scenes. It does not change how the product works for you.

499d7efcab4252154770c95067c5a1cb32368b56.text: Added guides explaining how the tool is built, how it handles errors, and how requests move through the system. These are internal reference documents for understanding the software's inner workings, not new features for users.

f2350eca2bd211bd25a64478537f2968b921be9b.text: The AI coding assistant is now available for free to users in New Zealand. This is a small internal update that expands access to a new region.

02ec8206f65656145e2c6e7a4d201323f0a16246.text: The assistant can now control a web browser to perform tasks automatically. This requires a specific web browser to be installed on your computer.

e70d0892277b28235a2b43ef4f6b0f6fccda03d1.title: Hide /plan in regular codebuff
e70d0892277b28235a2b43ef4f6b0f6fccda03d1.summary: Added FREEBUFF_ONLY_COMMANDS and FREEBUFF_ONLY_COMMAND_IDS sets containing 'plan' in cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts and cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts respectively. These sets filter out the /plan command when IS_FREEBUFF is false. Regular codebuff no longer exposes /plan in its command registry or slash command list.

70da96a9b41ca28173eda9595eecb8da4fb47a52.title: Add useCustomDeployment flag to createFireworksRequestWithFallback
70da96a9b41ca28173eda9595eecb8da4fb47a52.summary: The `createFireworksRequestWithFallback` function in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` now accepts an optional `useCustomDeployment` boolean parameter. This overrides the global `FIREWORKS_USE_CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT` constant, defaulting to the constant's value if unspecified. The change allows per-request control over whether to attempt deployment fallbacks during business hours.

b1e00515d7f86dbf24145f7cd8aac084d27e6fb0.title: Update Freebuff copy on web/readme
b1e00515d7f86dbf24145f7cd8aac084d27e6fb0.summary: Marketing copy updated in freebuff/README.md, freebuff/cli/release/README.md, and freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx. Headline shifted from 'strongest free coding agent' to 'free coding agent' with new 'Why Freebuff?' and FAQ sections. Performance claims adjusted to '5–10× speed up' and model details (MiniMax M2.5, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, GPT-5.4) added to FAQ. Web philosophy words updated to match new speed and feature descriptions.

a0acfcebfe71291893fad20243dc1878b9845fbf.title: Add shimmer subtitle to Freebuff CLI logo
a0acfcebfe71291893fad20243dc1878b9845fbf.summary: Adds 'The free coding agent' subtitle with animated shimmer to the Freebuff CLI logo in cli/src/hooks/use-logo.tsx. Shimmer effect cycles through 10 steps at 180ms intervals, highlighting 'free' with theme-aware color gradients (base/bright/peak). Subtitle centering calculated via logo width parsing. Gated by IS_FREEBUFF constant. Scope: CLI logo hook only. Detail: Shimmer position drives per-character color selection with distance-based gradient logic.

8d9b6c96fa37ebf843d0576046afb4bffd73abf7.title: Freebuff hides agent mode toggle
8d9b6c96fa37ebf843d0576046afb4bffd73abf7.summary: AgentModeToggle width reservation skips when IS_FREEBUFF. Freebuff lacks mode toggle, so estimatedToggleWidth returns 0. Affects cli/src/hooks/use-chat-input.ts. Prevents layout gap in Freebuff CLI.

1195b01792da977a0e8634fe269359802855e993.title: Help banner gains Tips section with conditional OAuth prompt
1195b01792da977a0e8634fe269359802855e993.summary: cli/src/components/help-banner.tsx adds a Tips section to the CLI help banner. Includes a conditional prompt to run /connect for /plan and /review access when Freebuff mode is active and ChatGPT OAuth is disconnected. Static tips cover @ file/agent references and Esc for response cancellation.

799c317d48d98e4090f78ce52078e909aac70242.title: CLI @agent references use id not displayName
799c317d48d98e4090f78ce52078e909aac70242.summary: Agent mention replacement in cli/src/chat.tsx now inserts @${selected.id} instead of @${selected.displayName}. Suggestion engine in cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts sets label to agent.id, clears description, and maps highlight indices to idHighlightIndices. Affects CLI chat surface. Removes displayName from visible suggestion metadata and reference output.

120729c8d54f26de85bef668cc0e5da67a716fc0.title: CLI ad banner entire area clickable, info panel hidden
120729c8d54f26de85bef668cc0e5da67a716fc0.summary: The ad banner's click target expands from discrete buttons to the entire content area, wrapped in a `Button` component. Hover states and click handlers now trigger on the whole banner. The expanded info panel is hidden by default, only appearing on specific interaction, while the 'Ad ?' label logic is gated by `IS_FREEBUFF`.

189be16225cfa3196773907e41fad7be46f049e4.title: Route openai models to direct API
189be16225cfa3196773907e41fad7be46f049e4.summary: OpenAI models now bypass OpenRouter via `handleOpenAIStream` and `isOpenAIDirectModel` in `web/src/llm-api/openai.ts`. Direct routing uses per-million-token cost maps for `gpt-5` through `gpt-5.4` variants plus `gpt-4o`/`gpt-4o-mini`, with `undici.Agent` enforcing 10-minute header timeouts for deep-thinking models. Scope limited to `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` and `web/src/llm-api/openai.ts`; free mode geo-block message generalized to 'Free mode is not available in your country.'

c6cf9db30789c4c56d264024faa527463bfc864d.title: Add country availability FAQ to home-client.tsx
c6cf9db30789c4c56d264024faa527463bfc864d.summary: Adds a new FAQ entry to freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx listing the 15 countries where Freebuff is currently available. Updates the faqs array with the specific question and answer regarding regional availability. Scope limited to the Web home client component.

e70d0892277b28235a2b43ef4f6b0f6fccda03d1.text: The '/plan' option is now hidden in the standard version of the assistant. It only appears in the free version.

120729c8d54f26de85bef668cc0e5da67a716fc0.text: Clicking anywhere on the ad banner now opens it. The extra details are hidden until you interact with it.

8d9b6c96fa37ebf843d0576046afb4bffd73abf7.text: The tool no longer reserves space for a button that doesn't exist. This removes an empty gap, making the screen look cleaner.

a0acfcebfe71291893fad20243dc1878b9845fbf.text: The tool now shows a moving highlight on the tagline 'The free coding agent' when it starts.

c6cf9db30789c4c56d264024faa527463bfc864d.text: The help section now lists the fifteen countries where the service is available. This lets users check if their region is supported without contacting support.

b1e00515d7f86dbf24145f7cd8aac084d27e6fb0.text: The company updated the website and guide text to describe the assistant as a free coding helper. They added answers to common questions and stated it can work five to ten times faster.

1195b01792da977a0e8634fe269359802855e993.text: The help menu now shows a tip to connect your account to unlock specific features.

799c317d48d98e4090f78ce52078e909aac70242.text: When you mention an assistant in chat, the system now uses its unique internal identifier instead of its display name. This change is internal and does not alter how you see or interact with the assistant's name.

70da96a9b41ca28173eda9595eecb8da4fb47a52.text: The assistant can now choose different service providers for individual requests instead of using one setting for all. This allows it to switch to a backup provider when the main one is busy, improving reliability during peak hours.

189be16225cfa3196773907e41fad7be46f049e4.text: The service now connects directly to OpenAI for certain models, skipping a middleman. This internal routing change may improve speed or reliability for users.

b6f81763204cc7fc69346b0731035c76b92ab44c.title: Thinker spawner prompt allows short prompts
b6f81763204cc7fc69346b0731035c76b92ab44c.summary: Updated `spawnerPrompt` in `agents/thinker/thinker.ts` to inform the spawner that short prompts are acceptable. Change clarifies that the thinker agent sees the entire conversation history for context, removing the implication that all context must be manually gathered into the prompt.

d0cc3a429f603da41749352ef1a8e78799b47cb2.title: Free mode: allow more english speaking countries
d0cc3a429f603da41749352ef1a8e78799b47cb2.summary: Expanded `FREE_MODE_ALLOWED_COUNTRIES` in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` to include GB, AU, and 12 European/Nordic countries. This change relaxes the geographic gate for free mode, enabling access for users in English-speaking and nearby regions. The update affects the `/v1/chat/completions` API endpoint.

aadbb4be06d0ed4a0ec75c4d2fec73b57bb412db.title: CLI ChatGPT connect UX improvements
aadbb4be06d0ed4a0ec75c4d2fec73b57bb412db.summary: ChatGPT connect flow in CLI now initiates OAuth automatically on entry, displays the auth URL, and shows a bordered panel with hover actions. `chat-input-bar.tsx` suppresses the input box during `connect:chatgpt` mode. `input-modes.ts` placeholder changed to 'authorizing in browser... press Escape to cancel'. `chatgpt-connect-banner.tsx` restructured to use `BORDER_CHARS` and track `authUrl`/`hovered` state, removing `BottomBanner` and `useChatStore` dependencies.

ad61a1c83345d5ae36e236ea7eee50e378fad197.title: bash input mode switches from icon to label
ad61a1c83345d5ae36e236ea7eee50e378fad197.summary: The bash input mode in cli/src/utils/input-modes.ts now uses a text label `!` instead of an icon. The color changed from success to info, and widthAdjustment increased from 2 to 4 to accommodate the new label padding. This affects how the bash mode indicator is rendered in the CLI input prompt.

fec627712ea8a9404bf80daa60f0d2d85e87952f.title: GPT-5.4 replaces GPT-5.2 in general agent and best-of-n selector
fec627712ea8a9404bf80daa60f0d2d85e87952f.summary: General agent and best-of-n selector2 now route `isGpt5` branches to `openai/gpt-5.4` instead of `openai/gpt-5.2`. This update ensures the default GPT-5 path uses the newer model version across core agent logic. Changes are localized to `agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts` and `agents/editor/best-of-n/best-of-n-selector2.ts`. Non-GPT-5 paths remain on `anthropic/claude-opus-4.6` with no other behavioral shifts.

7f62993f7408682aea0ba3b15b6af4b510a2fa95.title: Update slash command descriptions to specify GPT 5.4
7f62993f7408682aea0ba3b15b6af4b510a2fa95.summary: Updated description strings for /plan and /review commands in cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts to explicitly name GPT 5.4. Replaced generic 'GPT' references with the specific model version. Affects CLI help output and command picker metadata.

15d4c1857812f92171a6bd18590d29ac326492d8.title: Add /plan command, unify prompt builders, clean up review UI
15d4c1857812f92171a6bd18590d29ac326492d8.summary: Added /plan slash command for spawning @thinker-gpt planning sessions, requiring ChatGPT OAuth in Freebuff mode. Centralized prompt construction into cli/src/commands/prompt-builders.ts for consistent /plan and /review behavior across direct args and interactive modes. Refactored cli/src/components/review-screen.tsx to remove embedded custom input state, delegating to chat-input-bar via new onCustom prop and router.ts input mode handling. ChatInputBar now renders mode labels (e.g., 'plan', 'review') using theme.info background.

2013d45f59d629515cc3e90393b8d938223ce755.title: Update what-models.mdx orchestrator model assignments
2013d45f59d629515cc3e90393b8d938223ce755.summary: Updates the orchestrator model assignment table in web/src/content/advanced/what-models.mdx. Replaces GLM 4.7 with Minimax M2.5 for code editing, GPT-5.2 with GPT-5.4 for reasoning and review, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite/Grok 4.1 Fast with Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite for file discovery, terminal commands, and web research. Removes the speculative decoding note for file rewrites.

d86a41e78780d812c253791fc73ed3acf2de0e0f.title: ChatGPT OAuth connects via local callback server
d86a41e78780d812c253791fc73ed3acf2de0e0f.summary: CLI `/connect:chatgpt` now spins up local HTTP callback server at `localhost:1455` for automatic token exchange. Replaces manual paste flow. Auth URL adds `codex_cli_simplified_flow=true` and `originator=codex_cli_rs`. SDK routes ChatGPT OAuth requests through `chatgpt.com/backend-api` via custom fetch transformer converting Chat Completions to Responses API format. Token refresh failures no longer clear credentials, logging debug instead.

0242d2d8a6e36b9bb9fc39a8a744aff446df5366.title: Add identifiers to Stripe billing metering requests
0242d2d8a6e36b9bb9fc39a8a744aff446df5366.summary: The `reportPurchasedCreditsToStripe` function now generates a UUID `identifier` if one is not provided, ensuring all Stripe metering events carry a unique ID. This identifier is passed to `stripeServer.billing.meterEvents.create` and used to construct the `idempotencyKey`. The `consumeCredits` function in `balance-calculator.ts` was updated to pass a `crypto.randomUUID()` as `eventId` to this reporting mechanism. This change affects the `packages/billing` subsystem, specifically `stripe-metering.ts` and `balance-calculator.ts`.

d0cc3a429f603da41749352ef1a8e78799b47cb2.text: People in more English-speaking countries can now use the free version of the service.

fec627712ea8a9404bf80daa60f0d2d85e87952f.text: The assistant switched to a newer version of its main brain for standard tasks. This change is internal and does not add new features or change how you use the product.

2013d45f59d629515cc3e90393b8d938223ce755.text: The assistant now uses newer models for editing code, reasoning, and searching files or the web. You may notice it handles these tasks a bit more accurately or quickly.

7f62993f7408682aea0ba3b15b6af4b510a2fa95.text: The app now names the specific new assistant model when describing its planning and review tools. This change only updates help text. It does not change how the tools work.

ad61a1c83345d5ae36e236ea7eee50e378fad197.text: The command prompt now shows a simple text symbol instead of an icon for bash mode. This small visual update makes the indicator clearer and easier to read.

15d4c1857812f92171a6bd18590d29ac326492d8.text: The app now includes a dedicated planning mode that requires a specific account login. This update also standardizes how text is prepared for both planning and review tasks, and simplifies the review screen's interface to show clear mode labels.

b6f81763204cc7fc69346b0731035c76b92ab44c.text: The system now accepts brief instructions without needing all context repeated. This saves time and effort for users who just want to ask a quick question.

aadbb4be06d0ed4a0ec75c4d2fec73b57bb412db.text: The sign-in process for the assistant now opens your web browser automatically and shows a clear message while you wait. You can press the Escape key to cancel if you change your mind.

03ffe85e538b3ea5afb8a9f8943aef01c45771c0.title: /review switches to @thinker-gpt
03ffe85e538b3ea5afb8a9f8943aef01c45771c0.summary: CLI `/review` command and review-screen now spawn `@thinker-gpt` instead of `@GPT-5 Agent`. `command-registry.ts` and `review-screen.tsx` updated prompts; `slash-commands.ts` description changed. `base2.ts` adds `thinker-gpt` to agent list and restricts free-tier spawning. `thinker.ts` spawner prompt clarifies lack of tool access. `chatgpt-oauth.ts` adds `gpt-5.4` model mappings. `SPEC.md` updated.

37a87f8e75ae11c90fc36e9660235cf4711562af.title: Enable /review and /connect:chatgpt
37a87f8e75ae11c90fc36e9660235cf4711562af.summary: Removed 'review' from FREEBUFF_REMOVED_COMMANDS and FREEBUFF_REMOVED_COMMAND_IDS sets. Flipped CHATGPT_OAUTH_ENABLED from false to true in common/src/constants/chatgpt-oauth.ts. Activates /review command in CLI registry and slash command picker. Enables ChatGPT OAuth flow for /connect:chatgpt.

0c9043e39c1ca866b9c65799fa5c494c96815d9c.title: Disable custom Fireworks deployments
0c9043e39c1ca866b9c65799fa5c494c96815d9c.summary: Added FIREWORKS_USE_CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT flag set to false in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. Gated createFireworksRequestWithFallback deployment logic behind this constant to force global API usage. Scope limited to Fireworks LLM integration.

bc4f68a015730597836bc4b56f73d564bc04b8db.title: Block non-US/CA IPs from free mode
bc4f68a015730597836bc4b56f73d564bc04b8db.summary: Free mode requests now fail with 403 free_mode_unavailable if the client IP resolves outside US or CA. Web API `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` uses `geoip-lite` to check country codes, while CLI `cli/src/hooks/helpers/send-message.ts` surfaces the error via `isFreeModeUnavailableError`. Logic fails open if IP detection returns null, accommodating VPNs or proxies.

b02ac2e5d465624aba2bd5134f9aed1dc0684002.title: Add experimental /connect:chatgpt OAuth direct routing
b02ac2e5d465624aba2bd5134f9aed1dc0684002.summary: New CLI command `/connect:chatgpt` enables direct OpenAI subscription OAuth streaming, bypassing backend routing for eligible models. Feature gated by `CHATGPT_OAUTH_ENABLED=false` default; uses PKCE flow with local credential storage and refresh mutex. Scope covers CLI components, SDK provider logic, and shared constants; non-streaming requests remain backend-routed.

4a4200f89eab492b59b535f1bb9ed0c8305da26e.title: Fireworks custom deployment fallback with business hours and scaling
4a4200f89eab492b59b535f1bb9ed0c8305da26e.summary: Fireworks requests for `minimax/minimax-m2.5` now route to a custom deployment (`accounts/james-65d217/deployments/qne3jo8v`) during business hours (10am–8pm ET) and fall back to the standard API (`accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m2p5`) on `503 DEPLOYMENT_SCALING_UP`. `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` adds `isDeploymentHours` for timezone checks and `DEPLOYMENT_COOLDOWN_MS` (2 minutes) to pause deployment attempts after scaling failures. `createFireworksRequest` accepts `modelIdOverride` to swap deployment IDs, while `parseFireworksErrorFromText` extracts status/text to allow non-scaling 503s to throw immediately. Scope limited to `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` and `__tests__/fireworks-deployment.test.ts`.

d212c62159bded47a70d599b740b59d937e10318.title: Hide required ads banner for Freebuff CLI
d212c62159bded47a70d599b740b59d937e10318.summary: AdBanner now suppresses the 'Ads are required in Free mode' text when IS_FREEBUFF is true, even if isFreeMode is active. This prevents redundant or incorrect messaging for the free AI coding agent context. The change is scoped to cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx.

0f77739bef572c0d717fd12abf2d5e75126282e8.title: Reenable fireworks provider in chat completions
0f77739bef572c0d717fd12abf2d5e75126282e8.summary: Swapped routing flags in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`. Disabled `useCanopyWave` and enabled `useFireworks` for supported models. Streaming requests now route to Fireworks API instead of CanopyWave.

44084a06cd88c1402dd962c47c1972a118358e00.title: buffbench eval agent base2-free
44084a06cd88c1402dd962c47c1972a118358e00.summary: evals/buffbench/main.ts swaps agents config from 'base-deep-evals' to 'base2-free'. Internal eval harness routing update. No user-facing surface change.

a97a1c6d12bfa1d20ae8c27f2b4d8d3d4a37f12c.title: Prebuild CLI agents in CI
a97a1c6d12bfa1d20ae8c27f2b4d8d3d4a37f12c.summary: CI now runs bun run prebuild:agents before CLI unit and integration tests. Fixes e2e test failures by ensuring agents are built. Scope limited to .github/workflows/ci.yml.

26887d8a5a972c250cc792e14e31b0871913f2fa.title: Remove maxOutputTokens limit in agent stream
26887d8a5a972c250cc792e14e31b0871913f2fa.summary: Removed the 32,000 token cap for `maxOutputTokens` in `getAgentStreamFromTemplate` within `packages/agent-runtime/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`. This change unsets the hardcoded limit, allowing the agent stream to defer token limits to upstream model defaults or other configuration layers. The modification is isolated to the agent runtime's prompt streaming logic.

f3083517a4d8a9e600ca5cf3854e2a2577f3ad16.title: CLI e2e tests switch async spawn to sync spawnSync
f3083517a4d8a9e600ca5cf3854e2a2577f3ad16.summary: Refactored `runCLI` helper in `cli/src/__tests__/e2e-cli.test.ts` to use `child_process.spawnSync` instead of `spawn` with manual Promise handling. Removed manual stdout/stderr accumulation, timeout management, and process event listeners in favor of `spawnSync`'s built-in `timeout` and `status` properties. Tests updated to synchronous assertions. Internal test infrastructure change only.

3a469f8e39d543e758f96bd149f2cf2922d44b32.title: Web copy: drop strongest claim from title and description
3a469f8e39d543e758f96bd149f2cf2922d44b32.summary: Web page title and `siteConfig.description` now use plain 'the free coding agent' copy, replacing 'The Strongest Free Coding Agent' and the 'world's strongest' phrasing. `page.tsx` `generateMetadata` and `lib/constant.ts` carry the change. Keywords list unchanged.

cb57c6646303cca800943b0ae9d018e291b93bb6.title: Fix jest config paths
cb57c6646303cca800943b0ae9d018e291b93bb6.summary: Update jest.config.cjs testPathIgnorePatterns to use .*__tests__ for org billing. Add user/billing-portal and auth/cli/logout paths. Fixes test discovery for new API routes.

c9768351b870eb8065212af10a5b889b72b2538a.title: Add Fireworks long-context prompt caching test script
c9768351b870eb8065212af10a5b889b72b2538a.summary: Added `scripts/test-fireworks-long.ts` to measure Fireworks AI prompt caching efficiency across 10-turn conversations using a large system prompt. The script calculates costs based on cached vs. non-cached input tokens and includes a random seed to prevent cache hits on repeated runs. Minor formatting adjustments were made to `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` regarding reasoning delta extraction indentation.

f092bf89a849e45392c80d88dd5d02d4a0fceb19.title: Route streaming chat to CanopyWave over Fireworks
f092bf89a849e45392c80d88dd5d02d4a0fceb19.summary: Streaming chat completions now route to CanopyWave instead of Fireworks. The `_post.ts` handler toggles `useCanopyWave` to evaluate `isCanopyWaveModel(typedBody.model)` and disables `useFireworks`. This applies to the Web API surface for supported models.

683f6d1c8eb99d8e74da94ce9e56e75f65f85925.title: Fireworks provider enabled for minimax/minimax-m2.5
683f6d1c8eb99d8e74da94ce9e56e75f65f85925.summary: Fireworks routing enabled for `minimax/minimax-m2.5` in `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` by uncommenting `FIREWORKS_MODEL_MAP`. Streaming requests in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` now honor `isFireworksModel` check, though non-streaming remains hardcoded to OpenRouter. Internal routing logic adjustment.

06250cce4548b652a0d978fcd631a3c864e093fc.title: Landing page copy button particle burst and glow
06250cce4548b652a0d978fcd631a3c864e093fc.summary: Replaced static `CopyButton` with custom `handleCopy` in `InstallCommand` (`freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx`), triggering a 14-particle radial burst on clipboard write. Added `install-box-glow` breathing animation and `hover-glow-flare` text-shadow intensifiers to `freebuff/web/src/styles/globals.css`. `copied` state toggles acid-matrix border glow for 1.8s, overriding default hover shadow. Particle geometry randomized via `useMemo` keyed on `copyCount`.

3ee603e4c5d23af302e6505d2ead236164edf1de.title: Add bundled-agents.generated.d.ts type declarations
3ee603e4c5d23af302e6505d2ead236164edf1de.summary: New `bundled-agents.generated.d.ts` file provides TypeScript type declarations for the auto-generated bundled agents module. The actual `bundled-agents.generated.ts` file is created by `cli/scripts/prebuild-agents.ts` and is gitignored. This declaration file lets TypeScript resolve the module when the generated file has not been built yet, fixing the build.

54b1803c12a229de41ae93bf37cbd48fbf4ae781.title: Re-enable Fireworks routing in chat completions
54b1803c12a229de41ae93bf37cbd48fbf4ae781.summary: Fireworks model routing re-enabled in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` by restoring `isFireworksModel` checks. SiliconFlow and CanopyWave remain disabled. The `minimax` to `siliconflow/fp8` provider override was removed as it was dead code under the disabled flag.

8b107a0ab89f0bdf9950d4af8db021049885e653.title: Fix bundled agents import in CLI
8b107a0ab89f0bdf9950d4af8db021049885e653.summary: Replaced inline require() with static import for bundled-agents.generated in cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts. Removes try/catch fallback logic that previously handled missing files during development. Ensures consistent module resolution for bundled agents.

789820e7ef5e012252ad895bb9b25c3ad481ddfc.title: Remove navbar component, inline nav overlay on home page
789820e7ef5e012252ad895bb9b25c3ad481ddfc.summary: Deleted freebuff/web/src/components/navbar.tsx and removed its usage from freebuff/web/src/app/layout.tsx. Replaced with inline absolute-positioned motion.div nav overlay in freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx. Reordered PHILOSOPHY_WORDS array: SIMPLE moved before FAST, FAST description changed from '3× the speed' to 'Up to 3× the speed'.

61dbb26699328e0d2b636c8353ca7ae6060d9787.title: Add collapsible install guide to Freebuff landing page
61dbb26699328e0d2b636c8353ca7ae6060d9787.summary: Added collapsible `SetupGuide` component to `freebuff/web/src/app/home-client.tsx`. Renders 4-step terminal install flow with copyable commands (`npm install -g freebuff`, `freebuff`). Uses `AnimatePresence` for expand/collapse state. Scope limited to Web landing page.

1390d31043560aa8a653072bab2aeee4e094d7b1.title: Route minimax models via OpenRouter with SiliconFlow provider
1390d31043560aa8a653072bab2aeee4e094d7b1.summary: Direct SiliconFlow API calls for minimax models are disabled. Requests now route through OpenRouter using the `siliconflow/fp8` provider option. This applies to both streaming and non-streaming chat completions in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` and updates provider constraints in `agents/base2/base2.ts`.

be8555388e2dadcf95b9b51cc2ceed12252acf9e.title: Web styles: replace acid-green with acid-matrix
be8555388e2dadcf95b9b51cc2ceed12252acf9e.summary: Replaced the `acid-green` color token with `acid-matrix` across the web landing page components. Updated hardcoded hex values (#00FF95 to #7CFF3F) and rgba shadows in `globals.css` and `tailwind.config.ts`. Affected files include `home-client.tsx`, `background-beams.tsx`, `hero-grid.tsx`, and `terminal-demo.tsx`. Also removed the Codebuff attribution footer.

454dbb9eab7ab3b9a48b93b2d904a0195bc28f89.title: Upgrade next-themes to 0.4.6 for React 19 support
454dbb9eab7ab3b9a48b93b2d904a0195bc28f89.summary: Bumped next-themes from 0.3.0 to 0.4.6 in web/package.json and freebuff/web/package.json to enable React 19 compatibility. Added explicit react and react-dom overrides in root package.json. Updated theme-provider.tsx to import ThemeProviderProps directly from 'next-themes' instead of the deprecated 'next-themes/dist/types' path.

47abc4663bdbcf07a7201b136720f8760a1852f7.title: Route MiniMax M2.5 through SiliconFlow
47abc4663bdbcf07a7201b136720f8760a1852f7.summary: MiniMax M2.5 requests now route to SiliconFlow API instead of OpenRouter for free users. New `web/src/llm-api/siliconflow.ts` handles streaming and non-streaming chat completions with specific timeout configurations for deep-thinking models. Requires `SILICONFLOW_API_KEY` in environment variables. CanopyWave and Fireworks routing temporarily disabled in favor of this new provider.

36aa67ce5bb84e07bceb94d1173995dade9b2f9f.title: Simplify tmux-cli setup with single script execution
36aa67ce5bb84e07bceb94d1173995dade9b2f9f.summary: tmux-cli.ts consolidates helper script writing, session start, and command sending into a single `run_terminal_command` call via a combined bash script. base2.ts unconditionally registers 'tmux-cli' agent, removing isDefault check.

853643090200cdc81d726d5624f823b0c87011dc.title: Add keyword-hollow styles to globals.css
853643090200cdc81d726d5624f823b0c87011dc.summary: Added `.keyword-hollow` and `.keyword-filled` classes to `freebuff/web/src/styles/globals.css`. Implements transparent text with green stroke and glow effects on hover or when filled. Scoped to web styles.

8c077776cc855efa89d066e504ded3402611d0a7.title: Add CANOPYWAVEAPIKEY to .env.example
8c077776cc855efa89d066e504ded3402611d0a7.summary: Added `CANOPYWAVE_API_KEY` placeholder to `.env.example`. Aligns environment template with existing provider key patterns. No functional code change; affects local setup documentation only.

aaebab6ba804107ea5fc2277c287fb14d348b7b6.title: Consolidate React type overrides in root package.json
aaebab6ba804107ea5fc2277c287fb14d348b7b6.summary: Root `package.json` now pins `@types/react` and `@types/react-dom` overrides to `18.3.26` and `18.3.7`. Sub-package `overrides` blocks using `$` references were removed from `freebuff/web/package.json` and `web/package.json`. This centralizes dependency resolution for React types at the monorepo root.

e5ff7dce443241fe8c79119d00399bca1d6b49f2.title: Swap Baseten for CanopyWave in minimax provider
e5ff7dce443241fe8c79119d00399bca1d6b49f2.summary: Replaced Baseten with CanopyWave for the minimax provider in the chat completions API. This change updates environment variables, routing logic, and test scripts to use the new inference endpoint. The scope includes `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts`, `web/src/llm-api/canopywave.ts`, and related test files. Note that `CANOPYWAVE_API_KEY` replaces `BASETEN_API_KEY` in server environment configurations.

01ef8856c8985577e3f3562a3be1a0e138ea999d.title: Upgrade React to 19 across CLI and Web packages
01ef8856c8985577e3f3562a3be1a0e138ea999d.summary: React 19 replaces React 18 in CLI and Web dependencies, updating `@types/react` and `@types/react-dom` to 19.x. The upgrade resolves type incompatibilities with `FunctionComponent` returning `Promise<ReactNode>` in React 19. A new `react19-compat.d.ts` shim augments `FunctionComponent` to restore JSX compatibility for OpenTUI. Changes span `cli/package.json`, `web/package.json`, `freebuff/web/package.json`, and root `package.json` overrides.

b872dc945f3985a845747a2981c31200227b4173.title: Move tmux-cli to agents directory
b872dc945f3985a845747a2981c31200227b4173.summary: Relocates `tmux-cli.ts` from `.agents/` to `agents/`. This standardizes the directory structure for agent definitions. The change is purely organizational with no functional impact on the CLI or Web surfaces.

a10cd1daaff1e69d6443e01077f1ba771f8afb1b.title: Switch minimax-m2.5 to Baseten provider
a10cd1daaff1e69d6443e01077f1ba771f8afb1b.summary: Minimax-m2.5 routing moved from Fireworks to a new Baseten inference backend. The `web/src/llm-api/baseten.ts` file introduces `isBasetenModel` and request handlers for streaming/non-streaming, stripping OpenRouter-specific fields and applying custom timeouts. `agents/base2/base2.ts` and `agents/tmux-cli.ts` remove `inceptron/fp8` provider constraints, while `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts` adds optional `BASETEN_API_KEY`. `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` comments out the minimax model map entry, and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` prioritizes Baseten detection over Fireworks.

037ae3fe6c825b5f3d851911aad737a1e6455356.title: Web home copy update and philosophy section
037ae3fe6c825b5f3d851911aad737a1e6455356.summary: home-client.tsx adds a philosophy section with FAST, SIMPLE, LOADED keywords and descriptions. FAQ question pluralized to 'What models do you use?'. Hero subtitle changes to 'No subscription. No configuration. Start in seconds.' Scope: Web landing page only.

281a5f52ef9c3a605acea7202a68a9e743d700b2.title: Simplify Freebuff landing page
281a5f52ef9c3a605acea7202a68a9e743d700b2.summary: Removed feature grids, session-based auth UI, and external doc links from home-client.tsx, navbar.tsx, and footer.tsx. Updated headline to 'The free coding agent' and consolidated FAQ answers. Scope limited to freebuff/web/src.

0242d2d8a6e36b9bb9fc39a8a744aff446df5366.text: The system now gives a unique ID to every billing record to prevent errors if a request is accidentally sent twice. This small internal update makes credit tracking more reliable.

d86a41e78780d812c253791fc73ed3acf2de0e0f.text: Signing in now happens automatically in your web browser without copying codes. The app stays logged in even if it cannot immediately update its security key.

0c9043e39c1ca866b9c65799fa5c494c96815d9c.text: The system now uses a standard service for AI tasks instead of custom setups. This internal change has no visible effect on your experience.

03ffe85e538b3ea5afb8a9f8943aef01c45771c0.text: The review feature now uses a different AI model that cannot access your files or tools, making it safer for free users.

b02ac2e5d465624aba2bd5134f9aed1dc0684002.text: A new option lets users connect their OpenAI subscription directly for faster chat responses. This feature is currently disabled by default and only works for specific models.

bc4f68a015730597836bc4b56f73d564bc04b8db.text: Free access now blocks users outside the US and Canada. If you travel or use a VPN, the assistant may stop responding.

bd2276b98669efd76b968fe3fe2253c8a249ca3a.text: The system now reads error messages from the service more accurately. This means you see clearer explanations when something goes wrong, instead of vague or confusing text.

37a87f8e75ae11c90fc36e9660235cf4711562af.text: The review feature is now available. You can also connect your ChatGPT account to use it.

db37b85cf3e0e64e0beab185886ea30fc43b2dde.title: DiffViewer trims leading/trailing whitespace
db37b85cf3e0e64e0beab185886ea30fc43b2dde.summary: DiffViewer now trims diffText before splitting into lines. This removes extraneous blank lines at the start or end of the diff output. Affects cli/src/components/tools/diff-viewer.tsx. Implementation uses diffText.trim().split('\n').

f29ccc3e1876a5708f2589aaaa6ba667af47ce31.title: Free tier minimax-m2.5 switches to inceptron/fp8 provider
f29ccc3e1876a5708f2589aaaa6ba667af47ce31.summary: Free tier minimax-m2.5 now routes via inceptron/fp8. Previous fireworks provider replaced. Scope limited to agents/base2/base2.ts. allow_fallbacks remains false, data_collection set to deny.

17612d804f3826973857304988d4c6cd08a0b322.title: base2 prompts drop removed agent references
17612d804f3826973857304988d4c6cd08a0b322.summary: base2 agent prompts remove references to code-searcher, directory-lister, and glob-matcher agents, replacing them with direct code_search, list_directory, and glob tool usage. base2.ts still referenced agents that were removed, causing stale guidance in spawn instructions, examples, and EXPLORE_PROMPT. Affects agents/base2/base2.ts only. Spawn guidance now instructs direct tool use for codebase searching and exploration instead of spawning dedicated agents.

bcc43e4e215493850e86dbffabf5be10c58766df.title: tmux-cli agent added to base2 default subagent set
bcc43e4e215493850e86dbffabf5be10c58766df.summary: New `.agents/tmux-cli.ts` defines a tmux CLI interaction agent registered as a default subagent in `agents/base2/base2.ts`. It uses structured output schema for session tracking, step results, and script issue reporting. `createBase2` now includes `tmux-cli` in the default agent list alongside `context-pruner`.

ee5e984f9b354d71352cbca1ef9453fcb1e94ea4.title: CLI block spacing unified via gap: 1
ee5e984f9b354d71352cbca1ef9453fcb1e94ea4.summary: Refactored CLI message rendering to use consistent `gap: 1` spacing on flex containers instead of ad-hoc `marginTop`/`marginBottom` properties. Removed complex margin calculation logic from `ToolBlockGroup`, `AgentBranchWrapper`, and `SingleBlock`, and deleted the `block-margins` utility dependency. Updated `message-block.tsx` to apply `gap: 1` to the main column, ensuring uniform vertical spacing between text, tool, image, and agent blocks.

a5aa4a5044ac3d47e494cebb025253ff215d43a3.title: Track cache usage metrics in debug snapshots
a5aa4a5044ac3d47e494cebb025253ff215d43a3.summary: Added `onCacheDebugUsageReceived` callback and `CacheDebugUsageData` type to LLM contracts. Agent runtime and SDK now emit token usage (input, output, cached) to enrich cache debug snapshots. Comparison script updated to display cache hit rates. Covers `common`, `agent-runtime`, `sdk`, and `scripts`.

ac11f0809762c0c450be227d08607f5a698b5fa9.title: trimNewlines strips leading and trailing newlines
ac11f0809762c0c450be227d08607f5a698b5fa9.summary: Renamed trimTrailingNewlines to trimNewlines in block-helpers.ts. Regex updated to match ^\n+|\n+$ globally, stripping both leading and trailing newlines from assistant messages during streaming. Applied in agent-branch-wrapper.tsx, single-block.tsx, and user-content-copy.tsx.

d0b522ba55ee7857e935292f29ecffe9fccb4355.title: Opus agents pinned to amazon-bedrock provider
d0b522ba55ee7857e935292f29ecffe9fccb4355.summary: Added providerOptions.only: ['amazon-bedrock'] to all Opus-based agent definitions in agents/, including base2, editor, reviewer, thinker, and general-agent. Previously these agents used the default provider routing, causing frequent prompt cache misses when requests landed on non-Bedrock backends. Scope covers agents/base2/base2.ts, agents/editor/editor.ts, agents/editor/best-of-n/*, agents/general-agent/general-agent.ts, agents/reviewer/*, and agents/thinker/*. Opus agents now exclusively route through Amazon Bedrock, while GPT-5 and Sonnet variants remain unaffected.

ee5e984f9b354d71352cbca1ef9453fcb1e94ea4.text: The program now spaces text and images evenly, removing uneven gaps. This is a small visual cleanup that makes the chat look tidier.

bcc43e4e215493850e86dbffabf5be10c58766df.text: The assistant gained a new internal tool for managing terminal sessions. This small update helps it track steps and report issues more clearly.

4a4200f89eab492b59b535f1bb9ed0c8305da26e.text: During business hours, the assistant uses a dedicated server for faster responses. If that server is busy, it automatically switches to the standard server so you can keep working without interruption.

db37b85cf3e0e64e0beab185886ea30fc43b2dde.text: The tool now removes extra empty lines from the top and bottom of text comparisons. This makes the output look cleaner and easier to read.

17612d804f3826973857304988d4c6cd08a0b322.text: The assistant now uses built-in search and browsing tools directly, instead of calling on separate helper programs. This makes exploring files faster and simpler.

ac11f0809762c0c450be227d08607f5a698b5fa9.text: The assistant now removes extra blank lines from the start and end of its replies. This makes messages look cleaner when you copy them.

d212c62159bded47a70d599b740b59d937e10318.text: The app no longer shows a confusing message about required ads when using the free AI coding tool. This small fix removes unnecessary text for a cleaner experience.

f29ccc3e1876a5708f2589aaaa6ba667af47ce31.text: The free version of the assistant now uses a different computer system to generate its responses. This change happens behind the scenes and does not affect how you use the product.

a5aa4a5044ac3d47e494cebb025253ff215d43a3.text: The system now records how much it reuses saved information. This helps experts see if the assistant is working efficiently.

d0b522ba55ee7857e935292f29ecffe9fccb4355.text: We set the assistant to use a single, specific computer system for its most capable tasks. This stops it from switching between systems, which was causing it to forget recent conversations and slow down.

a97a1c6d12bfa1d20ae8c27f2b4d8d3d4a37f12c.text: The system now builds helper tools automatically before running checks. This fixes errors that could break the assistant. It is a small internal change.

f3083517a4d8a9e600ca5cf3854e2a2577f3ad16.text: The team improved the tools that check the command-line program. This internal update makes testing simpler and more reliable, but it does not change how the program works for you.

26887d8a5a972c250cc792e14e31b0871913f2fa.text: The assistant can now produce longer replies. It will follow the natural length limits of the model it uses, instead of a fixed cap.

0f77739bef572c0d717fd12abf2d5e75126282e8.text: The system now sends chat requests to a different service provider. This is an internal change that should not affect how you use the assistant.

3a469f8e39d543e758f96bd149f2cf2922d44b32.text: The website now describes the tool simply as a free coding assistant, removing the previous claim that it was the strongest option available.

f092bf89a849e45392c80d88dd5d02d4a0fceb19.text: The assistant now uses a different system to generate replies. This change happens behind the scenes, so you will not see any difference in how you use the product.

cb57c6646303cca800943b0ae9d018e291b93bb6.text: Fixed a small internal issue with how the system finds its own tests. This change does not affect how you use the product.

683f6d1c8eb99d8e74da94ce9e56e75f65f85925.text: The assistant can now use a specific new model through a different service. This update improves how the system handles certain requests, but you will not notice a change in how you use the product.

44084a06cd88c1402dd962c47c1972a118358e00.text: The system now uses a different model for internal testing. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

8b107a0ab89f0bdf9950d4af8db021049885e653.text: The assistant now finds its built-in helpers more reliably. This fixes rare startup errors.

06250cce4548b652a0d978fcd631a3c864e093fc.text: When you click the button to copy the installation command, a burst of small particles appears on the screen, and the box around the command briefly glows to show the copy was successful.

61dbb26699328e0d2b636c8353ca7ae6060d9787.text: The landing page now has a hidden setup guide that expands to show simple steps for getting started.

54b1803c12a229de41ae93bf37cbd48fbf4ae781.text: The assistant can now use the Fireworks model again. This change is internal and does not affect other models.

3ee603e4c5d23af302e6505d2ead236164edf1de.text: A small internal fix helps the product build correctly even when some parts are missing. This makes the software more reliable for users.

be8555388e2dadcf95b9b51cc2ceed12252acf9e.text: The website changed its bright green color to a different shade. A small credit line at the bottom was removed.

1390d31043560aa8a653072bab2aeee4e094d7b1.text: The assistant's connection to a specific model provider changed. You will not notice any difference in how the product works.

454dbb9eab7ab3b9a48b93b2d904a0195bc28f89.text: Updated the website's dark mode system to work with newer technology. This keeps the site stable and ensures theme switching continues to function correctly.

47abc4663bdbcf07a7201b136720f8760a1852f7.text: The assistant now uses a different service for free users. This change aims to keep the feature working smoothly.

789820e7ef5e012252ad895bb9b25c3ad481ddfc.text: The site now loads the menu faster. The description of the product's speed changed to 'Up to 3× the speed'.

853643090200cdc81d726d5624f823b0c87011dc.text: Keywords in the interface now have a new visual style with a green outline. When you hover over them or select them, they glow to show their status.

aaebab6ba804107ea5fc2277c287fb14d348b7b6.text: The app now uses one shared set of instructions for its visual building blocks. This small internal cleanup helps prevent display glitches.

b872dc945f3985a845747a2981c31200227b4173.text: The program moved some internal files to a new folder to keep things organized. This change does not affect how you use the product.

01ef8856c8985577e3f3562a3be1a0e138ea999d.text: The program now uses a newer version of its visual building blocks. This fixes hidden errors that could stop the screen from showing information correctly. You will see no change in how you use the product.

281a5f52ef9c3a605acea7202a68a9e743d700b2.text: The landing page is now simpler, with fewer lists and links. It focuses on the main message that the tool is a free coding assistant.

a10cd1daaff1e69d6443e01077f1ba771f8afb1b.text: The assistant switched to a new service to handle a specific model. This change happens behind the scenes, so users will not see any difference in how they use the product.

e5ff7dce443241fe8c79119d00399bca1d6b49f2.text: The chat assistant now uses a different service to process messages. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

8c077776cc855efa89d066e504ded3402611d0a7.text: A small internal update added a missing setup instruction for a service connection. This does not change how the product works for you.

36aa67ce5bb84e07bceb94d1173995dade9b2f9f.text: The assistant now starts terminal tasks more simply. This internal cleanup makes the setup process faster and less complex for you.

037ae3fe6c825b5f3d851911aad737a1e6455356.text: The website's main page was updated to explain the service's core values and simplify the sign-up promise. Questions and answers were also adjusted for better grammar.

43afde76e2a2f2d85fb5a1d72361df54fab988ae.title: Fix cache debug emission timing in SDK stream
43afde76e2a2f2d85fb5a1d72361df54fab988ae.summary: Moved `emitCacheDebugProviderRequest` call in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` from before stream processing to after `response.response` resolution. Prevents premature emission of provider request metadata during active streaming, ensuring cache debug callbacks receive finalized request state. Affects SDK core streaming implementation.

a6026d1f5fb63b6f0ee4d122e95c05ba6a329e62.title: Disable propose tools for Free tier
a6026d1f5fb63b6f0ee4d122e95c05ba6a329e62.summary: The propose_str_replace and propose_write_file tools are now conditionally disabled for the Free tier. This is implemented by checking the !isFree flag in the createBase2 function within agents/base2/base2.ts.

a73857232d3ab61ed1d12790ecac5399f92ac92e.title: base2-free uses direct tools instead of sub-agents
a73857232d3ab61ed1d12790ecac5399f92ac92e.summary: base2-free now invokes code_search, list_directory, and glob directly instead of spawning code-searcher, directory-lister, and glob-matcher sub-agents. This change prevents parallel tool execution issues by restricting free-tier agents to sequential tool calls. The update modifies agents/base2/base2.ts to conditionally include these tools and exclude the corresponding spawnable agents when isFree is true.

9fa5e732e6003051c79304b62761a3b2e3253f10.title: compare-cache-debug.ts adds run grouping and cachecontrol stripping
9fa5e732e6003051c79304b62761a3b2e3253f10.summary: Updates scripts/compare-cache-debug.ts to group cache debug snapshots by runId by default, with --cross-run and --run <id> flags for filtering. Adds stripCacheControlFromMessage to ignore cache_control placement during structural diffs, reporting shared prefix length instead of binary identical/differ. This improves diagnosis of prompt cache misses by isolating conversion-layer instability from intentional cache marker shifts.

7dc3fb96a92c35a2ac7703f2fb11359a12f6e7a9.title: Fix todo rendering spacing
7dc3fb96a92c35a2ac7703f2fb11359a12f6e7a9.summary: Added extra space after checkmark and checkbox icons in `WriteTodosItem` within `cli/src/components/tools/write-todos.tsx`. This adjusts visual spacing for completed and pending todo items.

580d90521384fa40268af32eead85438fd65abf3.title: Remove free-tier agent restrictions
580d90521384fa40268af32eead85438fd65abf3.summary: Freebuff now grants all users access to code_search, list_directory, glob, code-searcher, directory-lister, and glob-matcher. Base2 agent configuration drops isFree checks, exposing these tools universally. Context pruner blacklist updated to exclude removed agent IDs. Scope limited to agents/base2/base2.ts and agents/context-pruner.ts.

ee320c3b975f1f75f073ec2c4d3752c18e3ca04b.title: Fix env.ts error field access
ee320c3b975f1f75f073ec2c4d3752c18e3ca04b.summary: Corrected property access in `common/src/env.ts` from `.errors` to `.issues` to align with Zod's error object structure. This resolves a type error during environment validation failure logging. Scope limited to `common/src/env.ts`.

560f0ace43a7e2bcf5eebbfa7bb838503e411aef.title: Disable CACHEDEBUGFULLLOGGING in production
560f0ace43a7e2bcf5eebbfa7bb838503e411aef.summary: `CACHE_DEBUG_FULL_LOGGING` set to `false` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/constants.ts`. Prevents verbose debug cache logging in production. Internal agent runtime constant.

ed1100f857836154e655880272ece2b2e033d3fb.title: Remove /init command from Freebuff CLI
ed1100f857836154e655880272ece2b2e033d3fb.summary: Removed `/init` from Freebuff CLI. Added `init` to `FREEBUFF_REMOVED_COMMAND_IDS` in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. Updated `freebuff/SPEC.md` to drop `/init` references from command tables and knowledge files section. Scope: CLI slash commands, Freebuff spec.

b2c27168a27cc9da6a838be38d1b8c7a5b304718.title: Freebuff CLI drops agent, clear-logs, prompt args
b2c27168a27cc9da6a838be38d1b8c7a5b304718.summary: Freebuff CLI now uses simplified `parseArgs` in `cli/src/index.tsx`, removing `--agent`, `--clear-logs`, positional `[prompt...]`, and `--free`/`--max`/`--plan` flags. Codebuff retains full option set via `IS_FREEBUFF` conditional branching. `--continue` and `--cwd` remain available for both variants.

a6026d1f5fb63b6f0ee4d122e95c05ba6a329e62.text: Free users can no longer ask the assistant to suggest changes to their files. This feature remains available only to paid users.

560f0ace43a7e2bcf5eebbfa7bb838503e411aef.text: The assistant stopped saving extra background details about its memory in production. This change is small and internal. You will not notice any difference.

ed1100f857836154e655880272ece2b2e033d3fb.text: The command to start a new session was removed. You cannot use it anymore.

9fa5e732e6003051c79304b62761a3b2e3253f10.text: The tool now groups diagnostic data by session and ignores minor formatting differences to focus on actual content changes. This helps the team pinpoint why some requests might be slower or more expensive than others.

a73857232d3ab61ed1d12790ecac5399f92ac92e.text: The free version of the assistant now uses its built-in search tools directly. This change prevents errors that occurred when multiple tasks ran at once. You will experience fewer interruptions or failures when the assistant looks for information.

ee320c3b975f1f75f073ec2c4d3752c18e3ca04b.text: A small internal fix corrected how the system reports errors when checking its settings. This change does not affect how you use the product.

43afde76e2a2f2d85fb5a1d72361df54fab988ae.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant waits until a response is fully ready before sharing technical details. This prevents confusion in background logging but does not change how you use the product.

7dc3fb96a92c35a2ac7703f2fb11359a12f6e7a9.text: The list of tasks you see now has slightly more space between the checkmarks and the text. This small visual adjustment makes the list easier to read.

580d90521384fa40268af32eead85438fd65abf3.text: The assistant now searches code and lists files for everyone, not just paid users.

3c5f2b81ef5375c90a218b0d6e3e65cf58a14229.title: Upgrade action-gh-release to v2 in CI workflows
3c5f2b81ef5375c90a218b0d6e3e65cf58a14229.summary: Bumped softprops/action-gh-release from v1 to v2 across all release workflows. Updates cli-release-prod, cli-release-staging, npm-app-release-legacy, and npm-app-release-prod. Ensures compatibility with latest GitHub Actions runtime requirements.

a45e5363c132b97909f6a97060e9b53ec65800ba.title: Add dev:freebuff npm script
a45e5363c132b97909f6a97060e9b53ec65800ba.summary: Added `dev:freebuff` script to `package.json`. Runs `bun --cwd cli dev` with `FREEBUFF_MODE=true` env var. Enables local development of the Freebuff CLI.

cfb6cbe07b75cbef94ddc92ea79b9c7b5a9d3adc.title: CONTRIBUTING.md local env setup guide
cfb6cbe07b75cbef94ddc92ea79b9c7b5a9d3adc.summary: Added 'Required local env changes' section to CONTRIBUTING.md detailing mandatory .env.local variables (OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY, GRAVITY_API_KEY, PORT, NEXTAUTH_URL, CODEBUFF_GITHUB_ID/SECRET, DATABASE_URL, CODEBUFF_API_KEY). Included troubleshooting notes for dev server restarts, OpenRouter credits, and Postgres role errors during migrations.

417b5ba3a4297703716d4e72791ed38dbadff99d.title: Preserve line breaks in expanded thinking content
417b5ba3a4297703716d4e72791ed38dbadff99d.summary: Expanded thinking view in `cli/src/components/thinking.tsx` now preserves original line breaks for proper markdown rendering. Collapsed preview continues to normalize content to single line. New `expandedContent` variable applies regex replacement to normalize multiple newlines while keeping structure.

f90fbb70c5b64cfcee458e25288cefd6c935f149.title: Hide mode slash commands in Freebuff CLI
f90fbb70c5b64cfcee458e25288cefd6c935f149.summary: Mode slash commands are excluded from the CLI picker when IS_FREEBUFF is true. The AGENT_MODES constant remains the source of truth for non-Freebuff builds. Change scoped to cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts. MODE_COMMANDS array returns empty under Freebuff flag.

a15b697b15ce465ef6b795a5579b534b9ae4a5ac.title: Fix MCP tool params dropped when schemas use allOf
a15b697b15ce465ef6b795a5579b534b9ae4a5ac.summary: MCP tool parameters are now preserved when JSON schemas use allOf, anyOf, or oneOf instead of top-level properties. The paramsSection check relied solely on jsonSchema.properties, causing schemas with composition keywords to render as 'None'. Added hasMeaningfulJsonSchema to detect meaningful structure across properties, composition keywords, and required arrays. Affects packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts.

f658c35076ea52904412b671e168fdc382cba0ed.title: Upgrade GitHub Actions for Node 24 compatibility
f658c35076ea52904412b671e168fdc382cba0ed.summary: Upgraded `actions/checkout` to v6, `actions/cache` to v5, `actions/upload-artifact` to v7, `actions/download-artifact` to v8, and `actions/setup-node` to v6 across all CI workflows. This ensures compatibility with Node.js 24, which is now the standard runtime for GitHub Actions runners. Changes apply to core CI, release pipelines, and evaluation jobs in `.github/workflows/`.

af94dfb0e1b78acf86e55af4df5e8717ebdf8a7a.title: CLI publish check now argv2 only
af94dfb0e1b78acf86e55af4df5e8717ebdf8a7a.summary: The CLI publish command detection in `cli/src/index.tsx` changed from `process.argv.includes('publish')` to `process.argv[2] === 'publish'`. This prevents false positives when 'publish' appears as an argument or flag value rather than the subcommand position. Affects CLI startup logic in `cli/src/index.tsx`.

9a6cc9d95123a1587958dc38f95415b5b3ca2854.title: env.ts throws clearer Zod validation error
9a6cc9d95123a1587958dc38f95415b5b3ca2854.summary: Environment validation in common/src/env.ts now logs raw Zod errors to console and throws a prefixed Error message instead of rethrowing the raw parsedEnv.error. README.md documents /init for creating custom agent workflows in .agents/. Scope covers core environment loading and documentation. This aids debugging when clientEnvSchema.safeParse fails.

a45e5363c132b97909f6a97060e9b53ec65800ba.text: A small internal update helps developers test the assistant on their own computers before releasing new features.

cfb6cbe07b75cbef94ddc92ea79b9c7b5a9d3adc.text: The team added clear instructions to help new staff set up their work computers correctly. This internal update does not change how you use the product.

417b5ba3a4297703716d4e72791ed38dbadff99d.text: The assistant now keeps line breaks in its reasoning when expanded. This makes the text easier to read.

c9768351b870eb8065212af10a5b889b72b2538a.text: The team added a test to check how well the assistant saves money on long conversations. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

3c5f2b81ef5375c90a218b0d6e3e65cf58a14229.text: The system that sends out new software versions was updated to meet current platform rules. This internal maintenance step ensures future releases continue to work correctly.

f90fbb70c5b64cfcee458e25288cefd6c935f149.text: The app hides certain typing shortcuts when running in a specific mode. This keeps the menu clean for those users.

a15b697b15ce465ef6b795a5579b534b9ae4a5ac.text: Fixed an issue where some tools failed to recognize their settings. The assistant can now use these tools correctly.

af94dfb0e1b78acf86e55af4df5e8717ebdf8a7a.text: The command-line tool now checks only the first word after the command to decide what to do. This stops it from mistakenly running the 'publish' action when that word appears elsewhere in your instructions.

f658c35076ea52904412b671e168fdc382cba0ed.text: We updated the internal systems that build and release the software to match new standards. This change is small and internal, so you will not see any differences in how the product works.

9a6cc9d95123a1587958dc38f95415b5b3ca2854.text: If the app fails to start due to a settings problem, it now shows a clearer message explaining the issue. This helps you understand what went wrong without needing technical knowledge.

19d1cd67d2075b8e47c0f4889bd4898715ce399e.title: CLI env var FREEBUFFMODE added
19d1cd67d2075b8e47c0f4889bd4898715ce399e.summary: FREEBUFF_MODE added to CliEnv type and getCliEnv. IS_FREEBUFF constant reads via getCliEnv(). Covers cli/src/types/env.ts, cli/src/utils/env.ts, cli/src/utils/constants.ts, cli/src/testing/env.ts. Build-time flag check now uses unified env accessor.

a54e61b66c6f64af8e61791d106c8548222a6b3d.title: Guard cache debug snapshot creation with try/catch
a54e61b66c6f64af8e61791d106c8548222a6b3d.summary: Wrap `createCacheDebugSnapshot` in `try/catch` within `runAgentStep` to prevent snapshot creation errors from crashing the agent run. Failures now log a warning via `logger.warn` and set `cacheDebugCorrelation` to `undefined`. Affects `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`. Ensures robust execution when `CACHE_DEBUG_FULL_LOGGING` is enabled but snapshot generation encounters unexpected exceptions.

2237ce99e973141912d251e90ea69144dd78e772.title: Fix writefile error message property in agent runtime
2237ce99e973141912d251e90ea69144dd78e772.summary: Corrected `write_file` tool error handling in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/write-file.ts` to use `error.message` instead of `error.msg`. This ensures standard JavaScript `Error` objects are properly serialized in the tool response. Affects agent runtime tool execution only.

54c1386d5622b034b8a26ec4280e9cddf87bd27c.title: Pin React 18.3.1 and fix drizzle-orm type resolution
54c1386d5622b034b8a26ec4280e9cddf87bd27c.summary: Web package downgraded from React 19.0.0 to 18.3.1 (and types to 18.3.26/18.3.7) to resolve type conflicts. `useFormStatus` removed from `affiliates-client.tsx`; `SubmitButton` now receives `pending` prop from `useActionState` return value. `drizzle-orm` paths added to `tsconfig.json` in `web`, `scripts`, and `packages/billing` pointing to `packages/internal/node_modules`. This ensures correct type resolution for Drizzle ORM across the monorepo.

53fc285969ad9e204bfa96d4f93e33e246aaedce.title: New freebuff web app for marketing and CLI auth
53fc285969ad9e204bfa96d4f93e33e246aaedce.summary: Added a separate Next.js application in freebuff/web/ to serve as the marketing and authentication frontend for Freebuff. The app shares the NextAuth config and database with Codebuff, enabling one account for both services. Key files include freebuff/web/package.json, freebuff/web/next.config.mjs, and freebuff/web/src/app/api/auth/cli/code/route.ts for CLI login handling. The CLI auth flow generates a fingerprint-based login URL and polls a status endpoint to complete authentication.

c4d97b201a80accb2dde5134ef53f656386fe287.title: Fix types
c4d97b201a80accb2dde5134ef53f656386fe287.summary: Removes direct `drizzle-orm` dependency from `freebuff/web/package.json` and adds `paths` aliases in `freebuff/web/tsconfig.json` pointing to `packages/internal/node_modules`. Updates `freebuff/web/src/components/theme-provider.tsx` to derive `ThemeProviderProps` from `ComponentProps<typeof NextThemesProvider>` instead of importing the type directly. Scope limited to Web packaging and TS config.

c68871d3a1a0d94c2af8b33a6e17542f2344a22b.title: React 19 upgrade and 404/500 pages added
c68871d3a1a0d94c2af8b33a6e17542f2344a22b.summary: React and react-dom bumped to ^19.0.0 in freebuff/web/package.json, with matching @types/react and @types/react-dom devDependencies. New global-error.tsx and not-found.tsx files provide custom 500 and 404 pages. ThemeProvider import in theme-provider.tsx consolidated to avoid deprecated next-themes/dist/types path.

de29db72df8d9fd2823f92a936f99b6bac42a972.title: Route freebuff download url with tag prefix
de29db72df8d9fd2823f92a936f99b6bac42a972.summary: Download route now uses 'freebuff-v' tag prefix for filenames starting with 'freebuff-'. This prevents collision with codebuff releases. Only affects web/src/app/api/releases/download/[version]/[filename]/route.ts.

c08733b82d4ff63f1214abe238a5535d62c6da00.title: Freebuff website branding and font updates
c08733b82d4ff63f1214abe238a5535d62c6da00.summary: Updated website branding with new logo icons, favicon assets, and font changes. Headline text changed from "The world's strongest" to "The strongest" and copy now reads "No subscription. No API key. 5x faster than Claude Code." Navbar and footer now display the logo image with serif font, replacing the previous text-based logo. Added Domine and Manrope fonts to globals.css and tailwind.config.ts.

5e4f6082c14a4145927c879088df38f432796901.title: Add Freebuff CLI release script and package wiring
5e4f6082c14a4145927c879088df38f432796901.summary: New `freebuff/cli/release.ts` script triggers the `freebuff-release.yml` GitHub Actions workflow via `workflow_dispatch` to build and publish the Freebuff CLI. Requires `CODEBUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable to authenticate the API call. The `freebuff` workspace is added to the root `package.json` workspaces array, and a `release:freebuff` script is exposed at the root level to invoke the new CLI release command.

2237ce99e973141912d251e90ea69144dd78e772.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant shows the correct error message when it fails to save a file. This does not change how you use the product, but makes any future error notices more accurate.

a54e61b66c6f64af8e61791d106c8548222a6b3d.text: A safety check prevents rare internal errors from stopping the assistant. If a background logging step fails, the assistant keeps working normally.

c08733b82d4ff63f1214abe238a5535d62c6da00.text: The website now displays a new logo, updated fonts, and revised headline text.

de29db72df8d9fd2823f92a936f99b6bac42a972.text: The system now labels freebuff downloads differently to avoid mixing them up with other tools. This is a small internal fix that keeps your download links working correctly.

19d1cd67d2075b8e47c0f4889bd4898715ce399e.text: The program now uses a single, consistent method to check for a specific free mode setting. This internal change ensures the feature works reliably without altering how you use the product.

5e4f6082c14a4145927c879088df38f432796901.text: A new automated process was added to the product's internal packaging system to help build and publish the command-line tool. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

c68871d3a1a0d94c2af8b33a6e17542f2344a22b.text: The app's underlying technology was updated to improve stability and support new features. Custom error pages now appear when something goes wrong or a page cannot be found, providing clearer feedback instead of generic browser messages.

c4d97b201a80accb2dde5134ef53f656386fe287.text: Internal cleanup fixed how the web app finds its building blocks. This change does not affect how you use the product.

53fc285969ad9e204bfa96d4f93e33e246aaedce.text: A new website now handles sign-ups and logins for the marketing site and the command-line tool. You can use one account to access both services.

54c1386d5622b034b8a26ec4280e9cddf87bd27c.text: The website's underlying tools were updated to prevent errors. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

208a1782033a7b51bfb9aa784ca1fc1eea778c5e.title: Evalbuff brainstorm and Phase 1 spec docs added
208a1782033a7b51bfb9aa784ca1fc1eea778c5e.summary: New documentation files BRAINSTORM.md, PHASE-1-SPEC.md, and README.md define the Evalbuff project. Phase 1 spec outlines `init`, `context`, and `review` commands, authentication via Codebuff backend, and skill installation for coding agents. Brainstorm doc details future commands like `run`, `learn`, and `refresh`. Scope limited to `evalbuff/` directory; no code changes.

ed23be94063b44aa0c8e721380a80928ed5d55fb.title: High reasoning effort for base-deep GPT orchestrator
ed23be94063b44aa0c8e721380a80928ed5d55fb.summary: Added `reasoningOptions: { effort: 'high' }` to the `createBaseDeep` factory in `agents/base2/base-deep.ts`. This configures the `openai/gpt-5.4` model to use high reasoning effort for the Buffy orchestrator agent.

2651c0b945cdb2bea86e2ebe937914aafe81fde3.title: Route minimax-m2.5 to Fireworks
2651c0b945cdb2bea86e2ebe937914aafe81fde3.summary: Chat completions endpoint routes minimax-m2.5 to Fireworks API via new `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts` handler. Bypasses OpenRouter for this model using `FIREWORKS_MODEL_MAP` alias to `accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m2p5`. Requires `FIREWORKS_API_KEY` in `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts` and `.env.example`. Streaming and non-streaming paths both check `isFireworksModel` before dispatch.

5d98e790131598e3f38f2b43031e10e4d3a8bf5e.title: Free mode pins Base2 to Fireworks provider
5d98e790131598e3f38f2b43031e10e4d3a8bf5e.summary: Base2 agent now restricts free mode to the Fireworks provider via `providerOptions.only`, `order`, and `allow_fallbacks: false`. This ensures deterministic routing for the `minimax/minimax-m2.5` model and denies data collection. Paid mode remains unaffected, continuing to use `anthropic/claude-opus-4.6` with default provider routing.

d18df47ac9149474c95f6851ef1eacdb47102536.title: Add Freebuff CLI build mode and release provenance
d18df47ac9149474c95f6851ef1eacdb47102536.summary: Introduces `FREEBUFF_MODE` build flag and `IS_FREEBUFF` constant to branch CLI behavior for Freebuff binary. Hides subscription, ads, and mode commands via `FREEBUFF_REMOVED_COMMANDS` filter in `command-registry.ts`. Ad banner forces enabled state and replaces credits text with 'Ads help keep Freebuff free.' in `ad-banner.tsx`. Release workflows drop `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` env and add `--provenance` flag to `npm publish` in `freebuff-release.yml`.

98ffa6c38ece5e15ad14bfa2d018fcfdc9a9b014.title: Add FreeBuff CLI package, release workflow, and build scripts
98ffa6c38ece5e15ad14bfa2d018fcfdc9a9b014.summary: Initial commit introduces the `freebuff` npm package, a free-only variant of the Codebuff CLI. New `freebuff/cli/build.ts` wraps the standard binary build with `FREEBUFF_MODE=true` to strip paid features via dead-code elimination. `.github/workflows/freebuff-release.yml` automates version bumping, binary compilation, and GitHub Releases. `packages/agent-runtime/src/constants.ts` updated to support the new runtime context.

b94e7d2b8279e30a3d824ae3bd29fb3550cad6fe.title: Expanded prompt cache debug logging with provider request capture
b94e7d2b8279e30a3d824ae3bd29fb3550cad6fe.summary: Added `onCacheDebugProviderRequestBuilt` and `cacheDebugCorrelation` to LLM contracts and agent runtime to capture raw/normalized provider requests during cache debug snapshots. Implemented `createCacheDebugSnapshot` and `enrichCacheDebugSnapshotWithProviderRequest` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/cache-debug.ts` replacing simple file writes with structured JSON snapshots including system/tool hashes and data URL summaries. Shared serialization helpers moved to `common/src/util/cache-debug.ts`. Covers Agent Runtime, SDK, and Common types.

7f1e8004d8c8c86843581b245eecd821aaad634f.title: Freebuff placeholder release v0.0.1
7f1e8004d8c8c86843581b245eecd821aaad634f.summary: Placeholder release v0.0.1 replaces functional CLI logic with stubs. Removed binary download, telemetry, and cleanup scripts from `index.js`, `postinstall.js`, and `package.json`. `README.md` updated with new branding. `tar` dependency removed.

f09f86cba11df88d5c46a3f10971c631dc5b5893.title: Swap codex agents for gpt-5.4
f09f86cba11df88d5c46a3f10971c631dc5b5893.summary: Renamed thinker-codex to thinker-gpt and code-reviewer-codex to code-reviewer-gpt, switching underlying model from openai/gpt-5.3-codex to openai/gpt-5.4. Updated base-deep.ts prompts to reference new agent IDs in spec, plan, and review phases. Covers agents/base2, agents/thinker, and agents/reviewer directories.

75cfd15b3e81b44411fba88bf35b4f049acf1834.title: Improve CLI tester efficiency via session continuity and capture
75cfd15b3e81b44411fba88bf35b4f049acf1834.summary: Refined `codebuff-local-cli` agent prompts to enforce single-session continuity and high-value tmux captures, preventing silent session restarts and viewport thrashing. Added `cliSpecificDocs` guidance in `.agents/codebuff-local-cli.ts` and operating heuristics in `.agents/lib/cli-agent-prompts.ts` to prioritize meaningful UI state changes over frequent overlapping captures. New session artifacts in `.agents/sessions/03-06-0850-cli-tester-efficiency/` document baseline vs. post-change metrics, showing a reduction from 21 to 10 tool calls in implementation scenarios. Agents must now explicitly report session failure rather than spawning replacements.

208a1782033a7b51bfb9aa784ca1fc1eea778c5e.text: Internal planning documents were added to define the project's structure and future features. No user-facing changes occurred.

7f1e8004d8c8c86843581b245eecd821aaad634f.text: The app now shows placeholder screens instead of working tools. Background downloads and tracking scripts stopped. You see the new logo and name.

d18df47ac9149474c95f6851ef1eacdb47102536.text: The app now hides subscription and ad settings, ensuring ads always appear to keep the service free. This change also makes the software safer to install by verifying its source.

f09f86cba11df88d5c46a3f10971c631dc5b5893.text: The assistant switched to a newer underlying model. You may notice it thinks or reviews code slightly differently.

5d98e790131598e3f38f2b43031e10e4d3a8bf5e.text: Free users now always get the same AI model, so results are consistent and private. Paid users keep their usual model.

2651c0b945cdb2bea86e2ebe937914aafe81fde3.text: The assistant now uses a different provider for the minimax-m2.5 model. This internal change routes requests directly to that provider instead of going through a middleman.

ed23be94063b44aa0c8e721380a80928ed5d55fb.text: The assistant now uses more careful thinking to answer complex questions. You may see better results on tricky tasks.

b94e7d2b8279e30a3d824ae3bd29fb3550cad6fe.text: The system now records detailed snapshots of how it processes requests for troubleshooting. This internal change helps support staff diagnose issues faster without affecting how you use the product.

98ffa6c38ece5e15ad14bfa2d018fcfdc9a9b014.text: The team added a new free version of the coding assistant. This version automatically removes paid features so users can try the tool without cost. The update also includes automated tools to help release new versions of this free assistant.

8a449e81a4a8062056d71cc8c03ee08d19e4520d.title: Wrap knowledge files comparison in MarkdownTable component
8a449e81a4a8062056d71cc8c03ee08d19e4520d.summary: Replaced raw markdown table syntax in `web/src/content/tips/knowledge-files.mdx` with `<MarkdownTable>` component tags. This fixes rendering issues for the Home Directory vs Project knowledge files comparison table. Scope limited to the tips documentation page.

27d4960d7467b1464a50fcd89fe28c759356e3de.title: Remove colon from session directory name
27d4960d7467b1464a50fcd89fe28c759356e3de.summary: Session directory naming convention updated to replace colons with empty strings. Affected files include `.agents/sessions/` paths, `.agents/skills/meta/SKILL.md`, and `agents/base2/base-deep.ts`. This prevents filesystem issues with special characters in directory names.

80dc53ab3110fbd9c09ce2fa2e90453e4013893a.title: file-picker max mode spawns single file-lister-max agent
80dc53ab3110fbd9c09ce2fa2e90453e4013893a.summary: Added file-lister-max.ts and updated file-picker.ts to spawn this single agent in max mode, replacing the previous parallel spawn of two file-lister agents. The new agent is configured to list up to 20 relevant files, whereas the standard file-lister remains capped at 12. This change consolidates the max-mode file discovery into a dedicated agent definition with updated prompts and spawn logic.

b1957203eeb51dba493a545f238baa672aadde9c.title: Upgrade file picker and lister to Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
b1957203eeb51dba493a545f238baa672aadde9c.summary: File explorer agents now use google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview. The file-lister replaces x-ai/grok-4.1-fast, while the file-picker's max mode switches from grok-4.1-fast to the new model. Standard mode remains google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite. Updates affect agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts and agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts.

b493ab53110787a9c1cc7a02faf624ed4368a8f9.title: Add GPT-5.3, Claude-4.6, Gemini-3, Grok-4.1, GLM-5 to ModelName
b493ab53110787a9c1cc7a02faf624ed4368a8f9.summary: ModelName union type updated to include new AI models: openai/gpt-5.3, openai/gpt-5.3-codex, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6, anthropic/claude-opus-4.6, google/gemini-3-pro-preview, google/gemini-3-flash-preview, x-ai/grok-4.1-fast, z-ai/glm-5, and minimax/minimax-m2.5. Removed deprecated google/gemini-2.5-flash-preview-09-2025, google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-09-2025, and x-ai/grok-4-07-09. Changes applied to .agents/types/agent-definition.ts, agents/types/agent-definition.ts, and common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts.

a051d6395f9ebd84f1dcfc5c5c1e4fa534ec5b33.title: Fix markdown table alignment in knowledge-files.mdx docs
a051d6395f9ebd84f1dcfc5c5c1e4fa534ec5b33.summary: Aligned column widths in the 'When to Use Home Directory vs Project Knowledge Files' table in web/src/content/knowledge-files.mdx. Purely cosmetic fix to improve source readability. No functional changes to the rendered documentation or application logic.

3c28d5fdb0e7e037023c02e165369fb6828f7d0a.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite replaces Grok in default agents
3c28d5fdb0e7e037023c02e165369fb6828f7d0a.summary: Default agent definitions and free-mode constants migrate from x-ai/grok models to google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview. This updates Commander, Researcher, Notion, and file exploration agents to use the new Gemini model for cost and latency efficiency. Changes span .agents/, agents/, common/src/constants/, and SDK documentation/examples. The researcher-web.ts file includes minor type casting formatting adjustments.

af100a17c0367293ff1f89ad4e992fb09c1eb5fc.title: Add CACHEDEBUGFULLLOGGING flag for prompt cache debugging
af100a17c0367293ff1f89ad4e992fb09c1eb5fc.summary: Added `CACHE_DEBUG_FULL_LOGGING` constant in `packages/agent-runtime/src/constants.ts` to enable full LLM request logging. When active, `run-agent-step.ts` hashes system prompts and tool definitions, writing JSON snapshots to `debug/cache-debug/` via new `util/cache-debug.ts`.
