eaadfd2ebfb78e11b037af1e90aec9b09726f447.summary: Added `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522` and `anthropic/claude-4-sonnet` keys to `OPENROUTER_TO_ANTHROPIC_MODEL_MAP` in `common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts`. Both aliases resolve to the canonical `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` model ID. This ensures correct routing for OpenRouter requests using these specific model identifiers.

27a1225a727911ef4aff187402652ae400435967.title: Add gemini-tester agent for Gemini CLI testing
27a1225a727911ef4aff187402652ae400435967.summary: New `gemini-tester` agent added to `.agents/gemini-tester.ts` to test Google Gemini CLI functionality using tmux sessions. Agent spawns tmux, sends input, captures terminal output, and validates behavior with structured results. `scripts/tmux/README.md` updated to list `@gemini-tester` alongside existing TUI testing agents.

287c179493cd75c1e88a9aecd6d1f8ee30a3e40e.title: Add debug logging to CLI message queue and send hooks
287c179493cd75c1e88a9aecd6d1f8ee30a3e40e.summary: Instrumented `use-message-queue.ts` and `use-send-message.ts` with granular logging to diagnose input processing stalls. Queue processing logic now logs specific block reasons (e.g., `streamStatus`, `activeAgentStreams`) instead of silent returns. `use-send-message.ts` adds defensive state resets in `finally` blocks and logs validation failures and SDK run configs.

b9eb4a78d7ce4a1295a83fb65a3d201e7b6a8521.title: SDK loads knowledge files from user home directory
b9eb4a78d7ce4a1295a83fb65a3d201e7b6a8521.summary: SDK auto-discovers user knowledge files (~/.knowledge.md, ~/.AGENTS.md, ~/.CLAUDE.md) from the home directory, merging them with project context. New `userKnowledgeFiles` option in `run()` allows overriding or extending these defaults. Priority logic (knowledge.md > AGENTS.md > CLAUDE.md) is centralized in `common/src/constants/knowledge.ts` and applied across CLI init, Agent Runtime prompts, and Evals. Home directory files are read-only for the agent.

5a6348b74a6f86c73f6698bf81502dc5bbdfebf3.title: Add e2e database setup and Playwright infrastructure
5a6348b74a6f86c73f6698bf81502dc5bbdfebf3.summary: Introduced dedicated Postgres container (port 5433) and migration scripts via packages/internal/src/db/e2e-setup.ts for web E2E tests. Nightly CI now runs full `bun run e2e` suite instead of docs-only tests, with automatic cleanup. `web/package.json` scripts chain `e2e:setup` before Playwright execution; `playwright.config.ts` injects `E2E_DATABASE_URL` into webServer env. Remote DB safeguard requires `ALLOW_REMOTE_E2E_DATABASE=true` to bypass localhost check.

83be8c8402aadb3865406aa15d9a7571a11dc597.text: Internal testing tools now check more assistant apps. This change does not affect how you use the product.

ee4243fffcd14b9091a06132807caae6962b0385.text: The tool now pastes text directly into the chat if it is shorter than 1000 characters, instead of attaching it as a separate file.

eaadfd2ebfb78e11b037af1e90aec9b09726f447.text: Added support for new assistant model names. This lets the system correctly recognize and use these specific versions when you request them.

b9eb4a78d7ce4a1295a83fb65a3d201e7b6a8521.text: The assistant now automatically reads personal preference files stored in your home folder to better understand your needs. You can still override these defaults if you want to customize how the assistant behaves.

4a9f5399ab66052e1793f774e3c50fae738fd4cb.text: The program now handles pictures and other files in the same way internally. This cleanup makes it easier for the developers to add support for new file types in the future, but your current experience of attaching images stays the same.

b3e504afd2899688e8a5049ca9332a2133d561cd.text: The tool now handles pasted text more accurately and tries multiple times to connect to the session if the first attempt fails.

287c179493cd75c1e88a9aecd6d1f8ee30a3e40e.text: Internal tools were added to help diagnose why messages sometimes stop working. You will not see any changes in the app.

5a6348b74a6f86c73f6698bf81502dc5bbdfebf3.text: The system now automatically prepares a fresh, isolated test environment for every nightly check to ensure features work correctly before release. This internal improvement does not change how the product looks or feels for users.

1506118b849f954ef987c767cd716202fddaa047.text: The smallest amount of reward you get for viewing an ad now varies slightly instead of staying fixed. This is a minor internal update.

27a1225a727911ef4aff187402652ae400435967.text: A new internal test tool was added to check how the assistant handles text commands. This change is small and does not affect how the product works for users.

e1914a11273914c1231cce3e9c601e2a390fddbc.title: Remove gravity ad logging from CLI
e1914a11273914c1231cce3e9c601e2a390fddbc.summary: Deleted 6 `logger.info` calls from `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`. Removes '[gravity]' prefixed logs for AdBanner rendering, impression recording, rotation cycles, pause/resume states, and first-message detection. Reduces CLI console noise during ad lifecycle events.

1856ef41b700ca080571d7a991c8bafdf7b0959c.title: Fix ads minimum credits to 2
1856ef41b700ca080571d7a991c8bafdf7b0959c.summary: Corrects MINIMUM_CREDITS_GRANTED from 0.02 to 2 in web/src/app/api/v1/ads/impression/_post.ts. Ensures ad impression revenue share calculation grants a minimum of 2 credits per user.

52c9195bb6690eb8894cf681d1d85ed75f5017f2.title: Enforce minimum 0.02 credits for ad impressions
52c9195bb6690eb8894cf681d1d85ed75f5017f2.summary: Added `MINIMUM_CREDITS_GRANTED` constant (0.02) to `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/impression/_post.ts`. Credit calculation now uses `Math.max` to ensure payouts below the threshold still grant 0.02 credits, preventing zero-value grants from low-payout impressions. Scope limited to the server-side impression handler.

3af03fe87e2089c2ba3096d0356ee8d8b5479002.title: Track followup click events in CLI chat
3af03fe87e2089c2ba3096d0356ee8d8b5479002.summary: Added AnalyticsEvent.FOLLOWUP_CLICKED and instrumentation in cli/src/chat.tsx to track user interactions with followup suggestions. The handler now logs prompt length, index, and agent mode via logger and sends the event to analytics before submitting the prompt. Includes promise handling for onSubmitPrompt to log success or failure. Scope covers CLI chat component and shared analytics constants.

aded8b49a9e169fa253ad8bae99b655f1d8ed886.title: Fix agent store metrics mapping
aded8b49a9e169fa253ad8bae99b655f1d8ed886.summary: Agent store metrics lookup switched from `publisherId/agentName` to `publisherId/agentId` keys. Deduplication logic in `agents-transform.ts` now uses stable IDs to ensure correct version selection and metric association. Updates affect `web/src/app/store/store-client.tsx` and `web/src/server/agents-transform.ts`.

2c7bcde4cb24d7266343a781e586fbe47a17bd9f.title: suggest-followups restricts click target to label text
2c7bcde4cb24d7266343a781e586fbe47a17bd9f.summary: Refactored `FollowupLine` in `cli/src/components/tools/suggest-followups.tsx` to wrap only the label text in a `Button` component, moving the description out of the interactive element. This prevents accidental triggering of followups when hovering over or clicking the description area. The change adds manual padding calculation to maintain visual alignment between the clickable label and the non-clickable description.

88a0c20e49d2b40a3d2eed9eae481241d55ab176.title: Remove obsolete plans and update doc links
88a0c20e49d2b40a3d2eed9eae481241d55ab176.summary: Deleted `plans/` directory containing obsolete migration and feature specs (e.g., `agent-runtime-migration.md`, `bash-mode-ephemeral-execution.md`). Updated MDX documentation links in `web/src/content/` to use new path-based routing (e.g., `/docs/agents/overview#h2-built-in-agents` instead of `/docs/agents#h2-built-in-agents`). Scope limited to repo cleanup and docs integrity tests.

ec5fa96b62322090df2731a59f8f6834200bab4b.title: CLI credentials save preserves other fields
ec5fa96b62322090df2731a59f8f6834200bab4b.summary: saveUserCredentials now merges new user data into existing credentials file instead of overwriting. clearUserCredentials deletes only the 'default' key, preserving other entries. Implemented in cli/src/utils/auth.ts via readCredentialsFile helper. JSON output now pretty-printed with 2-space indent.

44e0ce088a75fb8768a03c6447855d81243e7e7f.title: Add Vale docs linting and CI E2E checks
44e0ce088a75fb8768a03c6447855d81243e7e7f.summary: Added Vale linting infrastructure and CI checks to the web package. New `.vale.ini` config enforces heading case, wordiness, and TODO comment removal. CI workflow `nightly-e2e.yml` now installs Vale v3.13.0, runs content integrity tests, and executes Playwright E2E docs tests.

9032b27453a861dee6a007ef1d04cbde3a8aa9dc.title: Web static generation and ISR for performance
9032b27453a861dee6a007ef1d04cbde3a8aa9dc.summary: Added `force-static` and `revalidate = 600` to web routes. Static generation applies to affiliates, pricing, privacy, terms, and docs. ISR configures publishers and agent pages with 10-minute revalidation. Docs layout moved client logic to `docs-layout-client.tsx`.

88a0c20e49d2b40a3d2eed9eae481241d55ab176.text: The team removed old planning notes and fixed broken links in the help guides. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how you use the product.

2c7bcde4cb24d7266343a781e586fbe47a17bd9f.text: Only the short suggestion text is clickable now. Clicking the longer description no longer triggers an action, preventing accidental selections.

1856ef41b700ca080571d7a991c8bafdf7b0959c.text: A small internal fix corrected how ad revenue is shared with users. Each ad view now guarantees a minimum of 2 credits.

52c9195bb6690eb8894cf681d1d85ed75f5017f2.text: Low-value ad views now earn a small minimum reward. This ensures you always get some credit, even for tiny amounts.

e1914a11273914c1231cce3e9c601e2a390fddbc.text: The tool no longer writes extra notes about ads to the screen while it runs. You will see a cleaner, less cluttered view when using the command line.

ec5fa96b62322090df2731a59f8f6834200bab4b.text: When you save new login details, the system now adds them to your existing list instead of replacing everything. This means your other saved accounts stay safe and accessible.

44e0ce088a75fb8768a03c6447855d81243e7e7f.text: Automatic checks now catch writing errors and broken links in the help guides. This keeps the instructions accurate and clear for you.

aded8b49a9e169fa253ad8bae99b655f1d8ed886.text: The system now uses a unique ID for each assistant to match performance data. This fixes errors where stats appeared for the wrong assistant or version.

9032b27453a861dee6a007ef1d04cbde3a8aa9dc.text: Pages for partners, prices, policies, and guides now load faster by showing saved copies instead of building fresh every time. Publisher and agent pages update automatically every ten minutes to keep information current.

3af03fe87e2089c2ba3096d0356ee8d8b5479002.text: The chat tool now quietly records when you click suggested follow-up questions. This helps the team understand which suggestions are useful to you.

e4e8a22f55e03d98f8691490296f8d6bb1c2c645.title: Docs switch to static generation
e4e8a22f55e03d98f8691490296f8d6bb1c2c645.summary: Docs pages now use `generateStaticParams` for build-time rendering. `web/src/app/docs/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx` and `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx` drop client-side `useParams` for async server props. `mdx-components.tsx` moves `'use client'` directive here.

bee92505bb5ee6828c82b034e39d11aa3e1e0b63.title: Researcher agents collapsed by default in CLI
bee92505bb5ee6828c82b034e39d11aa3e1e0b63.summary: Added researcher-web and researcher-docs to COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_AGENT_IDS in cli/src/utils/constants.ts. These agents now start collapsed in the CLI interface by default, matching the behavior of other utility agents like code-searcher. Scope limited to CLI constants.

624b646319fa2af93d2dd0b7365db47489fe3b99.title: Fix ad endpoint parsing
624b646319fa2af93d2dd0b7365db47489fe3b99.summary: Corrected Gravity API response handling in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts`. The code now expects an object with an `ads` array instead of a single ad object, extracting `ads[0]` for processing. This fixes potential errors when parsing the JSON body.

1bb9f79664696fedfd4b3fd40e6e0cbdb4862270.title: Fix ad selection index in ads POST handler
1bb9f79664696fedfd4b3fd40e6e0cbdb4862270.summary: Corrected array access in web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts. Changed `ads.ads[0]` to `ads[0]` to properly select the first ad object. This fixes the ad serving logic for the API endpoint.

b15da6fa4c00648fae15b7f32d8ad34708cbbccd.title: Docs redirect config replaces page component
b15da6fa4c00648fae15b7f32d8ad34708cbbccd.summary: Next.js config redirects handle /docs and /docs/help navigation to /docs/help/quick-start. Removes web/src/app/docs/page.tsx in favor of next.config.mjs entries. Updates footer and navbar links to use standard internal routing.

6a3e149f939aa8751c92a4c6729dc461d023a865.title: Navbar decorative spans set pointer-events-none
6a3e149f939aa8751c92a4c6729dc461d023a865.summary: Added `pointer-events-none` to absolute-positioned decorative gradient spans in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. These spans overlaid `Docs`, `Pricing`, `GitHub`, `Agent Store`, and `Usage` links, blocking click events on the underlying anchors. The fix ensures hover effects render without intercepting user interaction.

e018647fa7bc63e59f22a1099a0267fc1d3d108b.title: CLI file stats bars switch to full-width center-aligned layout
e018647fa7bc63e59f22a1099a0267fc1d3d108b.summary: cli/src/components/implementor-row.tsx replaces proportional +/- bars with full-width green/red bars meeting at a center axis. Removed maxLines calculation and leftPadding logic; added/removed counts now render in white inside padded sections using padStart/padEnd. Scope limited to CLI implementor row rendering.

21b43d28231b3c8e97a7852037ea24b0574b6d4a.title: docs: fix /init command references
21b43d28231b3c8e97a7852037ea24b0574b6d4a.summary: README and web docs replace `codebuff init-agents` with `/init` inside the CLI. Reflects current command surface. Covers `README.md`, `web/src/content/agents/overview.mdx`, `web/src/content/help/quick-start.mdx`, and `web/src/content/walkthroughs/creating-your-first-agent.mdx`. Quick-start adds a table for `knowledge.md` and `.agents/types/` output.

5830a41371f415e37548922dcbfe53ad7c04e124.title: CLI supports slashless init, new, help, logout, exit commands
5830a41371f415e37548922dcbfe53ad7c04e124.summary: Router now parses slashless exact matches for init, new, help, logout, and exit via parseCommandInput in cli/src/commands/router-utils.ts. Input matching SLASHLESS_COMMAND_IDS from cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts triggers command execution without a leading slash, while multi-word slashless input remains a normal message. Scope is CLI only; slash commands and referral codes unchanged. ImplicitCommand flag added to SlashCommand interface and analytics payload distinguishes slashless invocations.

2379ebdd7dc0b899dfde10e53aad5d0ee1475536.title: CLI pasted text becomes attachment like image
2379ebdd7dc0b899dfde10e53aad5d0ee1475536.summary: Pasted text in the CLI is converted into a pending attachment card, mirroring image paste behavior. The `onPasteLongText` handler in `cli/src/chat.tsx` adds the text to the store, and new `TextAttachmentCard` and `PendingAttachmentsBanner` components display it. This change affects the input flow and message rendering in `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` and related UI files.

b15da6fa4c00648fae15b7f32d8ad34708cbbccd.text: We moved the help page to a new address. Visiting the old link now sends you straight to the updated guide.

1bb9f79664696fedfd4b3fd40e6e0cbdb4862270.text: The system previously looked for ads in the wrong place, so the first ad was not selected correctly. This fix ensures the right ad appears when you use the product.

6a3e149f939aa8751c92a4c6729dc461d023a865.text: A small fix removed invisible layers blocking navigation links. Clicking Docs, Pricing, GitHub, Agent Store, and Usage now works.

2379ebdd7dc0b899dfde10e53aad5d0ee1475536.text: Pasting long text into the chat now turns it into a file-like attachment, similar to how images work. This keeps your chat window tidy while still letting you send the full text.

bee92505bb5ee6828c82b034e39d11aa3e1e0b63.text: Research tools now start hidden in the command line view. This keeps the screen cleaner, matching how other helper tools already behave.

624b646319fa2af93d2dd0b7365db47489fe3b99.text: Fixed a small internal error that could cause ads to fail to load correctly. No visible change for most users.

21b43d28231b3c8e97a7852037ea24b0574b6d4a.text: Instructions for setting up the assistant now show the correct command to type. This small internal fix prevents confusion when following the guide.

e018647fa7bc63e59f22a1099a0267fc1d3d108b.text: The file change indicators now use full-width bars that meet in the middle, with numbers displayed inside the colored sections. This makes the visual balance of added and removed lines easier to see at a glance.

5830a41371f415e37548922dcbfe53ad7c04e124.text: You can now type commands like 'new' or 'help' without adding a slash in front of them. This makes the interface slightly easier to use by allowing more natural typing.

e4e8a22f55e03d98f8691490296f8d6bb1c2c645.text: The help pages now build the full text before you visit, instead of assembling it while you wait. This internal update makes reading documentation faster and smoother.

7995908546f64334e1acb5bdb89b9a63810b4cb4.title: cli-ui-tester renamed to cli-tester
7995908546f64334e1acb5bdb89b9a63810b4cb4.summary: Agent definition `.agents/cli-ui-tester.ts` renamed to `.agents/cli-tester.ts`. Internal `id` and `displayName` updated to `cli-tester` and `CLI Tester`. References in `cli/tmux.knowledge.md`, `scripts/tmux/README.md`, and `scripts/tmux/tmux-viewer/README.md` updated to match new agent name.

f0eef6be25a0f614dadda4dd0e0485ef3f8c5311.title: Redirect /docs to quick-start
f0eef6be25a0f614dadda4dd0e0485ef3f8c5311.summary: DocsPage redirect target changed from /docs/help to /docs/help/quick-start. Eliminates intermediate /docs/help step. Affects web/src/app/docs/page.tsx only.

48828d98ddf7a968703fb8706cf5d60e46bea68c.title: ads API defaults sessionId to userId when missing
48828d98ddf7a968703fb8706cf5d60e46bea68c.summary: The `postAds` handler in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` now assigns `sessionId: sessionId ?? userId` to the request body, replacing the previous conditional spread that omitted `sessionId` entirely when absent. This ensures the downstream ads service always receives a valid session identifier, preventing potential mismatches or errors in ad placement tracking for unauthenticated or session-less requests.

9aa925a46842b21f4939378f22d0e8d5a4b8440c.title: tmux scripts add --binary flag for testing compiled CLI
9aa925a46842b21f4939378f22d0e8d5a4b8440c.summary: Added `--binary` flag to `tmux-cli.sh` and `tmux-start.sh` to test compiled CLI binaries instead of the dynamic development server. Supports optional path argument or `CODEBUFF_BINARY` environment variable, defaulting to `./cli/bin/codebuff`. Session metadata now records `cli_mode` and `cli_command` in `session-info.yaml`.

37bd86e3b484f17066b6d10223f694df268bc8da.title: Remove unstablecache from /api/agents route
37bd86e3b484f17066b6d10223f694df268bc8da.summary: Switched /api/agents GET handler from getCachedAgents to fetchAgentsWithMetrics. unstable_cache rejects payloads >2MB. Relies on route-level ISR revalidate: 600 for caching. Affects web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts.

da73910d42fa47d344cafa9840822922c7675768.title: CLI auth: default user schema optional
da73910d42fa47d344cafa9840822922c7675768.summary: Marked default user schema optional in credentialsSchema. Allows valid credentials object when logged out. Scope: cli/src/utils/auth.ts. Change: default: userSchema -> default: userSchema.optional().

8a8f1bf4b2dc63db9287af5c37347c3ab5de358a.title: Add JSON-LD structured data to Web pages
8a8f1bf4b2dc63db9287af5c37347c3ab5de358a.summary: Added JSON-LD structured data to agent detail, publisher, and store pages for SEO. Introduced optimized sitemap queries fetching minimal fields instead of full agent data blobs. Covers web/src/app/publishers, web/src/app/store, and web/src/app/sitemap.ts. Uses SoftwareApplication, Organization, and CollectionPage schema types.

6de489d104eb2a8c5df33254babcbdd8082b6853.title: Add JSON-LD schemas to web pages
6de489d104eb2a8c5df33254babcbdd8082b6853.summary: JSON-LD structured data added to homepage, pricing, and affiliates pages via `generateMetadata`. Client components extracted from `page.tsx` files into separate `*-client.tsx` files to support server-side metadata generation. Covers `web/src/app/page.tsx`, `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`, and `web/src/app/affiliates/page.tsx`.

0e8618beae7340f8c5738483e0c57729269e6573.title: Add /api/agents/metrics endpoint for client-side metrics loading
0e8618beae7340f8c5738483e0c57729269e6573.summary: New GET /api/agents/metrics route serves cached agent metrics separately from the store page's initial SSR payload. Store page now fetches only basic agent info via getCachedAgentsBasicInfo, while client-side queries load metrics from the new endpoint and merge them. Covers web/src/app/api/agents/metrics/route.ts, store/page.tsx, store-client.tsx, agents-data.ts, and agents-transform.ts. Metrics response keyed by publisherId/agentName; basic info dedupes to latest version per agent and sorts alphabetically, leaving metrics-based sorting to the client.

5e3264f498daeda08e1f714835bc683f1fd8ce85.title: Add SEO breadcrumbs, canonical URLs, and FAQ schema
5e3264f498daeda08e1f714835bc683f1fd8ce85.summary: Added BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, canonical URL metadata, and FAQ structured data to Web docs and publisher pages. Updated sitemap to include key documentation routes. Refactored SDK agent loader to rely on Bun's native TypeScript support, removing manual transpilation logic.

7995908546f64334e1acb5bdb89b9a63810b4cb4.text: The tool's name changed from 'CLI UI Tester' to 'CLI Tester'. This only affects how the tool is referred to internally and in documentation; it does not change what the tool does.

9aa925a46842b21f4939378f22d0e8d5a4b8440c.text: The team added a way to test the product using a different version of its core engine. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product today.

48828d98ddf7a968703fb8706cf5d60e46bea68c.text: The system now automatically assigns a unique tracking number to every ad request. This ensures accurate ad placement tracking, even for users without an active session.

0e8618beae7340f8c5738483e0c57729269e6573.text: The app now loads detailed performance data for AI agents separately from the main page. This makes the store page appear faster, while agent statistics update shortly after you open it.

f0eef6be25a0f614dadda4dd0e0485ef3f8c5311.text: A small internal update removes an extra step when you open the documentation. You now go directly to the quick-start guide instead of seeing a help page first.

37bd86e3b484f17066b6d10223f694df268bc8da.text: The system now uses a more reliable way to load agent information. This prevents errors when the list of agents is very large. Users may see slightly slower updates, but the data remains accurate.

da73910d42fa47d344cafa9840822922c7675768.text: The login system no longer requires a user profile to exist when you are signed out. This small fix prevents errors for users who are not logged in.

8a8f1bf4b2dc63db9287af5c37347c3ab5de358a.text: The website now gives search engines clearer details about agents, publishers, and stores. This helps those pages appear more accurately in search results.

6de489d104eb2a8c5df33254babcbdd8082b6853.text: The website now shares its page details in a standard format with search engines. This helps search results display the pages more clearly.

f043ef6f04e61d61a7fa203fb69d671a68154339.title: Add CI env defaults for ANTHROPICAPIKEY, GRAVITYAPIKEY
f043ef6f04e61d61a7fa203fb69d671a68154339.summary: ensureEnvDefault now injects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and GRAVITY_API_KEY stubs in packages/internal/src/env.ts under isCI. web/jest.config.cjs maps ^bun:test$ to src/test-stubs/bun-test.ts. Covers packages/internal and web test runner. Prevents missing env var failures in CI.

f4837612792b2fc89e06881c148132e06da070c5.title: Fix flaky timestamp comparison in messagesWithSystem test
f4837612792b2fc89e06881c148132e06da070c5.summary: Updated `messagesWithSystem` unit test to use spread operator for original message objects instead of constructing new ones. Avoids flaky assertions caused by `sentAt` timestamp mismatches. Internal test stability fix in `packages/agent-runtime`.

c8ba60fe617f1a2586164bbf60998ae1fbbe31c9.title: run-agent-step null-to-undefined coercion for agentTemplate
c8ba60fe617f1a2586164bbf60998ae1fbbe31c9.summary: Coerces null return from getAgentTemplate to undefined in loopAgentSteps within packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts. Fixes type compatibility for agentTemplate variable assignment. Scope limited to agent runtime step execution. Prevents null/undefined type mismatch during agent template resolution.

f8fd02ac2d4e33d0780e9f64b1ff3bd9a20c180f.title: Add session constants and fix bun-test stub type
f8fd02ac2d4e33d0780e9f64b1ff3bd9a20c180f.summary: Adds SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS and SESSION_TIME_WINDOW_MS to common/src/old-constants.ts. Fixes jest.Mock type in web/src/test-stubs/bun-test.ts. Internal type and constant cleanup.

534e9813c0cc9a2b34aa4fb73ebc2cf878a9fc28.title: CLI settings create config dir on first load
534e9813c0cc9a2b34aa4fb73ebc2cf878a9fc28.summary: Added `ensureConfigDirExists` helper in `cli/src/utils/settings.ts`. `loadSettings` now calls it before writing the default `settings.json`, preventing errors when the config directory is missing. `saveSettings` refactored to use the same helper instead of inline `mkdirSync` logic.

f51080f878829e318a2b462ba4c040734a35e510.title: Update Gravity endpoint and default ad payout
f51080f878829e318a2b462ba4c040734a35e510.summary: Switched Gravity API call to /api/v1/ad. Restructured request payload to match new schema (placements, testAd, user.id). Added DEFAULT_PAYOUT constant (0.04) fallback for missing ad payout data. Updated logging to include payout details. Affects web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts.

206730527e363e1bca216bacd55d5304cd3f5d3e.title: CLI ad requests use chat session ID instead of logger context
206730527e363e1bca216bacd55d5304cd3f5d3e.summary: The CLI `use-gravity-ad` hook now sources `sessionId` from `useChatStore.getState().chatSessionId` rather than `loggerContext.clientSessionId`. This aligns ad tracking with the active chat session, which is regenerated on `/new` via `crypto.randomUUID()` in `chat-store.ts`. The change also updates the Web API `postAds` endpoint to include `supports_links`, `supports_markdown`, and `numAds: 1` in the Gravity API request payload.

eed20257d2a0c7bd1e6c832bba3408e3259d147e.title: Add session createdat column for CLI logout time-window deletion
eed20257d2a0c7bd1e6c832bba3408e3259d147e.summary: Migration `0035_warm_orphan.sql` adds `created_at` timestamp column to `session` table with `DEFAULT now()`. Enables time-window deletion strategy for CLI logout flow. Updates `schema.ts`, `_db.ts`, `_post.ts` in logout API. Covers packages/internal and web auth surfaces.

428186cb3b0d7e93b1e3fa1dc6be1ae6c15eebbd.title: CLI logout deletes web sessions; auth refactor
428186cb3b0d7e93b1e3fa1dc6be1ae6c15eebbd.summary: CLI logout now deletes associated web sessions and unclaims fingerprints. New `_db.ts` and `_post.ts` modules in `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/logout/` handle session cleanup and fingerprint state. `auth-options.ts` uses `SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` constant. Onboarding logic moved to `web/src/app/onboard/_db.ts` with replay attack check.

5f43c1879089db13331ae9f7a0ed2600c17d4ee8.title: CLI auth fingerprint prefix updated to codebuff-cli
5f43c1879089db13331ae9f7a0ed2600c17d4ee8.summary: Internal refactor standardizes async/await usage across CLI, agent runtime, and common packages by extracting inline awaits into named variables. Additionally, the CLI login utility updates the fingerprint ID prefix from 'codecane-cli' to 'codebuff-cli' in cli/src/login/utils.ts. This ensures consistent identifier generation for authentication flows.

f8fd02ac2d4e33d0780e9f64b1ff3bd9a20c180f.text: Small internal updates. Improved session timing rules and fixed a testing tool. No visible changes for users.

5f43c1879089db13331ae9f7a0ed2600c17d4ee8.text: The tool updated how it identifies your login. This change makes the process more consistent behind the scenes.

eed20257d2a0c7bd1e6c832bba3408e3259d147e.text: The system now tracks when each login session starts. This helps remove old, unused sessions more cleanly.

f043ef6f04e61d61a7fa203fb69d671a68154339.text: Internal tests now run smoothly in automated checks. You won't see any changes or new features.

c8ba60fe617f1a2586164bbf60998ae1fbbe31c9.text: A small internal fix prevents a specific type of error when the assistant loads its settings. This makes the feature more stable for you.

206730527e363e1bca216bacd55d5304cd3f5d3e.text: The tool now tracks ad requests using the current conversation's unique identifier instead of a general system one. This helps keep ad data linked to the specific chat you are having.

534e9813c0cc9a2b34aa4fb73ebc2cf878a9fc28.text: The tool now automatically creates its settings folder when it starts up. This prevents errors if the folder is missing, so you can use the app without manually setting up files.

f4837612792b2fc89e06881c148132e06da070c5.text: This is a small, internal fix to make automated checks more reliable. You will not see any changes in how the product works.

f51080f878829e318a2b462ba4c040734a35e510.text: The system now uses a new method to connect with the ad service and has a set minimum payment value to ensure ads always have a cost assigned.

428186cb3b0d7e93b1e3fa1dc6be1ae6c15eebbd.text: When you log out on the command line, your web sessions are now deleted too. This internal change keeps you from being accidentally signed in elsewhere.

22f963340da5e4dc861ae0e85bb117fa7e1ec1e5.title: CLI test update: announceLoadedAgents assertion
22f963340da5e4dc861ae0e85bb117fa7e1ec1e5.summary: Updated integration test `announceLoadedAgents` to assert data availability via `getLoadedAgentsData` instead of spying on `console.log`. The change reflects that `announceLoadedAgents` now uses `logger.debug` internally, making direct console output assertions brittle. Scope limited to `cli/src/__tests__/integration/local-agents.test.ts`. The test now verifies the agent registry contains the expected ID and display name after initialization.

f988d78debb0a98dab289afa81a8239481e3597d.title: CLI renderer cleanup writes terminal reset escape sequences before
f988d78debb0a98dab289afa81a8239481e3597d.summary: renderer-cleanup.ts adds resetTerminalState() to write raw ANSI escape sequences to stdout before renderer.destroy(). This disables X10, button, and SGR mouse modes, focus reporting, and bracketed paste, while showing the cursor. The change ensures terminal state resets even if the renderer fails or on Windows where SIGTERM/SIGHUP are unavailable. Scope limited to cli/src/utils/renderer-cleanup.ts.

0ccf198a02188bd380c1a2e571fa25dde374a379.title: Add cta field to ad impressions and banner
0ccf198a02188bd380c1a2e571fa25dde374a379.summary: Ad banners now prioritize a dedicated `cta` field for button text, falling back to `title` then 'Learn more'. The `ad_impression` table receives a new non-null `cta` text column via migration `0034_orange_firebrand.sql`. This change updates the CLI `AdBanner` component, `use-gravity-ad` hook, internal DB schema, and web API ads handler.

5d179a62ea85ab8deb4706729b69b6a9eca7d3ad.title: CLI: announceLoadedAgents uses logger.debug instead of console.log
5d179a62ea85ab8deb4706729b69b6a9eca7d3ad.summary: cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts swaps console.log for logger.debug in announceLoadedAgents. cli/src/types/utils.ts drops unused SubsetOf and SetElement types. Agent identifiers are now passed as structured data to the logger.

a2b8c129128542a80a72b660be508873d199c53b.title: CLI publish command uses structured logger
a2b8c129128542a80a72b660be508873d199c53b.summary: Publish command in `cli/src/index.tsx` replaces direct `console.log` calls with `logger.info`, `logger.error`, and `logger.warn`. This routes output through the CLI's structured logging system, ensuring consistent formatting and log-level handling. Scope limited to `cli/src/index.tsx` publish result reporting.

11dbd952bcf4686fd720b4fb417cd0247b4f2b9c.title: CLI CopyButton logic extracted into testable utilities
11dbd952bcf4686fd720b4fb417cd0247b4f2b9c.summary: Refactored cli/src/components/copy-button.tsx to export COPIED_RESET_DELAY_MS, getCopyIconText, and copyButtonHandlers. The CopyIcon component now consumes these utilities instead of inline conditional logic, while CopyButton delegates state transitions to copyButtonHandlers. This change isolates pure logic for unit testing in cli/src/__tests__/unit/copy-button.test.ts, removing disconnected tests.

0ae1339c6e2feefdd99e09b9a2a1e6473f7b9dbb.title: Ads API includes render context and device targeting
0ae1339c6e2feefdd99e09b9a2a1e6473f7b9dbb.summary: Ads API requests now include `renderContext` with fixed placement and length constraints, plus optional `device` targeting data. CLI sends OS, timezone, and locale derived from Node.js process and Intl APIs. Server extracts client IP from `x-forwarded-for` or `x-real-ip` headers to populate device context. Changes affect `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts`.

43ea122eac6e68bea05bff686c4d6099e2af8072.title: Ads default on for new users, slash commands exit beta
43ea122eac6e68bea05bff686c4d6099e2af8072.summary: Removed '(beta)' from `/ads:enable` and `/ads:disable` in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. `cli/src/utils/settings.ts` now writes `adsEnabled: true` to `DEFAULT_SETTINGS` on first run.

7f153b3f0c5abe6ea4067329c8b7c289695ba2c9.title: Add Clickable component and refactor CopyButton
7f153b3f0c5abe6ea4067329c8b7c289695ba2c9.summary: New `Clickable` component in `cli/src/components/clickable.tsx` wraps interactive regions to automatically disable text selection, preventing accidental highlighting during clicks. `CopyButton` refactored into `copy-button.tsx` using this new primitive, replacing the previous `copy-icon-button.tsx` implementation and its associated hook. The `makeTextUnselectable` utility is now exported from `clickable.tsx` and shared by `Button` to ensure consistent non-selectable text behavior across all interactive CLI elements.

db3787c4112c1903b4122a030882a3bf7de16745.title: Gravity ad payload moves message filtering to server
db3787c4112c1903b4122a030882a3bf7de16745.summary: CLI `use-gravity-ad.ts` now sends full `adMessages` to `/api/v1/ads`, removing client-side selection of last user/assistant messages. Server `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` handles filtering, stripping `<user_message>` tags via `extractLastUserMessageContent`, and selecting the last assistant message preceding the last user message. Scope covers CLI hook and web API route. Request body now includes `userId` and `user.email` from `userInfo`.

43ea122eac6e68bea05bff686c4d6099e2af8072.text: Ads are now on by default for new users. The ads controls are no longer in testing.

11dbd952bcf4686fd720b4fb417cd0247b4f2b9c.text: The copy button's internal logic was moved to a separate, testable location. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how the button works for you.

a2b8c129128542a80a72b660be508873d199c53b.text: The publish command now uses a consistent logging system for its messages. This makes output formatting and error handling more uniform across the tool.

5d179a62ea85ab8deb4706729b69b6a9eca7d3ad.text: The program now sends internal updates to a hidden log instead of showing them on your screen. This keeps the display cleaner.

db3787c4112c1903b4122a030882a3bf7de16745.text: The app now sends all conversation history to the server instead of selecting parts itself. This means the server decides what to show, making the process more consistent.

0ccf198a02188bd380c1a2e571fa25dde374a379.text: Ad banners now show a specific button label instead of a generic one. If the ad does not provide a button label, it falls back to the ad title or 'Learn more'.

22f963340da5e4dc861ae0e85bb117fa7e1ec1e5.text: The way the system checks its own internal records was updated to be more reliable. This change is small and internal, so you will not see any difference in how the product works.

7f153b3f0c5abe6ea4067329c8b7c289695ba2c9.text: Clicking buttons no longer accidentally highlights text. This makes the interface feel smoother and prevents unwanted selections.

0ae1339c6e2feefdd99e09b9a2a1e6473f7b9dbb.text: Ad requests now share basic device details like location and language settings. This helps the system show ads that fit your screen size and local context better.

f988d78debb0a98dab289afa81a8239481e3597d.text: The tool now cleans up its visual settings automatically when it closes, even if it crashes. This prevents your terminal from getting stuck in weird modes where the mouse or keyboard might behave strangely.

0a2247ae002a0eb868ab0a38bedb597749cce5d6.title: Replace as-any casts with typed error helpers
0a2247ae002a0eb868ab0a38bedb597749cce5d6.summary: Type safety improved by replacing `as any` casts with typed error helpers and `instanceof Error` checks. New `common/src/testing/errors.ts` provides `createNodeError` and `createPostgresError` for structured test mocks. CLI `publish.ts` and Web profile components (`api-keys`, `referrals`, `security`) updated to use explicit types instead of unchecked casts. This eliminates silent type errors in error handling paths across core and UI layers.

74616a3668e5a622d6e98737957d79fb61ad9486.title: CLI login modal shows fallback URL
74616a3668e5a622d6e98737957d79fb61ad9486.summary: The CLI login modal now displays the raw `loginUrl` as a fallback option. This change addresses devices where the automatic browser opening via `open()` fails. Implemented in `cli/src/components/login-modal.tsx`, the UI updates the primary prompt to 'Opening browser...' and adds a secondary section labeled 'Or copy this URL if browser didn't open:' containing the exact link.

2a8e031963a5972dcb1ef8fffb27cd71bdd14fcf.title: Add File Filtering API reference to SDK README
2a8e031963a5972dcb1ef8fffb27cd71bdd14fcf.summary: Added `fileFilter` API documentation to `sdk/README.md`. Explains `CodebuffClient` usage with `blocked`, `allow-example`, and `allow` statuses. Clarifies default gitignore behavior versus custom filter ownership.

c7029de47bfc6b8d69f281e78262b226e4bf3c6e.title: CLI API integration tests mock setTimeout for speed
c7029de47bfc6b8d69f281e78262b226e4bf3c6e.summary: API integration tests now mock globalThis.setTimeout directly instead of using mockModule on retry-config. This avoids async module mocking overhead and ensures retry delays execute instantly. Scoped to cli/src/__tests__/integration/api-integration.test.ts. Original setTimeout is stored and restored in afterEach to prevent leakage.

fef63081a41aae1ff84c058596dd97c80f9a1d71.title: Fix CLI integration tests for retry logic
fef63081a41aae1ff84c058596dd97c80f9a1d71.summary: Updated `api-integration.test.ts` to mock `@codebuff/common/testing/mock-modules` and zero out retry delays via `retry-config`. Tests now expect multiple fetch calls due to `fetchWithRetry` behavior on network errors, replacing previous single-call assertions. Cleanup added in `afterEach` via `clearMockedModules`.

84afe501fae4f357c8da24a46ee540703bdad6d6.title: Rename /chats to /history in CLI command registry
84afe501fae4f357c8da24a46ee540703bdad6d6.summary: Primary slash command renamed from /chats to /history. Old /chats name retained as alias. Scope limited to command-registry.ts and slash-commands.ts. Alias ensures backward compatibility for existing muscle memory.

19fc2d7d12eb4a9df4f71aa489b76a7e9db64550.title: Remove duplicated .agents build artifacts from SDK package
19fc2d7d12eb4a9df4f71aa489b76a7e9db64550.summary: Deleted `sdk/.agents/constants.js` and type definition files (`agent-definition.js`, `secret-agent-definition.js`, `tools.js`, `util-types.js`) which were accidentally included in the SDK distribution. These files contained compiled JavaScript and source maps for internal agent logic, causing package bloat and potential import conflicts. The cleanup ensures the SDK only ships necessary public interfaces and runtime code.

363caf8e1860a51c0f4f59f8c3b2b217723e1652.title: Fix STEPTEXT agent streaming in CLI
363caf8e1860a51c0f4f59f8c3b2b217723e1652.summary: STEP_TEXT agents now stream assistant text directly via onResponseChunk in run-programmatic-step.ts, replacing the previous logic that overwrote streamed content with final result extraction in sdk-event-handlers.ts. This ensures agents like commander preserve their live output instead of displaying a static final message. The change affects CLI event handling and the agent runtime's programmatic step execution.

1bb18115cb107d956fa0026d5b9ae840db62b72e.title: Block sensitive files from readfiles
1bb18115cb107d956fa0026d5b9ae840db62b72e.summary: Added `fileFilter` to SDK `run()` options and CLI config to block sensitive files (`.env`, keys, credentials) and allow examples (`.env.example`) before gitignore checks. CLI `read_files` UI renders blocked files with strikethrough and `(blocked)` label, and example files with `(allowed - example only)`. Covers `sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts`, `cli/src/utils/create-run-config.ts`, and `cli/src/components/tools/read-files.tsx`. `FILE_READ_STATUS.IGNORED` value changed to `[BLOCKED]` in `common/src/old-constants.ts`.

74616a3668e5a622d6e98737957d79fb61ad9486.text: When signing in, the app now shows the web address if your browser does not open automatically. You can copy this link to finish logging in manually.

2a8e031963a5972dcb1ef8fffb27cd71bdd14fcf.text: The guide now explains how to choose which files the assistant can see. It shows how to block, allow, or follow default settings for file access.

1bb18115cb107d956fa0026d5b9ae840db62b72e.text: The tool now automatically blocks access to sensitive files like passwords and private keys while allowing safe example files. Users will see these blocked files marked with a strikethrough and a "blocked" label to prevent accidental sharing.

0a2247ae002a0eb868ab0a38bedb597749cce5d6.text: This is a small internal update to how the system checks for errors. It helps prevent minor glitches from going unnoticed, making the tool slightly more reliable.

fef63081a41aae1ff84c058596dd97c80f9a1d71.text: The system now checks that its automatic retry feature works correctly. This change was internal and does not affect how the product works for you.

19fc2d7d12eb4a9df4f71aa489b76a7e9db64550.text: The software package now removes extra internal files that were accidentally included. This reduces the size of the download and prevents possible errors when the product starts up.

84afe501fae4f357c8da24a46ee540703bdad6d6.text: The command to view past conversations now uses a clearer name, but the old one still works.

363caf8e1860a51c0f4f59f8c3b2b217723e1652.text: The assistant now shows its replies as they are generated, instead of waiting until the end to display a single block of text. This makes the conversation feel more natural and responsive.

53eca816fa3f666562181383b1c137f78c5b29fd.title: Add retry logic to SDK agent runtime client fetches
53eca816fa3f666562181383b1c137f78c5b29fd.summary: Added `fetchWithRetry` to `sdk/src/impl/database.ts` and retry loops to `packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-api/codebuff-web-api.ts`. Both now handle transient HTTP errors (408, 429, 5xx) and network failures with exponential backoff. `database.ts` uses shared `MAX_RETRIES_PER_MESSAGE` and `RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE_DELAY_MS` from `retry-config`, while `codebuff-web-api.ts` defines local constants (`MAX_RETRIES = 3`, `RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS = 1000`) and caps at 3 attempts. Scope covers SDK database calls and agent-runtime web API requests.

b73cf196116be5e193801702359014c9abf7fdf7.title: Retry web search credits charge up to 3 times
b73cf196116be5e193801702359014c9abf7fdf7.summary: The web search API endpoint in `web/src/app/api/v1/web-search/_post.ts` now retries the `checkCreditsAndCharge` call up to 3 times if it fails. This addresses flaky credit charging failures by introducing a loop with exponential backoff (`sleep(1000 * attempt)`). The change is scoped to the backend API logic, specifically the `postWebSearch` function. If all retries fail, the original error response is returned; if successful, the `creditsUsed` value is extracted from the final successful attempt.

8f8d69631f510f5e00f0b95e875b7637a42d9b80.title: Support allMessages and structuredOutput in spawn agent results
8f8d69631f510f5e00f0b95e875b7637a42d9b80.summary: Added handling for allMessages and structuredOutput modes in extractSpawnAgentResultContent. This fixes researcher-web result display where final content was previously ignored. updateSpawnAgentBlocks now prioritizes extracted content over streamed text if the extracted content is more substantial. Changes affect cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts and cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts.

46b792bd9bd8339b916315562ec5968dbb00d212.title: Add tmux-viewer TUI for CLI session inspection
46b792bd9bd8339b916315562ec5968dbb00d212.summary: New `scripts/tmux/tmux-viewer` package provides an interactive TUI for viewing tmux session logs. Supports replay mode, GIF export via `canvas`/`gif-encoder-2`, and JSON output for AI consumption. `validate-cli-with-tmux.sh` now delegates session creation to `tmux-start.sh`.

57ee778c1dc43fe76c8cf74948c6ece40f340197.title: Add PageUp/PageDown keyboard shortcuts for scrolling chat history
57ee778c1dc43fe76c8cf74948c6ece40f340197.summary: PageUp/PageDown keys now scroll chat history in the CLI. Dispatches `scroll-up`/`scroll-down` actions via `resolveChatKeyboardAction`, triggering `scrollUp`/`scrollDown` callbacks in `useChatScrollbox`. Scroll amount is 80% of viewport height (`PAGE_SCROLL_FRACTION = 0.8`). Affects `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-keyboard.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-scroll-management.ts`, `cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts`.

28e56655182b955afbc04b30e07a97e31ac28efb.title: Fix Anthropic token counting for image parts
28e56655182b955afbc04b30e07a97e31ac28efb.summary: Updated `convertContentToAnthropic` in `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts` to correctly handle both URL and base64 image sources. The function now checks the `image` field for http/https prefixes to emit `type: 'url'` sources, falling back to `type: 'base64'` for raw data. Images without valid data are skipped. Functions `convertToAnthropicMessages`, `convertContentToAnthropic`, and `formatToolContent` were exported for testing.

fe0f9da74428dd6f6ab8cdf0333f005332f6d099.title: Allow dynamic process.env access in MCP env resolution
fe0f9da74428dd6f6ab8cdf0333f005332f6d099.summary: Dynamic process.env access allowed in resolveMcpEnv via process[envName][envVarName]. Bypasses static analysis constraints for $VAR_NAME references in sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts. Scope limited to SDK MCP environment resolution. Minor formatting adjustment in loadLocalAgents error handling.

dac685215273c06475caca9eeb14e068e2d0e9fb.title: Fallback to cta for ad title in API
dac685215273c06475caca9eeb14e068e2d0e9fb.summary: The `postAds` function in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` now uses `ad.cta` as a fallback when `ad.title` is empty, preventing blank titles in `adImpression` database records. This ensures ad impressions retain meaningful text even if the primary title field is missing.

86c38afdba3b611d829db4e2619dbf70f304b910.title: Add global error handlers in web server
86c38afdba3b611d829db4e2619dbf70f304b910.summary: Added `web/instrumentation.ts` to register global `unhandledRejection` and `uncaughtException` handlers. Prevents Node.js process crashes from unhandled errors, avoiding 502 Bad Gateway responses from Render's proxy. Logs critical errors via `logger` but does not exit the process, allowing continued request handling.

1ad9d6062d128b5250882fff882cec350009cef9.title: Add cli-ui-tester agent and tmux helper scripts
1ad9d6062d128b5250882fff882cec350009cef9.summary: New `@cli-ui-tester` agent and `scripts/tmux/` helper suite enable automated CLI UI verification via tmux. Scripts wrap input in bracketed paste mode (`\e[200~...\e[201~`) to prevent character dropping caused by OpenTUI's rapid key processing, and save session logs to `debug/tmux-sessions/`. `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts` updated to inject full `spawnerPrompt` descriptions for spawnable agents instead of just IDs. Covers CLI tooling, agent runtime templates, and documentation.

57ee778c1dc43fe76c8cf74948c6ece40f340197.text: The app now moves up and down through past messages when you press the Page Up and Page Down keys.

86c38afdba3b611d829db4e2619dbf70f304b910.text: The system now catches unexpected errors to prevent crashes. This means the service stays online instead of showing 'error' pages when something goes wrong internally.

b73cf196116be5e193801702359014c9abf7fdf7.text: The system now tries up to three times to check and deduct credits for web searches if the first attempt fails. This reduces the chance of search errors caused by temporary issues with the credit system.

53eca816fa3f666562181383b1c137f78c5b29fd.text: The system now automatically tries again when it hits a temporary connection error, waiting a bit longer between each attempt. This makes the product more stable and less likely to fail during brief network hiccups.

28e56655182b955afbc04b30e07a97e31ac28efb.text: The system now correctly counts images when checking text limits. This prevents errors when you paste pictures into the chat.

46b792bd9bd8339b916315562ec5968dbb00d212.text: A new tool lets users view and share command-line session logs as animated clips or text files. This makes it easier to review past activities without needing technical skills.

8f8d69631f510f5e00f0b95e875b7637a42d9b80.text: The assistant now correctly shows the final, complete answer instead of ignoring it or showing only partial updates.

fe0f9da74428dd6f6ab8cdf0333f005332f6d099.text: The assistant can now use a wider range of settings to customize its behavior. This small update improves how the system reads configuration details without changing how you interact with it.

dac685215273c06475caca9eeb14e068e2d0e9fb.text: A small internal update fixes missing ad titles. Ads now show their call-to-action text if the main title is empty. This prevents blank spaces in ad reports.

da03ad7a6b42e378db51a4acb8836f55d0e26465.title: Fix analytics logger init cycle in CLI
da03ad7a6b42e378db51a4acb8836f55d0e26465.summary: Removed `logger` import from `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts` to break a circular dependency during initialization. Replaced `logger.debug` calls with a local `logAnalyticsDebug` helper using `console.debug` guarded by `DEBUG_ANALYTICS`. Scope limited to CLI analytics utilities. Helper silently catches console errors in restricted environments.

42fda58c17245db40f843a3edddb27d09d6d0a3f.title: Ad banner fallback for missing title
42fda58c17245db40f843a3edddb27d09d6d0a3f.summary: Ad banner CTA text now defaults to 'Learn more' when ad.title is empty. Ad impression inserts coerce null title and favicon fields to empty strings. Covers cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx and web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts. Prevents undefined rendering and satisfies non-null column constraints.

958c4fea5be1efe9aecae7e88551e51d66015cb3.title: Lazy-load logger for analytics debug
958c4fea5be1efe9aecae7e88551e51d66015cb3.summary: cli/src/utils/analytics.ts lazy-loads logger module for debug messages. Caches logger import promise to avoid repeated module resolution. Falls back to console.debug if logger import fails. Applies to CLI analytics debug output.

2156595e43c31fc4c5c8873c0c69f8b9ba75fee8.title: Upgrade opentui to 0.1.70
2156595e43c31fc4c5c8873c0c69f8b9ba75fee8.summary: Bumped @opentui/core and @opentui/react to ^0.1.70 in cli/package.json. Documented bracketed paste mode necessity in cli/knowledge.md to resolve tmux send-keys partial input issues caused by async event processing timing.

088b9926045a195d70dbe396641dfdd44e100662.title: base2 prompt tweaks
088b9926045a195d70dbe396641dfdd44e100662.summary: base2.ts prompt logic updated. Validation step now triggers only for non-trivial changes. Followup suggestion prompt moved to end of turn.

c5de0df8248195257e8d9c953677f428d0e77aab.title: CLI imports fs and path statically
c5de0df8248195257e8d9c953677f428d0e77aab.summary: Static imports for `fs` and `path` replace dynamic imports in `cli/src/index.tsx`. `fs.promises` passed to `getProjectFileTree`. Removes runtime `await import` overhead.

b58585a1b493b05414657cc11ec5d7883c46aa03.title: Fix MCP tool execution for subagents
b58585a1b493b05414657cc11ec5d7883c46aa03.summary: Subagent MCP tool calls now execute correctly. The `MCPConfig` type moved `headers` from stdio to http/sse variants. `sdk/src/run.ts` adds explicit `callMCPTool` handling for `action.mcpConfig`. Covers `.agents`, `agents`, and `common` templates.

f06fa97aa368fd3c421b6045c3d68f1bc28bf63b.title: Add DEBUGANALYTICS flag and expand analytics event properties
f06fa97aa368fd3c421b6045c3d68f1bc28bf63b.summary: Introduces centralized `DEBUG_ANALYTICS` flag in `common/src/env.ts` to control dev-mode analytics logging via structured logger. Replaces local `DEBUG_DEV_EVENTS` in `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts` and applies to `common/src/analytics.ts`. Expands telemetry payloads: `router.ts` adds `durationMs`, `stdoutLength`, `mentionCount` to command/input events; `init.ts` adds `fileSizeBytes`; `index.tsx` masks paths with `isGitRepo`/`pathDepth`; `billing` adds token/latency details. Scope covers CLI core, shared env, agent runtime, and billing packages.

bc83390be8a7c2995938a7162af2209a82b77017.title: Add card-based grid layout for implementor proposals
bc83390be8a7c2995938a7162af2209a82b77017.summary: Implementor agent proposals now render in a responsive card grid via ImplementorGroup, replacing sequential list view. Logic in `cli/src/components/implementor-row.tsx` calculates columns based on terminal width (1 for xs/sm, 2 for md, 3 for lg) and distributes agents round-robin. `message-block.tsx` groups consecutive implementor agents using `groupConsecutiveImplementors` before rendering. Status indicators unified via new `getAgentStatusInfo` helper in `cli/src/utils/agent-helpers.ts`.

0113a78e3c2200437ef8b60e79d1b7ba1af8989c.title: MCP env vars support $VARNAME syntax
0113a78e3c2200437ef8b60e79d1b7ba1af8989c.summary: Agent definitions now accept `$VAR_NAME` strings in MCP server `env` blocks, resolving them from `process.env` at load time via `resolveMcpEnv` in `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts`. This replaces hardcoded tokens (e.g., `ntn_***`) with secure references (e.g., `$NOTION_TOKEN`) in `.agents/notion-agent.ts` and `.agents/notion-researcher.ts`. Missing variables throw errors during `loadLocalAgents`, skipping the agent if `verbose` logging is enabled. Type definitions in `util-types.ts` document the behavior across core, agents, and template directories.

088b9926045a195d70dbe396641dfdd44e100662.text: The assistant now skips extra checks for simple requests and gives suggestions at the end of its reply, making responses feel smoother and faster.

42fda58c17245db40f843a3edddb27d09d6d0a3f.text: Ad banners now show a default 'Learn more' button when an ad lacks a title. This prevents broken or empty buttons from appearing.

da03ad7a6b42e378db51a4acb8836f55d0e26465.text: Fixed an internal startup issue in the command-line tool that could cause it to fail when loading analytics settings. This change improves stability for users who run the tool from a terminal.

2156595e43c31fc4c5c8873c0c69f8b9ba75fee8.text: Fixed a bug where text pasted into the terminal sometimes arrived incomplete.

0113a78e3c2200437ef8b60e79d1b7ba1af8989c.text: The assistant now finds its login keys in a secure system instead of having them written directly into its settings. This makes the app safer and easier to update.

c5de0df8248195257e8d9c953677f428d0e77aab.text: The tool now loads the parts it needs to see your files right when it starts, instead of waiting to load them later. This removes a small step from the startup process.

bc83390be8a7c2995938a7162af2209a82b77017.text: Implementor proposals now appear in a grid of cards instead of a single list. This layout adapts to the screen width, showing more proposals side-by-side when there is space.

b58585a1b493b05414657cc11ec5d7883c46aa03.text: The assistant now correctly connects to external tools when working in smaller background tasks. This fixes a connection issue so these tools run as expected.

958c4fea5be1efe9aecae7e88551e51d66015cb3.text: The app now loads debugging tools only when needed to help fix issues. This makes the app start up slightly faster and use less memory.

f06fa97aa368fd3c421b6045c3d68f1bc28bf63b.text: The app now hides private details like file paths when sending usage data, while adding more performance info to help fix slowness. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the tool.

b34f27c30a564364e351e955aeb9631cc8666b4e.title: POST /api/v1/ads accepts optional sessionId
b34f27c30a564364e351e955aeb9631cc8666b4e.summary: Added optional sessionId field to bodySchema in web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts. Passed through to Gravity API user object when present. Scope limited to ads endpoint request parsing and upstream payload.

1146a2d326051ac01289ba442e7403ff3c7a019e.title: Remove extraneous agents build artifacts
1146a2d326051ac01289ba442e7403ff3c7a019e.summary: Deleted generated JavaScript files in `agents/.agents/` (constants, types). These were compiled artifacts from `.ts` sources, not source code. Cleanup reduces repository size and prevents stale build outputs from being committed.

66270505ffecf8e449f3ba87cdea43b161532819.title: CLI: Pause timer during askuser tool
66270505ffecf8e449f3ba87cdea43b161532819.summary: Added pause/resume logic to `useElapsedTime` hook and `SendMessageTimerController` to freeze the status bar timer when the `ask_user` tool is active. `chat.tsx` triggers these methods based on `askUserState`, while `status-bar.tsx` renders a frozen elapsed time instead of resetting or hiding the indicator. Scope covers CLI core utilities (`use-elapsed-time.ts`, `send-message-timer.ts`) and UI components (`status-bar.tsx`, `chat.tsx`).

7be012258fcb4a33bcabc702f71a45c936b46c55.title: CLI markdown tables use box-drawing characters
7be012258fcb4a33bcabc702f71a45c936b46c55.summary: CLI `markdown-renderer` replaces pipe-delimited output with Unicode box-drawing characters (┌, ─, │) for table borders. New `truncateText` and `padText` helpers ensure column alignment using `stringWidth` for accurate Unicode width calculation. Logic adjusts column widths proportionally to fit within `codeBlockWidth`, adding ellipsis to overflowed cells. Affects `cli/src/utils/markdown-renderer.tsx`.

aa14cd499b507412ae2183857efaf076e008124b.title: Fix multi-byte IME input in CLI multiline component
aa14cd499b507412ae2183857efaf076e008124b.summary: Updated `multiline-input.tsx` to accept multi-byte characters from IME. Replaced strict `sequence.length === 1` check with `isPrintableCharacterKey` heuristic handling keys with no name or single-char name. Fixes input for Chinese, Japanese, Korean. Scope limited to CLI components.

b9faa7c76b61238580b33f2775b2e65401e291d9.title: CLI auto-spawns user agents for base agents
b9faa7c76b61238580b33f2775b2e65401e291d9.summary: Base agents now automatically include user-defined agents in their spawnableAgents list. This removes the need to manually update base agent definitions. Implemented in local-agent-registry.ts by appending user agent IDs to base agent configs. Agent runtime main-prompt.ts no longer overrides spawnableAgents with template-only lists.

0d38d8e3d5b6bae22fccdd74b7413731d7447c68.title: Send last user and assistant message for ads endpoint
0d38d8e3d5b6bae22fccdd74b7413731d7447c68.summary: Gravity ad request payload changed from last 3 user messages to last 1 user and last 1 assistant message. Added `sessionId` from `loggerContext` to request body. Scope: `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`.

2c0db067743914f34017ba345f6613ac4d70948a.title: Move bundled agents to agents directory
2c0db067743914f34017ba345f6613ac4d70948a.summary: Moved most .agents to agents directory for CLI bundling. Local .agents now reserved for repo-specific agents. Updated imports in agents/.agents/constants.js, agents/package.json, agents/types/agent-definition.ts and others. Affected Agents, CLI, Evals, Agent Runtime.

9d83bb9869fe418a6f49761a11e0f1e3efa33969.title: CLI analytics event tracking
9d83bb9869fe418a6f49761a11e0f1e3efa33969.summary: Implemented comprehensive analytics event tracking in CLI. New `cli/src/utils/analytics.ts` module sends events to PostHog. Tracks slash menu activation, command usage, terminal completion, user input, knowledge file updates, and auth states. Update failures in `cli/release/index.js` now report to PostHog.

24d04f4074629d1766bd27fde3f4e62e4fc104ec.title: Add /chats command for CLI chat history
24d04f4074629d1766bd27fde3f4e62e4fc104ec.summary: New /chats command opens a searchable chat history screen in the CLI. Users can browse, search, and resume past conversations directly from the terminal. The feature adds a new ChatHistoryScreen component, a zustand store for state management, and utility functions to scan the local chats directory. Two-phase loading ensures fast initial render while backgrounding the rest of the history.

7be012258fcb4a33bcabc702f71a45c936b46c55.text: Tables in the text interface now use clean, straight lines instead of pipes for borders. This makes data easier to read and keeps columns aligned, even with special characters.

b9faa7c76b61238580b33f2775b2e65401e291d9.text: The assistant now automatically recognizes custom helper agents you create, without needing manual setup. This makes it easier for the assistant to use your custom tools.

66270505ffecf8e449f3ba87cdea43b161532819.text: The time counter stops running while the assistant waits for your answer. This ensures the total time shown reflects only actual work, not your thinking pauses.

aa14cd499b507412ae2183857efaf076e008124b.text: Fixed a bug where typing in Chinese, Japanese, or Korean sometimes failed in the command-line tool. Users can now enter these languages correctly.

24d04f4074629d1766bd27fde3f4e62e4fc104ec.text: You can now search and resume past conversations directly from the command line. The history loads quickly so you can start browsing right away.

b34f27c30a564364e351e955aeb9631cc8666b4e.text: The ads system now accepts an optional session identifier. This helps track user sessions more accurately.

9d83bb9869fe418a6f49761a11e0f1e3efa33969.text: The tool now records how you use it to help the team understand what works best. If an update fails, the system sends a report so problems can be found and fixed faster.

2c0db067743914f34017ba345f6613ac4d70948a.text: Built-in tools now live in a shared space, while your own custom tools stay in a separate folder. This keeps the app's features and your personal settings from mixing.

0d38d8e3d5b6bae22fccdd74b7413731d7447c68.text: The app now sends only the most recent message from you and the assistant to ad providers, instead of your last three messages. This limits the amount of conversation history shared for ad targeting.

1146a2d326051ac01289ba442e7403ff3c7a019e.text: The team cleaned up old, unused files that were left over from building the software. This change is internal and does not affect how the product works or looks to users.

69e6936e75c11426c89c6e87aa492fb4707058d9.title: Mark ads slash commands as beta
69e6936e75c11426c89c6e87aa492fb4707058d9.summary: Updates the label for /ads:enable and /ads:disable to include '(beta)'. This change clarifies the experimental status of contextual ads in the CLI. Modified in cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts.

2745a2ad758cea1e0e5949d66f770cbca80292b1.title: Refresh Claude OAuth credentials on CLI init
2745a2ad758cea1e0e5949d66f770cbca80292b1.summary: Added background refresh of Claude OAuth credentials during `initializeApp` in `cli/src/init/init-app.ts`. Uses `getClaudeOAuthCredentials` to check for existing creds and `getValidClaudeOAuthCredentials` to refresh them, ensuring subscription status is current on startup. Errors are silently ignored as they will be retried on subsequent API calls. Scope limited to CLI initialization.

46254878afe23989a846b43e95312b28250ec585.title: Claude Connect Banner Auto-Opens OAuth Browser
46254878afe23989a846b43e95312b28250ec585.summary: ClaudeConnectBanner now auto-triggers openOAuthInBrowser on mount when getClaudeOAuthStatus returns disconnected. This replaces the static 'not-connected' state with an immediate 'waiting-for-code' flow. Error handling catches browser launch failures and transitions to 'error' state. Change applies to cli/src/components/claude-connect-banner.tsx.

9c0b8acb628d9f3699a74960aba0ed8691ba0d1b.title: base2 validation prompt: skip typecheck for small changes
9c0b8acb628d9f3699a74960aba0ed8691ba0d1b.summary: Updated validation prompt in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to allow skipping typechecks for changes under 10 lines. This reduces unnecessary validation overhead for minor, targeted edits while preserving strict checks for larger modifications.

e520374fbcfa06c7757534671a0a9c3657b292ea.title: Add note to CLI out-of-credits banner
e520374fbcfa06c7757534671a0a9c3657b292ea.summary: Adds a note to the CLI out-of-credits banner stating that some credits are needed even with a Claude subscription for other model usage. This clarifies that a subscription does not cover all model usage. The change is in `cli/src/components/out-of-credits-banner.tsx`.

21d528e58eb8198508c6d0df275cccfcef7bd886.title: reviewer-editor-gpt-5 agent for max mode
21d528e58eb8198508c6d0df275cccfcef7bd886.summary: New reviewer-editor-gpt-5 agent replaces code-reviewer in max mode. GPT-5 model with high reasoning effort reviews changes. code-reviewer restricted to default mode only. Files: .agents/editor/reviewer-editor-gpt-5.ts, .agents/base2/base2.ts

d94c3b4f078ea68664d0d8e2e2bb423ef8d9106d.title: Track Claude OAuth analytics events in SDK
d94c3b4f078ea68664d0d8e2e2bb423ef8d9106d.summary: Added `CLAUDE_OAUTH_REQUEST`, `CLAUDE_OAUTH_RATE_LIMITED`, and `CLAUDE_OAUTH_AUTH_ERROR` to `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`. `promptAiSdkStream` in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` now calls `trackEvent` for these states, passing `userId`, `model`, and `userInputId`. Scope limited to SDK and shared core constants. Event tracking now precedes the `onClaudeOAuthStatusChange` callback.

a88f3d09172212d924391e82eadcd75bd8d69eba.title: Reorder CLI slash command list and help banner shortcuts
a88f3d09172212d924391e82eadcd75bd8d69eba.summary: Reordered SLASH_COMMANDS array in cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts to prioritize connect:claude and init, moving ads:enable, ads:disable, referral, and logout/exit to the end. Updated help-banner.tsx to display /commands first in the shortcut list. Removed commented-out undo, redo, and checkpoint entries. No functional changes to command logic.

afd5a5fb26404957351454ae6cfaaa61f34fc2f6.title: Fix web researcher subagent output not displaying in CLI
afd5a5fb26404957351454ae6cfaaa61f34fc2f6.summary: Web researcher subagent output now displays correctly in the CLI. The fix adds `spawnToolCallId` and `spawnIndex` to `AgentContentBlock` in `cli/src/types/chat.ts` to precisely match spawn results to their originating blocks. `cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts` was updated to use these IDs for recursive block matching instead of fragile index parsing, while `cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts` gained robust text extraction logic. This ensures streamed content is preserved and errors are properly surfaced for all agent types.

46254878afe23989a846b43e95312b28250ec585.text: When you start the tool and see a 'not connected' message, it now automatically opens your web browser to let you sign in. This saves you from having to find and click a button to start the login process.

e520374fbcfa06c7757534671a0a9c3657b292ea.text: The app now shows a message explaining that a subscription doesn't cover every feature. You may still need to pay for some extra usage.

a88f3d09172212d924391e82eadcd75bd8d69eba.text: The list of available commands and the help menu shortcuts were reordered to show the most common options first. This change does not affect how the product works.

69e6936e75c11426c89c6e87aa492fb4707058d9.text: The labels for the ads enable and disable commands now show '(beta)'. This tells you the feature is still experimental.

9c0b8acb628d9f3699a74960aba0ed8691ba0d1b.text: The system now skips extra safety checks for very small internal updates, saving time without lowering standards for bigger changes.

2745a2ad758cea1e0e5949d66f770cbca80292b1.text: The app now quietly updates your login details when it starts, so your subscription status is correct from the first moment you open it.

afd5a5fb26404957351454ae6cfaaa61f34fc2f6.text: Previously, results from web research tasks sometimes failed to appear in the command-line interface. The system now correctly identifies and displays this information, so you can see research outputs as they happen.

d94c3b4f078ea68664d0d8e2e2bb423ef8d9106d.text: The system now records data about sign-in attempts and errors. This helps the company understand and improve how users connect their accounts. You will not see any changes in the app.

21d528e58eb8198508c6d0df275cccfcef7bd886.text: In max mode, the system now uses a new reviewer to check changes. This reviewer works more carefully than the old one. The old reviewer still handles standard checks.

09578671897274d3acb5a20c235b5368e04f2730.title: Add attribution comment to OpenRouterUsageAccounting in SDK
09578671897274d3acb5a20c235b5368e04f2730.summary: Added a source attribution comment to the `OpenRouterUsageAccounting` type in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`. This documents the type's origin from the `ai-sdk-provider` repository, clarifying its provenance for maintainers. The change is internal to the SDK implementation and affects only code comments.

a436fb59e728ff5c31ced5a91864866579da7104.title: Gravity ads send last 3 user messages
a436fb59e728ff5c31ced5a91864866579da7104.summary: The `useGravityAd` hook in `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` now filters `adMessages` to include only the last three user messages, stripping `<user_message>` tags, before sending them to the `/api/v1/ads` endpoint. This change reduces the payload size sent to the ad service by excluding assistant responses and older history. The logging statement also reflects this filtered set.

07d770778199061f3891325a6f628645b4748a3d.title: Add /buy-credits slash command
07d770778199061f3891325a6f628645b4748a3d.summary: New `/buy-credits` command added to CLI command registry and slash command list. Opens `WEBSITE_URL + '/profile?tab=usage'` in browser via `open` package. Command excluded from input history. Files: `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts`, `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`.

7541b151819f14294dcb1f61a07acf13772ab145.title: Fix useActivityQuery polling interval reset
7541b151819f14294dcb1f61a07acf13772ab145.summary: The `useActivityQuery` hook now stores `queryFn` in a ref to prevent polling interval resets caused by inline function references changing on every render. This fixes a bug where the `doFetch` dependency array included `queryFn`, causing `useCallback` to recreate the fetch logic frequently and interrupt background polling. The change is isolated to `cli/src/hooks/use-activity-query.ts`. `isEntryStale` was also exported to facilitate testing of the cache staleness logic.

558d2c89186764a8e65d162ef4881a5248a4534b.title: Color-code CLI subscription usage
558d2c89186764a8e65d162ef4881a5248a4534b.summary: Bottom status line now applies conditional coloring to remaining subscription percentage. Thresholds set at <=10% (error) and <=25% (warning), defaulting to muted otherwise. Change isolated to cli/src/components/bottom-status-line.tsx. Purely visual; no logic or data flow alterations.

a1ed1b06034c3724b962164753cf6bb97e905dd9.title: Gravity ad request message assembly fixes
a1ed1b06034c3724b962164753cf6bb97e905dd9.summary: The `useGravityAd` hook now wraps the latest UI user message in `<user_message>` tags and checks for substring containment before appending, preventing duplicate or missing context in ad requests. `convertToAdMessages` updated to filter out `INSTRUCTIONS_PROMPT` tags instead of `USER_PROMPT`. This ensures system instructions are excluded from gravity ad payloads while preserving user context. Scope limited to `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`.

f9864d271e8f84678643282a52af796dc759f60c.title: Replace TanStack Query with custom activity-aware query hook in CLI
f9864d271e8f84678643282a52af796dc759f60c.summary: Introduced `useActivityQuery` and `activityTracker` to replace `@tanstack/react-query` in the CLI, resolving terminal polling instability. The new singleton tracker detects user inactivity to pause background refetches, while `useUsageQuery` and `useClaudeQuotaQuery` now leverage this mechanism for efficient credit polling. Scope includes `cli/src/hooks/use-activity-query.ts`, `cli/src/utils/activity-tracker.ts`, and updated consumers in `chat.tsx` and banner components. Manual `setInterval` polling hacks in `usage-banner.tsx` were removed in favor of `refetchInterval` managed by the activity state.

e99971717407dd2a1eea0d0595c99d244cd530b3.title: Include HTTP status in ads API logs
e99971717407dd2a1eea0d0595c99d244cd530b3.summary: web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts now logs response.status across all Gravity API paths. Error branch returns 500 with getErrorObject(error) instead of silent 200. Scope limited to ads API handler.

57a4cce906474762dd99bec2de2d4763f45cc23b.title: Add /connect:claude command for OAuth integration
57a4cce906474762dd99bec2de2d4763f45cc23b.summary: CLI adds /connect:claude command enabling Claude subscription OAuth via browser flow. New components handle auth code exchange, quota polling, and status display. Shared constants and SDK model-provider updated to support Claude OAuth. BottomStatusLine shows quota percentage and reset time when connected.

09578671897274d3acb5a20c235b5368e04f2730.text: A note was added to the code to explain where a specific feature came from. This is an internal change that does not affect how the product works.

7541b151819f14294dcb1f61a07acf13772ab145.text: The background activity updates now run smoothly without unnecessary interruptions. This ensures the information displayed stays current and reliable.

07d770778199061f3891325a6f628645b4748a3d.text: A new command lets you buy credits by opening your account's usage page in your web browser.

a436fb59e728ff5c31ced5a91864866579da7104.text: The system now sends only your last three messages to the ad service, instead of the entire conversation history.

57a4cce906474762dd99bec2de2d4763f45cc23b.text: The app can now connect to your existing Claude subscription using a simple web login. Once connected, the bottom of the screen displays your remaining usage limits and when they reset.

558d2c89186764a8e65d162ef4881a5248a4534b.text: The status bar at the bottom of the screen now changes color to show how much of your subscription is left. It turns red when you have 10% or less remaining, and yellow when you have 25% or less.

1ad9d6062d128b5250882fff882cec350009cef9.text: The app now uses a safer text-pasting method for command-line tests, preventing dropped characters and saving logs for debugging.

f9864d271e8f84678643282a52af796dc759f60c.text: The tool now pauses checking your usage limits when you are idle and resumes when you return. This prevents the terminal from freezing or glitching during periods of inactivity.

a1ed1b06034c3724b962164753cf6bb97e905dd9.text: The system now correctly separates private instructions from your typed messages when sending requests. This prevents errors where context was missing or duplicated, ensuring the assistant sees only your intended input.

e99971717407dd2a1eea0d0595c99d244cd530b3.text: The system now records how the ad service responded. If the service fails, the system reports an error instead of pretending everything worked. This small internal change helps staff spot problems faster.

88a308155a7e7beacd38292b5234e16f3ecbcd22.title: Skip empty text parts in Anthropic message conversion
88a308155a7e7beacd38292b5234e16f3ecbcd22.summary: The `convertContentToAnthropic` function in `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts` now filters out empty or whitespace-only text parts before adding them to the Anthropic message payload. Previously, trimmed empty strings were pushed as `type: 'text'` content blocks, which could cause validation errors or unexpected behavior in the Anthropic API. This change ensures only non-empty text content is included in the converted messages.

d477b9c4ec225146614de7953ec1c90eb9cd3ed9.title: Block banned users from buying credits
d477b9c4ec225146614de7953ec1c90eb9cd3ed9.summary: Added `banned` column checks to credit purchase routes in `web/src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/credits/route.ts` and `web/src/app/api/stripe/buy-credits/route.ts`. Prevents suspended accounts from purchasing credits by returning 403 errors and logging warnings. Scope limited to Web API routes.

026aa43673a847a3dee5f3b752d1800436be8100.title: Skip tmux integration tests on CI
026aa43673a847a3dee5f3b752d1800436be8100.summary: isTmuxAvailable returns false when process.env.CI is true or 1. Prevents rerender-perf.integration.test.ts from running in GitHub Actions. Removes .catch(() => {}) from tmux set-environment calls. Reorders console.log statements in analysis output.

96591067bade84488cd8127638b44726ac87e11a.title: Tighten context pruner summary target to 10 percent
96591067bade84488cd8127638b44726ac87e11a.summary: Context pruner target summary factor drops from 15% to 10% of max context. User message truncation limit lowers to 15000 chars; assistant limit to 4000. Affects .agents/context-pruner.ts. Formatting tweaks in findLastIndex and splice logic.

135181161b75b9b8a65fc48830f607c04d8f5761.title: Trim token-count payloads, log request context
135181161b75b9b8a65fc48830f607c04d8f5761.summary: Token counting endpoint trims assistant text and JSON parts before sending to Anthropic. Error logs now include messages, system prompt, and model on API failure. Change isolated to `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts`.

500a7b527c8bb22cac539bf045a7caa82fb12016.title: Update messages.test.ts assertions for sentAt
500a7b527c8bb22cac539bf045a7caa82fb12016.summary: Added `sentAt: expect.any(Number)` to multiple test cases in `common/src/util/__tests__/messages.test.ts`. Removed `satisfies AssistantModelMessage` type assertion from one test case. This aligns tests with the `sentAt` field in model messages.
