8ed3d48f8a1e85adcc5796116ab6237cb1c370b0.title: CLI test-utils isTmuxAvailable verifies tmux usability
8ed3d48f8a1e85adcc5796116ab6237cb1c370b0.summary: The `isTmuxAvailable` helper in `cli/src/__tests__/test-utils.ts` now verifies tmux usability by creating and killing a temporary session, rather than just checking for the binary. This change ensures the function returns false in environments like GitHub Actions where the tmux server socket directory is inaccessible, preventing false positives. The update is scoped to CLI test utilities and includes a 5-second timeout for the session check.

855741f5fbcd935fe8b0c9b2624f2bf6b1de4585.title: Simplify Gravity ads client and add request logging
855741f5fbcd935fe8b0c9b2624f2bf6b1de4585.summary: Refactored `useGravityAd` to remove pre-fetch logic, simplifying rotation to a single 60-second interval (`AD_ROTATION_INTERVAL_MS`) and gating ad display behind user activity. Updated `postAds` to authenticate before parsing the request body, filter empty messages, and log the full request payload for debugging. Added `userId` and `operationId` to impression pixel logs in `postAdImpression` for better traceability. Covers `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/`.

1b7f63b5ab369b2d07964130b6d337bc3e1a5976.title: Prune context on 5-minute cache expiry
1b7f63b5ab369b2d07964130b6d337bc3e1a5976.summary: Context pruning now triggers on prompt cache expiry, not just token limits. The `context-pruner` detects gaps >5 minutes between the last assistant message and the current `USER_PROMPT`, forcing a fresh summary to avoid cache miss costs. Added `sentAt` timestamps to `AuxiliaryMessageData` in `common` and `agent-runtime` to track message age. The `sentAt` field is stripped before sending to the LLM.

20aaa76bb2a5342c178b3789fe752caa38a69235.title: CLI and agent runtime migrate live user input checks to AbortSignal
20aaa76bb2a5342c178b3789fe752caa38a69235.summary: Replaced custom `liveUserInputRecord` and `sessionConnections` state with standard `AbortSignal` for cancellation. `cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts` now passes `abortController.signal` into `createRunConfig`, which threads it through `packages/agent-runtime/src/main-prompt.ts` and `prompt-agent-stream.ts`. Deleted `packages/agent-runtime/src/live-user-inputs.ts` and `common/src/types/contracts/live-user-input.ts`, updating type contracts in `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts` to require `signal: AbortSignal` instead of check functions. Evals in `evals/impl/agent-runtime.ts` and `evals/buffbench/pick-commits.ts` updated to provide dummy signals, removing reliance on `disableLiveUserInputCheck`.

500a7b527c8bb22cac539bf045a7caa82fb12016.text: The system now checks that messages include a sent time. This makes sure the assistant's responses are properly stamped.

88a308155a7e7beacd38292b5234e16f3ecbcd22.text: The assistant now ignores blank messages when sending them to the AI. This prevents errors and keeps conversations running smoothly.

d477b9c4ec225146614de7953ec1c90eb9cd3ed9.text: Banned accounts are now blocked from buying credits. This is a small internal safety fix.

96591067bade84488cd8127638b44726ac87e11a.text: The system now keeps shorter summaries of past chats, using less memory. This helps it stay focused and faster, though it might forget tiny details from very old messages.

135181161b75b9b8a65fc48830f607c04d8f5761.text: The system now removes extra text before counting words to save space. When an error occurs, it records more details to help the team fix the problem faster.

855741f5fbcd935fe8b0c9b2624f2bf6b1de4585.text: The app now shows ads only when you are active, and waits a minute between changes. Support teams can track ad views more easily to fix problems.

20aaa76bb2a5342c178b3789fe752caa38a69235.text: The system now uses a standard method to stop actions when a user cancels. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

026aa43673a847a3dee5f3b752d1800436be8100.text: The software now skips certain internal checks when running automatically in the cloud. This change only affects how developers test the product and does not change how you use it.

1b7f63b5ab369b2d07964130b6d337bc3e1a5976.text: The assistant now refreshes its memory if you pause for more than five minutes. This helps it respond faster and more accurately after a break.

8ed3d48f8a1e85adcc5796116ab6237cb1c370b0.text: A small internal update checks if the terminal tool works properly before running tests. This prevents the software from thinking the tool is available when it cannot actually be used.

9bc6b6279a6d6308b140675fc4e776acb472a322.title: Exclude integration tests from default bun test run
9bc6b6279a6d6308b140675fc4e776acb472a322.summary: bunfig.toml now adds `**/*.integration.test.*` to the default test exclude list. This prevents long-running integration tests from executing during standard `bun test` invocations, reducing noise and potential timeouts. Scope is limited to the root `bunfig.toml` configuration.

233b7aa652437e7799f52ad20ddfdb5f2a114b46.title: Strip think tags in context pruner
233b7aa652437e7799f52ad20ddfdb5f2a114b46.summary: Context pruner now strips `<think>` tags and contents before summarizing text parts in `.agents/context-pruner.ts`. Prevents internal reasoning traces from polluting pruned context summaries. Affects internal agent context management only.

0c321bca7d1954fc485583b706ac234bb750cc42.title: Delete dead evals code
0c321bca7d1954fc485583b706ac234bb750cc42.summary: Removed unused agent execution and test setup logic from `evals/scaffolding.ts` and deleted `evals/test-setup.ts`. `TEST_REPOS_DIR` now defined inline in `evals/buffbench/setup-test-repo.ts`. Imports for `runAgentStep`, `assembleLocalAgentTemplates`, and `ToolHelpers` stripped from `scaffolding.ts`.

128cb40232f2da78f25fffe7ace79c21a64ae6d3.title: Enable askuser step in base2 agent prompt
128cb40232f2da78f25fffe7ace79c21a64ae6d3.summary: The `ask_user` tool is now explicitly included in the `base2` agent's workflow steps when `noAskUser` is false. Previously, this instruction was only added for `isMax` configurations and framed as an optional "if needed" step. The change ensures the agent proactively seeks clarifications after gathering context, unless explicitly disabled. This affects the internal prompt generation logic in `.agents/base2/base2.ts`.

43603d527a501ae9d4a2c02e8adfd19f2d8582b0.title: Anthropic token count API replaces local estimation in context pruner
43603d527a501ae9d4a2c02e8adfd19f2d8582b0.summary: Added /api/v1/token-count endpoint proxying Anthropic API and callTokenCountAPI client. Context pruner now uses agentState.contextTokenCount updated every step, replacing countMessagesTokens estimation. Scope includes agent-runtime, common types, web API, and analytics events. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY server env.

326eb6eebd6e018ecb5c12e82fb0cbe3d865914c.title: Gate think tag instructions to default and max modes
326eb6eebd6e018ecb5c12e82fb0cbe3d865914c.summary: `base2.ts` gates the `<think>` tag instruction to `isDefault || isMax` modes only, removing it from lite and fast paths. The quick-problem guidance now directs the agent to briefly explain reasoning to the user instead of relying on hidden tags. `isOpus` flag switches from hardcoded `true` to `!isLite`, aligning model selection with mode. Affects internal agent prompt construction in `.agents/base2/base2.ts`.

e99a693aea32b666e23f3b5d31a480106d08b5a7.title: Fix CLI sluggishness by removing unnecessary re-renders
e99a693aea32b666e23f3b5d31a480106d08b5a7.summary: Stabilized `streamingAgents` reference in `cli/src/chat.tsx` using `useMemo` on a sorted key, preventing re-renders when Set content is unchanged. Memoized `onOpenFeedback` callback in `cli/src/components/message-with-agents.tsx` via `useCallback` to avoid prop identity changes. Scope limited to CLI React components. These changes address performance issues caused by unstable references triggering excessive UI updates.

0791333cfed30bcc55af1240090ed5e06d47fbd3.title: Add CODEBUFFPERFTEST env flag for CLI re-render diagnostics
0791333cfed30bcc55af1240090ed5e06d47fbd3.summary: New `CODEBUFF_PERF_TEST` environment variable gates `useWhyDidYouUpdateById` logging in `AgentBranchItem` and `MessageBlock`. Previously hardcoded `false`, these components now check `getCliEnv().CODEBUFF_PERF_TEST === 'true'` to enable debug-level render tracking. The flag is added to `CliEnv` types and `getCliEnv` utility in `cli/src/types/env.ts` and `cli/src/utils/env.ts`. This allows developers to diagnose unnecessary re-renders in the CLI TUI without code changes.

d117982018b999e2bc02269627b1a86a340f4bd8.title: Remove committed eval error output files
d117982018b999e2bc02269627b1a86a340f4bd8.summary: Deleted 24 `*-agent-output-error.json` files from `evals/` that were accidentally committed. These files contained agent run failure traces and error messages from eval executions. This cleanup prevents stale error artifacts from polluting the repository and ensures eval outputs are not tracked in version control.

a2ce12824d8a873e296bd31e89399fd48d753401.title: Context pruner replaces heuristic trimming with LLM summarization
a2ce12824d8a873e296bd31e89399fd48d753401.summary: The `context-pruner` agent now uses a single-pass LLM summarization strategy instead of multi-pass heuristic trimming. Old logic removed orphaned tool calls, truncated large results, and aggressively pruned non-important messages; new logic condenses the entire conversation history into a single user-role summary message when context exceeds `maxContextLength`. Target summary size is 15% of max context (`TARGET_SUMMARY_FACTOR = 0.15`). Long individual messages are truncated to 80% prefix / 20% suffix (`USER_MESSAGE_LIMIT = 20000`, `ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_LIMIT = 5000`) before summarization.

d117982018b999e2bc02269627b1a86a340f4bd8.text: The team removed old error logs that were accidentally saved in the system. This keeps the software clean but does not change how you use it.

e99a693aea32b666e23f3b5d31a480106d08b5a7.text: Fixed a performance issue where the command-line interface updated the screen too often. The interface now feels smoother and more responsive.

0791333cfed30bcc55af1240090ed5e06d47fbd3.text: The app now includes a hidden setting for experts to check performance issues. Regular users will not notice any change.

0c321bca7d1954fc485583b706ac234bb750cc42.text: The team deleted old, unused code that ran internal quality checks. This is a small cleanup task that does not change how the product works for you.

a2ce12824d8a873e296bd31e89399fd48d753401.text: The assistant now summarizes long conversations into one brief message instead of deleting parts. This helps it remember more details from earlier chats without losing context.

43603d527a501ae9d4a2c02e8adfd19f2d8582b0.text: The assistant now uses a more accurate method to measure conversation length, replacing a rough local estimate. This helps it manage memory better and stay within usage limits more reliably.

233b7aa652437e7799f52ad20ddfdb5f2a114b46.text: The system now hides its internal reasoning steps from its short-term memory. This keeps its summaries cleaner and more focused.

9bc6b6279a6d6308b140675fc4e776acb472a322.text: The system now skips certain background checks during routine updates to save time. This makes the process faster and smoother for you.

128cb40232f2da78f25fffe7ace79c21a64ae6d3.text: The assistant now asks questions when it needs more information, instead of guessing.

326eb6eebd6e018ecb5c12e82fb0cbe3d865914c.text: The assistant now shows its reasoning steps only in standard and maximum effort modes. In faster modes, it explains its thinking directly in the answer.

d86eebfd3bafba52cf5b4c73b8ed4b0a8fef1cae.title: Fix double logging in web logger
d86eebfd3bafba52cf5b4c73b8ed4b0a8fef1cae.summary: Replaced `pinoLogger[level]` with direct `console[level]` calls in `logWithSync` to prevent double logging. The previous implementation caused duplicate entries because `pinoLogger` was configured to write to the same file as the sync logger. This change ensures logs are written to the file once and output to the console separately for interactive debugging.

37126c04f583af9a61215363c0d25648e999776c.title: CLI out-of-credits banner with live polling and Enter-to-buy flow
37126c04f583af9a61215363c0d25648e999776c.summary: New `outOfCredits` input mode replaces `usage` on credit exhaustion, rendering `OutOfCreditsBanner` instead of the standard input bar. Banner polls `useUsageQuery` every 5s, gates restoration behind a `confirmedZeroBalance` check to prevent stale-cache false positives, and exposes a global `areCreditsRestored` flag. `Enter` triggers `open(WEBSITE_URL + '/usage')` unless credits already restored, in which case it resets to `default` mode; `Escape` or `Ctrl+C` exits the mode. Covers `cli/src/components/out-of-credits-banner.tsx`, `chat.tsx`, `chat-input-bar.tsx`, `send-message.ts`, `use-chat-keyboard.ts`, `input-modes.ts`, `keyboard-actions.ts`.

d556ad7feeb7ae22dd584dbbf92d1fae490ae8c8.title: Fix send-message test assertion for payment error input mode
d556ad7feeb7ae22dd584dbbf92d1fae490ae8c8.summary: Updated `send-message.test.ts` assertion to expect `setInputModeMock` called with `'outOfCredits'` instead of `'usage'`. Aligns test with current implementation handling payment errors. Internal test fix only.

98340cb75d0702cc2595c7854cf89ae6a688c748.title: Simplify analytics and delete tests
98340cb75d0702cc2595c7854cf89ae6a688c748.summary: Removed analytics config extraction and environment checks from `common/src/analytics-core.ts`, and stripped dependency injection, state management, and configuration logic from `common/src/analytics.ts`. The `trackEvent` function now initializes the PostHog client directly using environment variables, eliminating the previous indirection layers. This change affects the shared core analytics modules, simplifying the initialization flow and removing test-specific hooks.

5f023636ac8fd147b251e6565adb745ed88b98f5.title: Detect payment required via HTTP 402 status code
5f023636ac8fd147b251e6565adb745ed88b98f5.summary: Payment-required detection now checks for HTTP 402 status codes in addition to custom error types. `isPaymentRequiredError` uses duck typing to identify AI SDK `APICallError` instances with `statusCode === 402`. `loopAgentSteps` re-throws errors matching this status, bypassing the previous `PaymentRequiredError` name check. Updates affect `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, and `sdk/src/errors.ts`.

7c95ae2da1567bc3b3c089abfdfbdc32682dc45d.title: Analytics gating switched to NEXTPUBLICCBENVIRONMENT
7c95ae2da1567bc3b3c089abfdfbdc32682dc45d.summary: Event tracking in common/src/analytics.ts now checks env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT !== 'prod' instead of isProdEnv(analyticsConfig?.envName). This replaces the previous environment validation logic with a direct Next.js public environment variable check. Scope is limited to the shared analytics module.

151e202d4da7d9ebd388342495b4a3bd4ae934bf.title: Ads API drops message schema enforcement
151e202d4da7d9ebd388342495b4a3bd4ae934bf.summary: `messageSchema` in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` replaced with empty `z.object({})`, removing `role` and `content` validation. Ads endpoint now accepts arbitrary message objects without schema rejection. Internal API surface only.

5ed90fba63526c235aca49db1a3eee6e5da4591b.title: CLI auth retry logic switches to HTTP status codes
5ed90fba63526c235aca49db1a3eee6e5da4591b.summary: CLI auth and error handling now derive retryability from HTTP status codes via `isRetryableStatusCode` and `getErrorStatusCode` instead of custom `NetworkError` classes and `RETRYABLE_ERROR_CODES`. SDK retry config removed from `createRunConfig`; auth status logic in `app.tsx` updated to handle 4xx as 'ok' and 5xx/retryable as 'retrying'/'unreachable'. `send-message.ts` simplifies out-of-credits handling using `OUT_OF_CREDITS_MESSAGE`. Covers CLI auth, message sending, and error utils.

874054fee9db3ed1cdc1fa21d529b2f7588e025e.title: CLI ad request sends only user and assistant messages
874054fee9db3ed1cdc1fa21d529b2f7588e025e.summary: CLI `use-gravity-ad.ts` filters message history to `user` and `assistant` roles before sending to the ads API via new `convertToAdMessages` helper. Web `api/v1/ads/_post.ts` updates `messageSchema` to require `role` and `content` string fields, replacing the previous empty object schema. Gravity API 204 no-ad response moved after error check to prevent misclassification. Invalid request body errors now logged server-side.

d556ad7feeb7ae22dd584dbbf92d1fae490ae8c8.text: A small internal check was updated to match how the assistant handles payment errors. This does not change what you see or do in the app.

d86eebfd3bafba52cf5b4c73b8ed4b0a8fef1cae.text: A small internal fix stops the system from recording the same event twice. You will see cleaner logs without duplicate entries.

37126c04f583af9a61215363c0d25648e999776c.text: When you run out of credits, the app now shows a clear message and checks for new credits every few seconds. Pressing Enter opens the website to buy more, while pressing Escape closes the message.

5e3264f498daeda08e1f714835bc683f1fd8ce85.text: The website now shows clearer navigation paths and answers common questions directly in search results. The underlying software system was simplified to run more efficiently.

98340cb75d0702cc2595c7854cf89ae6a688c748.text: The background system that tracks usage became simpler. This change happened inside the software and does not affect how the product looks or works for users.

5f023636ac8fd147b251e6565adb745ed88b98f5.text: The app now recognizes a specific 'payment required' signal from the server, even when it arrives in a different format. This means users will see clearer errors if their account needs payment, rather than a generic failure.

5ed90fba63526c235aca49db1a3eee6e5da4591b.text: The app now uses standard web signals to decide if it should try again after a connection issue. This makes the app more reliable when the server is temporarily busy or unreachable.

874054fee9db3ed1cdc1fa21d529b2f7588e025e.text: The app now filters chat history before sending requests for ads, ensuring only relevant conversation parts are used. This change fixes how the system handles ad requests and errors, making the ad display process more reliable for users.

7c95ae2da1567bc3b3c089abfdfbdc32682dc45d.text: A small internal change updated how the system identifies the live environment. This adjustment does not affect any features or your experience using the product.

151e202d4da7d9ebd388342495b4a3bd4ae934bf.text: A small internal change removed checks that ensured messages sent to the ad system were in the right format. This affects only how the system talks to itself and does not change what you see or do in the product.

bac76a77d3f823a386e81067d463a4aaa9dcf7be.title: billing usage-service test fixture add ad balance field
bac76a77d3f823a386e81067d463a4aaa9dcf7be.summary: Test fixture in packages/billing/src/__tests__/usage-service.test.ts adds ad: 0 to mockBalance breakdown and principals. Aligns mock shape with balance service returning ad category. Internal test sync only.

08e01629f478039b00048950ecf21ca7abf831ef.title: Replace console logs with structured logger in analytics init and chat
08e01629f478039b00048950ecf21ca7abf831ef.summary: Replaced raw console.log calls with structured logger.info calls in web/src/instrumentation.ts and added debug logging for analytics initialization in common/src/analytics.ts and chat completions requests in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts. This change standardizes log output format for production debugging, ensuring analytics configuration details and request metadata are captured consistently alongside existing event tracking. Scope limited to web server instrumentation and common analytics initialization logic. Note that sensitive API keys are logged as boolean presence flags rather than raw values to prevent secret leakage.

e30037ccf61d7fd6c1227087fa99d890f66ff311.title: Remove escape key clear input action
e30037ccf61d7fd6c1227087fa99d890f66ff311.summary: The CLI now only clears the input buffer when Ctrl+C is pressed, removing the Escape key from this action. This change prevents accidental input loss, specifically addressing concerns from vim users who rely on Escape for other navigation tasks. The modification is localized to `cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts` in the `resolveChatKeyboardAction` function. The `clear-input` action type remains available but is now exclusively triggered by Ctrl+C when text is present.

318ead2df33872679a07d548f4d558d4d528829c.title: writetodos tool result replaced with static message
318ead2df33872679a07d548f4d558d4d528829c.summary: The write_todos tool result schema and handler now return a static message string instead of echoing the input todos array. This prevents duplication of todo data in tool outputs. Changes applied to common/src/tools/params/tool/write-todos.ts and packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/write-todos.ts.

c269c1cfc765ce0e176612df2263b72579883001.title: Lazy-init analytics in trackEvent
c269c1cfc765ce0e176612df2263b72579883001.summary: Removed explicit initAnalytics and web instrumentation.ts. Analytics client now initializes lazily inside trackEvent if missing. Uses global env for config. Prevents skipped events due to uninitialized client.

67a33a8db3e67c1aa872f9529dc45989b3628de7.title: Remove initAnalytics from agent runtime tests
67a33a8db3e67c1aa872f9529dc45989b3628de7.summary: Removed `initAnalytics` mocks and calls from agent runtime tests, switching to `configureAnalytics` in analytics server tests. This aligns test suites with the new analytics initialization API. Covers `packages/agent-runtime` and `common/src`.

6a7669dddb1114ca0408761d28ca816510effac8.title: Gravity ads integration
6a7669dddb1114ca0408761d28ca816510effac8.summary: Added contextual ads via @gravity-ai/api. New /ads:enable and /ads:disable commands toggle visibility and credit earning. AdBanner displays rotating ads above input; impressions add ad credits to balance. Covers CLI, Web API, and shared settings.

ec0c885cfa1098cd8b6c441b3fb44737b7a74e34.title: Add debug logging to web instrumentation
ec0c885cfa1098cd8b6c441b3fb44737b7a74e34.summary: Added console logs to `web/src/instrumentation.ts` `register()` to trace analytics initialization. Logs capture environment variables (`NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT`, PostHog keys) and success/failure states. Internal only; no user-facing behavior change.

022a5647165db9116361662682f5cf37bb262932.title: Add fetch-monthly-revenue script
022a5647165db9116361662682f5cf37bb262932.summary: New `scripts/fetch-monthly-revenue.ts` added to aggregate Stripe balance transactions. Script queries hardcoded months (Sept-Dec 2025), paginating `stripeServer.balanceTransactions.list` with `starting_after`. Calculates gross, fees, refunds, and net revenue, printing a formatted console summary. Detects test vs live mode via `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` prefix.

7a3e53a749133333f6c3aedcb2e70fc81d1f43ee.title: CLI process cleanup handlers replace manual renderer destroy
7a3e53a749133333f6c3aedcb2e70fc81d1f43ee.summary: installProcessCleanupHandlers in cli/src/utils/renderer-cleanup.ts registers SIGTERM, SIGHUP, SIGINT, beforeExit, exit, uncaughtException, and unhandledRejection listeners to destroy the renderer. This replaces scattered cleanupRenderer() calls in cli/src/hooks/use-exit-handler.ts, cli/src/hooks/use-login-keyboard-handlers.ts, and cli/src/components/project-picker-screen.tsx. The change ensures terminal state resets on all exit paths, including crashes and unhandled rejections, not just explicit Ctrl+C or exit handler flows. SIGKILL remains uncapturable per POSIX constraints.

bac76a77d3f823a386e81067d463a4aaa9dcf7be.text: A small internal update keeps our testing tools aligned with how balances are tracked. This change does not affect how you use the product.

318ead2df33872679a07d548f4d558d4d528829c.text: The assistant's task list no longer repeats itself in the output. This makes the response cleaner and less cluttered.

08e01629f478039b00048950ecf21ca7abf831ef.text: The app now keeps its internal records in a consistent format. This change is internal and helps the team fix issues faster, but you will not notice any difference in how the app works.

67a33a8db3e67c1aa872f9529dc45989b3628de7.text: This is an internal update to how the system checks its analytics tools. It does not change how the product works for you.

e30037ccf61d7fd6c1227087fa99d890f66ff311.text: The Escape key no longer clears your typed text, preventing accidental loss of input. Only pressing Ctrl+C will now clear the text field.

c269c1cfc765ce0e176612df2263b72579883001.text: The system now starts its usage tracking tool automatically when needed. This prevents missed activity reports. You might see more accurate data in your analytics.

022a5647165db9116361662682f5cf37bb262932.text: A small internal tool was created to automatically gather revenue data for specific months in late 2025. This helps the team see accurate earnings totals without manual calculation.

6a7669dddb1114ca0408761d28ca816510effac8.text: You can now choose to show or hide ads. Turning them on earns you credits for using the service.

7a3e53a749133333f6c3aedcb2e70fc81d1f43ee.text: The app now resets the screen automatically if it closes unexpectedly, such as during a crash. This prevents the display from looking broken or stuck after the program exits.

ec0c885cfa1098cd8b6c441b3fb44737b7a74e34.text: The team added hidden notes to help them track how the product records usage data. This change is internal only and does not affect how you use the product.

72f3a8e02425af57ec6dbd8d21d7e683e26688c9.title: Add logo icons to web public directory
72f3a8e02425af57ec6dbd8d21d7e683e26688c9.summary: Added `logo-icon.png` and `logo-icon-black-bg.png` to `web/public/`. These binary assets are now available for static serving. Scope limited to the web public directory.

4d37107ebcc0605f494429c7ba35071ac554e4de.title: Fix types in context-pruner tests
4d37107ebcc0605f494429c7ba35071ac554e4de.summary: Updated `context-pruner.test.ts` to fix TypeScript errors. Changed `mockAgentState` declarations from `as AgentState` to `: any` to allow partial objects. Added optional `maxContextLength` parameter to `runHandleSteps` helper to pass params correctly to `handleSteps`.

131863efb600d81a773a41da157ec1817771914d.title: Remove middle-out compression from SDK llm.ts
131863efb600d81a773a41da157ec1817771914d.summary: Removed `transforms: ['middle-out']` from `getProviderOptions` in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts`. This change addresses potential toolcall/toolresult pairing mismatches caused by the compression. Scope limited to SDK LLM implementation.

9bea7bee8d5287bdee1f40071f274db3a66e9bb7.title: Fix thinking preview truncation
9bea7bee8d5287bdee1f40071f274db3a66e9bb7.summary: Removed `Math.min(..., 120)` width cap and adjusted `effectiveWidth` to subtract ellipsis prefix length in `cli/src/components/thinking.tsx`. Changed `wrapMode` from `word` to `none` and line joiner from space to newline. Ensures 3-line thinking preview renders accurately without premature truncation or wrapping artifacts.

4974a0ac14084386cac2c89eaa485117378bb084.title: Switch web analytics init to Next.js instrumentation hook
4974a0ac14084386cac2c89eaa485117378bb084.summary: Replaced `web/src/lib/server-init.ts` with `web/instrumentation.ts` to use Next.js native server lifecycle for `initAnalytics`. Removes manual `server-only` guard and layout import, relying on `register()` to run once at startup. Added `path: false` to `next.config.mjs` webpack fallbacks to resolve bundling issues with `pino`/`thread-stream`.

e28fbc6dea6867b8174f5f79b5403567b33fba4c.title: Context pruner removes all but last instructions prompt
e28fbc6dea6867b8174f5f79b5403567b33fba4c.summary: Added PASS 0.5 to context-pruner.ts to filter out all but the last INSTRUCTIONS_PROMPT message. This prevents context bloat from repeated instruction prompts in long sessions. The change is internal to the .agents/ subsystem and affects message history construction before tool result truncation.

8042f539c522106d8d639e58a570428e440c407f.title: Context pruner preserves important tools
8042f539c522106d8d639e58a570428e440c407f.summary: Context pruning logic updated to preserve essential tool calls (read_files, write_todos, etc.) and recent messages. Large tool results are truncated based on a 1000-char threshold, and aggressive pruning targets 25% of max tokens. Non-important tool pairs outside the last 30 messages are removed. Changes confined to .agents/context-pruner.ts.

1b45d60b9cf8d19c8b38a282e5ebf8df09d38281.title: Fix orphan tool result in agent runtime
1b45d60b9cf8d19c8b38a282e5ebf8df09d38281.summary: Tool execution errors now emit `onResponseChunk` with `type: 'error'` instead of pushing synthetic `ToolMessage` objects to `toolResults`. This prevents orphaned tool results from appearing in the conversation history when a tool call fails validation or execution. The change applies to both `executeToolCall` and `executeCustomToolCall` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts`, removing the `jsonToolResult` dependency for error paths.

27e7b6d754920d27c373c37ed7138c46b2a63848.title: send-message tests expect blocks preserved
27e7b6d754920d27c373c37ed7138c46b2a63848.summary: send-message.test.ts handleRunError assertion changed from `toBeUndefined()` to `toEqual()`. Error path now expects `aiMessage.blocks` to retain `[{ type: 'text', content: 'some block' }]` for debugging. Internal test fix only.

f18a8857ac5977f5717213c9b3af27a2ca35699e.title: Context pruner token counting fix
f18a8857ac5977f5717213c9b3af27a2ca35699e.summary: Context pruner token counting now accurately includes all message fields when images or media are present. The previous logic only counted specific metadata keys (role, toolCallId, toolName) for tool messages and just role for user/assistant messages, ignoring other fields. The updated implementation destructures the message to count all non-content fields via `countTokensJson(rest)`, ensuring tags and other metadata contribute to the token estimate. This change affects internal context management within `.agents/context-pruner.ts`.

f18a8857ac5977f5717213c9b3af27a2ca35699e.text: The system now counts every detail in your conversations to better manage memory. This prevents the assistant from losing track of important context during long chats.

4d37107ebcc0605f494429c7ba35071ac554e4de.text: Fixed internal test setup issues. No user-facing changes.

8042f539c522106d8d639e58a570428e440c407f.text: The assistant now keeps key instructions and recent history while shortening long results to save space. This internal update helps it stay focused and accurate during long conversations.

9bea7bee8d5287bdee1f40071f274db3a66e9bb7.text: The preview of the assistant's reasoning process now displays full text without cutting off sentences or breaking words incorrectly.

4974a0ac14084386cac2c89eaa485117378bb084.text: The system now starts its data tracking tool automatically when the website launches, instead of relying on a manual setup step. This internal change makes the service more reliable and fixes a technical glitch that could have stopped the site from loading correctly.

1b45d60b9cf8d19c8b38a282e5ebf8df09d38281.text: The assistant now reports errors directly when a tool fails, instead of adding broken entries to the chat history. This keeps the conversation clean and prevents confusion from failed actions.

27e7b6d754920d27c373c37ed7138c46b2a63848.text: A small internal test update ensures error details stay visible for debugging. No change to how you use the product.

131863efb600d81a773a41da157ec1817771914d.text: The system stopped shortening messages in a way that sometimes confused it about which instructions and results went together. This small fix helps the assistant follow multi-step tasks more accurately.

e28fbc6dea6867b8174f5f79b5403567b33fba4c.text: The assistant now ignores repeated instruction messages in long chats to save memory. This internal fix helps it stay focused on the latest request without getting confused by old notes.

72f3a8e02425af57ec6dbd8d21d7e683e26688c9.text: Small internal update added two new logo images to the website's public folder. These images are now ready to be displayed or used by the site.

d9e302b2e94dc95b45778526b88bc592e38cf8ca.title: Include message history in OpenRouter error log
d9e302b2e94dc95b45778526b88bc592e38cf8ca.summary: Added `messages` field to the OpenRouter error logging payload in `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`. This change captures the full message history when an upstream error occurs, aiding in debugging specific conversation states that trigger failures.

ba20001626733deae4168b84a899b43f5f31c832.title: Cleanup renderer before process.exit
ba20001626733deae4168b84a899b43f5f31c832.summary: Added cleanupRenderer() calls before process.exit(0) in CLI keyboard handlers. Ensures terminal state resets correctly on Ctrl+C exit. Affects project-picker-screen.tsx and use-login-keyboard-handlers.ts.

55a194bea95574fd13e94cf52d4cfd2e7734bfab.title: Log messageHistory and systemPrompt on agent failure
55a194bea95574fd13e94cf52d4cfd2e7734bfab.summary: Added messageHistory and systemPrompt to the error logging payload in packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts. This provides the full conversation context and system instructions when loopAgentSteps fails, aiding in debugging agent execution errors. Scope limited to Agent Runtime internal logging.

201d60896c1ae47d039c0ec9a98b52155ebfeb37.title: Tab key now toggles agent mode if file menu fails
201d60896c1ae47d039c0ec9a98b52155ebfeb37.summary: Tab key now triggers agent mode toggle in CLI chat when file menu open fails. Multiline input delegates tab handling to global keyboard hooks. `use-chat-keyboard.ts` adds fallback logic to `open-file-menu-with-tab` action. `keyboard-actions.ts` expands agent mode toggle condition to include `isTab` alongside `isShiftTab`.

864a1f1e6c44b1841f5ee725c4252b55192780fe.title: Add 1s timeout to CLI exit handler
864a1f1e6c44b1841f5ee725c4252b55192780fe.summary: CLI exit handler now wraps `flushAnalytics` with a 1s timeout (`EXIT_FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS`) via `withTimeout` to prevent hangs. This ensures `cleanupRenderer` and `process.exit` run promptly even if Posthog is unresponsive. Changes apply to `cli/src/hooks/use-exit-handler.ts`.

9b898076ad7ce25534618bfa7a50f6c6827aa4f8.title: Preserve chat blocks on error in CLI message updater
9b898076ad7ce25534618bfa7a50f6c6827aa4f8.summary: Removed logic clearing `blocks` during error updates in `cli/src/utils/message-updater.ts`. Previously, errors wiped block data; now blocks are preserved for debugging context. Applies to both `createMessageUpdater` and `createBatchedMessageUpdater`.

a995965967df8fdbc1506425313f7cad072c0489.title: Fix project picker screen highlighting and sorting
a995965967df8fdbc1506425313f7cad072c0489.summary: Project picker screen updates list highlighting to use subtle theme surfaces instead of primary backgrounds, fixing contrast issues. Directory entries now sort alphabetically with Git repos highlighted via accent color. UI text simplified to 'Navigate to your project folder and press Open', and current directory path displayed in footer.

3b94768dd3dc50c99953bed604d70a84131451ef.title: Refine base2 plan mode prompt to encourage multi-round clarifying
3b94768dd3dc50c99953bed604d70a84131451ef.summary: Updated `.agents/base2/base2.ts` plan mode instructions to explicitly permit multiple rounds of clarifying questions. The prompt now guides the agent to continue questioning until the request is fully understood, while avoiding trivial or easily changeable details. This internal change affects the `buildPlanOnlyInstructionsPrompt` function and related documentation within the base2 agent configuration.

bf65fbf5987a232e17b137c759b2fa05896af174.title: CLI input history re-reads disk before save
bf65fbf5987a232e17b137c759b2fa05896af174.summary: Input history now re-reads from disk before appending new entries in `use-input-history.ts`. This prevents overwriting history added by other concurrent terminal sessions. The change also ensures bash commands starting with `!` are saved to history in `router.ts`.

382195146821bd80e40fed2ffba7ba5efcdbe4f4.title: Project picker layout adapts to short terminals
382195146821bd80e40fed2ffba7ba5efcdbe4f4.summary: Refactored `project-picker-screen.tsx` to use dynamic height allocation instead of fixed thresholds, ensuring the file picker renders in short terminals. Added `COMPACT_MODE_THRESHOLD` (12 rows) to strip padding/margins and hide decorative elements (logo, help text) when space is constrained. Essential elements (input, file list, bottom bar) now receive priority over optional recents and branding. Updated input placeholder to "Select project directory...".

ba20001626733deae4168b84a899b43f5f31c832.text: Pressing Ctrl+C now closes the command-line tool cleanly. The terminal screen resets properly instead of looking broken.

a995965967df8fdbc1506425313f7cad072c0489.text: The list of folders is now easier to read, with better contrast and alphabetical sorting. Project folders are highlighted, and instructions are simplified.

bf65fbf5987a232e17b137c759b2fa05896af174.text: The app now checks for new history entries before saving its own, so commands from other open windows are not lost. It also saves commands starting with an exclamation mark.

382195146821bd80e40fed2ffba7ba5efcdbe4f4.text: The project selection screen now adjusts its layout when your terminal window is small. It hides extra decorations to ensure the file list and input field remain visible and usable.

55a194bea95574fd13e94cf52d4cfd2e7734bfab.text: When the assistant fails, it now saves the full conversation history and its core instructions for support to review. This internal change helps the team diagnose and fix errors faster.

864a1f1e6c44b1841f5ee725c4252b55192780fe.text: The app now stops waiting for background data updates after one second when closing. This prevents the program from hanging if the update service is slow.

d9e302b2e94dc95b45778526b88bc592e38cf8ca.text: The system now records the full conversation when an error occurs. This helps the support team understand exactly what went wrong. You may see faster fixes for rare problems.

201d60896c1ae47d039c0ec9a98b52155ebfeb37.text: Pressing the Tab key now switches modes if the file list does not appear. This fixes a glitch where the key stopped working in that specific case.

3b94768dd3dc50c99953bed604d70a84131451ef.text: The assistant now asks follow-up questions until it fully understands your request, rather than guessing on small details. This means you get a more accurate plan with less need to correct mistakes later.

9b898076ad7ce25534618bfa7a50f6c6827aa4f8.text: The assistant no longer hides previous messages when an error occurs. This keeps the conversation visible for troubleshooting.

b64dce68089ffb73a86ae204cfd483769030a1cf.title: CLI button click fix
b64dce68089ffb73a86ae204cfd483769030a1cf.summary: Updated `cli/src/components/button.tsx` to require both mouse down and mouse up events for click triggers. Added `useRef` to track mouse down state, preventing accidental clicks from hover events in some terminals. `handleMouseUp` fires `onClick` only if `mouseDownRef.current` is true, resetting on `handleMouseOut`.

a82662b13f70356e4dc381ad40478ee90f5e24d6.title: Pin signal-exit to v3.0.7
a82662b13f70356e4dc381ad40478ee90f5e24d6.summary: Added `signal-exit: 3.0.7` to `package.json` overrides. Resolves Jest transform cache errors caused by `signal-exit` v4 incompatibility. Scope limited to dependency resolution configuration.

1c0912ab07069d32ef9bf83302fa44ccf7a5249c.title: CLI build invokes SDK build directly
1c0912ab07069d32ef9bf83302fa44ccf7a5249c.summary: CLI binary build script now invokes `bun run --cwd ../sdk build` directly instead of calling the removed `build:sdk` wrapper script. This removes an indirection layer in the build pipeline. Changes affect `cli/package.json` and `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts`. The SDK build step remains a prerequisite for CLI compilation.

41659feb0430aa21b917e73a8e9b2bedcfbd5c50.title: CLI dev script adds cwd flag
41659feb0430aa21b917e73a8e9b2bedcfbd5c50.summary: Updated `dev` script in `cli/package.json` to pass `--cwd ..` to `bun run src/index.tsx`. Removed unused `start` script. Ensures local development runs from repository root context.

98e09dcabaff3ff8b117fa4969eb003807818ee7.title: CLI exit handler now cleans up TUI renderer before process.exit
98e09dcabaff3ff8b117fa4969eb003807818ee7.summary: Added `cleanupRenderer` utility to explicitly destroy the TUI renderer before calling `process.exit(0)` in the CLI exit handler. This prevents garbled terminal output by ensuring mouse tracking, focus reporting, and raw mode are reset. The renderer is registered via `registerRendererForCleanup` in `index.tsx` and cleaned up in `use-exit-handler.ts`.

a0f70e367714a7ca875128b946f1ee81ebd9b619.title: CI Bun setup uses .bun-version file
a0f70e367714a7ca875128b946f1ee81ebd9b619.summary: CI setup action replaces hardcoded bun-version input with bun-version-file pointing to .bun-version. oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 now reads the version from the file instead of a literal string. Scope limited to .github/actions/setup-project/action.yml and .github/knowledge.md. Follow-up requires ensuring .bun-version exists and matches Dockerfile version for local act runs.

dc4b67202e6431c98f0a1e0123e042e85a5ca1e6.title: Drop esbuild dep, transpile agents via Bun.build only
dc4b67202e6431c98f0a1e0123e042e85a5ca1e6.summary: Removed esbuild from sdk/package.json dependencies. sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts transpileAgent now relies solely on Bun.build, dropping esbuild dynamic import and fallback logic. web/next.config.mjs removes esbuild from serverExternalPackages.

25db595fe9859abdb39da090e44b7e4cbe428e53.title: Fix thinking block collapse state in CLI
25db595fe9859abdb39da090e44b7e4cbe428e53.summary: Thinking blocks in the CLI now use stable `thinkingId` identifiers instead of index-based keys for collapse/expand state. `block-operations.ts` generates unique IDs via `generateThinkingId()`, and `ThinkingBlock` reads `thinkingId` from props rather than constructing it from `keyPrefix` and `startIndex`. `chat.tsx` updates collapse toggles to match by `thinkingId` directly. `thinking.tsx` simplifies the collapsed/expanded rendering logic by removing redundant left-border boxes and adjusting padding.

33f4f1ee757625a0beb228f8c27292ecb28a5bad.title: PostgreSQL transient errors now retry with jittered backoff
33f4f1ee757625a0beb228f8c27292ecb28a5bad.summary: Database transactions retry on PostgreSQL transient failures (classes 08, 40, 53, 57) using expanded logic in packages/internal/src/db/transaction.ts. withRetry in common/src/util/promise.ts adds ±20% jitter to exponential backoff to prevent thundering herd. Billing balance-calculator.ts extracts pgCode, pgConstraint, and related fields into structured logs for debugging.

7d12c4b1de13b91b3d3233fbad77912dd0adf21e.title: Bump deps, isolate test env helpers, fix ParamsOfUnion type
7d12c4b1de13b91b3d3233fbad77912dd0adf21e.summary: Dependency versions updated in `cli/package.json` and `common/package.json` (e.g., `@tanstack/react-query` to ^5.90.12, `posthog-node` to ^5.8.0, `zod` to ^4.2.1). Test environment helpers (`createTestCliEnv`, `createTestBaseEnv`) moved from production modules to dedicated testing files (`cli/src/testing/env.ts`, `common/src/testing-env-process.ts`) to prevent test logic leakage. `ParamsOfUnion` in `cli/src/types/function-params.ts` updated to handle non-union types correctly via `IsUnion` check. Bun test preload includes `./test/setup-bigquery-mocks.ts`.

dc4b67202e6431c98f0a1e0123e042e85a5ca1e6.text: The app now uses a single, built-in tool to prepare its features, replacing an older external helper. This internal cleanup simplifies the software structure without changing how the app looks or feels for you.

33f4f1ee757625a0beb228f8c27292ecb28a5bad.text: The system now waits briefly and retries automatically if the database has a temporary problem. This reduces errors during busy times.

a82662b13f70356e4dc381ad40478ee90f5e24d6.text: A small internal update fixes a tool error that could stop the software from working properly. You do not need to do anything.

98e09dcabaff3ff8b117fa4969eb003807818ee7.text: The app now resets your terminal settings before closing. This prevents messy or garbled text from appearing after you exit.

b64dce68089ffb73a86ae204cfd483769030a1cf.text: The app now needs both a press and a release to register a button click. This stops accidental clicks when your cursor just hovers over a button.

25db595fe9859abdb39da090e44b7e4cbe428e53.text: Fixed a bug where the assistant's thought process sections might collapse or expand incorrectly. The display is now more stable and easier to read.

41659feb0430aa21b917e73a8e9b2bedcfbd5c50.text: The tool now starts from the main folder. This helps it find files correctly during internal testing. Users will not notice any change.

a0f70e367714a7ca875128b946f1ee81ebd9b619.text: The automatic setup process now checks a shared file for its tool version instead of using a fixed number. This is an internal change that helps keep all environments aligned, with no visible difference for users.

1c0912ab07069d32ef9bf83302fa44ccf7a5249c.text: The program now talks directly to the part that creates its features, skipping an extra step. This internal cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

df5708ec8d1cbeac271e912f58fd6cdda28f39ed.title: Clarify comment on production flag in CLI binary build
df5708ec8d1cbeac271e912f58fd6cdda28f39ed.summary: Moved the explanatory comment for the `--production` flag in `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts` to directly follow the flag itself, rather than the preceding `--compile` flag. This ensures the rationale—that the production build is required to use the production JSX runtime and avoid `jsxDEV` crashes—is correctly associated with the specific flag responsible for that behavior. The change is limited to comment placement in the CLI binary build script.

fc563134985b83d2c57b79b6e6b796423eb84d9b.title: CLI build script uses production mode
fc563134985b83d2c57b79b6e6b796423eb84d9b.summary: The CLI binary build script in cli/scripts/build-binary.ts now passes --production to bun build. This ensures the compiled binary excludes development-only code and optimizations. Scope limited to CLI packaging.

e5780608c317ba6bbd3a18c5c5d966d7a3896280.title: Document --compile flag purpose in CLI binary build
e5780608c317ba6bbd3a18c5c5d966d7a3896280.summary: Added comment to `--compile` flag in `cli/scripts/build-binary.ts`. Explains flag ensures compiled binaries use production JSX runtime to avoid `jsxDEV` crashes. Change affects CLI build script only. No functional code changes.

c14d06271ac1eacec8974bb924022e49bcc270f0.title: main-prompt test fix
c14d06271ac1eacec8974bb924022e49bcc270f0.summary: Updated `main-prompt.test.ts` to assert that `spawnableAgents` excludes other local agents when a specific `agentId` is provided. The test now verifies that `spawnableAgents` remains empty unless explicitly defined in the agent's template, preventing auto-addition of all available agents.

544c715d25319753d2828fb288fc474c531dd947.title: Show git root notice in top banner
544c715d25319753d2828fb288fc474c531dd947.summary: Added `gitRoot` type to `TopBannerType` and implemented a new top banner in `top-banner.tsx` that appears when the current working directory differs from the git root. The banner provides a `Switch to git root` action via `TerminalLink`. `init-app.ts` updated to set `projectRoot` to `baseCwd` instead of defaulting to `findGitRoot`, allowing the new logic to correctly detect subdirectory starts.

9de3cfd7328a6436630d0b2e8758dd87b11ff6fc.title: Fix editor-best-of-n e2e test assertion
9de3cfd7328a6436630d0b2e8758dd87b11ff6fc.summary: Updated `editor-best-of-n.e2e.test.ts` to check both `outputStr` and `sessionState` for implementation evidence. Expanded `relevantTerms` to include `propose_str_replace`, `propose_write_file`, and generic keywords like `function` and `return`. This accommodates varying agent output structures in the e2e environment.

32ed3cd539855c9528c7f60d1257416f86260b78.title: Remove demo gif from README
32ed3cd539855c9528c7f60d1257416f86260b78.summary: Deleted `assets/demo.gif` and its reference in `README.md`. Reduces repository size by removing unused binary asset. Scope: root README and assets directory.

eaab1c00c97488d39d1212c7b8b7036f4ca9088b.title: CLI project picker logic fix
eaab1c00c97488d39d1212c7b8b7036f4ca9088b.summary: New `shouldShowProjectPicker` helper in `cli/src/utils/project-picker.ts` replaces ad-hoc checks in `cli/src/index.tsx`. Previous logic incorrectly triggered the picker for valid non-git project directories. The new implementation uses `path.relative` to strictly limit the picker to the home directory or its ancestors. Covers CLI entry point and utilities.

ebd5edbbb74dae39f5c9a1fc1a855d946486a289.title: Add AI SDK schema validation to convertCbToModelMessages
ebd5edbbb74dae39f5c9a1fc1a855d946486a289.summary: Added strict validation of aggregated messages against `modelMessageSchema` from the `ai` package in `convertCbToModelMessages`. This change introduces a loop that calls `safeParse` on each message, throwing a descriptive error if validation fails, and optionally logs the failure details via a new `logger` parameter. The update affects `common/src/util/messages.ts`, ensuring malformed message structures are caught early before reaching the provider.

80432f1b4f1ab10ce0575cbd9131422c6eb8c518.title: Restrict spawnable agents when agentId provided
80432f1b4f1ab10ce0575cbd9131422c6eb8c518.summary: The agent runtime now conditionally merges available agents into spawnable subagents. If an `agentId` is present, the system strictly uses `mainAgentTemplate.spawnableAgents`, bypassing the union with `availableAgents`. This prevents unintended agent spawning when a specific agent is targeted. The change applies to `packages/agent-runtime/src/main-prompt.ts`.

32ed3cd539855c9528c7f60d1257416f86260b78.text: The product team removed an unused animation from the software's online home. This small cleanup makes the download faster and saves space. You will see no change in how the product works.

80432f1b4f1ab10ce0575cbd9131422c6eb8c518.text: When you ask for a specific helper, the system now only allows that helper's approved partners to join. This stops random helpers from appearing when you want a focused task.

eaab1c00c97488d39d1212c7b8b7036f4ca9088b.text: The tool now shows the project selection menu only in the correct locations, preventing it from appearing unexpectedly in valid folders.

ebd5edbbb74dae39f5c9a1fc1a855d946486a289.text: The system now checks messages for errors before sending them to the assistant. This helps catch problems early, making the experience more reliable.

544c715d25319753d2828fb288fc474c531dd947.text: The tool now shows a notice if you start it in a subfolder of your project. It offers a button to switch to the main project folder.

df5708ec8d1cbeac271e912f58fd6cdda28f39ed.text: A small internal cleanup moved a note to the correct spot in the setup instructions. This does not change how the product works or looks for you.

c14d06271ac1eacec8974bb924022e49bcc270f0.text: A small internal fix ensures the assistant only works with the specific agent you choose, rather than automatically adding others. This prevents unexpected behavior when using different helpers.

fc563134985b83d2c57b79b6e6b796423eb84d9b.text: The program now skips extra test parts when it gets packaged. This makes the final download smaller and cleaner for you.

e5780608c317ba6bbd3a18c5c5d966d7a3896280.text: The team added a note to the internal instructions used to create the app's downloadable files. This helps ensure the app doesn't crash when people use it.

9de3cfd7328a6436630d0b2e8758dd87b11ff6fc.text: A small internal update makes the assistant's checks more flexible. This helps the product work smoothly even when the assistant answers in slightly different ways.

391be7121819e81dbfd9849d29a1128d6b82457d.title: CI Bun version bump to 1.3.5
391be7121819e81dbfd9849d29a1128d6b82457d.summary: Bun version updated from 1.3.0 to 1.3.5 in CI workflows. Added .bun-version file with 1.3.5. Applies to ci.yml, evals.yml, nightly-agents-e2e.yml, and nightly-evals.yml.

680bafa4a2ca4b259404e954b3db541a9e693c70.title: Document --agent override behavior
680bafa4a2ca4b259404e954b3db541a9e693c70.summary: Clarified that `--agent` skips loading local `.agents` overrides to prevent unintended agent substitution. Updated `README.md`, `cli/src/index.tsx` help text, and `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/README.md` to reflect this behavior and correct testing instructions. Developers must now run `codebuff` without `--agent` to test local agent definitions.

c7cc70ffc827b782a8b9b50c068e4606fedefcee.title: Base2 agent prompt: forbid spawning context-pruner
c7cc70ffc827b782a8b9b50c068e4606fedefcee.summary: Added explicit instruction to base2 agent prompt in .agents/base2/base2.ts to never spawn the context-pruner agent. Prevents redundant agent spawning since context pruning runs automatically. Internal prompt constraint only.

f943f8dcdcacf53ade9e9c59f5cc2f251f26a003.title: CLI skips agent registry init on --agent flag
f943f8dcdcacf53ade9e9c59f5cc2f251f26a003.summary: cli/src/index.tsx conditionally skips initializeAgentRegistry() when --agent flag provides non-empty value, unless publish command detected. Reduces startup overhead for explicit agent overrides. Scope limited to CLI entrypoint.

33e33c5df485c4ee34c0a945a7bcbd263757e64f.title: Bun upgraded to 1.3.5
33e33c5df485c4ee34c0a945a7bcbd263757e64f.summary: Workspace-wide Bun version bumped from 1.3.0 to 1.3.5 across all package.json engines, devDependencies, and packageManager fields. @opentui/core and @opentui/react in cli/package.json also updated to ^0.1.63. This aligns the toolchain with the latest stable Bun release.

7bee7825c743832ab15be6d7fe2a74efd27b7955.title: Make CLI usage banner clickable
7bee7825c743832ab15be6d7fe2a74efd27b7955.summary: Usage banner text is now a clickable Button opening WEBSITE_URL + '/usage' via open(). BottomBanner layout refactored to render close button outside text/children block, allowing custom children to fill space. generateUsageBannerText appends '. See more' to indicate interactivity. Scope: cli/src/components/bottom-banner.tsx, cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx, cli/src/utils/usage-banner-state.ts.

b45bf79e8b2ada08ccfad5873fbefd8e8fb9231e.title: Update macOS runner labels in release workflows
b45bf79e8b2ada08ccfad5873fbefd8e8fb9231e.summary: Replaces macos-13 with macos-15-intel in CLI and npm app release build workflows. Ensures darwin-x64 binaries compile on current supported macOS runners. Affects .github/workflows/cli-release-build.yml and .github/workflows/npm-app-release-build.yml.

8edcd033320d505662b983af3d38e3114fe9ff4a.title: Consolidate error utilities and reduce verbose API error logs
8edcd033320d505662b983af3d38e3114fe9ff4a.summary: The CLI imports getErrorObject from @codebuff/common/util/error, deleting cli/src/utils/error.ts. getErrorObject now accepts includeRawError option and extracts status/code fields. Agent runtime simplifies APICallError messages to just error.message, removing URL, headers, and body dumps. OpenRouter stream handlers use structured logging with includeRawError: true.

025f9ea3de3e383d108eb9fee90cfcc744d54b60.title: Nightly e2e workflow added, CI skips .agents live tests
025f9ea3de3e383d108eb9fee90cfcc744d54b60.summary: Added nightly-agents-e2e.yml to run .agents e2e tests daily at 12:00 UTC. CI workflow updated to skip .agents integration tests, requiring local execution via bun run test:e2e. sdk/e2e/utils/get-api-key.ts modified to require RUN_CODEBUFF_E2E=true for local live API runs unless running in CI. sdk/test/setup-env.ts removed default CODEBUFF_API_KEY to enforce explicit configuration.

53e16e0e54d46b627ddaefc2c06fc7fa3831b2cd.title: Fix local agent loading in compiled binaries
53e16e0e54d46b627ddaefc2c06fc7fa3831b2cd.summary: Local TypeScript agents now load correctly in compiled binaries where esbuild is unavailable. The `transpileAgent` function in `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts` adds a fallback to `Bun.build` if esbuild import fails or throws. This ensures agents defined in local files are transpiled and executed even when the standard Node.js build tools are missing from the runtime environment.

8edcd033320d505662b983af3d38e3114fe9ff4a.text: The program now records fewer unnecessary details when problems happen, making error messages clearer and logs shorter. This internal cleanup helps the system run more smoothly without changing how you use it.

391be7121819e81dbfd9849d29a1128d6b82457d.text: We updated the tools that run our automated tests to match a newer standard. This small internal change helps us catch bugs sooner and keeps the product stable for you.

c7cc70ffc827b782a8b9b50c068e4606fedefcee.text: The assistant now avoids creating duplicate tasks for trimming conversation history. This keeps things running smoothly behind the scenes.

33e33c5df485c4ee34c0a945a7bcbd263757e64f.text: The tool that runs the assistant's background processes was updated to its newest stable version. This change is internal and keeps the system current.

680bafa4a2ca4b259404e954b3db541a9e693c70.text: The guide now explains that using a specific setting prevents the assistant from loading your custom instructions. This avoids unexpected changes to how the assistant behaves.

f943f8dcdcacf53ade9e9c59f5cc2f251f26a003.text: The app now starts faster when you pick a specific assistant, because it skips loading the full list of options. This small speed-up only affects how quickly the program opens.

53e16e0e54d46b627ddaefc2c06fc7fa3831b2cd.text: The app now loads custom assistant rules from local files even if the usual setup tools are missing. This fixes a bug where some local rules failed to apply, ensuring the assistant follows your instructions correctly.

025f9ea3de3e383d108eb9fee90cfcc744d54b60.text: Automated checks for the assistant now run on a fixed nightly schedule instead of every time code changes. This keeps the main testing process faster while still verifying the assistant works correctly each day.

7bee7825c743832ab15be6d7fe2a74efd27b7955.text: The usage information shown at the bottom of the command line is now a clickable link. Clicking it opens the detailed usage page in your web browser.

b45bf79e8b2ada08ccfad5873fbefd8e8fb9231e.text: The team updated the computer system used to build the app. This change helps keep the software working correctly on current Mac computers.

bac6b6cb5f0591c3f52b67e53d4da3102737e420.title: Set absWorkingDir in esbuild to fix test isolation
bac6b6cb5f0591c3f52b67e53d4da3102737e420.summary: Added `absWorkingDir: process.cwd()` to the esbuild configuration in `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts`. This forces esbuild to resolve paths relative to the current working directory, preventing test isolation issues caused by ambient directory state. The change ensures consistent transpilation behavior for agent loading within the SDK.

811a0abfc1ec6c13cd8ef76013bd7a6928c12e45.title: e2e test files converted to ES modules
811a0abfc1ec6c13cd8ef76013bd7a6928c12e45.summary: Added `export {}` to `store-hydration.spec.ts` and `store-ssr.spec.ts` in `web/src/__tests__/e2e/`. This marks the files as ES modules, resolving TypeScript compatibility issues with global scope detection. Scope limited to web e2e test infrastructure.

19b5b7a6455bfa5120d548c053f552aa96d89b6a.title: Fix TypeScript compatibility in CLI init and agent schema handling
19b5b7a6455bfa5120d548c053f552aa96d89b6a.summary: Added `@ts-expect-error` comments to suppress TypeScript errors for Bun-specific `with { type: 'text' }` import attributes in `cli/src/commands/init.ts`. This resolves compatibility issues where the standard TypeScript compiler rejects Bun's text import syntax. Scope limited to CLI init command and agent runtime schema tests.

6e4aa872d7d57efc68a738139497c0b8fc46f17a.title: CI: Upgrade actions to v4 and update runner targets
6e4aa872d7d57efc68a738139497c0b8fc46f17a.summary: GitHub Actions `actions/checkout` and `actions/cache` upgraded from v3 to v4 across CI, evals, and nightly workflows. The `cli-release-build` workflow now targets `macos-13` instead of `macos-15-intel` for Darwin x64 builds. Internal knowledge base updated to reflect Bun v1.3.0 and new action versions.

9f074c8f750b353560565210fb8562a773951aa1.title: web: exclude Bun-only tests from Jest
9f074c8f750b353560565210fb8562a773951aa1.summary: Added playwright-runner.test.ts and ban-conditions.test.ts to testPathIgnorePatterns in web/jest.config.cjs. These tests rely on Bun-specific features and fail in the Jest environment. Scope limited to web package configuration.

2ca472a0cd39b8081ab62966d071c943c469ea14.title: SDK: Dynamic esbuild import for compiled binaries
2ca472a0cd39b8081ab62966d071c943c469ea14.summary: SDK agent loader now dynamically imports `esbuild` inside `transpileAgent` to support compiled binary environments. Static imports caused failures when `esbuild` was unavailable in bundled executables. The change is isolated to `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts`. If `esbuild` fails to load, local TypeScript agents are skipped with a verbose warning, while pre-bundled agents continue to function.

d785ad2d1cc547704386b254e06d567c35ad9757.title: Add /help command and project picker screen
d785ad2d1cc547704386b254e06d567c35ad9757.summary: Added `/help` slash command and new `ProjectPickerScreen` component to CLI. Refactored banner system, replacing `AnnouncementBanner` with modular `TopBanner` and `BottomBanner` components. Updated `App` to conditionally render project picker when outside project root or at home directory. Core logic in `cli/src/app.tsx`, `cli/src/commands/help.ts`, and `cli/src/components/project-picker-screen.tsx`.

057da0ff3ce9dd133cdf56c49d9ed0db162833ab.title: Report purchased credit usage to Stripe metering
057da0ff3ce9dd133cdf56c49d9ed0db162833ab.summary: Added stripe-metering.ts to report purchased credit consumption to Stripe billing meter events. consumeCredits and consumeCreditsAndAddAgentStep now trigger reporting after successful transactions. User contract adds stripe_customer_id column; API handlers propagate it to credit consumption. Metering skipped in CI/test or when Stripe key missing; uses idempotency keys for message-based events.

46b77ba9352d95676ad63add9be1a82e9098ebbd.title: Add .agents/types scaffolding and Zod schema error handling
46b77ba9352d95676ad63add9be1a82e9098ebbd.summary: CLI init command now scaffolds .agents/types directory with agent-definition, tools, and util-types files. Agent runtime adds ensureJsonSchemaCompatible helper to catch Zod-to-JSON-Schema conversion failures, falling back to passthrough objects. Scope covers cli/src/commands/init.ts and packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts plus templates/prompts.ts. Schema errors in lookup-agent-info.ts return { type: 'object', description: 'Schema unavailable' } instead of throwing.

1ac0923d47a048c8e0030e8f5cb25a901b2e9fb7.title: Cache Stripe loader, typed test fixtures, Playwright output dirs
1ac0923d47a048c8e0030e8f5cb25a901b2e9fb7.summary: Billing setup page hoists loadStripe to module scope for cached promise reuse. Test agent runtime fixture getUserInfoFromApiKey now generic over UserColumn fields, filtering response. Playwright config adds outputDir and reporter outputFolder paths. Comments document inline require rationale in clipboard, local-agent-registry, model-utils.

811a0abfc1ec6c13cd8ef76013bd7a6928c12e45.text: A small internal update fixes a hidden glitch in the background checks that test the app. Users will not notice any change in how the product works.

057da0ff3ce9dd133cdf56c49d9ed0db162833ab.text: The system now automatically records how many credits you use for billing purposes. This ensures your account charges match your actual usage without any extra steps from you.

2ca472a0cd39b8081ab62966d071c943c469ea14.text: The app now loads its translation tool only when needed, fixing a startup error in certain versions. If this tool fails, custom scripts are skipped, but standard features still work.

46b77ba9352d95676ad63add9be1a82e9098ebbd.text: The setup tool now creates a standard folder for assistant instructions. If the assistant encounters a confusing instruction format, it skips that specific rule instead of stopping the entire process.

19b5b7a6455bfa5120d548c053f552aa96d89b6a.text: Fixed a small internal issue that could stop the setup tool from working. This keeps the product running smoothly.

6e4aa872d7d57efc68a738139497c0b8fc46f17a.text: The system that builds and tests the software switched to newer, more stable tools and a different computer for creating the Mac version. This change is internal and should not affect how you use the product.

d785ad2d1cc547704386b254e06d567c35ad9757.text: You can now type /help to see available commands. The app will also show a list of your projects to choose from when you start it in a folder without a project.

9f074c8f750b353560565210fb8562a773951aa1.text: A small internal fix stops certain tests from running in the wrong place, preventing unnecessary errors during development.

bac6b6cb5f0591c3f52b67e53d4da3102737e420.text: Fixed a small internal issue to make sure the assistant loads correctly every time, preventing random errors.

09c2ec040fafdb90a175f154097895e080e0dfce.title: Expand Stripe charge object in dispute threshold check
09c2ec040fafdb90a175f154097895e080e0dfce.summary: Added expand: ['data.charge'] to stripeServer.disputes.list() in web/src/lib/ban-conditions.ts. This ensures the charge object is fully populated, fixing a bug where dispute counting failed due to missing charge data. Updated support email references in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts and packages/internal/src/loops/client.ts to use env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL or simplified copy.

699c6198a75338e02e129ee74cb2ca8f0fedbd4e.title: Max mode editor-multi-prompt agent full task instruction
699c6198a75338e02e129ee74cb2ca8f0fedbd4e.summary: Removed redundant <think> tag instruction from .agents/base2/base2.ts. Updated editor-multi-prompt agent instruction to require full task implementation instead of single steps. Applies to Max mode only.

51ae4b3182a0298139656c9319fb9d85c6072c90.title: Make ban-conditions tests Jest-compatible
51ae4b3182a0298139656c9319fb9d85c6072c90.summary: Migrated `web/src/lib/__tests__/ban-conditions.test.ts` from Bun to Jest. Replaced `bun:test` imports with `@jest/globals`, converted `mock` to `jest.fn`, and updated `mock.module` calls to `jest.mock`. Scope limited to web test suite; no production code or user-facing behavior changed.

e392b80b1bcfa1947ffd24f5624bb924fa0770af.title: agent-tree requires versioned references
e392b80b1bcfa1947ffd24f5624bb924fa0770af.summary: agent-tree.ts enforces versioned agent references. parseAgentId now throws on non-publisher/agentId@version formats, removing defaultPublisher fallbacks. ParsedAgentId.version and AgentTreeNode.version change from string | null to string. buildTreeNodeRecursive signature drops defaultPublisher parameter. generateMermaidDiagram always renders version labels.

7f1db058a8bc17e8cad49d2b7ea6e1c0a8dc9e13.title: Add banned column to user table
7f1db058a8bc17e8cad49d2b7ea6e1c0a8dc9e13.summary: New migration 0032 adds `banned` boolean column to `user` table, defaulting to false. Updates `User` type and `userColumns` in `common/src/types/contracts/database.ts` to include the new field. Propagates `banned: false` to test fixtures in `common/src/testing/fixtures/agent-runtime.ts` and `evals/impl/agent-runtime.ts`.

017ae9888f1491d0d8f2eae5c59d16f2688cf46b.title: SDK getUserInfoFromApiKey requests only needed fields
017ae9888f1491d0d8f2eae5c59d16f2688cf46b.summary: SDK `getUserInfoFromApiKey` in `sdk/src/impl/database.ts` now requests only missing fields from `/api/v1/me` instead of all `userColumns`. Cache logic updated to merge partial responses, preventing overwrites with incomplete data. This reduces payload size and network overhead for user info retrieval.

203ba11fc2d9ef5687ad7f61b28c26d22193f472.title: Add store-lite agents cache for SEO and prefetch
203ba11fc2d9ef5687ad7f61b28c26d22193f472.summary: Introduces `getCachedAgentsLite` and `buildAgentsDataLite` to serve a reduced agents dataset. This replaces the full `getCachedAgents` in `healthz`, `sitemap`, and store metadata generation to improve performance. The store client now uses `router.prefetch` on hover/focus/touch to optimize agent detail page navigation.

9a06ffce0d6666c7b244ebee6f272b9f45a70bf8.title: Auto-ban system for excessive Stripe disputes
9a06ffce0d6666c7b244ebee6f272b9f45a70bf8.summary: Added automated user banning triggered by Stripe `charge.dispute.created` webhooks. Users exceeding 5 disputes within 14 days are banned via `evaluateBanConditions` in `web/src/lib/ban-conditions.ts`. Banned users receive a 403 `account_suspended` error in chat completions instead of a 503 timeout, and get a resolution-focused email via `sendDisputeNotificationEmail` in `packages/internal/src/loops/client.ts`. Thresholds are configurable constants in `ban-conditions.ts`.

05491fbab4eac3f56281ee813f35728748bb9eee.title: Add agent dependency tree visualization to store pages
05491fbab4eac3f56281ee813f35728748bb9eee.summary: New API route `/api/agents/[publisherId]/[agentId]/[version]/dependencies` and component `AgentDependencyTree` visualize subagent relationships. Uses batching lookup in `_get.ts` to solve N+1 queries, reducing DB hits to max depth. Integrates into `page.tsx` definition section when `spawnableAgents` exist. Includes Mermaid diagram generation with error boundary fallback.

7f1db058a8bc17e8cad49d2b7ea6e1c0a8dc9e13.text: The system added a hidden setting to track whether a user is blocked. This change is internal and does not affect normal usage.

017ae9888f1491d0d8f2eae5c59d16f2688cf46b.text: The app now asks for only the information it needs, not everything. This makes loading your profile data faster and lighter.

51ae4b3182a0298139656c9319fb9d85c6072c90.text: The company updated internal checks to use a new standard tool. This change does not affect how the product works for users.

699c6198a75338e02e129ee74cb2ca8f0fedbd4e.text: The assistant now handles complete tasks instead of single steps. This change applies only to Max mode.

7d12c4b1de13b91b3d3233fbad77912dd0adf21e.text: The software received routine maintenance to improve stability and keep its tools up to date. Users will not see any visible changes, but the application may run more reliably.

203ba11fc2d9ef5687ad7f61b28c26d22193f472.text: The site loads a smaller set of information when checking its status or preparing pages, which helps it run faster. Also, when you hover over or tap a link to an agent's page, the site starts loading that page in the background so it opens more quickly for you.

e392b80b1bcfa1947ffd24f5624bb924fa0770af.text: The system now requires every agent to have a specific version label. This ensures each agent is correctly identified and tracked.

9a06ffce0d6666c7b244ebee6f272b9f45a70bf8.text: The system now automatically suspends accounts with too many payment disputes. Affected users receive a suspension notice by email instead of a connection error.

05491fbab4eac3f56281ee813f35728748bb9eee.text: The store now shows a simple map of which assistants work together. This makes it easier to see how different helpers connect without reading technical details.

09c2ec040fafdb90a175f154097895e080e0dfce.text: A small internal fix ensures the system correctly counts payment disputes. This keeps the service running smoothly for you.

ae7c26c81519220602e7916920af8d6f73cf5380.title: Remove group headers from doc sidebar
ae7c26c81519220602e7916920af8d6f73cf5380.summary: Refactor in `web/src/components/docs/doc-sidebar.tsx` removes `sectionGroups` and associated icons (`Code`, `GraduationCap`, `Library`). The sidebar now renders a flat list of `sections` directly, eliminating the Learn/Build/Reference grouping. This simplifies the component structure and reduces vertical spacing.

55396b181ba377b0e5aedbf9118569029f6a5005.title: Mermaid diagram hydration mismatch fix
55396b181ba377b0e5aedbf9118569029f6a5005.summary: Replaced module-level counter with React's useId hook for generating Mermaid diagram IDs. Fixes hydration mismatches during SSR caused by non-deterministic ID generation. Affects web/src/components/docs/mdx/mermaid-diagram.tsx. Colon characters in useId output sanitized to hyphens for valid DOM IDs.

a78e9fb85a9a938121845beefece882a3527f0fc.title: Fix MarkdownTable inline code handling
a78e9fb85a9a938121845beefece882a3527f0fc.summary: MarkdownTable now recursively extracts text from React children to support inline code in cells. Previous logic only handled string or flat array children, failing on nested elements. Change affects web/src/components/docs/mdx/markdown-table.tsx.

a4f80a52b115799c9bdc515677f0388daba736ae.title: Remove version-control.mdx from web content
a4f80a52b115799c9bdc515677f0388daba736ae.summary: Deleted web/src/content/tips/version-control.mdx. File provided documentation for undo, redo, and diff commands alongside git integration advice. No functional code changes; purely a documentation cleanup.

a55e9bb7be033f3dbd8868778cbb8a5209452404.title: Mobile docs section bar fully clickable
a55e9bb7be033f3dbd8868778cbb8a5209452404.summary: The mobile docs navigation bar in `web/src/app/docs/layout.tsx` now uses a full-width `<button>` instead of a small icon-only `Button` and a separate `SheetTrigger` header. Clicking anywhere on the sticky bottom bar now toggles the `Sheet` component. This change consolidates the trigger logic and improves touch accessibility.

42f6dc11aa645d63658468bd7d0059435d08ea90.title: Fix React 19 key prop warning in typescript-viewer
42f6dc11aa645d63658468bd7d0059435d08ea90.summary: Refactored token rendering in `typescript-viewer.tsx` to prevent React 19 key prop warnings. Explicitly extracts and discards `key` from `getLineProps` and `getTokenProps` return objects before spreading remaining props. This ensures React controls the key generation without conflicting with the library's provided keys. Scope limited to `web/src/components/agent/typescript-viewer.tsx`.

ec08abd50cf82fe06e8aeabcd2de8094f20be761.title: Make collapsed agent branch clickable in CLI
ec08abd50cf82fe06e8aeabcd2de8094f20be761.summary: Replaced `<box>` with `<Button>` in `cli/src/components/agent-branch-item.tsx`. This ensures the entire collapsed preview area is interactive, triggering `onToggle` when clicked. Scope limited to CLI agent branch rendering. The change relies on the existing `onToggle` prop to handle the expansion logic.

343f9ec46ee9509fb999c8e080c6148ed3a40493.title: Wrap what-models.mdx tables in MarkdownTable component
343f9ec46ee9509fb999c8e080c6148ed3a40493.summary: Tables in `web/src/content/advanced/what-models.mdx` wrapped in `<MarkdownTable>` component. Fixes rendering of markdown tables in MDX. Scope: web docs only.

39f46e6a389c16d28b5dd59c2348268e2c67b99d.title: CLI: Truecolor detection for native terminal colors
39f46e6a389c16d28b5dd59c2348268e2c67b99d.summary: Added `supportsTruecolor` detection in `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts` to handle 256-color terminals like macOS Terminal.app. Logo colors and input cursors now fallback to ANSI names (`white`, `black`, `lime`) when hex rendering fails. `COLORTERM` environment variable added to `cli/src/types/env.ts` and `cli/src/utils/env.ts` to assist capability detection.

0c7192b7f8041d52d8d307934b0a35af8448933c.title: Reduce CLI thinking block width offsets
0c7192b7f8041d52d8d307934b0a35af8448933c.summary: Adjusted WIDTH_OFFSET and NESTED_WIDTH_OFFSET constants in cli/src/components/blocks/thinking-block.tsx to reduce horizontal padding for thinking blocks. Removed logic in cli/src/components/thinking.tsx that padded preview lines to a fixed count and eliminated the explicit '• Thinking' label box. Scope limited to CLI rendering components. Collapsed state now renders directly from truncated lines without fixed-height padding.

a55e9bb7be033f3dbd8868778cbb8a5209452404.text: Tapping anywhere on the bottom navigation bar now opens the menu.

343f9ec46ee9509fb999c8e080c6148ed3a40493.text: We fixed a small formatting error in the internal documentation so that comparison tables now display correctly.

ae7c26c81519220602e7916920af8d6f73cf5380.text: The documentation sidebar no longer groups links under headings like Learn or Build. It now shows a single, simple list of all sections.

55396b181ba377b0e5aedbf9118569029f6a5005.text: Fixed a rare glitch where diagrams might fail to load correctly on first page view. This ensures charts and flow diagrams appear reliably for all users.

39f46e6a389c16d28b5dd59c2348268e2c67b99d.text: The app now checks your screen's color capabilities to ensure the logo and cursor appear correctly. If your system cannot display complex colors, it automatically switches to standard colors instead.

a78e9fb85a9a938121845beefece882a3527f0fc.text: Tables in documentation now show special formatting for text snippets correctly. This internal fix ensures that code examples inside table cells appear as intended.

42f6dc11aa645d63658468bd7d0059435d08ea90.text: A small internal fix stopped a hidden warning from appearing when viewing code. This keeps the display running smoothly without changing how it looks.

a4f80a52b115799c9bdc515677f0388daba736ae.text: A guide about undoing changes was removed from the help pages. This does not affect how the product works or what you can do.

0c7192b7f8041d52d8d307934b0a35af8448933c.text: The 'thinking' section in the command line interface now uses less horizontal space and has a cleaner look. This small visual update makes the text easier to read without changing how the assistant works.

ec08abd50cf82fe06e8aeabcd2de8094f20be761.text: The entire collapsed agent branch area is now clickable. This makes it easier to expand or collapse the section by clicking anywhere on it, rather than just a small button.

e25bb873f43b98638d6adb5e98f9102c22186fa6.title: Remove top and bottom padding in expanded agent branch box
e25bb873f43b98638d6adb5e98f9102c22186fa6.summary: Removes vertical padding within the expanded agent branch box in the CLI. The `paddingBottom` property in `agent-branch-item.tsx` is unconditionally set to 0, and the `marginTop` for the button is reduced to 0. This tightens the layout of the expanded view.

d695bf8a37aa4c4c8b5c13d56b347d2d0288d39c.title: CLI: Replace hardcoded colors with theme tokens
d695bf8a37aa4c4c8b5c13d56b347d2d0288d39c.summary: Refactors message-block.tsx and diff-viewer.tsx to use theme.error and theme.muted instead of hardcoded 'red' and 'gray' strings. Removes color: 'grey' from reasoning blocks in block-operations.ts, simplifying isReasoningTextBlock to rely solely on textType === 'reasoning'. This centralizes styling logic within the theme system across CLI components.
