Scope: CLI chat components, hooks. Detail: Default collapse state changed to `true` for thinking blocks and agent lists, `false` for tool branches.

5dc3cb8f5d3c297141fdf29dc54d7b791705484c.title: base2 max mode uses sonnet selector
5dc3cb8f5d3c297141fdf29dc54d7b791705484c.summary: base2 max mode now uses sonnet selector for editor-best-of-n. Removed gpt-5 from base2-max. Covers .agents/base2/base2.ts and .agents/editor/best-of-n/editor-best-of-n.ts. Deleted best-of-n-selector-gpt-5.ts and unified handleSteps to use sonnet selector only.

02673a5a36c56079121349f82cf8ef8292adafdc.title: Add /feedback command and message feedback buttons to CLI
02673a5a36c56079121349f82cf8ef8292adafdc.summary: New /feedback slash command opens dedicated feedback input mode; each chat message now renders a feedback icon button. Feedback categories (good/bad/bug/other) with contextual placeholders and keyboard shortcuts (Escape cancel, Ctrl+C clear/cancel). Covers cli/src/components/feedback-*.tsx, chat.tsx, commands/router.ts, message-block.tsx. Feedback state isolated from main chat input; button hover triggers analytics event FEEDBACK_BUTTON_HOVERED.

94368ccf248874fa609a0c64672134d6f3eff6b2.title: Add --continue flag to restore last CLI chat state
94368ccf248874fa609a0c64672134d6f3eff6b2.summary: New --continue CLI flag restores previous conversation context. Mechanism: run-state-storage.ts persists RunState and ChatMessage[] to disk; index.tsx parses flag; use-send-message.ts loads most recent state on mount, collapsing subagents/tools. Scope: CLI only (app.tsx, chat.tsx, project-files.ts). Detail: getMostRecentChatDir sorts chat directories by mtime; missing state logs 'No previous chat state found to continue from' without error.

415d0e7edf82282fe445e5e53a4eb9b400c129f7.title: Add n parameter to agent runtime for multi-response generation
415d0e7edf82282fe445e5e53a4eb9b400c129f7.summary: Introduced `n` parameter in `PromptAiSdkFn` and `runAgentStep` to generate multiple responses. Refactored `editor-best-of-n` agents to use native `GENERATE_N` step type instead of spawning separate implementor agents. Updated `AgentStepContext` to return `nResponses` array. Affects `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, and `.agents/editor/best-of-n/`.

e7b7989e227570a82dcf04c0ade95f9dab958766.text: The assistant now records the instructions and settings used when it starts a background task. This helps the system track exactly what was asked of it, without changing how you use the product.

9aba6179f07afd42472ea2c8568b264599736692.text: The app now remembers which parts of the conversation are open or closed more reliably. This makes the chat view cleaner and less cluttered.

94368ccf248874fa609a0c64672134d6f3eff6b2.text: The command-line assistant now saves your conversation history. Starting it again with the new continue option picks up where you left off.

0f2eaf2c414270cbb8c83e61e6c9673383dc6aaf.text: You can now resume a specific past conversation by copying the exact command shown when you exit the app. If you do not specify one, it continues the most recent chat.

02673a5a36c56079121349f82cf8ef8292adafdc.text: You can now rate responses with buttons or type detailed feedback using a new command. This helps the team understand what works and what needs fixing.

b05e8030ada34f1adbf472cd03ba108d9b874cdc.text: A small internal update helps the assistant better understand editing instructions. No visible changes to the product.

af0040a76bf0356ba3df336d6da1b08dcb7752fb.text: The command-line tool now shows a message like 'Generating 3 implementations...' when it creates multiple options. This lets you see how many attempts are being made before the results appear.

950489aee91def0ee271e5f66bb1e15aa3b7b928.text: The team fixed a small internal issue with how the system identifies itself during automatic checks. This change does not affect how you use the product.

5dc3cb8f5d3c297141fdf29dc54d7b791705484c.text: The internal editor feature now uses a different AI model to help choose the best text suggestions. This change does not affect how you use the product.

0113870be5722e9f1d35500ebd97af8f509a77a6.title: Remove unused slash-commands utility
0113870be5722e9f1d35500ebd97af8f509a77a6.summary: Deleted `cli/src/utils/slash-commands.ts`. The `handleSlashCommands` function was unused in the current CLI architecture. This removes 133 lines of dead code related to local slash command interception (login, logout, exit).

2d00a2117b4ee87a0097aa2951aa14b5a9b28828.title: Researcher-docs prompt simplified
2d00a2117b4ee87a0097aa2951aa14b5a9b28828.summary: Simplified instructions for researcher-docs agent. Enforces single read_docs call and ultra-concise reporting. Removes loop instruction. Affects .agents/researcher/researcher-docs.ts.

cfc3307af15da7a1c4421c5079cbd303639faa77.title: Suggestion menu compact layout for wide terminals
cfc3307af15da7a1c4421c5079cbd303639faa77.summary: CLI suggestion menu switches to single-line layout when terminal width allows. Calculates max label/description lengths to determine fit, aligning descriptions with padding. Narrow terminals retain two-line layout with indented descriptions. Affects cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx only.

49aab02e193f67664600a729fa315939dfcc6e4f.title: Fix multiline input width calculation in CLI
49aab02e193f67664600a729fa315939dfcc6e4f.summary: Corrected width calculation for the CLI multiline input box by updating the dependency array in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx`. The `useEffect` hook now includes `scrollBoxRef.current` alongside `width` to ensure accurate column measurement when the scroll box dimensions change. This resolves a bug where the input box incorrectly calculated its width as 1.

3158a6f1ae2d7f078f8cf682a48a83f6c8cab8c2.title: CLI readdocs tool call UI
3158a6f1ae2d7f078f8cf682a48a83f6c8cab8c2.summary: Added cli/src/components/tools/read-docs.tsx for read_docs tool. Registers ReadDocsComponent in cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts. Renders compact bullet line showing libraryTitle and topic. No expand/collapse support.

12bd093e1968d959d33cc228ed5e84186813afd8.title: Remove parentheticals from slash command labels
12bd093e1968d959d33cc228ed5e84186813afd8.summary: Slash command labels in `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts` no longer show redundant parentheticals. `logout`, `exit`, `usage`, and `new` commands now display their primary names only, as aliases handle secondary terms. This simplifies the CLI menu UI while preserving functionality via existing aliases.

e8e8a05fcb281138c308840f70c28154e8cb3b42.title: Add decision-maker agent and base2-max-with-decision-maker
e8e8a05fcb281138c308840f70c28154e8cb3b42.summary: New `decision-maker` agent using `openai/gpt-5.1` added to resolve tricky implementation decisions. `createBase2` factory gains `withDecisionMaker` option, injecting the agent into the sub-agent list and prepending orchestration instructions to spawn it for key choices. A new `base2-max-with-decision-maker` orchestrator definition exposes this configuration. The `decision-maker` agent accepts a prompt and file paths, utilizing exploration and research tools to output a structured decision string.

bde1512b23a3e0d3f849e7f1ba386b32d193ec22.title: CLI bootstrap comment
bde1512b23a3e0d3f849e7f1ba386b32d193ec22.summary: Added '// Hi!' comment to cli/src/index.tsx in bootstrapCli function. Internal code annotation only. No functional changes.

2947b3cc64a7417da3728a98af647e7247ce4b66.title: Add providerOptions to agent definition for OpenRouter routing
2947b3cc64a7417da3728a98af647e7247ce4b66.summary: Agent definitions now support `providerOptions` to control OpenRouter provider routing, fallbacks, and pricing caps. The `OpenRouterProviderOptions` type was refactored in `common/src/types/agent-template.ts` to separate reasoning and routing configurations. `packages/agent-runtime/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts` passes these options to the SDK, while `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` applies them to provider requests. Dynamic agent schemas in `common/src/types/dynamic-agent-template.ts` validate the new fields.

67fc4211757842802ad66af074415327313236a9.title: Add OpenAI direct chat completions endpoint
67fc4211757842802ad66af074415327313236a9.summary: Added `web/src/llm-api/openai.ts` to handle non-streaming chat completions directly via OpenAI API for supported models (currently `gpt-5`). Updated `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts` to route requests to this new handler when `openai/gpt-5` is specified with non-streaming parameters, bypassing OpenRouter. Added `OPENAI_API_KEY` to `.env.example` and `packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts`. Renamed `reasoningModel` to `reasoningOptions` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` for GPT-5 configuration.

bde1512b23a3e0d3f849e7f1ba386b32d193ec22.text: The software developers added a hidden note inside the code that starts the command tool. This change does not affect how the product works or looks for users.

cfc3307af15da7a1c4421c5079cbd303639faa77.text: The suggestion menu now shows items on a single line when your screen is wide enough, making the list easier to scan. On narrower screens, it keeps the previous two-line format.

2d00a2117b4ee87a0097aa2951aa14b5a9b28828.text: The research assistant now follows simpler rules to give you shorter, more direct answers.

e8e8a05fcb281138c308840f70c28154e8cb3b42.text: The assistant now consults a special helper to pick the best approach for complex tasks. This means it makes smarter choices when solving tricky problems.

0113870be5722e9f1d35500ebd97af8f509a77a6.text: Removed unused internal code related to command handling. This internal cleanup does not change how you use the product.

2947b3cc64a7417da3728a98af647e7247ce4b66.text: You can now choose which service provides the AI answers, with options to control costs and pick alternatives if one fails.

3158a6f1ae2d7f078f8cf682a48a83f6c8cab8c2.text: The assistant now shows a brief list of the library and topic it is reading. This small change helps you see what information the assistant is using.

49aab02e193f67664600a729fa315939dfcc6e4f.text: Fixed a bug where the text box could appear too narrow. The input area now adjusts its width correctly when the window size changes.

67fc4211757842802ad66af074415327313236a9.text: The assistant now connects directly to one provider for a specific model when you do not want text to appear word by word. This change is internal.

12bd093e1968d959d33cc228ed5e84186813afd8.text: The menu now shows shorter names for commands like logout and exit, removing extra words in parentheses. This makes the list cleaner and easier to read, but the commands still work exactly the same way.

c0b8ca14393cf63a2919d63ef370dc893a72a5a2.title: CLI resets codebuff client on login and logout
c0b8ca14393cf63a2919d63ef370dc893a72a5a2.summary: Added resetCodebuffClient to clear cached CodebuffClient instance on auth transitions. Login and logout mutations now invoke this reset to ensure fresh credential binding and prevent stale client reuse. Scope limited to CLI auth hooks and client utility.

ad9fd7f093114987fae76b180cfe2e862ccec534.title: Add Ctrl+C exit handler to login modal
ad9fd7f093114987fae76b180cfe2e862ccec534.summary: use-login-keyboard-handlers.ts adds Ctrl+C handler to exit login modal. login-modal.tsx removes unused constants, changes error banner to theme.surface, hardcodes #00cc00 for prompt text. Scope limited to CLI login flow.

f3d115f270095a094d266b016a3afbd4b2b51422.title: Release-legacy fetches latest version from npm registry
f3d115f270095a094d266b016a3afbd4b2b51422.summary: npm-app/release-legacy/index.js now fetches the latest legacy version from https://registry.npmjs.org/${packageName}/legacy instead of the GitHub releases.atom feed. This replaces the manual Atom XML regex parsing with direct JSON parsing of the registry response. The change is internal to the release tooling and does not affect the CLI or Web UI.

5f0e9b628a887f061b22e784c3be556852aa6e80.title: CLI auth moves to app.tsx, login becomes full screen
5f0e9b628a887f061b22e784c3be556852aa6e80.summary: Auth logic in cli/src/app.tsx now gates rendering, replacing chat.tsx's inline LoginModal. Unauthenticated states render a full-screen LoginModal instead of an overlay. chat.tsx loses auth props and receives auth state via hooks in app.tsx. LoginModal drops absolute positioning and border styling for 100% viewport coverage.

78f5fcd6c2574813bb4b0a4d659de21d0ca3bf91.title: Release script fetches version from npm registry
78f5fcd6c2574813bb4b0a4d659de21d0ca3bf91.summary: The release script now fetches the latest version from the npm registry instead of parsing GitHub release Atom feeds. This change replaces the fragile regex-based XML parsing of GitHub tags with a direct JSON request to `registry.npmjs.org`, ensuring version detection relies on the published package state. The update applies to the `npm-app/release/index.js` file.

2603b90a50e0bb9c8323e685c3933d4120b72ad0.title: Refactor onboard page login flow
2603b90a50e0bb9c8323e685c3933d4120b72ad0.summary: Replaced image-based success cards with text-only prompts in web/src/app/onboard/page.tsx. Removed next/image dependency and auto-redeem referral logic. Updated copy to direct users back to terminal.

daf16ca2ecc600a2a903f2e0a9850aa2f899463f.title: CLI input height scales to half terminal
daf16ca2ecc600a2a903f2e0a9850aa2f899463f.summary: Multiline input max height now `Math.floor(terminalHeight / 2)` in `cli/src/chat.tsx`. Replaces fixed `maxHeight: 5`. `useTerminalDimensions` exposes `terminalHeight` (default 24). Affects CLI chat rendering.

7196df259ff67620a2c456e420bbbec92692d74f.title: Strip http and https prefixes from terminal links
7196df259ff67620a2c456e420bbbec92692d74f.summary: TerminalLink component in cli/src/components/terminal-link.tsx now strips leading 'http://' and 'https://' prefixes from display text. This change improves readability by removing redundant protocol information from login links shown in the CLI. The underlying href remains unchanged, ensuring correct navigation while optimizing visual presentation.

2c8076c8bd7adf07813ed0686e7e1b7514b76c9f.title: CLI logout clears login store state
2c8076c8bd7adf07813ed0686e7e1b7514b76c9f.summary: CLI logout now calls resetLoginState() from useLoginStore in router.ts, use-auth-state.ts, and slash-commands.ts. Prevents stale auth state persisting after logout. Scope limited to CLI auth hooks and command handlers.

486a32de43a44a516729eb482e87a741cad30d4a.title: Catch all errors in SDK run
486a32de43a44a516729eb482e87a741cad30d4a.summary: SDK `run` now catches all errors, returning `getCancelledRunState` with the error message instead of throwing. `getCancelledAdditionalMessages` accepts a `systemMessage` parameter to inject dynamic cancellation text. Invalid API keys return a structured error state rather than throwing. Covers `sdk/src/run.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/messages.ts`.

c0b8ca14393cf63a2919d63ef370dc893a72a5a2.text: The app now clears old login data when you sign in or out. This stops it from using the wrong account details.

2c8076c8bd7adf07813ed0686e7e1b7514b76c9f.text: When you sign out, the app now clears your login details completely. This prevents old information from staying behind, so you start fresh next time you sign in.

2603b90a50e0bb9c8323e685c3933d4120b72ad0.text: The sign-up page now shows simple text instead of pictures. It tells you to finish the process in the command window.

daf16ca2ecc600a2a903f2e0a9850aa2f899463f.text: The text box where you type your messages now grows to take up half the screen height, instead of staying small. This lets you see and edit longer messages more easily.

ad9fd7f093114987fae76b180cfe2e862ccec534.text: Pressing Ctrl+C now exits the login screen. The error message color changed to match the app theme. This is a small internal fix.

5f0e9b628a887f061b22e784c3be556852aa6e80.text: The login screen now takes up the entire window instead of appearing as a small pop-up. This makes the sign-in process clearer and easier to see.

7196df259ff67620a2c456e420bbbec92692d74f.text: Login links in the command line no longer show 'http://' or 'https://' at the start. They look cleaner, but still work the same way.

f3d115f270095a094d266b016a3afbd4b2b51422.text: The tool that checks for updates now uses a different source for version information. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

78f5fcd6c2574813bb4b0a4d659de21d0ca3bf91.text: The tool now checks the official software store for updates instead of guessing from release notes. This makes finding the newest version more reliable.

486a32de43a44a516729eb482e87a741cad30d4a.text: When a task fails, the system now shows a clear message instead of stopping unexpectedly. This makes errors easier to understand and helps you know when to try again.

4e507bf65b8d90ebbd20053dfed5e616ba84f803.title: Move editor-best-of-n into editor/best-of-n directory
4e507bf65b8d90ebbd20053dfed5e616ba84f803.summary: Relocates editor-best-of-n agent files from .agents/base2/best-of-n/ to .agents/editor/best-of-n/. Six files moved with 100% similarity: best-of-n-implementor.ts, best-of-n-implementor-gpt-5.ts, best-of-n-selector.ts, best-of-n-selector-gpt-5.ts, editor-best-of-n.ts, editor-best-of-n-gpt-5.ts. Pure directory reorganization. No code changes.

beec8c13a1a01b577732e78de4c02e8cc426e8fd.title: Prevent file-picker from spawning agents
beec8c13a1a01b577732e78de4c02e8cc426e8fd.summary: Updated systemPrompt in .agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts to explicitly forbid tool usage and agent spawning. This prevents the file-explorer sub-agent from recursively invoking other agents during file location tasks. Scope limited to internal agent configuration.

310a76336f906a545e004b7751303704329b7bfc.title: file-lister instruction update
310a76336f906a545e004b7751303704329b7bfc.summary: Updated instructionsPrompt in .agents/file-explorer/file-lister.ts. Changed 'Do not use any tools' to 'Do not use any more tools. Do not call read_subtree again.' to explicitly prevent redundant subtree reads. Affects internal agent definition only.

9d173e0096705631b0f27e8544627cffba0c4047.title: file-picker prompt description broadened
9d173e0096705631b0f27e8544627cffba0c4047.summary: Updated `inputSchema.prompt.description` in `.agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts` to explicitly instruct users to provide broader file search descriptions. The new text advises listing related files rather than single targets to improve agent recall. Internal change to agent definition metadata. No runtime logic or API surface modifications.

c7088238ba1e0852431a6280d585515e246e1604.title: Upgrade internal agents to gpt-5.1
c7088238ba1e0852431a6280d585515e246e1604.summary: Model string updated from openai/gpt-5 to openai/gpt-5.1 across agent definitions. Covers base, base2, editor, orchestrator, planner, reviewer, and ETL agent files. Includes logic adjustments in best-of-n editor for tool call inclusion.

9f957b42e3f0b7bf8a9c2bee7c06ece6c64b34ec.title: AbortSignal threaded through agent runtime and SDK run
9f957b42e3f0b7bf8a9c2bee7c06ece6c64b34ec.summary: Added AbortSignal parameter to loopAgentSteps, processStreamWithTools, CodebuffToolHandlerFunction, ExecuteToolCallParams, and SDK run(). Checks signal.aborted before tool execution and in main loop, returning 'Run cancelled by user' error. WebSocket and evals pass new AbortController().signal.

e6fbb859c88a1211185293e12729a369875e7ead.title: Add editor-implementor-gpt-5 agent to base2 orchestrator
e6fbb859c88a1211185293e12729a369875e7ead.summary: New `editor-implementor-gpt-5` agent and `base2-with-editor-implementor-gpt-5` orchestrator variant added. `createBase2` accepts `withImplementorGpt5` flag to swap standard `editor-best-of-n` agents for the new single-pass implementation generator. Buffbench evals updated to test this new configuration against the default `base2` agent, with concurrency reduced to 3.

9897a3dd58ae05443a8230e26490a90cfb21c8f2.title: Refactor researcher-web to single tool call
9897a3dd58ae05443a8230e26490a90cfb21c8f2.summary: Simplified `handleSteps` in `.agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts` to execute a single `web_search` tool call and yield raw results directly. Replaced previous multi-step generation logic with direct `STEP_TEXT` output from `toolResult`. Updated `spawnerPrompt` to reflect concise browsing capability.

16c5bfa2bb7afad848bad1d614ce15af5d74ab2d.title: base2 fast mode uses sonnet, drops validation and todos
16c5bfa2bb7afad848bad1d614ce15af5d74ab2d.summary: base2 fast mode now uses anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 instead of z-ai/glm-4.6:nitro. hasNoValidation defaults to true for fast mode, and write_todos tool is removed from fast mode tool list. Prompts instruct fast mode to prioritize speed, skip unnecessary tools, and implement changes in one go with single targeted typecheck.

1d78d8a12d6d39196c329f94a9db7bb2ae551f47.title: Add isFast gate to best-of-n editor spawn prompt
1d78d8a12d6d39196c329f94a9db7bb2ae551f47.summary: The implementation step prompt in .agents/base2/base2.ts now conditionally instructs the agent to spawn the best-of-n editor agent only when isFast is false. This introduces an isFast boolean parameter to buildImplementationStepPrompt, allowing fast-mode agents to bypass the mandatory editor delegation instruction. The change applies to the core agent orchestration logic, distinguishing between standard and fast execution paths.

16c5bfa2bb7afad848bad1d614ce15af5d74ab2d.text: The fast mode now uses a different engine to work quicker. It skips some extra checks and planning steps to save time.

9f957b42e3f0b7bf8a9c2bee7c06ece6c64b34ec.text: You can now stop an assistant's task immediately by cancelling it. The system checks for this cancellation signal before running any tools, ensuring the process halts cleanly without completing unwanted actions.

4e507bf65b8d90ebbd20053dfed5e616ba84f803.text: Files for a new editing feature were moved to a different folder. This is just an internal cleanup. It does not change how the product works for you.

beec8c13a1a01b577732e78de4c02e8cc426e8fd.text: A small internal update stops the file finder from starting other AI helpers. This prevents endless loops and keeps file searches running smoothly.

9d173e0096705631b0f27e8544627cffba0c4047.text: The assistant now asks for broader file search descriptions to improve its ability to find relevant files.

e6fbb859c88a1211185293e12729a369875e7ead.text: A new AI model is now available for writing code. This change is internal and will not affect how the product looks or works.

1d78d8a12d6d39196c329f94a9db7bb2ae551f47.text: The system now skips an extra review step when running in fast mode. This makes quick tasks finish sooner.

9897a3dd58ae05443a8230e26490a90cfb21c8f2.text: The research assistant now uses a simpler method to find information online. This internal change may make search results appear faster, but it does not change what you can do.

310a76336f906a545e004b7751303704329b7bfc.text: The file explorer tool now stops looking for more information once it finds the file list. This change is internal and makes the process slightly more efficient.

c7088238ba1e0852431a6280d585515e246e1604.text: The software's internal helpers switched to a newer AI model. This small update improves how they plan, review, and edit tasks.

10dee2542c0f3ce6f67b573389c4aa11067c282d.title: Tighten base2 agent prompts
10dee2542c0f3ce6f67b573389c4aa11067c282d.summary: base2.ts prompts enforce editor-best-of-n for non-trivial changes and add IMPORTANT tag to GPT-5 tool-call requirement. Clarifies summary duplication rule. Internal agent instruction tweak only.

29aea41011e6fa48048b04ae4e4c893167b1b109.title: Remove stray comment from CLI bootstrap
29aea41011e6fa48048b04ae4e4c893167b1b109.summary: Deleted a placeholder comment in `cli/src/index.tsx` within `bootstrapCli`. No functional changes to CLI initialization or rendering. Internal cleanup only.

90e3928e01d3d9600e466ed7c4d8c06492a4f80d.title: SDK adds spawn injection for git state
90e3928e01d3d9600e466ed7c4d8c06492a4f80d.summary: SDK introduces `CodebuffSpawn` type and `spawn`/`spawnSource` options to `run` and `InitialSessionStateOptions`. This enables injecting `child_process.spawn` to compute initial git status, diffs, and commit logs for session state. Changes affect `common/src/types/spawn.ts`, `sdk/src/run.ts`, and `sdk/src/run-state.ts`. Default behavior falls back to Node's `child_process.spawn` if `spawnSource` is omitted.

5f4d34b2769d81b16d0f701f2a114379dc1f7427.title: ScrollBox height-change re-render
5f4d34b2769d81b16d0f701f2a114379dc1f7427.summary: useChatScrollbox in cli/src/hooks/use-scroll-management.ts now checks scrollHeight on every render and calls requestRender() when the delta exceeds 10px. Addresses scrollbox visual desync when content height shifts without a scroll event. Scope limited to CLI chat scroll management. Threshold constant heightThreshold=10 gates the re-render to avoid redundant work on minor changes.

2f9fcbb89954783baa9f678753b9ce92381fafdb.title: CLI theme detection: restore Zed guard, remove Ghostty dark override
2f9fcbb89954783baa9f678753b9ce92381fafdb.summary: Restores the `isZedTerminal()` guard in `detectZedTheme` and removes the hard-coded dark theme override for Ghostty in `detectTerminalOverrides` within `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts`. The Ghostty override previously forced dark mode due to light theme legibility issues, but its removal allows native theme detection to proceed. Scope is limited to CLI terminal theme detection logic.

ae6b7f01572a5f3cfa0fe6570c47015da81c0c8b.title: Switch CLI entrypoint to bun shebang
ae6b7f01572a5f3cfa0fe6570c47015da81c0c8b.summary: CLI index.tsx now uses #!/usr/bin/env bun shebang. Replaces runtime Bun.main detection and global __CLI_ENTRY_POINT definition with direct bun execution. Imports reordered: polyfills removed, type-only imports moved to end. Covers cli/src/index.tsx.

0aed1a8c261a72a8b5f60878d41693f4c6b846f2.title: CLI pause queue and cleaner status bar
0aed1a8c261a72a8b5f60878d41693f4c6b846f2.summary: Refactors CLI status handling into `StatusBar` and `ScrollToBottomButton`, removing `StatusIndicator`. Adds pause queue controls via `useQueueControls` and `useQueueUi`. Improves `MultilineInput` cursor handling for tabs and control chars. Scope: `cli/src/components`, `cli/src/hooks`, `cli/src/chat.tsx`.

0191ec4529e34e59920b89b2f195a403ff2b0526.title: Fix typecheck in CLI MessageBlock tests
0191ec4529e34e59920b89b2f195a403ff2b0526.summary: MessageBlock test props updated to match component interface. Added missing autoCollapsedAgents, setCollapsedAgents, and addAutoCollapsedAgent to baseProps in completion and streaming test files. Import order adjusted for lint/typecheck compliance. No runtime behavior change.

99166d1235b91ccda0f08ade523e00c5be5c439d.title: Refactor CLI message-block into separate components
99166d1235b91ccda0f08ade523e00c5be5c439d.summary: Split monolithic `message-block.tsx` into dedicated components for agent lists, markdown content, thinking blocks, tool branches, and plan boxes. This modularization isolates rendering logic for specific content types, improving maintainability and testability within the CLI interface.

0aed1a8c261a72a8b5f60878d41693f4c6b846f2.text: The command-line interface now shows a cleaner status bar and lets you pause or resume queued tasks. Text input handles special keys like tabs more reliably.

99166d1235b91ccda0f08ade523e00c5be5c439d.text: The program's internal structure was cleaned up to separate different parts of the chat display. This helps developers fix issues and add features more easily, but you will not see any changes in how the app looks or works.

5f4d34b2769d81b16d0f701f2a114379dc1f7427.text: The chat window now updates its size more accurately when text changes. This prevents the view from looking misaligned or stuck.

29aea41011e6fa48048b04ae4e4c893167b1b109.text: The program cleaned up a leftover note inside its startup instructions. This change does not affect how the application works or looks for users.

90e3928e01d3d9600e466ed7c4d8c06492a4f80d.text: The system can now use a custom method to check your project's file history. This helps the assistant understand recent changes more accurately when starting a new session.

415d0e7edf82282fe445e5e53a4eb9b400c129f7.text: The assistant can now generate multiple responses at once. This lets it pick the best answer for you automatically.

0191ec4529e34e59920b89b2f195a403ff2b0526.text: The computer now checks the test files for this tool. This change does not affect how you use the product.

2f9fcbb89954783baa9f678753b9ce92381fafdb.text: The app now checks your screen's color settings again to match its look to your system. This fixes a bug where it sometimes forced a dark theme even when you preferred light.

ae6b7f01572a5f3cfa0fe6570c47015da81c0c8b.text: The tool now starts up more simply. This is a small internal cleanup that does not change how you use it.

10dee2542c0f3ce6f67b573389c4aa11067c282d.text: The assistant now double-checks its work before giving you an answer. This small update helps it avoid repeating itself and follow instructions more closely.

fa9ae200a8deda63f5cf9923794dbd56a1c79403.title: Add base2-with-code-reviewer agent variant
fa9ae200a8deda63f5cf9923794dbd56a1c79403.summary: New agent definition `base2-with-code-reviewer` (display name "Buffy the Code Reviewing Orchestrator") added at `.agents/base2/base2-with-code-reviewer.ts`. Extends `createBase2('default', { hasCodeReviewer: true })`. The `hasCodeReviewer` option in `base2.ts` appends `'code-reviewer'` to the sub-agent array and injects a prompt instruction to spawn a code-reviewer agent after edits. Scope: internal agent configs only, no user-facing model picker or CLI changes.

cf92cb22890b5b99f8e29b7293fd065ddab02d8d.title: CLI chat.tsx removes MessageRenderer wrapper, renders
cf92cb22890b5b99f8e29b7293fd065ddab02d8d.summary: MessageRenderer component removed. Chat.tsx now maps topLevelMessages directly to MessageWithAgents inside scrollbox. message-renderer.tsx renamed to message-with-agents.tsx; MessageRenderer interface and export deleted. Eliminates intermediate component layer.

1d5fa92e3c3f06eea801fc7edca8abcb93d29270.title: CLI auto-collapse thinking blocks via store
1d5fa92e3c3f06eea801fc7edca8abcb93d29270.summary: Moved auto-collapse logic from use-send-message.ts to chat-store.ts. Added autoCollapsedAgents state and addAutoCollapsedAgent action. ThinkingBlock now triggers collapse via store updates, removing ref-based tracking. Affects cli/src/chat.tsx, message-block.tsx, message-with-agents.tsx, use-send-message.ts, chat-store.ts.

2dd14a8796d9eb5e03b00d4d8f713f044fc3f6e9.title: Add code-reviewer-best-of-n agent suite
2dd14a8796d9eb5e03b00d4d8f713f044fc3f6e9.summary: New `code-reviewer-best-of-n` orchestrator spawns parallel `code-reviewer-implementor` agents to generate multiple review proposals, then uses a `code-reviewer-selector` to pick the best one. This mechanism replaces single-pass review logic to improve code quality via ensemble selection. The change introduces four new agent definition files in `.agents/reviewer/` and updates `.agents/base2/base2.ts` to register the new orchestrator and its sub-agents. The `createBase2` factory now accepts a `hasCodeReviewerBestOfN` flag to conditionally include the new agent in the spawnable list and prompt instructions.

b447105d2fefc0c74d7ff617170c90c15bac0de9.title: Refactor CLI message creation into getUserMessage and getSystemMessage
b447105d2fefc0c74d7ff617170c90c15bac0de9.summary: Added `getUserMessage` and `getSystemMessage` helpers in `cli/src/utils/message-history.ts` to standardize chat message object creation. These functions replace inline object literals in `init.ts`, `router.ts`, `usage.ts`, `use-send-message.ts`, and `slash-commands.ts`, handling ID generation, timestamps, and variant assignment. The refactor supports both string content and `ContentBlock[]` arrays for system and user messages.

e507034c904edc143975fd12492a135c19713b5a.title: Add placeholder comment in CLI bootstrap
e507034c904edc143975fd12492a135c19713b5a.summary: Added a comment in cli/src/index.tsx within bootstrapCli. No functional changes or logic modifications. Internal codebase adjustment.

3174c4413b7f2a23aa3184cbe8c6fea27a24ab96.title: Block slash commands in CLI router
3174c4413b7f2a23aa3184cbe8c6fea27a24ab96.summary: Added guard in cli/src/commands/router.ts to intercept messages starting with / before agent runtime dispatch. Slash commands now trigger local Command not found system message instead of reaching the agent. Scope limited to CLI router; init command remains exempt. Mechanism prevents unhandled slash syntax from propagating to the agent backend.

9dd2fdfd32eb1f977e6796e996a993c1c7a732b5.title: CLI cancel keeps pending agent response
9dd2fdfd32eb1f977e6796e996a993c1c7a732b5.summary: Cancellation logic now preserves partial assistant output in session state. New getCancelledAdditionalMessages utility wraps pending text in <previous_assistant_message> tags. SDK run.ts replaced early abort checks with deferred state calculation via getCancelledRunState. CLI hook use-send-message.ts updated to store runState before error handling.

166714289a14e603703e5a97e3eb9e7b5fc299e5.title: GPT-5 code reviewer variants added to base2
166714289a14e603703e5a97e3eb9e7b5fc299e5.summary: Added gpt-5 variants for code reviewer, implementor, and selector agents. `base2.ts` now conditionally selects these gpt-5 specific definitions when `isGpt5` is true. Files moved to `.agents/reviewer/best-of-n/` directory. Removed `reasoning` field from selector output schema.

5aff4e9abb7e273137e9897ed92e08089e85afca.title: BYOK OpenRouter support added
5aff4e9abb7e273137e9897ed92e08089e85afca.summary: Added BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) support for OpenRouter. New constants in `common/src/constants/byok.ts` define `BYOK_OPENROUTER_HEADER` and `BYOK_OPENROUTER_ENV_VAR`. Database migration `0031_damp_hobgoblin.sql` adds a `byok` boolean column to the `message` table. Billing logic in `packages/billing/src/balance-calculator.ts` skips credit consumption when `byok` is true.

cf92cb22890b5b99f8e29b7293fd065ddab02d8d.text: The app now shows chat messages directly, without an extra background step. This change is small and internal, so you won't notice any difference in how you use the product.

fa9ae200a8deda63f5cf9923794dbd56a1c79403.text: The assistant can now automatically check its own work for errors after making changes. This is an internal update that improves quality without changing how you use the product.

9dd2fdfd32eb1f977e6796e996a993c1c7a732b5.text: When you stop a response, the text already written stays visible. This prevents losing partial answers during cancellations.

1d5fa92e3c3f06eea801fc7edca8abcb93d29270.text: The app now automatically hides long reasoning steps to keep the chat clean. This makes it easier to read the final answer without manually closing extra text.

b447105d2fefc0c74d7ff617170c90c15bac0de9.text: The team cleaned up how the app builds messages behind the scenes. This change is internal and does not affect how you use the product.

e507034c904edc143975fd12492a135c19713b5a.text: The developers added a note to the command line tool. This change does not affect how you use the product.

166714289a14e603703e5a97e3eb9e7b5fc299e5.text: The system now uses a newer AI model for reviewing and creating software. This update is internal and may improve the quality of the results.

3174c4413b7f2a23aa3184cbe8c6fea27a24ab96.text: Typing a slash command in the chat now shows an error instead of confusing the assistant. This prevents broken commands from reaching the system.

5aff4e9abb7e273137e9897ed92e08089e85afca.text: You can now connect your own account to use the service, which means it won't use up your existing credits.

2dd14a8796d9eb5e03b00d4d8f713f044fc3f6e9.text: The assistant now compares several possible answers at once and picks the best one for code reviews. This small internal update aims to improve review quality.

2b7cc8d044beb0752627cdd7ae585e2be514789c.title: Make Task Complete tool not render
2b7cc8d044beb0752627cdd7ae585e2be514789c.summary: The Task Complete tool component now returns null for content, preventing it from rendering in the CLI. The `renderToolComponent` function and `ToolComponent` interface were updated to return `undefined` instead of `null` when a tool is not found or fails to render, and `message-block.tsx` was adjusted to handle this change. This affects `cli/src/components/tools/task-complete.tsx`, `cli/src/components/tools/registry.ts`, `cli/src/components/tools/types.ts`, and `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx`.

af4eec66d118971ec0b3cecdf2adf08dde566b71.title: CLI /exit now sends SIGINT to self
af4eec66d118971ec0b3cecdf2adf08dde566b71.summary: Replaced manual state teardown in cli/src/commands/router.ts with process.kill(process.pid, 'SIGINT'). The previous implementation failed to properly terminate the CLI session. The change ensures consistent shutdown behavior across all exit paths.

8e6faa0b9d53153f9f87387521bfd761a57655bf.title: Dark theme surface and border adjustments in CLI
8e6faa0b9d53153f9f87387521bfd761a57655bf.summary: Dark theme surface shifted to #202327, with muted and border colors brightened to #acb3bf and #536175 respectively. Changes applied to DEFAULT_CHAT_THEMES in cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts.

81b1faa006e98bd4e0599edefd96a9296e783f8a.title: CLI tool render returns ToolRenderConfig not null
81b1faa006e98bd4e0599edefd96a9296e783f8a.summary: Tool component render signatures in `cli/src/components/tools/` drop `ToolRenderConfig | null` for `ToolRenderConfig`. Empty-input guards (e.g. `glob.tsx`, `list-directory.tsx`, `write-todos.tsx`) now return `{ content: null }` instead of `null`. `run-terminal-command.tsx` removes its early null return entirely. Internal refactor; no user-visible behavior change.

ad99717f547a2dd28cdf6bd4cb6c99271a17bd5f.title: Add reasoningdelta event to print mode
ad99717f547a2dd28cdf6bd4cb6c99271a17bd5f.summary: New printModeReasoningDeltaSchema added to printModeEventSchema in common/src/types/print-mode.ts. Client.ts updates stream-start logic to trigger on reasoning_delta chunks with empty ancestorRunIds. Scope covers shared core types and CLI client. The event includes text and runId fields, enabling granular reasoning stream handling.

4419bc4290dfb8ef6aed8cc7869daf9d3494431d.title: Restore reasoning output in npm-app client
4419bc4290dfb8ef6aed8cc7869daf9d3494431d.summary: Added conditional handling for `reasoning` chunks in `npm-app/src/client.ts`. This ensures reasoning text is printed to stdout in gray and triggers `onStreamStart` if the stream hasn't begun. Scope limited to the npm-app client implementation.

53b8b7346749bee218b7eba524694cd1d072b842.title: Route subagent reasoning to agent streams
53b8b7346749bee218b7eba524694cd1d072b842.summary: SDK `run.ts` converts raw `reasoning` chunks to `reasoning_delta` events carrying `agentId` and `ancestorRunIds`, removing the global `flushReasoning` buffer. CLI `use-send-message.ts` checks `ancestorRunIds.length` to route root reasoning to the main stream and subagent reasoning to `updateAgentContent`, while `npm-app/src/client.ts` drops legacy `reasoning` handling. `common/src/types/print-mode.ts` removes `printModeReasoningSchema`, and `agent-runtime` propagates `ancestorRunIds` through `spawn-agent-utils.ts` and `stream-parser.ts` to track lineage.

cdb009caddd9cf86c8e2f9e8be36cebf94ab2431.title: Add onCostCalculated mock to agent-runtime tests
cdb009caddd9cf86c8e2f9e8be36cebf94ab2431.summary: Added onCostCalculated mock callbacks to test files in packages/agent-runtime/src/__tests__/. Aligns test mocks with runtime interface requirements. Scope limited to internal test utilities.

a9788f567596666349e7440f0bc5308844b81974.title: Add paused queue UX with bottom border display
a9788f567596666349e7440f0bc5308844b81974.summary: Added `queuePaused` state and `pauseQueue`/`resumeQueue` functions to `useMessageQueue`. Interrupting a stream via Ctrl+C now pauses the queue, hiding the preview and displaying a 'queued — your next message sends first' border. The queue automatically resumes after the next message completes successfully. Modified `chat.tsx`, `use-keyboard-handlers.ts`, and `use-send-message.ts` to handle the state transitions.

ffe5106290924a533efcaa0a6da7cda824454624.title: Brighten CLI input colors and remove dim text
ffe5106290924a533efcaa0a6da7cda824454624.summary: Removed TextAttributes.DIM from multiline-input.tsx, making placeholder text fully visible. Deleted inputBg and inputFocusedBg from theme-system.ts and utils/theme-system.ts, simplifying color logic. Chat.tsx border styling updated to use theme.foreground exclusively, removing secondary border color dependencies.

2b7cc8d044beb0752627cdd7ae585e2be514789c.text: The app now hides the 'Task Complete' message in the command-line view. This keeps the screen cleaner.

81b1faa006e98bd4e0599edefd96a9296e783f8a.text: The tool's internal instructions were tightened to always expect complete settings. This cleanup does not change how the product works for you.

a9788f567596666349e7440f0bc5308844b81974.text: Pressing the stop button now pauses queued messages and shows a border confirming the next message will send first. The queue resumes automatically after the next message finishes.

53b8b7346749bee218b7eba524694cd1d072b842.text: The app now separates the 'thinking' steps of its main assistant from those of its helpers. This prevents the text from getting mixed up or appearing in the wrong place on your screen.

af4eec66d118971ec0b3cecdf2adf08dde566b71.text: The application now uses a standard shutdown signal when you type the exit command. This ensures the program closes completely and consistently, preventing it from getting stuck open.

ffe5106290924a533efcaa0a6da7cda824454624.text: Text boxes now show clearer colors, making typed words and hints easier to see. Borders use a single, consistent color for a cleaner look.

8e6faa0b9d53153f9f87387521bfd761a57655bf.text: The app's dark mode colors were adjusted. The background is now slightly darker, and the text and lines are a bit brighter to make them easier to read.

ad99717f547a2dd28cdf6bd4cb6c99271a17bd5f.text: The assistant now shares its step-by-step thoughts in real time while printing text. This lets users see how answers are formed as they appear.

4419bc4290dfb8ef6aed8cc7869daf9d3494431d.text: The app now displays the assistant's thought process in gray text before the final answer.

cdb009caddd9cf86c8e2f9e8be36cebf94ab2431.text: The software now correctly records costs during internal tests. This change does not affect how the product works for you.

1a5f776fdc01c6f3863e82741646a0909a0a388d.title: Build mode buttons stack vertically
1a5f776fdc01c6f3863e82741646a0909a0a388d.summary: Refactored `BuildModeButtons` in `cli/src/components/build-mode-buttons.tsx` to use `flexDirection: 'column'` and removed terminal-width logic. Replaced conditional narrow-screen prompt with static text "Choose an option to build this plan:". Eliminates `useTerminalDimensions` dependency.

00bc75c53375f3601512779366eba29ac15c81f2.title: Gray accent line for agent prompt in CLI
00bc75c53375f3601512779366eba29ac15c81f2.summary: Agent branch accent line changed from green to gray (#6b7280) in default CLI themes. `aiLine` token in `theme-system.ts` updated for dark and light modes. `agent-branch-item.tsx` now uses `theme.aiLine` instead of `theme.userLine` for the vertical indicator.

47ec5fb424d229f4bb349ce482fe4f5a59f0b681.title: Clarify plan mode follow-up questions prompt
47ec5fb424d229f4bb349ce482fe4f5a59f0b681.summary: Updated plan mode prompt in .agents/base2/base2.ts to rename Questions to Follow-up questions. Changed default option label from (DEFAULT) to (CURRENT) and wrapped example in <example> tags. Clarified that questions are optional for user completion.

d341faaa2c7a0b06664ff9f7aaae57d1009c97c5.title: Web navbar refactored for sticky layout and hover effects
d341faaa2c7a0b06664ff9f7aaae57d1009c97c5.summary: Refactored web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx to implement a sticky header with backdrop-blur effects. Updated navigation links to use absolute positioning for gradient hover states and adjusted responsive breakpoints. Improved animation durations and transition classes for smoother UI interactions.

3e90de9474241a1f14dfd9cb1639ab10178b0823.title: New Button component fixes CLI crash on click and drag
3e90de9474241a1f14dfd9cb1639ab10178b0823.summary: New `Button` component in `cli/src/components/button.tsx` replaces raw `box` elements with `onMouseDown` handlers across CLI UI surfaces. The component recursively sets `selectable={false}` on all child text nodes, preventing terminal text selection during mouse interactions which previously caused crashes. Updated files include `chat.tsx`, `agent-branch-item.tsx`, `agent-mode-toggle.tsx`, `build-mode-buttons.tsx`, `message-renderer.tsx`, `raised-pill.tsx`, `segmented-control.tsx`, and `terminal-link.tsx`.

bde7e88d8f549ae4e56913c25ca9e5b07384692c.title: Fix CLI multiline input word wrap cursor navigation
bde7e88d8f549ae4e56913c25ca9e5b07384692c.summary: CLI multiline input now uses `word-wrap-utils.ts` to calculate cursor positions for up/down navigation. Previous logic failed to account for visual line wrapping, causing cursor jumps to incorrect logical lines. The fix reads `lineStarts` from `@opentui/core` `TextBufferView` to map visual rows to text offsets. Applies to `multiline-input.tsx` keyboard handlers.

5ad4ac4b1bb872ca79ba8cda1d8cfcb622e06a1a.title: Collapse file-picker agent by default
5ad4ac4b1bb872ca79ba8cda1d8cfcb622e06a1a.summary: CLI file-picker agents now collapse automatically upon start. Logic updated in `use-send-message.ts` to check `shouldCollapseByDefault` from `constants.ts`. Scope limited to CLI agent rendering. New `COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_AGENT_IDS` constant defines agents to hide initially.

7d78d2f21f026dc755396e89e29753da3c305356.title: Fix terminal output overflow by visual line counting
7d78d2f21f026dc755396e89e29753da3c305356.summary: Terminal command output preview now calculates visible lines based on terminal width rather than raw newlines. The component uses `useTerminalDimensions` and `getLastNVisualLines` to determine the exact count of wrapped visual lines for the 5-line preview limit. This change applies to `cli/src/components/tools/run-terminal-command.tsx` to prevent horizontal overflow in narrow terminals.

56d7380c078b5768aad603721901a06a31c2fbff.title: Add web and docs search API endpoints
56d7380c078b5768aad603721901a06a31c2fbff.summary: New POST endpoints /api/v1/web-search and /api/v1/docs-search added to web/src/app/api/v1/. Handlers validate input via Zod, enforce API key auth, and consume credits using billing services. Analytics events for request, auth, validation, credit, and error states tracked in common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts. Web search uses linkup-api; docs search uses context7-api.

7e505fbceb0d2c91b30efceb72f8fa23075e3d00.title: Agent runtime web and docs search switch to Codebuff web API
7e505fbceb0d2c91b30efceb72f8fa23075e3d00.summary: Web search and docs search tools now call Codebuff web API endpoints instead of Linkup and Context7. Client-side credit charging replaced by server-reported `creditsUsed` in tool outputs, with `onCostCalculated` propagated through `run-agent-step.ts`. Scope: `packages/agent-runtime/src/llm-api/codebuff-web-api.ts` (new), `web-search.ts`, `read-docs.ts`, `run-agent-step.ts`, `tool-executor.ts`. `callWebSearchAPI` and `callDocsSearchAPI` return `creditsUsed` as a number alongside result/error, which tool handlers capture and attach to output.

00bc75c53375f3601512779366eba29ac15c81f2.text: The vertical line next to agent responses changed from green to gray. This small visual update helps distinguish agent prompts from user inputs.

bde7e88d8f549ae4e56913c25ca9e5b07384692c.text: Pressing the up or down arrow keys in the text box now moves the cursor to the correct line, even when a long sentence wraps onto multiple visual rows.

d341faaa2c7a0b06664ff9f7aaae57d1009c97c5.text: The top menu now stays visible while scrolling, with a soft blurred background and smooth color effects when hovering over links.

3e90de9474241a1f14dfd9cb1639ab10178b0823.text: The app no longer crashes when you click and drag on buttons or text. This fixes a problem where selecting text during mouse actions caused the program to stop working.

7e505fbceb0d2c91b30efceb72f8fa23075e3d00.text: The assistant now uses a new service to find information online. It also tracks usage costs more accurately by getting numbers directly from the service instead of estimating them.

56d7380c078b5768aad603721901a06a31c2fbff.text: The assistant can now search the web and documentation. It checks your login and counts this action against your usage limits.

47ec5fb424d229f4bb349ce482fe4f5a59f0b681.text: The assistant now labels its follow-up questions more clearly and notes that answering them is optional. This small change helps users understand they can skip extra questions if they want.

5ad4ac4b1bb872ca79ba8cda1d8cfcb622e06a1a.text: The file picker now starts in a compact view, hiding details until you expand it. This keeps the screen cleaner when you begin.

7d78d2f21f026dc755396e89e29753da3c305356.text: Terminal output now wraps text correctly when the window is narrow. You see the last five lines of a command's result without horizontal scrolling or cut-off text.

1a5f776fdc01c6f3863e82741646a0909a0a388d.text: The build option buttons now stack vertically instead of adjusting to screen width. This ensures the 'Choose an option to build this plan:' prompt always appears clearly.

dd76dae19f155430bdab33d4027322a410496399.title: CLI suggestion menu up key stays open at top
dd76dae19f155430bdab33d4027322a410496399.summary: Pressing up at index 0 returns true instead of false. Prevents menu exit when scrolling up. Scope: use-suggestion-menu-handlers.ts.

7ae3f17d9002681f3dc46d5e2ebc01a85fb1713f.title: Reduce verbosity in docs and web researcher prompts
7ae3f17d9002681f3dc46d5e2ebc01a85fb1713f.summary: Instruction prompts in `.agents/researcher/researcher-docs.ts` and `.agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts` now request concise reports with key findings, replacing comprehensive/verbose wording. Aims to tighten researcher output. Scope limited to internal agent definitions.

6112546b200896a09c61cb6d13fe012ad1831d11.title: Skip OSC theme detection when IDE theme available
6112546b200896a09c61cb6d13fe012ad1831d11.summary: Adds early return in `initializeOSCDetection` to skip background OSC commands if `detectIDETheme` returns a theme. Prevents unnecessary OSC queries when IDE fallback is present. Affects `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts`. Behavior: IDE theme takes precedence over OSC detection.

892814b3b51ad549a8965c3045233372216010a5.title: Suggestion menu width adapts to terminal dimensions
892814b3b51ad549a8965c3045233372216010a5.summary: Suggestion menu width now derives from terminal dimensions via useTerminalDimensions instead of max label length. Replaces static width calculation with dynamic menuWidth = Math.max(10, terminalWidth - screenPadding * 2). Removes redundant nested box container in cli/src/components/suggestion-menu.tsx. Padding calculation uses menuWidth minus labelLength.

a54e2c0b461ba6bd84e6b6dbf3f5528da75742a8.title: Suggestion menu arrow key handling
a54e2c0b461ba6bd84e6b6dbf3f5528da75742a8.summary: Updated handleAgentMenuKey in use-suggestion-menu-handlers.ts to return true when down arrow is pressed at the end of the list. Prevents default key behavior in this edge case.

59702a8749708d211b2cd2daf5bc3bbfbf80ffdd.title: Remove shell check from PowerShell theme detection
59702a8749708d211b2cd2daf5bc3bbfbf80ffdd.summary: Removed `detectShell()` check in `detectWindowsPowerShellTheme` within `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts`. Detection now relies solely on `powershell` background color queries, fixing theme mismatches when running under non-PowerShell shells on Windows. Scope limited to CLI theme system. Dark/light color arrays remain unchanged.

f98abc6747424c58719df37a51f6b84c20983172.title: Move theme store into use-theme hook
f98abc6747424c58719df37a51f6b84c20983172.summary: Theme store logic moved from `cli/src/state/theme-store.ts` to `cli/src/hooks/use-theme.tsx`. `detectSystemTheme` now lives in the hook and exports `THEME_PRIORITY` array. `ChatTheme` interface gains `name` field, populated by `buildTheme` in `cli/src/utils/theme-config.ts`. `detectIDETheme`, `detectTerminalOverrides`, `detectPlatformTheme` exported from `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts`.

0e972b85f2fe1870103af3097a31dbff4e861be9.title: Fix Ctrl+W word delete in CLI multiline input
0e972b85f2fe1870103af3097a31dbff4e861be9.summary: Corrected operator precedence in cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx. Ctrl+W now deletes a word backward without requiring the backspace key name. Alt+Backspace behavior remains unchanged.

247e0ea10906dc49d3db10c89cad4f20c90120a0.title: Implement '@' file search in CLI
247e0ea10906dc49d3db10c89cad4f20c90120a0.summary: Added '@' trigger support for file path searching in the CLI suggestion engine. The `useSuggestionEngine` hook now accepts a `fileTree` prop and filters file matches alongside agent matches, while `useSuggestionMenuHandlers` manages combined navigation and selection logic for both agents and files. This change propagates the `fileTree` from `index.tsx` through `app.tsx` to `chat.tsx`, enabling context-aware file insertion.

5b00df1c632aa677a9bfbd0f3e5822d949dae85a.title: Track session credits and print in /usage
5b00df1c632aa677a9bfbd0f3e5822d949dae85a.summary: Added sessionCreditsUsed state and addSessionCredits action to chat-store.ts. use-send-message.ts now tracks totalCost on finish events. /usage command prepends session credits to backend balance data.

a54e2c0b461ba6bd84e6b6dbf3f5528da75742a8.text: Pressing the down arrow at the bottom of the list no longer triggers unexpected actions.

dd76dae19f155430bdab33d4027322a410496399.text: When you pressed the up arrow key at the top of the suggestion menu, the menu would not close as expected. This fix ensures the menu closes properly when you press up at the top.

247e0ea10906dc49d3db10c89cad4f20c90120a0.text: Typing the @ symbol in the command line now lets you search for and pick files to insert. This saves time by letting you reference files directly without typing their full paths.

f98abc6747424c58719df37a51f6b84c20983172.text: The app organizes color settings more efficiently. This internal cleanup improves stability without changing how the product looks or works for you.

7ae3f17d9002681f3dc46d5e2ebc01a85fb1713f.text: The internal instructions for the research assistant were simplified to ask for shorter, more direct answers. This small change helps the assistant provide clearer summaries without extra details.

5b00df1c632aa677a9bfbd0f3e5822d949dae85a.text: The app now tracks how many credits you use during a single session. When you check your usage, it shows both this session total and your remaining balance.

892814b3b51ad549a8965c3045233372216010a5.text: The suggestion menu now automatically adjusts its width to fit your screen size, preventing it from looking too narrow or too wide.

6112546b200896a09c61cb6d13fe012ad1831d11.text: The app now uses the editor's color scheme instead of searching for a theme on its own. This saves a small amount of time during startup.

59702a8749708d211b2cd2daf5bc3bbfbf80ffdd.text: The app now checks the system colors directly to pick the right look. This fixes cases where the wrong dark or light mode was used on Windows.

0e972b85f2fe1870103af3097a31dbff4e861be9.text: Pressing the shortcut for deleting a word backward in the text box now works correctly. This small fix means you can edit longer messages more smoothly without needing to use a different key combination.

d16f6ec50432abc8e5b7dc4d280b7c975ebf1b0a.title: Add @ai-sdk/provider-utils dependency to internal package
d16f6ec50432abc8e5b7dc4d280b7c975ebf1b0a.summary: Added @ai-sdk/provider-utils v3.0.17 to packages/internal/package.json dependencies. Removed unused getRuntimeEnvironmentUserAgent import from packages/internal/src/openai-compatible/openai-compatible-provider.ts. This ensures the provider-utils package is explicitly available for internal usage.

07c152a450251e53dd95775e687532f9de4e4d1c.title: Add msw for internal package tests
07c152a450251e53dd95775e687532f9de4e4d1c.summary: Added `msw` as a dependency to `packages/internal` to support unit test mocking. Updated `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` to `^3.0.17` and fixed unit tests in `chat/index.test.ts` and `completion/index.test.ts` to use the new mock server.

a5d217f912042fd2f845e8f06d1255fa03ad3c01.title: Pin @ai-sdk/provider-utils to 3.0.7 in packages/internal
a5d217f912042fd2f845e8f06d1255fa03ad3c01.summary: Reverts `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` from 3.0.17 to 3.0.7 in `packages/internal/package.json`. Downgrade resolves internal test failures in `packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk/chat/index.test.ts`. Change scoped to `packages/internal` dependencies.

d3831e98e541020175ce5c8e500b0e42e01a6aed.title: Fix agent spawn error display and status handling in CLI
d3831e98e541020175ce5c8e500b0e42e01a6aed.summary: Invalid agent spawn errors now display correctly and mark the agent block as 'failed' instead of 'complete'. The `use-send-message` hook extracts `errorMessage` from result values, updating `AgentContentBlock` status logic and UI indicators in `message-block.tsx`. `codebuff-client.ts` also handles `errorMessage` in JSON tool outputs. This change affects CLI components, hooks, types, and utils.

3baf4009a3728d1df7aaa75537148ebee2048f61.title: Run OSC theme detection inline instead subprocess
3baf4009a3728d1df7aaa75537148ebee2048f61.summary: CLI theme detection executes OSC queries in-process via `detectTerminalTheme`, replacing the previous `Bun.spawn` subprocess pattern. `withTerminalInputGuard` pauses stdin during detection to prevent input race conditions, while `initializeOSCDetection` switches from fire-and-forget async to synchronous void invocation. Debug logging gated by `CODEBUFF_OSC_DEBUG` tracks subprocess results and errors. Covers `cli/src/index.tsx`, `cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts`, and new `cli/src/utils/terminal-input-guard.ts`.

1c0c35f9cb1176c2cd2ef65d2a752d146c9b4503.title: Remove short text cache control skip in messages.ts
1c0c35f9cb1176c2cd2ef65d2a752d146c9b4503.summary: Removed logic skipping cache control for text parts <2 chars in convertCbToModelMessages. This ensures all text parts receive cache control regardless of length. Affects common/src/util/messages.ts. Fixes messages.test.ts.

818ccf576ed51b2f180f1c592a844bfd08b01576.title: Update openai-compatible and openrouter chat message conversion tests
818ccf576ed51b2f180f1c592a844bfd08b01576.summary: Test expectations updated in packages/internal to match chat message conversion behavior. Single text parts now assert array content structure `[{ type: 'text', text: '...' }]` instead of string content. `cacheControl` and `contentLevel` metadata assertions moved to part level. Unused `afterEach` import removed in openrouter chat index tests.

45e15684d0075eaa744078e21b99c9beed409243.title: getProviderOptions accepts providerOptions
45e15684d0075eaa744078e21b99c9beed409243.summary: getProviderOptions in sdk/src/impl/llm.ts accepts providerOptions. Spreads into codebuff, merging codebuff key. Internal SDK refactor. Adds providerOptions?: Record<string, JSONObject> to params.

519af8336763e7adef1740f28d0e5442e21bbe9b.title: /usage command added to CLI
519af8336763e7adef1740f28d0e5442e21bbe9b.summary: New `/usage` command (alias `/credits`) added to CLI router and slash commands. Fetches credit balance from backend, displays remaining credits with color coding and quota reset info. Files: `cli/src/commands/usage.ts`, `cli/src/commands/router.ts`, `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts`. `routeUserPrompt` now async to support the new command handler.

cf07ad1d224ec44e02d4f6145d8c4d1705e1237d.title: Fix auto-collapse thinking timing
cf07ad1d224ec44e02d4f6145d8c4d1705e1237d.summary: Moved `autoCollapseThinkingBlock` call from `subagent_chunk` handler to top-level `delta.type === 'reasoning'` check in `use-send-message.ts`. Ensures thinking blocks collapse immediately upon first reasoning content, regardless of stream nesting. Affects CLI message rendering logic.

818ccf576ed51b2f180f1c592a844bfd08b01576.text: This is a small internal update to how the system checks its own work. It does not change how the assistant behaves or what you see.

1c0c35f9cb1176c2cd2ef65d2a752d146c9b4503.text: A small internal change now applies the same speed-up setting to all text messages, regardless of how short they are. This ensures more consistent performance for the assistant.

07c152a450251e53dd95775e687532f9de4e4d1c.text: Internal tests were updated to use a new mock server. This change is small and does not affect how the product works for users.

519af8336763e7adef1740f28d0e5442e21bbe9b.text: You can now type a command to see how much usage you have left. The tool shows your remaining balance and when it resets.

3baf4009a3728d1df7aaa75537148ebee2048f61.text: The app now checks your computer's color settings directly, instead of starting a separate helper process. This makes the startup faster and prevents input glitches.

a5d217f912042fd2f845e8f06d1255fa03ad3c01.text: We fixed a small internal issue to keep the assistant working correctly. You might not notice any change.

45e15684d0075eaa744078e21b99c9beed409243.text: The assistant can now receive extra settings from different providers.

d16f6ec50432abc8e5b7dc4d280b7c975ebf1b0a.text: A small internal update improves how the system connects to its AI services. Users will not notice any difference.

d3831e98e541020175ce5c8e500b0e42e01a6aed.text: When an assistant fails to start, the interface now clearly shows the error and marks the task as failed. Previously, these errors were hidden or incorrectly marked as complete.

cf07ad1d224ec44e02d4f6145d8c4d1705e1237d.text: The assistant's 'thinking' notes now hide as soon as they appear. This keeps the conversation cleaner.

332f189caff832d937d0c93841979ffc09b27e66.title: Guard env logging against OSC detection
332f189caff832d937d0c93841979ffc09b27e66.summary: common/src/env.ts suppresses `Using environment:` log when `--internal-osc-detect` appears in `process.argv`. Prevents noisy output during terminal capability probing in spawned processes. Scope: shared core env module. Uses `Array.isArray(process.argv)` check for safety.

47e5858bb71893b123e3bef19e6b7fab791f9b5b.title: Refactor CLI bootstrap and add internal OSC detection
47e5858bb71893b123e3bef19e6b7fab791f9b5b.summary: CLI startup logic moved into async `bootstrapCli` function. New `--internal-osc-detect` flag triggers `runOscDetectionSubprocess` to identify terminal theme without full app initialization. `createQueryClient` extracted to isolate React Query configuration. Entry point path stored in global `__CLI_ENTRY_POINT` property.

1cbca347626e2e8f03b187961781f648eb714602.title: Prettier formatting in openai-compatible chat converter
1cbca347626e2e8f03b187961781f648eb714602.summary: Applied Prettier formatting to packages/internal/src/openai-compatible/chat/convert-to-openai-compatible-chat-messages.ts. Changes include semicolon removal, arrow function parameter parenthesization, and import reordering. No functional logic changes occurred. Scope limited to internal package source formatting.

a3e71a58bee9aed0b92124e99ddbf8061ce7a1b9.title: Agent mode toggle button font styling
a3e71a58bee9aed0b92124e99ddbf8061ce7a1b9.summary: AgentModeToggle text color now responds to hover state via conditional theme assignment. Fixes native macOS rendering issues in cli/src/components/agent-mode-toggle.tsx.

6e752a5a7060b3a294065aef3948380505d8b463.title: Remove extraneous wrapper boxes
6e752a5a7060b3a294065aef3948380505d8b463.summary: Deleted redundant `box` wrappers in `cli/src/app.tsx` and `cli/src/chat.tsx`. The `Chat` component now renders directly without a parent `box`, and the `scrollbox` is no longer nested inside an intermediate `box`. This simplifies the component tree and removes unnecessary layout containers.

209b81809c8e3277270343cd139150e6ea9980c0.title: Binary replacement fallback rename
209b81809c8e3277270343cd139150e6ea9980c0.summary: downloadBinary now attempts renaming existing binary if unlinkSync fails. Handles locked files on Windows. Fallback path appends timestamp suffix. Throws combined error if both unlink and rename fail.

267fadde6c1040b10f172801f22c71887f9357ea.title: Fork openai-compatible v5 into internal packages
267fadde6c1040b10f172801f22c71887f9357ea.summary: OpenAI-compatible v5 provider code forked into `packages/internal/src/openai-compatible`. Adds chat and completion modules with message conversion, finish-reason mapping, and metadata extraction. Implements `LanguageModelV2` spec via `openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts`. Supports structured outputs, tool calls, and image URL/base64 data handling.

bb254dd891cc2bc69ac23011fd6e8f67a396b5dc.title: Remove single-text cache split in message converters
bb254dd891cc2bc69ac23011fd6e8f67a396b5dc.summary: Removed logic splitting single-text user messages into cache-controlled fragments in convertCbToModelMessages and provider-specific converters (OpenAI-compatible, OpenRouter). This ensures messages are passed as unified content parts, preventing unintended cache control application on split text. Scope covers common/src/util/messages.ts and packages/internal chat converters. SDK llm.ts now imports OpenAICompatibleChatLanguageModel from @codebuff/internal/openai-compatible/index.

fd4c93b3bfb2e431317665fc6cb87aab12607158.title: Harden shell detection and OSC guard
fd4c93b3bfb2e431317665fc6cb87aab12607158.summary: New `detect-shell.ts` utility identifies shells via environment variables or parent process inspection, caching results to support PowerShell theme detection. OSC terminal detection logic is restored in `terminal-color-detection.ts` and `theme-system.ts`, guarded by a new `terminalSupportsOSC` check in `cli/src/index.tsx` to prevent hangs in non-supporting terminals. Windows PowerShell background color detection is added to `theme-system.ts`, prioritizing `(Get-Host).UI.RawUI.BackgroundColor` over generic system theme checks. `packages/internal/src/env.ts` suppresses environment logging during OSC detection subprocesses by checking `process.argv` for `--internal-osc-detect`.

1cbca347626e2e8f03b187961781f648eb714602.text: The team cleaned up the internal code to make it easier to read. This change does not affect how the product works.

a3e71a58bee9aed0b92124e99ddbf8061ce7a1b9.text: Fixed a visual glitch where the text on the 'Agent Mode' button looked wrong on Mac computers. The button now displays the correct color when you hover over it.

6e752a5a7060b3a294065aef3948380505d8b463.text: Removed extra layout containers to simplify the interface structure. This internal change does not affect how you use the product.

47e5858bb71893b123e3bef19e6b7fab791f9b5b.text: The app now starts up faster and cleaner behind the scenes. It can also quickly check your screen's color settings without loading everything else, making the experience smoother.

fd4c93b3bfb2e431317665fc6cb87aab12607158.text: The app now checks your computer's settings more carefully to pick the best colors and fonts. This stops the program from getting stuck or showing the wrong look on some computers.

bb254dd891cc2bc69ac23011fd6e8f67a396b5dc.text: The software now sends your messages as one whole piece instead of breaking them into tiny parts. This prevents the system from accidentally applying memory-saving tricks to your text, keeping your chats more accurate.

332f189caff832d937d0c93841979ffc09b27e66.text: The app now hides a specific status message when it automatically checks your screen's capabilities. This keeps the display cleaner and less cluttered during startup.

209b81809c8e3277270343cd139150e6ea9980c0.text: The app now tries a safer way to replace old files if the first attempt fails, especially on Windows. This helps prevent errors when updating the program.

267fadde6c1040b10f172801f22c71887f9357ea.text: The internal system was updated to better connect with the AI service. This means the assistant can now handle more complex requests, like using tools or analyzing images, more reliably.
